requirement_text: If the items are in stock, the system shall display the items; if not, it shall display that the items are out of stock.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to see whether an item is in stock or out of stock, so that I know if I can get it.
technical_task: Display the item when it is in stock and an out-of-stock message when it is not, based on the item's stock status.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item that is in stock, when the item is displayed, then the system shows the item.
Given an item that is not in stock, when the item is displayed, then the system shows that the item is out of stock.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. The two stock outcomes are stated in the requirement.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to create a new task by tapping the "+" icon in the bottom right corner of the screen.
user_story: As a user, I want to create a new task by tapping the "+" icon, so that I can add tasks quickly.
technical_task: Add a "+" icon in the bottom right corner of the screen that starts new task creation when tapped.
acceptance_criteria: Given the screen is displayed, when the user looks at the bottom right corner, then a "+" icon is visible.
Given the "+" icon is visible, when the user taps it, then a new task is created.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The benefit of quick task entry is inferred from the interaction described.

requirement_text: The NE shall start transmitting a sync message using class 2 exchanges once 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, thus enabling inter-NE data exchanges.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.2.3.2) start transmitting a sync message using class 2 exchanges once 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, thus enabling inter-NE data exchanges.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want the NE to start transmitting a sync message once 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, so that inter-NE data exchanges are enabled.
technical_task: Start transmitting the sync message using class 2 exchanges in the NE once 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: Given fewer than 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, when the NE checks its clocks, then it does not start transmitting the sync message.
Given 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, when the NE checks its clocks, then it starts transmitting the sync message using class 2 exchanges.
Given the sync message is being transmitted, when other NEs receive it, then inter-NE data exchanges are enabled.
rationale: Role assumed: network engineer. The condition, message type and outcome come from the requirement.

requirement_text: User's personal information shall be securely stored to prevent identity theft.
user_story: As a user, I want my personal information to be stored securely, so that it cannot be used for identity theft.
technical_task: Store users' personal information using secure storage controls so that it is protected against unauthorized access.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's personal information is saved, when it is stored, then it is stored using secure storage.
Given stored personal information, when someone without authorization tries to access it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The specific security mechanism is not stated, so the task stays at the level of secure storage.

requirement_text: The system shall move the request to the Approval Workflow upon clicking the Approve Button.
user_story: As an approver, I want a request to move to the Approval Workflow when I click the Approve Button, so that approval proceeds.
technical_task: Move the request into the Approval Workflow when the Approve Button is clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request awaiting approval, when the approver clicks the Approve Button, then the request is moved to the Approval Workflow.
Given a request that has not been approved, when no one clicks the Approve Button, then the request is not moved to the Approval Workflow.

requirement_text: System shall offer video editing tools such as trim, cut, crop, merge, copy/duplicate, collage, and looping video clips on the storyboard.
user_story: As a video creator, I want editing tools to trim, cut, crop, merge, duplicate, collage and loop clips on the storyboard, so that I can edit my video.
technical_task: Provide trim, cut, crop, merge, copy/duplicate, collage and looping tools for video clips on the storyboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video clip on the storyboard, when the creator opens the editing tools, then trim, cut, crop, merge, copy/duplicate, collage and looping are available.
Given a clip on the storyboard, when the creator applies one of the tools, then the clip is changed accordingly on the storyboard.
rationale: Role assumed: video creator. The tool list is taken directly from the requirement.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to extract data for public health purposes.
user_story: As a public health officer, I want to extract data from the solution for public health purposes, so that it can support public health work.
technical_task: Provide a data extraction capability in the solution that can export data for public health purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given data held in the solution, when an authorized user requests an extraction for public health purposes, then the data is extracted.
Given a data extraction request, when the extraction completes, then the extracted data is available to the requester.
rationale: Role assumed: public health officer. Which data and format are not specified.

requirement_text: The system shall sense any music playing, create an audio fingerprint, and compare it against the database.
user_story: As a listener, I want the system to recognize music that is playing, so that I can identify it.
technical_task: Capture the audio of any music playing, create an audio fingerprint, and compare it against the database.
acceptance_criteria: Given music is playing, when the system senses it, then the system creates an audio fingerprint.
Given an audio fingerprint, when the system compares it, then the comparison is made against the database.
rationale: Role assumed: listener. The benefit is inferred; the requirement states only the sense, fingerprint and compare steps.

requirement_text: The details of the simulations as well as the data exchange process are set forth in the following.
rationale: The sentence points to details elsewhere and states no behaviour the system must provide.
clarification_questions: Which simulations do the details refer to?
What does "the following" refer to?

requirement_text: The system shall allow indicating external descriptions and versions of objects.
user_story: As a user, I want to indicate external descriptions and versions of objects, so that this information is recorded with each object.
technical_task: Add fields to objects for external descriptions and versions and allow users to enter them.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object, when the user enters an external description, then the description is saved with the object.
Given an object, when the user enters a version, then the version is saved with the object.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What counts as an external description is not defined.

requirement_text: A user (a patient patient representative or LHCP) views the number of unread messages from his or her message inbox.
requirement_text_raw: A user (a patient  patient representative  or LHCP) views the number of unread messages from his or her message inbox.
user_story: As a patient or patient representative, I want to view the number of unread messages in my inbox, so that I know how many messages still need attention.
technical_task: Show the count of unread messages on the message inbox for patients, patient representatives and LHCPs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with unread messages, when the user views the message inbox, then the number of unread messages is shown.
Given a user with no unread messages, when the user views the message inbox, then the unread count shows that there are none.
rationale: The requirement names the user types; the second criterion covers the empty case.

requirement_text: If this parameter is false no internet details will be requested.
rationale: The parameter and the internet details are not identified, so behaviour cannot be specified.
clarification_questions: Which parameter is meant?
What internet details are requested otherwise?

requirement_text: Any makefiles or other automated scripts that support the build, down-load, and flash programming processes shall be delivered with the software to NASA.
requirement_text_raw: Any makefiles or other automated scripts that support the build, down-load, and flash programming processes shall (3.3.7.2) be delivered with the software to NASA.
user_story: As a NASA project owner, I want makefiles and automated scripts for the build, download and flash programming processes delivered with the software, so that I can rebuild and load it myself.
technical_task: Include all makefiles and automated scripts that support the build, download and flash programming processes in the software delivery to NASA.
acceptance_criteria: Given the software delivery package, when it is prepared for NASA, then it contains the makefiles and scripts for the build process.
Given the software delivery package, when it is prepared for NASA, then it contains the scripts for the download and flash programming processes.

requirement_text: The system shall have a simple yet high-quality user interface.
rationale: "Simple" and "high-quality" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes an interface "simple" and "high-quality" here?
How will the quality be judged?

requirement_text: Clear instructions and tooltips shall be provided where necessary to guide users through different features and processes.
user_story: As a user, I want clear instructions and tooltips where I need them, so that I can find my way around the features and processes.
technical_task: Add instructions and tooltips to features and processes where users need guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a feature that needs guidance, when the user opens it, then clear instructions or tooltips are shown.
Given a tooltip is available, when the user points at the related element, then the tooltip is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which places count as "where necessary" is left to design.

requirement_text: The Scheduler in the FTPP shall keep all redundant copies of a process, which are executing in different computers, in synchronization.
requirement_text_raw: The Scheduler in the FTPP shall (3.3.4.16) keep all redundant copies of a process, which are executing in different computers, in synchronization.
user_story: As a system integrator, I want the Scheduler in the FTPP to keep all redundant copies of a process synchronized, so that copies running in different computers stay consistent.
technical_task: Make the FTPP Scheduler keep every redundant copy of a process, executing in different computers, in synchronization.
acceptance_criteria: Given redundant copies of a process executing in different computers, when the Scheduler runs, then the copies are kept in synchronization.
Given a process with redundant copies, when one copy advances, then the other copies stay synchronized with it.

requirement_text: The system shall offer various order fulfillment options (in-store pickup, delivery).
user_story: As a customer, I want to choose between in-store pickup and delivery, so that I can receive my order the way that suits me.
technical_task: Offer in-store pickup and delivery as order fulfillment options in the ordering process.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order being placed, when the customer selects a fulfillment option, then in-store pickup and delivery are offered.
Given the customer selects one option, when the order is confirmed, then the order uses the chosen fulfillment option.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. "Various" is read as the two listed options.

requirement_text: User shall be able to configure application settings according to state requirements.
user_story: As a user, I want to configure application settings according to state requirements, so that the application meets what my state requires.
technical_task: Provide application settings that can be configured to match state requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application settings, when a user opens them, then settings related to state requirements can be configured.
Given a changed setting, when the user saves it, then the application uses the configured value.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The state requirements themselves are not specified.

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to perform online balance checks.
user_story: As a customer, I want to check my balance online, so that I can see how much I have.
technical_task: Provide an online balance check function for users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is signed in, when the user requests a balance check online, then the balance is displayed.
Given a user is not signed in, when the user requests a balance check, then the balance is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The sign-in criterion is an assumption about access, not stated in the requirement.

requirement_text: All functionality must be thoroughly tested through comprehensive test cases.
rationale: "Thoroughly" and "comprehensive" are subjective and no coverage target is given.
clarification_questions: What counts as "thoroughly" and "comprehensive" testing?
Which functionality is in scope, and what coverage is expected?

requirement_text: System shall facilitate the import of EAD data into the application.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to import EAD data into the application, so that I can work with existing descriptions.
technical_task: Implement an import function that reads EAD data into the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file of EAD data, when the user imports it, then the data is available in the application.
Given a file that is not valid EAD data, when the user imports it, then the import is refused with an error message.
rationale: Role assumed: archivist. The error handling criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: The system shall meet the minimum requirements to allow for successful activation of Adobe Illustrator and access to all features.
rationale: The minimum requirements are not stated, so they cannot be tested.
clarification_questions: What are the minimum requirements for activation?
Which features of Adobe Illustrator must be accessible?

requirement_text: User shall be able to see which summits they're signed up for, to confirm attendance.
user_story: As an attendee, I want to see which summits I have signed up for, so that I can confirm my attendance.
technical_task: Show a user the summits they are signed up for, with a way to confirm attendance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user signed up for summits, when the user opens their summits, then the summits they signed up for are listed.
Given a listed summit, when the user confirms attendance, then the confirmation is recorded.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to enter the Module for the exam.
user_story: As a student, I want to enter the Module for the exam, so that I can take the exam.
technical_task: Allow users to enter the Module for the exam.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has access to the exam, when the user opens the Module for the exam, then the user enters the Module.
Given the Module for the exam, when the user selects it, then it opens.
rationale: Role assumed: student. What the Module contains is not described.

requirement_text: VS Code shall be downloadable as a file smaller than 200 MB.
user_story: As a developer, I want VS Code to be downloadable as a file smaller than 200 MB, so that the download is manageable.
technical_task: Package VS Code for download as a single file smaller than 200 MB.
acceptance_criteria: Given the VS Code download, when its file size is checked, then the size is smaller than 200 MB.
Given the download page, when a user downloads VS Code, then it is delivered as a file.
rationale: Role assumed: developer. The size limit of 200 MB is taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: VS Code shall require a full operating system when running in a virtual machine environment.
user_story: As an administrator, I want VS Code to require a full operating system in a virtual machine, so that its runtime needs are clear.
technical_task: Document and enforce that VS Code requires a full operating system when running in a virtual machine environment.
acceptance_criteria: Given a virtual machine environment, when VS Code is installed, then it requires a full operating system.
Given a virtual machine without a full operating system, when VS Code is started, then it does not run.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The second criterion is an interpretation of "shall require".

requirement_text: Second field will be date of task completion.
rationale: The sentence refers to a "second field" without saying where it is, and gives no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which form or screen is this second field on?
What format should the date of task completion have?

requirement_text: An application programming interface shall be documented in a FTSS API document.
requirement_text_raw: An application programming interface shall (3.3.13.3) be documented in a FTSS API document.
user_story: As a developer, I want the application programming interface documented in a FTSS API document, so that I can learn how to use it.
technical_task: Write a FTSS API document that describes the application programming interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS API document, when a developer reads it, then the application programming interface is documented in it.
Given the application programming interface, when it changes, then the FTSS API document is kept consistent with it.
rationale: Role assumed: developer. The second criterion extends the requirement slightly.

requirement_text: Frequently-executed transactions must be completed with minimal interactions.
clarification_questions: How many interactions count as "minimal"?
Which transactions are "frequently executed"?

requirement_text: System shall output request to turn on or off heating or cooling unit based on temperature data.
user_story: As a home occupant, I want the system to request heating or cooling to be switched on or off based on temperature data, so that the temperature is controlled.
technical_task: Output a request to turn the heating or cooling unit on or off based on the temperature data.
acceptance_criteria: Given temperature data, when the system evaluates it, then it outputs a request to turn the heating or cooling unit on or off.
Given the system outputs a request, when the request is sent, then it targets the heating or cooling unit.
rationale: Role assumed: home occupant. The thresholds that trigger a request are not specified.

requirement_text: Upon successful authentication the user will be directed to a personalized home page based on their role.
requirement_text_raw: Upon successful authentication  the user will be directed to a personalized home page based on their role.
user_story: As an authenticated user, I want to be directed to a personalized home page based on my role, so that I see what is relevant to me.
technical_task: After successful authentication, redirect the user to a home page personalized by the user's role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who authenticates successfully, when authentication completes, then the user is directed to a personalized home page.
Given two users with different roles, when each authenticates, then each home page is personalized to that user's role.
rationale: The benefit is inferred from the personalization described.

requirement_text: Employee shall receive quick notifications for prompt action.
rationale: "Quick" and "prompt" are not measurable and the notification trigger is missing.
clarification_questions: What counts as a "quick" notification?
What action is meant by "prompt action"?

requirement_text: Card reader shall be a magnetic stripe reader with Smart card option and include an extra indentation for card polarization.
user_story: As a customer service operator, I want a card reader that is a magnetic stripe reader with a smart card option and an extra indentation for card polarization, so that cards are inserted correctly.
technical_task: Specify a magnetic stripe card reader with a smart card option and an extra indentation for card polarization.
acceptance_criteria: Given the card reader, when it is inspected, then it is a magnetic stripe reader.
Given the card reader, when it is inspected, then it has a smart card option and an extra indentation for card polarization.
rationale: Role assumed: customer service operator. The hardware features come from the requirement.

requirement_text: The CT shall also contain time-outs and vote masks.
requirement_text_raw: The CT shall (3.2.2.2.2) also contain time-outs and vote masks.
rationale: "CT", the time-outs and the vote masks are not explained, and "also" refers to context not provided.
clarification_questions: What does CT stand for?
What are the time-outs and vote masks used for?

requirement_text: The system shall prioritize WiFi connection and automatically switch to mobile network when WiFi is unavailable.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want the system to prefer WiFi and switch to the mobile network when WiFi is unavailable, so that I stay connected.
technical_task: Prioritize the WiFi connection and automatically switch to the mobile network when WiFi is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given WiFi and the mobile network are both available, when the system connects, then it uses WiFi.
Given WiFi becomes unavailable, when the system loses it, then it automatically switches to the mobile network.

requirement_text: All radiation test results shall be characterized and documented.
requirement_text_raw: All radiation test results shall (3.2.3.1.3.3.7) be characterized and documented.
user_story: As a project manager, I want all radiation test results characterized and documented, so that the test outcomes are on record.
technical_task: Characterize and document every radiation test result.
acceptance_criteria: Given a radiation test result, when the test is completed, then the result is characterized.
Given a characterized radiation test result, when the work is finished, then it is documented.

requirement_text: A patient or personal health representative can answer any of the following questions relative to a previous (in UC9 S1) office visit according to Data Format 6.13.
requirement_text_raw: A patient or personal health representative can answer any of the following questions relative to a previous (in UC9  S1) office visit according to Data Format 6.13.
rationale: "The following questions" are not provided and the data format and use case steps are referenced but not described.
clarification_questions: Which questions can the patient or representative answer?
What does Data Format 6.13 specify?

requirement_text: System shall maintain response time under 100 milliseconds for normal workload conditions.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to respond in under 100 milliseconds under normal workload, so that it feels responsive.
technical_task: Keep system response time under 100 milliseconds for normal workload conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a normal workload, when a request is made, then the response time is under 100 milliseconds.
Given a normal workload over a period of use, when response times are measured, then they stay under 100 milliseconds.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What counts as a normal workload is not defined.

requirement_text: System shall analyze emails and categorize them automatically into primary, social, or promotional categories.
user_story: As an email user, I want my emails analyzed and sorted automatically into primary, social or promotional categories, so that I can find important mail easily.
technical_task: Analyze incoming emails and categorize them automatically as primary, social or promotional.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new email, when the system analyzes it, then the email is assigned to primary, social or promotional.
Given categorized emails, when the user opens a category, then it lists the emails assigned to it.

requirement_text: System shall be able to indicate the current day on the calendar.
user_story: As a calendar user, I want the current day to be indicated on the calendar, so that I can see today's date at a glance.
technical_task: Highlight the current day on the calendar view.
acceptance_criteria: Given the calendar is displayed, when the user views the current month, then the current day is indicated.
Given the date changes, when the calendar is displayed on the new day, then the indicator moves to the new day.

requirement_text: The component design shall allow to upgrade in a later design step to larger memory with the same footprint and the same interface without PCB modification.
user_story: As a hardware designer, I want the component design to allow an upgrade to larger memory with the same footprint and interface, so that I can upgrade without changing the board.
technical_task: Design the component so larger memory with the same footprint and the same interface can be fitted later without PCB modification.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component design, when larger memory with the same footprint and interface is fitted in a later design step, then no PCB modification is needed.
Given the larger memory, when it is fitted, then it uses the same interface as the original memory.

requirement_text: The system shall utilize separate databases for cars and customers.
user_story: As a system architect, I want separate databases for cars and customers, so that the two kinds of data are kept apart.
technical_task: Use one database for cars and a separate database for customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given car data, when it is stored, then it is stored in the cars database.
Given customer data, when it is stored, then it is stored in the customers database, separate from car data.
rationale: Role assumed: system architect. The reason for separation is inferred.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to select the option of view incompleted tasks.
user_story: As a user, I want to select the option to view incomplete tasks, so that I can see what is still to be done.
technical_task: Add an option that lets users view only incomplete tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of tasks, when the user selects the option to view incomplete tasks, then only incomplete tasks are shown.
Given the option is selected, when a task is completed, then it is no longer listed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an assumption about how the view updates.

requirement_text: The solution should be able to support time synchronization using NTP or SNTP and use this synchronized time in all security records of time.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should be able to support time synchronization using NTP or SNTP  and use this synchronized time in all security records of time.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want the solution to support time synchronization using NTP or SNTP, so that the time in all security records is consistent.
technical_task: Support time synchronization using NTP or SNTP and use the synchronized time in all security records of time.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NTP or SNTP time source, when the solution synchronizes its clock, then time synchronization is performed.
Given a security record is created, when its time is recorded, then it uses the synchronized time.

requirement_text: Any user who creates or joins a game will be able to upload their own JPEG or GIF image that they wish to have displayed above their name, if they do not wish to use a preset icon.
user_story: As a game player, I want to upload my own JPEG or GIF image to display above my name, so that I don't have to use a preset icon.
technical_task: Allow a user who creates or joins a game to upload a JPEG or GIF image shown above their name, as an alternative to a preset icon.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who creates or joins a game, when the user uploads a JPEG or GIF image, then the image is displayed above the user's name.
Given a user who does not upload an image, when the user chooses a preset icon, then the preset icon is displayed instead.

requirement_text: LMS product shall handle both expected and unexpected errors to prevent loss of information and minimize downtime.
user_story: As a LMS administrator, I want the LMS product to handle expected and unexpected errors, so that information is not lost and downtime is minimized.
technical_task: Handle both expected and unexpected errors in the LMS product in a way that prevents loss of information.
acceptance_criteria: Given an expected error occurs, when the LMS handles it, then no information is lost.
Given an unexpected error occurs, when the LMS handles it, then no information is lost and downtime is kept as short as possible.
rationale: Role assumed: LMS administrator. How much downtime is acceptable is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall provide information on the responsible party for each DMP.
user_story: As a data steward, I want the system to show the responsible party for each DMP, so that I know who is in charge of it.
technical_task: Display the responsible party on each DMP record.
acceptance_criteria: Given a DMP, when a user views it, then the responsible party is shown.
Given two different DMPs with different responsible parties, when each is viewed, then each shows its own responsible party.
rationale: Role assumed: data steward. The term DMP is kept as written.

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes". "Pipes" provide fast data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group when minimal data latency is necessary.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS226] provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes". "Pipes" provide fast data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group when minimal data latency is necessary.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes", so that data moves fast between virtual groups when minimal data latency is necessary.
technical_task: Provide "immediate" message passing services in FTSS as "pipes" for data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group.
acceptance_criteria: Given two virtual groups, when a message is sent through a "pipe", then it is passed between the groups.
Given a "pipe" within one virtual group, when a message is sent through it, then it is passed within that virtual group.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. How fast "fast" is is not specified.

requirement_text: Extensive usage statistics for various categories shall be accessible.
user_story: As a manager, I want to access usage statistics for various categories, so that I can see how the system is used.
technical_task: Provide access to usage statistics grouped by category.
acceptance_criteria: Given usage data has been collected, when a user opens the statistics, then usage statistics are shown for the categories.
Given a category, when a user selects it, then the statistics for that category are displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. The categories are not listed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow editing items in the estimation list.
user_story: As a user, I want to edit items in the estimation list, so that I can correct my estimates.
technical_task: Allow users to edit items in the estimation list.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item in the estimation list, when the user edits it, then the changes are saved.
Given an edited item, when the list is displayed again, then the item shows the new values.

requirement_text: The prototype NE shall reside on a single commercial grade 6U VME board.
requirement_text_raw: The prototype NE shall (3.2.3.1.1.1) reside on a single commercial grade 6U VME board.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the prototype NE to reside on a single commercial grade 6U VME board, so that it is built on standard hardware.
technical_task: Implement the prototype NE on one commercial grade 6U VME board.
acceptance_criteria: Given the prototype NE, when its hardware is inspected, then it resides on a single board.
Given the board, when its specification is checked, then it is a commercial grade 6U VME board.

requirement_text: Fault Tolerant System Services (FTSS) software shall use VxWorks Version 5.4 as the Operating System.
requirement_text_raw: Fault Tolerant System Services (FTSS) software shall (3.3.1.1) use VxWorks Version 5.4 as the Operating System.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS software to use VxWorks Version 5.4 as the Operating System, so that the software runs on a known platform.
technical_task: Build and run the FTSS software on VxWorks Version 5.4 as the Operating System.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS software, when it is built, then it targets VxWorks Version 5.4.
Given the FTSS software is running, when the Operating System is checked, then it is VxWorks Version 5.4.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to browse collections and view object and component details.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to browse collections and view object and component details, so that I can explore what is held.
technical_task: Provide pages to browse collections and view the details of objects and components.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of collections, when the user browses them, then the collections are listed.
Given an object or component, when the user opens it, then its details are shown.

requirement_text: User shall only delete routes that they have added.
user_story: As a user, I want to delete only the routes that I have added, so that I cannot remove other people's routes.
technical_task: Restrict route deletion to the user who added the route.
acceptance_criteria: Given a route added by the user, when the user deletes it, then the route is deleted.
Given a route added by another user, when the user tries to delete it, then the deletion is not allowed.

requirement_text: The connection between the client and server shall have no more than 200ms latency.
user_story: As a user, I want the connection between the client and server to have no more than 200ms latency, so that the application responds promptly.
technical_task: Keep latency between the client and the server at or below 200ms.
acceptance_criteria: Given a client connected to the server, when latency is measured, then it is no more than 200ms.
Given a request from the client, when the server replies, then the round trip does not exceed the 200ms latency limit.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion treats latency as the delay of a request and reply, which is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The NE shall operate with a worst case card edge thermal interface temperature of +65 °C for greater than 10 hours.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.3.1.3.1.2) operate with a worst case card edge thermal interface temperature of +65 °C for greater than 10 hours.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the NE to operate at a worst case card edge thermal interface temperature of +65 °C for greater than 10 hours, so that it keeps working in hot conditions.
technical_task: Verify that the NE operates with a worst case card edge thermal interface temperature of +65 °C for greater than 10 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given the card edge thermal interface is at +65 °C, when the NE runs for greater than 10 hours, then it continues to operate.
Given the NE is tested at the worst case temperature, when the test ends, then the NE has operated throughout the period.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The unit symbol in the source text is garbled and read as degrees Celsius.

requirement_text: Performance requirements The capability of the computer depends on the performance of the software. The software can take any number of inputs provided the database size is larger enough. This would depend on the available memory space.
rationale: The text describes performance in general terms ("any number of inputs", "available memory space") without a testable requirement.
clarification_questions: What performance targets (response time, throughput) are required?
How large is the database and what memory is available?

requirement_text: The event is logged (UC 5 S8) and the HCP is returned in the specific office visit record to verify his or her changes.
requirement_text_raw: The event is logged (UC 5  S8) and the HCP is returned in the specific office visit record to verify his or her changes.
user_story: As an HCP, I want the event to be logged and the specific office visit record to show my changes, so that I can verify them.
technical_task: Log the event and return the HCP to the specific office visit record so the HCP can verify the changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an HCP has made changes, when the changes are saved, then the event is logged.
Given the event has been logged, when the HCP is returned to the office visit record, then the HCP can see the changes to verify them.
rationale: The reference to (UC 5 S8) is context only; the behaviour is the logging and the return to the record.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to use digital signatures as the means for attestation.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to use digital signatures for attestation, so that attestations are signed.
technical_task: Support digital signatures as the means of attestation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a record that needs attestation, when the user attests it, then a digital signature is applied.
Given an attested record, when it is viewed, then it shows that it was attested with a digital signature.

requirement_text: System shall comply with relevant privacy regulations and standards to safeguard user privacy and data security.
rationale: "Relevant" regulations and standards are not named, so compliance cannot be tested.
clarification_questions: Which privacy regulations and standards apply?
How is compliance to be verified?

requirement_text: This decision shall be made based on the health and status of all the physical links from the FCP to the CTC.
requirement_text_raw: This decision shall (3.4.2.7) be made based on the health and status of all the physical links from the FCP to the CTC.
user_story: As a system operator, I want the decision to be based on the health and status of all physical links from the FCP to the CTC, so that decisions reflect the state of the links.
technical_task: Base the decision on the health and status of all the physical links from the FCP to the CTC.
acceptance_criteria: Given the physical links from the FCP to the CTC, when the decision is made, then the health and status of all of them is considered.
Given one physical link has a poor status, when the decision is made, then that status is taken into account.
rationale: Role assumed: system operator. The decision itself is not described in this sentence.

requirement_text: User shall be able to log in to Gmail using their email id and password.
user_story: As a Gmail user, I want to log in with my email id and password, so that I can access my account.
technical_task: Implement login to Gmail using an email id and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered email id and its password, when the user logs in, then the user is signed in.
Given a wrong password, when the user tries to log in, then the login is refused.

requirement_text: System shall ensure data security and privacy by encrypting emails and implementing robust authentication mechanisms.
user_story: As an email user, I want my emails encrypted and protected by authentication mechanisms, so that my data stays private and secure.
technical_task: Encrypt emails and implement authentication mechanisms for access.
acceptance_criteria: Given an email, when it is stored or sent, then it is encrypted.
Given a user who is not authenticated, when the user tries to access emails, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: email user. "Robust" is not measurable, so the criteria cover only encryption and authentication.

requirement_text: Users will be able to turn the sound on or off at any stage during the game.
user_story: As a player, I want to turn the sound on or off at any stage of the game, so that I can control the audio.
technical_task: Provide a control to switch game sound on or off during any stage of the game.
acceptance_criteria: Given a game in progress, when the player turns the sound off, then the sound stops.
Given the sound is off, when the player turns it on at any stage, then the sound plays again.

requirement_text: System shall be able to display an enlarged version of the main site image when the user clicks on it on the sites page.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to click the main site image on the sites page to see an enlarged version, so that I can see it in more detail.
technical_task: Display an enlarged version of the main site image when the user clicks it on the sites page.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sites page, when the user clicks the main site image, then an enlarged version of the image is displayed.
Given an enlarged image is shown, when the user closes it, then the sites page is shown again.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. The closing behaviour is an assumption.

requirement_text: On each FCP, the FTPP system shall configure the Radstone firmware to perform the IBIT tests shown in Table 3.3.2.1, FCP IBIT Table.
requirement_text_raw: On each FCP, the FTPP system shall (3.3.2.26) configure the Radstone firmware to perform the IBIT tests shown in Table 3.3.2.1, FCP IBIT Table.
user_story: As a system integrator, I want the FTPP system to configure the Radstone firmware on each FCP to perform the IBIT tests, so that the tests in Table 3.3.2.1 are run.
technical_task: Configure the Radstone firmware on each FCP so it performs the IBIT tests listed in Table 3.3.2.1, FCP IBIT Table.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP, when the FTPP system configures it, then the Radstone firmware is set to perform the IBIT tests.
Given the IBIT tests are configured, when they are compared with Table 3.3.2.1, then they are the tests shown in that table.
rationale: Role assumed: system integrator. The contents of the table are not given.

requirement_text: The LHCP chooses to view a report of all patients of a single or either gender in a specified age range with none one or more diagnoses.
requirement_text_raw: The LHCP chooses to view a report of all patients of a single or either gender  in a specified age range   with none  one  or more diagnoses.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view a report of patients of a chosen gender within a specified age range and with zero or more diagnoses, so that I can review a patient group.
technical_task: Generate a report of patients filtered by gender (single or either), a specified age range and any number of diagnoses.
acceptance_criteria: Given the report options, when the LHCP selects a gender, an age range and diagnoses, then the report lists patients matching the selection.
Given the LHCP selects either gender, when the report is run, then patients of both genders are included.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. "None one or more diagnoses" is read as zero, one or more diagnoses.

requirement_text: User shall be able to use only well-visible buttons.
clarification_questions: What makes a button "well-visible"?
Should the visibility be judged against a contrast or size criterion?

requirement_text: User shall have ALFRED preinstalled, eliminating the need for manual setup.
user_story: As a user, I want ALFRED to be preinstalled, so that I don't need to set it up manually.
technical_task: Deliver the system with ALFRED already installed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user receives the system, when it is first used, then ALFRED is already installed.
Given the delivered system, when the user starts it, then no manual setup of ALFRED is required.

requirement_text: The system should efficiently handle medium-sized information databases without significant performance degradation.
clarification_questions: How large is a "medium-sized" information database?
What counts as "significant" performance degradation?

requirement_text: User shall navigate back to the previous screen using the back button located in the top left corner of every screen except the Homepage.
user_story: As a user, I want a back button in the top left corner of every screen except the Homepage, so that I can return to the previous screen.
technical_task: Add a back button in the top left corner of every screen except the Homepage that navigates to the previous screen.
acceptance_criteria: Given any screen other than the Homepage, when the user views it, then a back button is shown in the top left corner.
Given the back button is shown, when the user selects it, then the previous screen is displayed.
Given the Homepage, when the user views it, then no back button is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to use the system without experiencing any faults, even with a high number of items and users.
rationale: "Any faults" and "a high number" are not quantified, so the requirement cannot be tested.
clarification_questions: How many items and users count as "a high number"?
What fault rate, if any, is acceptable?

requirement_text: Clicking 'Edit' next to one of these sections will present you with this patient's issues list for that category.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to click Edit next to a section to see the patient's issues list for that category, so that I can review the issues.
technical_task: Show the patient's issues list for a category when the user clicks Edit next to that section.
acceptance_criteria: Given a section of the patient record, when the user clicks Edit next to it, then the patient's issues list for that category is shown.
Given the issues list is shown, when the user views it, then it contains only the issues for the selected category.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The second criterion follows from "for that category".

requirement_text: The system shall render complex projects faster with a compatible graphics card.
user_story: As a designer, I want complex projects to render faster with a compatible graphics card, so that I spend less time waiting.
technical_task: Use a compatible graphics card to speed up rendering of complex projects.
acceptance_criteria: Given a complex project and a compatible graphics card, when the project is rendered, then rendering uses the graphics card.
Given the same project with and without a compatible graphics card, when both are rendered, then the render with the card is faster.
rationale: Role assumed: designer. "Faster" is relative; no time target is given.

requirement_text: The system shall be configurable to prevent corruption or loss of data already accepted into the system in the event of a system failure (e.g. integrating with a UPS etc.).
requirement_text_raw: The system shall be configurable to prevent corruption or loss of data already accepted into the system in the event of a system failure (e.g. integrating with a UPS  etc.).
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the system to be configurable to prevent corruption or loss of accepted data in a system failure, so that data stays safe.
technical_task: Make the system configurable so data already accepted is protected from corruption or loss in the event of a system failure, for example by integrating with a UPS.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system configured for failure protection, when a system failure occurs, then data already accepted into the system is not corrupted.
Given the same configuration, when a system failure occurs, then data already accepted into the system is not lost.
rationale: Role assumed: system administrator. The UPS is given only as an example.

requirement_text: User shall view and select available examination categories.
user_story: As a candidate, I want to view and select available examination categories, so that I can choose my exam.
technical_task: Display the available examination categories and let the user select one.
acceptance_criteria: Given available examination categories, when the user opens the examination page, then the categories are listed.
Given the list of categories, when the user selects one, then that category is chosen.

requirement_text: FTSS shall only allow a single task residing on each specified virtual group to "open" the respective end of the pipe.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS230] only allow a single task residing on each specified virtual group to "open" the respective end of the pipe.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to allow only a single task on each specified virtual group to open its end of a pipe, so that pipe ends have one owner.
technical_task: Allow only one task residing on a specified virtual group to open the respective end of the pipe.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pipe end in a specified virtual group, when a single task opens it, then the open succeeds.
Given a pipe end already opened by a task in that virtual group, when a second task tries to open the same end, then the open is not allowed.

requirement_text: The Clinical Task Assignment & Routing capability should provide non-repudiation requirements (IN 1.5) that guarantees that the sources and receivers of data cannot deny that they entered or sent or received the data.
user_story: As a clinician, I want sources and receivers of data not to be able to deny entering, sending or receiving it, so that data exchange can be trusted.
technical_task: Provide non-repudiation (IN 1.5) in the Clinical Task Assignment & Routing capability for entering, sending and receiving data.
acceptance_criteria: Given data is entered or sent, when the action completes, then a record shows the source cannot deny it.
Given data is received, when the receipt completes, then a record shows the receiver cannot deny it.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The mechanism for non-repudiation is not stated.

requirement_text: The FTSS API shall specify a memory map that provides the boundaries for congruent aligned memory, congruent initialized memory, and non-congruent memory.
requirement_text_raw: 2.     The FTSS API shall [SRS217] specify a memory map that provides the boundaries for congruent aligned memory, congruent initialized memory, and non-congruent memory.
user_story: As a software developer, I want the FTSS API to specify a memory map, so that I know the boundaries of congruent aligned, congruent initialized and non-congruent memory.
technical_task: Specify in the FTSS API a memory map giving the boundaries for congruent aligned memory, congruent initialized memory and non-congruent memory.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS API specification, when a developer reads it, then it contains a memory map.
Given the memory map, when a developer reads it, then it gives the boundaries for congruent aligned, congruent initialized and non-congruent memory.

requirement_text: System shall never include unauthorized records in search results.
user_story: As a user, I want search results never to include unauthorized records, so that I only see what I may access.
technical_task: Filter search results by the user's authorization so unauthorized records are excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Given records the user is not authorized to see, when the user searches, then those records are not in the results.
Given records the user is authorized to see, when the user searches, then matching records are in the results.

requirement_text: To add one of these clearinghouses click on 'X12 Partners' and then click the 'Add New Partner' button.
requirement_text_raw: To add one of these clearinghouses  click on 'X12 Partners' and then click the 'Add New Partner' button.
rationale: The sentence reads as help text for using the screen; it states no system behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a user instruction?
What must the system do when a partner is added?

requirement_text: The solution should require that the new prescription label be barcode-checked before the product can be dispensed.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want the new prescription label to be barcode-checked before the product is dispensed, so that the right product goes out.
technical_task: Require a barcode check of the new prescription label before a product can be dispensed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new prescription label that has not been barcode-checked, when dispensing is attempted, then it is not allowed.
Given a new prescription label that has been barcode-checked, when dispensing is attempted, then it is allowed.

requirement_text: The solution should conform to Auditable Records to audit all changes to privilege rules.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want all changes to privilege rules audited, so that changes can be traced.
technical_task: Record an auditable entry for every change to privilege rules, conforming to Auditable Records.
acceptance_criteria: Given a privilege rule, when it is changed, then an auditable record of the change is created.
Given the audit records, when a reviewer opens them, then the changes to privilege rules can be found.

requirement_text: All computers within the CMCS system shall have the ability for authorized users to directly access individual systems for maintenance and monitoring through remote logins.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want authorized users to log in remotely to individual CMCS computers, so that I can maintain and monitor them.
technical_task: Enable remote logins for authorized users to directly access individual CMCS computers for maintenance and monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user logs in remotely to a CMCS computer, then the user can access that computer.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries a remote login, then access is refused.

requirement_text: System shall ensure data security and compliance with relevant regulations and standards.
rationale: The regulations and standards are not named, so compliance cannot be tested.
clarification_questions: Which regulations and standards apply?
What data security measures are expected?

requirement_text: User shall be able to initiate the investigation process for registered complaints.
user_story: As an officer, I want to start the investigation process for a registered complaint, so that the complaint is investigated.
technical_task: Allow users to initiate the investigation process for registered complaints.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered complaint, when the user initiates the investigation process, then the investigation starts.
Given a complaint that is not registered, when the user tries to initiate an investigation, then the investigation does not start.
rationale: Role assumed: officer. The second criterion follows from "registered".

requirement_text: The product shall make the users want to use it. 80% of the users surveyed report they are regularly using the product after the first 2 weeks post-launch.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall make the users want to use it. 80\% of the users surveyed report they are regularly using the product after the first 2 weeks post-launch.'
user_story: As a product owner, I want 80% of surveyed users to report regularly using the product after the first 2 weeks post-launch, so that the product is engaging.
technical_task: Run a survey of users after the first 2 weeks post-launch and check that 80% report regularly using the product.
acceptance_criteria: Given users surveyed after the first 2 weeks post-launch, when the results are counted, then 80% report regularly using the product.
Given the survey results, when fewer than 80% report regular use, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: product owner. The sample size is not given.

requirement_text: The SQL database must have scalable capacity.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want the SQL database to have scalable capacity, so that it can grow with the data.
technical_task: Configure the SQL database so its capacity can be scaled.
acceptance_criteria: Given the SQL database is running, when more capacity is needed, then the capacity can be increased.
Given capacity is increased, when the database is used, then existing data remains available.
rationale: Role assumed: database administrator. The scale target is not given.

requirement_text: System shall secure in-app purchases via encryption and use a reliable payment gateway.
user_story: As a customer, I want in-app purchases to be secured by encryption through a reliable payment gateway, so that my payment is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt in-app purchases and process them through a reliable payment gateway.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer makes an in-app purchase, when payment details are sent, then they are encrypted.
Given an in-app purchase, when the payment is processed, then it goes through the payment gateway.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. "Reliable" is not measurable.

requirement_text: You may click on an issue in the list at any time to edit it.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to click an issue in the list at any time to edit it, so that I can keep the list current.
technical_task: Allow any issue in the list to be opened for editing by clicking it at any time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of issues, when the user clicks an issue, then the issue opens for editing.
Given an issue being edited, when the user saves it, then the updated issue appears in the list.

requirement_text: The system shall display "video not found" if the requested video is not available.
user_story: As a viewer, I want to see "video not found" when the requested video is unavailable, so that I know why nothing plays.
technical_task: Display the message "video not found" when the requested video is not available.
acceptance_criteria: Given a requested video that is not available, when the user requests it, then "video not found" is displayed.
Given a requested video that is available, when the user requests it, then "video not found" is not displayed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to navigate through the CCTNS application.
user_story: As a police officer, I want to navigate through the CCTNS application, so that I can reach the functions I need.
technical_task: Provide navigation through the CCTNS application.
acceptance_criteria: Given the CCTNS application is open, when the user selects a navigation item, then the related page is displayed.
Given a page in the application, when the user navigates to another, then the user can return to the first page.
rationale: Role assumed: police officer. The pages and functions are not listed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow applicants to satisfy hearing requirements before a hearing.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to satisfy hearing requirements before a hearing, so that I am ready for the hearing.
technical_task: Allow applicants to complete the hearing requirements before the hearing date.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scheduled hearing, when the applicant completes the hearing requirements before the hearing, then the requirements are recorded as satisfied.
Given an applicant who has not completed the requirements, when the hearing is reviewed, then the unmet requirements are shown.
rationale: Role stated: applicant. The hearing requirements themselves are not described.

requirement_text: A server shall host the Swiggy App and provide system data processing and storage capability.
user_story: As a product owner, I want a server to host the Swiggy App and provide data processing and storage, so that the app has a backend.
technical_task: Provision a server that hosts the Swiggy App and provides system data processing and storage.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Swiggy App, when it is deployed, then it is hosted on a server.
Given data from the app, when it is processed and stored, then the server provides the processing and storage capability.

requirement_text: System shall have a contractual agreement with an internet service provider for T3 access with 99.9999% availability.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want a contractual agreement with an internet service provider for T3 access with 99.9999% availability, so that connectivity is covered.
technical_task: Obtain a contractual agreement with an internet service provider for T3 access with 99.9999% availability.
acceptance_criteria: Given the service provider contract, when it is reviewed, then it covers T3 access.
Given the service provider contract, when its availability terms are reviewed, then they state 99.9999% availability.

requirement_text: System design shall prioritize modularity to facilitate efficient maintenance.
user_story: As a maintenance engineer, I want the system designed to be modular, so that maintenance is efficient.
technical_task: Structure the system design into modules so that each part can be maintained separately.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system design, when it is reviewed, then it is divided into modules.
Given a change to one module, when it is made, then other modules need little or no change.
rationale: Role assumed: maintenance engineer. "Efficient" is not measured; the criteria look at module structure.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to handle large and complex spreadsheets without significant performance degradation.
clarification_questions: What size counts as "large" and "complex" for a spreadsheet?
What amount of slowdown is "significant"?

requirement_text: System shall facilitate smooth registration for summits.
rationale: "Smooth" is subjective and no registration behaviour is described.
clarification_questions: What does "smooth" mean for summit registration?
Which steps should be included?

requirement_text: The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'
user_story: As a data steward, I want basic data integrity checking, so that incorrect or invalid data is less likely to be introduced.
technical_task: Add basic integrity checks that reject incorrect or invalid data on entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given invalid data is entered, when the system checks it, then the data is not accepted.
Given valid data is entered, when the system checks it, then the data is accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: data steward. "Basic" checks are not listed.

requirement_text: Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.
requirement_text_raw: Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds  unless noted by an exception below.'
user_story: As a user, I want any interface between me and the automated system to respond within 5 seconds, so that I am not kept waiting, except where an exception is noted.
technical_task: Enforce a maximum response time of 5 seconds on every user interface to the automated system, except where an exception is noted.
acceptance_criteria: Given an interface between a user and the automated system, when the user makes a request, then the response arrives within 5 seconds.
Given an interface with a noted exception, when the user makes a request, then the response time stated in the exception applies instead of 5 seconds.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The exceptions are said to be noted elsewhere and are not listed here.

requirement_text: The depth of the component shall be smaller than 20 millimetres.
user_story: As a hardware designer, I want the depth of the component to be smaller than 20 millimetres, so that it fits the available space.
technical_task: Design the component with a depth smaller than 20 millimetres.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component, when its depth is measured, then it is smaller than 20 millimetres.
Given a component whose depth is 20 millimetres or more, when it is checked against the requirement, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware designer. The reason for the limit is inferred.

requirement_text: An HCP can add commentary to a pending lab procedure .
user_story: As an HCP, I want to add commentary to a pending lab procedure, so that my notes are attached to it.
technical_task: Allow an HCP to add commentary to a lab procedure that is pending.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pending lab procedure, when an HCP adds commentary, then the commentary is saved with the procedure.
Given a lab procedure that is no longer pending, when an HCP tries to add commentary, then the commentary is not added.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to define context based on legal requirements or disaster conditions.
user_story: As an emergency coordinator, I want to define context based on legal requirements or disaster conditions, so that the solution behaves appropriately in those situations.
technical_task: Provide a way to define context based on legal requirements or disaster conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a legal requirement, when the user defines a context based on it, then the context is saved.
Given disaster conditions, when the user defines a context based on them, then the context is saved.
rationale: Role assumed: emergency coordinator. What the context affects is not stated.

requirement_text: Superuser shall view users' stats to monitor website usage.
user_story: As a superuser, I want to view users' stats, so that I can monitor website usage.
technical_task: Show users' stats to the superuser for monitoring website usage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a superuser, when the superuser opens the users' stats, then the stats are shown.
Given a user who is not a superuser, when the user tries to open the stats, then access is not granted.
rationale: Role stated: superuser. The second criterion follows from "Superuser shall".

requirement_text: Encryption shall be employed by the system for all privacy-sensitive data stored on the server.
user_story: As a user, I want all privacy-sensitive data stored on the server to be encrypted, so that my private data stays protected.
technical_task: Encrypt all privacy-sensitive data stored on the server.
acceptance_criteria: Given privacy-sensitive data, when it is stored on the server, then it is encrypted.
Given encrypted stored data, when it is read without decryption, then it is not readable.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The encryption algorithm is not specified.

requirement_text: Set the test level Ucal1 between DUT port A and DUT port B with the closed loop method.
rationale: The sentence is a test instruction that uses terms not defined in the text.
clarification_questions: What do Ucal1, DUT port A and DUT port B refer to?
What is the closed loop method, and who performs this test?

requirement_text: As an option the contractor shall present concepts with smaller batteries and other different power supplies.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor to present concepts with smaller batteries and other different power supplies as an option, so that I can consider alternatives.
technical_task: Prepare and present optional concepts that use smaller batteries and other different power supplies.
acceptance_criteria: Given the contractor's concepts, when they are presented, then an option with smaller batteries is included.
Given the contractor's concepts, when they are presented, then an option with other different power supplies is included.
rationale: Role assumed: client. "Smaller" is relative to a baseline that is not given.

requirement_text: System shall identify each thermostat using unique identifiers.
user_story: As a homeowner, I want each thermostat to be identified by a unique identifier, so that I can tell them apart.
technical_task: Assign every thermostat a unique identifier and use it to identify the thermostat.
acceptance_criteria: Given a thermostat added to the system, when it is registered, then it receives an identifier.
Given two thermostats, when their identifiers are compared, then they are different.

requirement_text: The system shall encrypt sensitive data before sending it over insecure connections like the internet.
user_story: As a user, I want sensitive data encrypted before it is sent over insecure connections such as the internet, so that others cannot read it.
technical_task: Encrypt sensitive data before sending it over insecure connections like the internet.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data to be sent over the internet, when it is sent, then it is encrypted first.
Given data sent over an insecure connection, when it is intercepted, then it cannot be read in plain form.

requirement_text: Administrator shall have authority to set rules, regulations, and policies.
user_story: As an administrator, I want authority to set rules, regulations and policies, so that I can govern how the system is used.
technical_task: Give administrators the ability to create and set rules, regulations and policies.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator sets a rule, regulation or policy, then it is saved.
Given a user who is not an administrator, when the user tries to set a policy, then the action is not allowed.
rationale: Role stated: administrator. The second criterion follows from "Administrator shall have authority".

requirement_text: System shall maintain the book status as Rejected/Canceled if the administrator rejects the requested book.
user_story: As a library user, I want the book status to remain Rejected/Canceled when the administrator rejects my request, so that I can see my request was declined.
technical_task: Keep the book status as Rejected/Canceled when the administrator rejects the requested book.
acceptance_criteria: Given a requested book, when the administrator rejects the request, then the book status is Rejected/Canceled.
Given a rejected request, when the user views the book status, then it still shows Rejected/Canceled.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall configure each ICP to perform IBIT Minimum Processing Environment (MPE) Tests, Power-up Tests, and Initial BIT on each ICP, as shown inTable 3.2-3.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS287] configure each ICP to perform IBIT Minimum Processing Environment (MPE) Tests, Power-up Tests, and Initial BIT on each ICP, as shown inTable 3.2-3.
user_story: As a system integrator, I want the FTSS to configure each ICP to perform the MPE Tests, Power-up Tests and Initial BIT, so that the ICPs are tested as shown in Table 3.2-3.
technical_task: Configure each ICP to perform IBIT Minimum Processing Environment (MPE) Tests, Power-up Tests and Initial BIT, as shown in Table 3.2-3.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ICP, when the FTSS configures it, then it is set to perform the MPE Tests, Power-up Tests and Initial BIT.
Given the configured tests, when they are compared with Table 3.2-3, then they match the table.
rationale: Role assumed: system integrator. The table contents are not given.

requirement_text: The solution should have a standard interface to a send required medication data to a variety of EHR's or CDR for access by clinicians involved in the inmate’s care.
user_story: As a clinician, I want a standard interface to send required medication data to a variety of EHRs or CDRs, so that clinicians caring for an inmate can access it.
technical_task: Provide a standard interface that sends required medication data to a variety of EHRs or CDRs for access by the clinicians involved in the inmate's care.
acceptance_criteria: Given required medication data, when it is sent through the standard interface, then it reaches an EHR or CDR.
Given medication data in an EHR or CDR, when a clinician involved in the inmate's care opens it, then the clinician can access the data.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. EHR and CDR are kept as written.

requirement_text: Select 'History' at the top of the page to view a summary of the patients Medical History and Lifestyle information.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to select History at the top of the page to see a summary of the patient's Medical History and Lifestyle information, so that I can review the patient's background.
technical_task: Add a History option at the top of the page that shows a summary of the patient's Medical History and Lifestyle information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient page, when the clinician selects History at the top, then a summary of the patient's Medical History and Lifestyle information is shown.
Given the summary is shown, when the clinician reads it, then it contains Medical History and Lifestyle information.

requirement_text: The FTPP spare hardware shall include one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set (5 NEs) and three (3) individual NEs including all optical connects, cables, and required accessories which are flight certified to meet the requirements specified herein for the X-38 space flight vehicles.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP spare hardware shall (3.1.28) include one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set (5 NEs) and three (3) individual NEs including all optical connects, cables, and required accessories which are flight certified to meet the requirements specified herein for the X-38 space flight vehicles.
user_story: As a mission manager, I want the FTPP spare hardware to include one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set (5 NEs) and three (3) individual NEs with all accessories, so that spares are ready for the X-38 flights.
technical_task: Supply FTPP spare hardware consisting of one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set (5 NEs) and three (3) individual NEs, including all optical connects, cables and required accessories, flight certified for the X-38 space flight vehicles.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTPP spare hardware, when it is inventoried, then it includes one (1) radiation hardened FTPP set of 5 NEs.
Given the FTPP spare hardware, when it is inventoried, then it includes three (3) individual NEs with all optical connects, cables and required accessories.
Given the spare hardware, when its certification is checked, then it is flight certified to meet the requirements for the X-38 space flight vehicles.

requirement_text: The Test Manager shall be familiar with the details of the progress and results of the tests over all integration levels and answer to the client on these issues.
rationale: "Familiar with the details" is a personal attribute that cannot be tested as stated.
clarification_questions: What level of familiarity counts as "familiar with the details"?
How is the Test Manager's reporting to the client verified?

requirement_text: The solution should use notification message provides appropriate privacy and security notices (based on associated privacy and security policies or summaries) and remains on the screen until the user takes explicit actions to log on to the information solution.
user_story: As a user, I want a notification message with privacy and security notices to stay on the screen until I explicitly log on, so that I have seen the notices before using the solution.
technical_task: Show a notification message with the appropriate privacy and security notices that remains on screen until the user takes an explicit action to log on.
acceptance_criteria: Given the log-on screen, when it is displayed, then a notification message with privacy and security notices is shown.
Given the notification message is shown, when the user has not taken an explicit action to log on, then the message stays on the screen.
Given the notification message is shown, when the user takes an explicit action to log on, then the message may be dismissed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which policies the notices are based on is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall be able to complete transactions, including managing the shopping cart.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to complete transactions, including managing the shopping cart, so that I can buy what I need.
technical_task: Support completing transactions, including managing the shopping cart.
acceptance_criteria: Given items in the shopping cart, when the user manages the cart, then the items can be changed.
Given a cart, when the user completes the transaction, then the transaction is completed.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to customize the layout and appearance of their Gmail inbox.
user_story: As a Gmail user, I want to customize the layout and appearance of my inbox, so that it looks the way I prefer.
technical_task: Provide options to customize the layout and appearance of the Gmail inbox.
acceptance_criteria: Given the inbox, when the user changes a layout option, then the inbox layout is updated.
Given the inbox, when the user changes an appearance option, then the inbox appearance is updated.

requirement_text: User shall be able to create an account to access additional features and create their own profile.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to create an account, so that I can access additional features and have my own profile.
technical_task: Allow users to create an account that unlocks additional features and a personal profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor without an account, when the visitor creates an account, then the account is created.
Given a signed-in account holder, when the user opens their profile, then their own profile is shown with the additional features available.

requirement_text: The database backup shall be continuously maintained and updated for reliability.
rationale: "Continuously" and "for reliability" are not defined enough to test.
clarification_questions: What does "continuously" mean: real time or a fixed interval?
What reliability target should the backup support?

requirement_text: System shall require authorization for project admins before they can access the admin interface to manage project sites.
user_story: As a project admin, I want to be required to get authorization before accessing the admin interface, so that only authorized admins manage project sites.
technical_task: Require authorization for project admins before they can access the admin interface for managing project sites.
acceptance_criteria: Given a project admin who is authorized, when the admin opens the admin interface, then access is granted.
Given a project admin who is not authorized, when the admin opens the admin interface, then access is denied.

requirement_text: Filtering options by date, instrument, or trade type shall be available.
user_story: As a trader, I want filtering options by date, instrument or trade type, so that I can find the trades I need.
technical_task: Provide filters by date, instrument and trade type.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of items, when the user filters by date, then only items matching the date are shown.
Given a list of items, when the user filters by instrument or trade type, then only matching items are shown.
