requirement_text: The product shall provide Monitoring Services.
rationale: "Monitoring Services" are named without any described behaviour.
clarification_questions: What do the Monitoring Services monitor?
What outputs or alerts must they provide?

requirement_text: System shall maintain database availability through failover mechanisms in case of server failures.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want the database to stay available through failover mechanisms when a server fails, so that service continues.
technical_task: Implement failover mechanisms that keep the database available in case of server failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given a running database, when a server fails, then the failover mechanism keeps the database available.
Given a failover has happened, when users access the database, then they can still read and write data.

requirement_text: The system shall allow any authorized university group member to add assets to the inventory.
user_story: As a university group member, I want to add assets to the inventory, so that the inventory stays up to date.
technical_task: Allow any authorized university group member to add assets to the inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized university group member, when the member adds an asset, then it is added to the inventory.
Given a user who is not an authorized group member, when the user tries to add an asset, then it is not added.
rationale: Role stated: authorized university group member.

requirement_text: System shall ensure availability by implementing precautions against server failures, such as checkpoints and regular backups, to maintain a stable state for users.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to be protected against server failures with checkpoints and regular backups, so that it stays in a stable state for me.
technical_task: Implement precautions against server failures, such as checkpoints and regular backups, to maintain a stable state.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is running, when checkpoints are taken, then the system state can be restored from them.
Given regular backups are made, when a server failure occurs, then the system returns to a stable state.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How often backups run is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to include new members in the network through simple administrative tasks.
clarification_questions: What counts as a "simple" administrative task?
How many steps or how much time may adding a member take?

requirement_text: Selecting Configure Diagnostics from the File menu shall open the configuration window modally, making it the active window in front of the main window.
user_story: As a user, I want Configure Diagnostics in the File menu to open the configuration window modally in front of the main window, so that I finish configuring before returning.
technical_task: Open the configuration window modally as the active window in front of the main window when Configure Diagnostics is selected from the File menu.
acceptance_criteria: Given the File menu, when the user selects Configure Diagnostics, then the configuration window opens.
Given the configuration window is open, when the user looks at the screen, then it is modal and the active window in front of the main window.

requirement_text: User shall be able to view the operating hours of each recycling facility.
user_story: As a resident, I want to view the operating hours of each recycling facility, so that I know when I can visit.
technical_task: Display the operating hours for each recycling facility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a recycling facility, when the user views it, then its operating hours are shown.
Given several recycling facilities, when the user views each, then each shows its own operating hours.

requirement_text: System shall redo the transaction if the withdrawal amount exceeds allowed limits.
user_story: As a bank customer, I want the transaction to be redone when my withdrawal amount exceeds allowed limits, so that I can correct the amount.
technical_task: Redo the transaction when the withdrawal amount exceeds allowed limits.
acceptance_criteria: Given a withdrawal amount that exceeds allowed limits, when the customer submits it, then the transaction is redone.
Given a withdrawal amount within the allowed limits, when the customer submits it, then the transaction is not redone.
rationale: Role assumed: bank customer. What "redo" involves exactly is not described.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to configure and operate a TCP/IP server.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want to configure and operate a TCP/IP server, so that I can provide network services.
technical_task: Provide configuration and operation of a TCP/IP server.
acceptance_criteria: Given the TCP/IP server settings, when the user configures the server, then the configuration is saved.
Given a configured TCP/IP server, when the user starts it, then it operates.

requirement_text: All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.
requirement_text_raw: All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'
user_story: As a new user, I want to be able to use the system after one day of training, so that I can start working soon.
technical_task: Design the system and training so that all users can use the system after one day of training.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has completed one day of training, when the user performs the main tasks, then the user can use the system.
Given all users trained for one day, when they use the system, then each of them can use it.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. "Use the system" is not defined, so the tasks tested are an interpretation.

requirement_text: The list of available follow up actions for a given dispute case must be filtered by the status of the case and the access level of the user.
user_story: As a case handler, I want the follow-up actions for a dispute case to be filtered by the case status and my access level, so that I only see actions I may take.
technical_task: Filter the list of available follow-up actions for a dispute case by the status of the case and the access level of the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dispute case with a given status, when the list of follow-up actions is shown, then only actions available for that status are listed.
Given a user with a given access level, when the list of follow-up actions is shown, then only actions allowed for that access level are listed.

requirement_text: Therefore the RCU doesn't need a special fixation concept.
rationale: The sentence states a conclusion about the design rather than a behaviour, and depends on context not provided.
clarification_questions: What does "special fixation concept" refer to?
What must the RCU provide instead?

requirement_text: For each mission mode, the congruent and non-congruent memory boundaries shall be known and fixed.
requirement_text_raw: For each mission mode, the congruent and non-congruent memory boundaries shall (3.3.8.1) be known and fixed.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the congruent and non-congruent memory boundaries to be known and fixed for each mission mode, so that memory layout is predictable.
technical_task: Define fixed congruent and non-congruent memory boundaries for each mission mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mission mode, when its memory boundaries are examined, then the congruent and non-congruent boundaries are known.
Given a mission mode, when the system runs in it, then the boundaries do not change.

requirement_text: Intentional powering down of an FCP, ICP, or NE shall not be classified as a fault.
requirement_text_raw: Intentional powering down of an FCP, ICP, or NE shall (3.3.5.32) not be classified as a fault.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want intentional powering down of an FCP, ICP or NE not to be classified as a fault, so that fault reports are accurate.
technical_task: Exclude intentional power-down of an FCP, ICP or NE from fault classification.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP, ICP or NE is powered down intentionally, when the system classifies the event, then it is not classified as a fault.
Given an FCP, ICP or NE stops without being powered down intentionally, when the system classifies the event, then it can be classified as a fault.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall configure the FCP to act as the Radstone IBIT master, with the exception that the ICP on the NEFU is the master.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall [SRS237] configure the FCP to act as the Radstone IBIT master, with the exception that the ICP on the NEFU is the master.
user_story: As a system integrator, I want the FTSS software to configure the FCP as the Radstone IBIT master, except that the ICP on the NEFU is the master, so that one master runs the IBIT tests.
technical_task: Configure the FCP as the Radstone IBIT master from the FTSS software, with the exception that the ICP on the NEFU is the master.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS software configures an FCP, when it is not on the NEFU, then the FCP acts as the Radstone IBIT master.
Given the NEFU, when the FTSS software configures it, then the ICP on the NEFU is the master.

requirement_text: User shall easily find what they are looking for on the website, with a simple web design ensuring ease of use.
rationale: "Easily", "simple" and "ease of use" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How quickly or in how many steps should users find what they look for?
What makes the web design "simple" and "easy to use"?

requirement_text: System shall allow front-desk staff to assign a unique ID to each patient and add it to the patient’s record.
user_story: As a front-desk staff member, I want to assign a unique ID to each patient and add it to the patient's record, so that each patient can be identified.
technical_task: Allow front-desk staff to assign a unique ID to a patient and store it in the patient's record.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient without an ID, when front-desk staff assign a unique ID, then the ID is added to the patient's record.
Given an ID already assigned to a patient, when staff try to assign it to another patient, then it is refused.

requirement_text: Movement shall be facilitated by touching the respective buttons (up, down, left, right) for character movement, with interruptions if there is no light at the destination or if the movement path is blocked.
user_story: As a player, I want to move my character by touching the up, down, left and right buttons, so that I can control it.
technical_task: Move the character when the up, down, left or right button is touched, and interrupt the movement when there is no light at the destination or the movement path is blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Given the movement buttons, when the player touches one, then the character moves in that direction.
Given there is no light at the destination, when the character moves, then the movement is interrupted.
Given the path is blocked, when the character moves, then the movement is interrupted.

requirement_text: The administrator will maintain a listing of allowable immunizations that an HCP can use.
requirement_text_raw: The administrator will maintain  a listing of allowable immunizations that an HCP can use.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to maintain a listing of allowable immunizations, so that HCPs can choose only from approved ones.
technical_task: Maintain an administrator-managed list of allowable immunizations for HCPs to use.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list of allowable immunizations, when an administrator adds or removes an entry, then the list is updated.
Given an HCP, when the HCP selects an immunization, then only those on the allowable list can be used.

requirement_text: The system shall maintain a memory buffer to store lag frames and track the status of each record in the buffer.
user_story: As a software developer, I want a memory buffer that stores lag frames and tracks the status of each record in it, so that lag frames are not lost.
technical_task: Maintain a memory buffer holding lag frames and track the status of every record in the buffer.
acceptance_criteria: Given lag frames arrive, when they are processed, then they are stored in the memory buffer.
Given records in the memory buffer, when their state changes, then the status of each record is tracked.

requirement_text: The system shall handle complex projects and large files without lag or slowdown.
rationale: "Complex", "large" and "without lag or slowdown" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What size counts as a "complex project" or a "large file"?
How much lag or slowdown is tolerable?

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to review code modifications submitted by applicants and associate approved modifications with projects.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to review code modifications submitted by applicants and associate approved ones with projects, so that accepted work is tracked.
technical_task: Provide a review screen for submitted code modifications and a way to link approved modifications to projects.
acceptance_criteria: Given a code modification submitted by an applicant, when staff open it, then they can review it.
Given an approved modification, when staff associate it with a project, then it is linked to that project.
rationale: Role stated: staff member and applicant.

requirement_text: All tests shall be performed and passed at the worst case automotive boundary conditions.
user_story: As a test engineer, I want all tests performed and passed at the worst case automotive boundary conditions, so that the product is proven under extreme conditions.
technical_task: Run every test at the worst case automotive boundary conditions and require it to pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test, when it is run, then it is run at the worst case automotive boundary conditions.
Given a test run at the worst case automotive boundary conditions, when its result is evaluated, then it has passed.
rationale: Role assumed: test engineer. The boundary conditions themselves are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall initiate the play function by selecting the play icon, transitioning the menu screen to the play game screen.
user_story: As a player, I want to start the game by selecting the play icon, so that the menu screen changes to the play game screen.
technical_task: Switch from the menu screen to the play game screen when the user selects the play icon.
acceptance_criteria: Given the menu screen, when the user selects the play icon, then the play game screen is displayed.
Given the play game screen is displayed, when the user looks at the screen, then the menu screen is no longer shown.

requirement_text: User shall post questions, comments, or discussions related to examinations.
user_story: As a student, I want to post questions, comments or discussions related to examinations, so that I can get help from others.
technical_task: Allow users to post questions, comments and discussions related to examinations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user posts a question, comment or discussion about an examination, then it is published.
Given a published post, when other users view the examination discussion, then the post is visible.

requirement_text: User shall mark attendance using a selected method.
user_story: As a student, I want to mark my attendance using a selected method, so that my presence is recorded.
technical_task: Allow users to mark attendance using a method they select.
acceptance_criteria: Given the attendance page, when the user selects a method and marks attendance, then the attendance is recorded.
Given attendance marked, when the record is viewed, then it shows the attendance.
rationale: Role assumed: student. The available methods are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall validate the information provided by the user using JavaScript on the client side.
user_story: As a user, I want the information I provide to be validated in my browser with JavaScript, so that mistakes are caught before submission.
technical_task: Add JavaScript checks that run on the client side to validate user-entered information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters invalid information, when the user submits the form, then JavaScript validation reports the problem on the client side.
Given a user enters valid information, when the user submits the form, then the information passes the client-side validation.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which fields are validated is not stated.

requirement_text: Users can view, update, or delete their own profile.
user_story: As a registered user, I want to view, update or delete my own profile, so that I control my information.
technical_task: Offer view, update and delete actions on the signed-in user's own profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in user, when the user opens their profile, then the profile is shown with options to update and delete it.
Given a signed-in user, when the user tries to open another user's profile for editing, then the action is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: registered user. "Own" implies the second criterion.

requirement_text: The solution should provide audit capabilities indicating the time stamp for an object or data modification in accordance with users' scope or practice organizational policy or jurisdictional law.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide audit capabilities indicating the time stamp for an object or data modification in accordance with users' scope or practice  organizational policy  or jurisdictional law.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want audit capabilities that show a time stamp for each modification of an object or data, so that changes can be traced under the applicable policy or law.
technical_task: Record a time stamp whenever an object or data is modified, following the user's scope of practice, organizational policy or jurisdictional law.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object or data is modified, when the change is saved, then an audit record with a time stamp is created.
Given the audit records, when a reviewer opens them, then the time stamp of each modification can be seen.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. Which policy or law applies is not specified.

requirement_text: The LHCP can view of the comprehensive patient report for the specified group including the information below.
requirement_text_raw: The LHCP can view of the comprehensive patient report for the specified group  including the information below.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view the comprehensive patient report for a specified group including the listed information, so that I can review the group as a whole.
technical_task: Generate a comprehensive patient report for a specified group of patients that includes the listed information items.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specified group of patients, when the LHCP requests the comprehensive patient report, then the report is shown.
Given the report, when the LHCP reads it, then it includes the information items listed for the report.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The list of information items is not included in the sentence.

requirement_text: The system shall allow to Submit applications with information, plans, and documents.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to submit an application with information, plans and documents, so that it can be reviewed.
technical_task: Build an application submission that accepts information, plans and documents together.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application form, when the applicant adds information, plans and documents and submits, then the application is submitted with all of them.
Given an application missing required content, when the applicant submits it, then the applicant is told what is missing.
rationale: Role assumed: applicant. Which items are mandatory is not stated; the second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: It is feasible to allocate objects not to the ego lane with collision overlap during small curve radii to avoid potentially implausible functional reactions, i.
rationale: The sentence is cut off and does not say what behaviour is required.
clarification_questions: What is meant by "implausible functional reactions"?
What is the complete text of the sentence, which ends with "i."?

requirement_text: The FCP shall wait up to 2.5 seconds (from the sending of the FCP Ready Sync) for the ICP Ready signal. Note that FTSS will not fail the FCR if this signal is not received within this time. FTSS will wait until the normal ICP presence test fails.
requirement_text_raw: The FCP shall [SRS189] wait up to 2.5 seconds (from the sending of the FCP Ready Sync) for the ICP Ready signal.  Note that FTSS will not fail the FCR if this signal is not received within this time.  FTSS will wait until the normal ICP presence test fails.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP to wait up to 2.5 seconds after sending the FCP Ready Sync for the ICP Ready signal, so that a late signal is still accepted.
technical_task: Set the FCP to wait up to 2.5 seconds from the sending of the FCP Ready Sync for the ICP Ready signal, and have FTSS keep waiting until the normal ICP presence test fails instead of failing the FCR.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP has sent the FCP Ready Sync, when the ICP Ready signal arrives within 2.5 seconds, then the FCP accepts it.
Given the ICP Ready signal is not received within 2.5 seconds, when the time passes, then FTSS does not fail the FCR and waits until the normal ICP presence test fails.

requirement_text: System shall display all available cars with hourly and per kilometer charges.
user_story: As a renter, I want to see all available cars with their hourly and per kilometer charges, so that I can compare prices.
technical_task: List every available car together with its hourly charge and its per kilometer charge.
acceptance_criteria: Given available cars, when the renter opens the car list, then each available car is shown.
Given a listed car, when the renter views it, then its hourly and per kilometer charges are displayed.

requirement_text: The solution should appropriately label information in storage in process and in transmission.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should appropriately label information in storage  in process  and in transmission.
user_story: As a security officer, I want information to be labeled whether it is in storage, in process or in transmission, so that it is handled according to its label.
technical_task: Apply labels to information that is stored, in process or in transmission.
acceptance_criteria: Given information in storage, when it is held by the solution, then it carries a label.
Given information in process or in transmission, when it is handled, then it carries a label.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. What "appropriately" means for the label is not defined.

requirement_text: The solution should leverage CCHCS Secure FTP infrastructure for sending files external to CCHCS data center.
user_story: As a data custodian, I want files sent outside the CCHCS data center to go through the CCHCS Secure FTP infrastructure, so that transfers are secure.
technical_task: Route outbound files for destinations external to the CCHCS data center through the existing CCHCS Secure FTP infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file to be sent outside the CCHCS data center, when it is sent, then it goes through the CCHCS Secure FTP infrastructure.
Given a file for an internal destination, when it is sent, then the requirement does not apply.

requirement_text: System shall provide meaningful error messages when dataset creation or reconfiguration fails due to incompatible properties.
user_story: As a data analyst, I want meaningful error messages when dataset creation or reconfiguration fails because of incompatible properties, so that I can fix the settings.
technical_task: Show an error message that names the problem when dataset creation or reconfiguration fails due to incompatible properties.
acceptance_criteria: Given incompatible properties, when dataset creation fails, then an error message explains the problem.
Given incompatible properties, when dataset reconfiguration fails, then an error message explains the problem.
rationale: Role assumed: data analyst. "Meaningful" is read as naming the cause.

requirement_text: If the timer is running and the hood open M:Hood open, execution of the function is to be ended and can be restarted by closing the hood.
user_story: As a machine operator, I want the function to end when the hood is open while the timer is running and to restart when the hood is closed, so that the machine stops safely.
technical_task: End the running function when the hood opens (M:Hood open) and allow it to be restarted by closing the hood.
acceptance_criteria: Given the timer is running, when the hood is opened, then execution of the function ends.
Given the function has ended because the hood was opened, when the hood is closed, then the function can be restarted.

requirement_text: The user could erase all the statistics.
user_story: As a user, I want to erase all the statistics, so that I can start fresh.
technical_task: Offer a function that deletes all stored statistics.
acceptance_criteria: Given stored statistics, when the user chooses to erase them, then all statistics are erased.
Given statistics have been erased, when the user opens the statistics, then none are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Could" is read as a capability the user has.

requirement_text: System's reliability depends on continuous backup of the database.
rationale: The sentence states a dependency instead of a requirement and gives no target.
clarification_questions: Is the requirement that the database backup must run continuously?
What reliability level is expected?

requirement_text: The solution de-identification capability should include: FAX numbers.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want the de-identification capability to include FAX numbers, so that they are removed from shared data.
technical_task: Add FAX numbers to the identifiers handled by the de-identification capability.
acceptance_criteria: Given data containing a FAX number, when it is de-identified, then the FAX number is removed.
Given de-identified data, when it is reviewed, then no FAX number remains.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. "Include" is read as including FAX numbers among identifiers to remove.

requirement_text: User shall follow exact sequencing of operations for system tasks.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want users to follow an exact sequence of operations for system tasks, so that tasks are done correctly.
technical_task: Enforce a fixed order of steps for system tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a system task, when the user performs the steps in the required order, then the task completes.
Given a system task, when the user performs a step out of order, then the system does not allow it.
rationale: Role assumed: system administrator. The sequences are not listed.

requirement_text: He or she can report the height weight possibly and possibly pedometer reading for the patient.
requirement_text_raw: He or she can report the height  weight  possibly and possibly pedometer reading  for the patient.
user_story: As a patient, I want to report my height, weight and possibly pedometer reading, so that my record is complete.
technical_task: Let a patient or representative enter height, weight and optionally a pedometer reading.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient record, when the user enters height and weight, then the values are saved.
Given a patient record, when the user enters a pedometer reading, then the reading is saved.
rationale: Role assumed: patient; the sentence says "he or she".

requirement_text: The system shall allow authorized users to delete sub-apps and their launchers within the main application.
user_story: As an authorized user, I want to delete sub-apps and their launchers in the main application, so that unused ones are removed.
technical_task: Support removal of a sub-app together with its launcher, restricted to authorized users.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user deletes a sub-app, then the sub-app and its launcher are removed from the main application.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to delete a sub-app, then it is not deleted.

requirement_text: These additional non-functional requirements aim to further enhance the performance, security, user experience, reliability, and availability of the system.
rationale: The sentence describes the aim of other requirements and states none itself.
clarification_questions: Which non-functional requirements does "these additional" point to?
What measurable targets are meant for performance, security, reliability and availability?

requirement_text: Process scheduling shall only be performed at certain controlled locations (synchronization points).
requirement_text_raw: Process scheduling shall (3.3.4.4) only be performed at certain controlled locations (synchronization points).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want process scheduling to happen only at controlled synchronization points, so that scheduling is predictable.
technical_task: Restrict process scheduling to specific controlled locations known as synchronization points.
acceptance_criteria: Given a process to be scheduled, when scheduling occurs, then it takes place at a synchronization point.
Given no synchronization point is reached, when time passes, then no process scheduling is performed.

requirement_text: User shall test the functionality of a Neurohub installation with a script.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to test a Neurohub installation with a script, so that I can confirm it works.
technical_task: Provide a test script that exercises the functionality of a Neurohub installation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Neurohub installation, when the test script is run, then the functionality is tested.
Given the script finishes, when the administrator reads the output, then the outcome of the tests is shown.

requirement_text: 7.For the NEFU, if errors are identified after the processor has been masked out, and if at least 4 NEs are still active, the NE shall be removed from the configuration and recovery will be attempted. Note that the NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.
requirement_text_raw: 7.For the NEFU, if errors are identified after the processor has been masked out, and if at least 4 NEs are still active, the NE shall [SRS283] be removed from the configuration and recovery will be attempted.  Note that the NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want an NE on the NEFU removed from the configuration and recovery attempted when errors are found after the processor is masked out and at least 4 NEs are still active, so that the system keeps running.
technical_task: After the processor is masked out on the NEFU, remove the NE from the configuration and attempt recovery if errors are identified and at least 4 NEs are still active, regardless of whether alignment is permitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given errors are identified on the NEFU after the processor is masked out and at least 4 NEs are active, when the check runs, then the NE is removed from the configuration and recovery is attempted.
Given the NEFU recovery, when alignment is not permitted, then recovery is still attempted.

requirement_text: The solution should authenticate principals prior to accessing an EMR application or EMR data.
user_story: As a clinician, I want principals to be authenticated before they access an EMR application or EMR data, so that only identified users get in.
technical_task: Require authentication of the principal before access to an EMR application or EMR data is granted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a principal who has authenticated, when the principal opens an EMR application, then access is granted.
Given a principal who has not authenticated, when the principal requests EMR data, then access is not granted.

requirement_text: System shall provide an intuitive blog creation interface for administrators.
clarification_questions: What makes a blog creation interface "intuitive"?
How will intuitiveness be measured for administrators?

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to generate an audit report.
user_story: As an auditor, I want to generate an audit report, so that I can review activity.
technical_task: Add an audit report generation function.
acceptance_criteria: Given recorded activity, when the user requests an audit report, then the report is generated.
Given the generated report, when it is opened, then it lists the audited activity.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. The report contents are not described.

requirement_text: The system shall have a disaster recovery plan to ensure data integrity and system functionality in case of outages.
user_story: As a system owner, I want a disaster recovery plan, so that data integrity and system functionality are kept in case of outages.
technical_task: Write and maintain a disaster recovery plan for outages that protects data integrity and system functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system documentation, when it is reviewed, then a disaster recovery plan exists.
Given an outage, when the plan is followed, then data integrity and system functionality are maintained.
rationale: Role assumed: system owner. The plan's contents are not specified.

requirement_text: (A) Electronic health information that is stored must be encrypted in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(a)(1).
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want stored electronic health information to be encrypted according to the standard in 170.210(a)(1), so that it is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt all stored electronic health information using the method required by the standard specified in 170.210(a)(1).
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information that is stored, when it is saved, then it is encrypted in accordance with 170.210(a)(1).
Given stored electronic health information, when it is read without the key, then it cannot be understood.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The standard is only referenced; the section symbol in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: The system shall allow researchers to download files, reports, and locate materials for social media sharing.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to download files and reports and find materials to share on social media, so that I can spread my work.
technical_task: Offer file and report downloads and a way to locate materials for social media sharing.
acceptance_criteria: Given available files and reports, when a researcher selects one to download, then it is downloaded.
Given materials in the system, when a researcher looks for something to share, then the materials can be located for social media sharing.

requirement_text: The SELECT [by name] command is processed by the OPEN.

user_story: As a reader, I want user interface elements in multiple languages, possibly including multilingual ebooks, so that I can use my own language.
technical_task: Support multiple languages for the user interface elements and, where possible, multilingual ebooks.

Given a multilingual ebook, when the user opens it, then the ebook can be read in a supported language.
rationale: Role assumed: reader. Ebook support is only "potentially" required.

requirement_text: The system shall not lose any orders or customer payments under any circumstances (P2, P3).
user_story: As a customer, I want my orders and payments never to be lost, so that I can trust the system.
technical_task: Ensure orders and customer payments are never lost, whatever happens.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order or payment is accepted, when a failure occurs, then the order or payment is not lost.
Given an order or payment is accepted, when the system restarts, then the order or payment is still present.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. "Under any circumstances" cannot be proven; the criteria cover failure and restart.

requirement_text: The procedures used to build the executable FTSS software using a cross-compiler and linker, down-load the image to the target processors, and burn the load image into the Radstone PowerPC flash RAM shall be documented in the release notes that accompany Engineering Releases of the FTSS software and in the Software Users Manual.
requirement_text_raw: The procedures used to build the executable FTSS software using a cross-compiler and linker, down-load the image to the target processors, and burn the load image into the Radstone PowerPC flash RAM shall (3.3.7.1) be documented in the release notes that accompany Engineering Releases of the FTSS software and in the Software Users Manual.
user_story: As a release manager, I want the procedures for building, downloading and burning the FTSS software documented, so that releases are repeatable.
technical_task: Document the build, download and flash-burning procedures in the release notes of Engineering Releases and in the Software Users Manual.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Engineering Release of the FTSS software, when the release notes are read, then they document the procedures for building with a cross-compiler and linker, down-loading and burning to the Radstone PowerPC flash RAM.
Given the Software Users Manual, when it is read, then it documents the same procedures.

requirement_text: The solution should provide documentation on information classification matrix of all information elements accessed possibly and possibly processed by the solution.
user_story: As an information security officer, I want documentation of an information classification matrix for all information elements accessed or processed, so that information is handled by class.
technical_task: Produce documentation containing an information classification matrix for every information element the solution accesses or possibly processes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the solution documentation, when it is reviewed, then it contains an information classification matrix.
Given the matrix, when its entries are checked, then every information element the solution accesses or processes is classified.

requirement_text: The supermarket staff shall add new items to the inventory.
user_story: As a supermarket staff member, I want to add new items to the inventory, so that stock is up to date.
technical_task: Provide a way for supermarket staff to register new items in the inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new item, when staff add it, then it appears in the inventory.
Given the inventory list, when staff view it, then the new item is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to select a channel and view content from that channel.
user_story: As a viewer, I want to select a channel and view its content, so that I can watch what I like.
technical_task: Allow selecting a channel and then displaying that channel's content.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of channels, when the user selects one, then that channel is chosen.
Given a chosen channel, when the user opens it, then its content is shown.

requirement_text: The solution should provide time stamps that are synchronized with the authoritative enterprise time server for use in audit record generation.
user_story: As an auditor, I want time stamps synchronized with the authoritative enterprise time server in audit records, so that audit times are reliable.
technical_task: Obtain time stamps for audit record generation from a clock synchronized with the authoritative enterprise time server.
acceptance_criteria: Given an audit record is generated, when it is time stamped, then the time stamp comes from a clock synchronized with the authoritative enterprise time server.
Given the audit records, when the auditor reviews them, then their time stamps are consistent with the enterprise time server.

requirement_text: System shall support efficient filtering and management of trainee information for admins.
user_story: As an admin, I want to filter and manage trainee information, so that I can find and update trainees.
technical_task: Provide filters and management functions for trainee information for admins.
acceptance_criteria: Given trainee information, when an admin applies a filter, then only matching trainees are shown.
Given a trainee, when an admin edits the information, then the changes are saved.
rationale: Role stated: admin. "Efficient" is not measured.

requirement_text: The component calculates additional objects on the left and right side of the path and also an object behind the nearest object in path.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the component to compute extra objects to the left and right of the path and one behind the nearest object in the path, so that more of the scene is considered.
technical_task: Have the component compute additional objects on the left and on the right of the path and an object behind the nearest object in the path.
acceptance_criteria: Given a path with objects, when the component calculates, then additional objects on the left and right sides of the path are produced.
Given a nearest object in the path, when the component calculates, then an object behind it is also produced.

requirement_text: The LHCP can download an XML-formatted document containing the results of the group report.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to download an XML-formatted document with the results of the group report, so that I can use the results elsewhere.
technical_task: Add an XML download for the results of the group report.
acceptance_criteria: Given a group report, when the LHCP requests the download, then an XML document is provided.
Given the downloaded document, when it is opened, then it contains the results of the group report.

requirement_text: The application shall maintain a list of classes for the user.
user_story: As a student, I want the application to keep a list of my classes, so that I can see them.
technical_task: Maintain a per-user list of classes in the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user adds a class, then it appears in the user's list.
Given the user's list, when the user opens it, then the classes are shown.

requirement_text: The solution should conform to function IN.1.3 (Entity Access Control) in order for a healthcare delivery organization to manage a patient’s access to his or her healthcare information.
user_story: As a healthcare organization, I want the solution to conform to function IN.1.3 (Entity Access Control), so that I can manage a patient's access to their health information.
technical_task: Implement entity access control in line with function IN.1.3 so the organization can control who may access a patient's health information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient's health information, when access is requested, then access is decided according to entity access control.
Given the organization, when it changes a patient's access, then the change is applied to future requests.

requirement_text: User passwords shall be encrypted in the database management system (DBMS) for security.
user_story: As a user, I want my password encrypted in the DBMS, so that it stays secure.
technical_task: Store user passwords in the DBMS in encrypted form.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user password, when it is saved in the database management system, then it is encrypted.
Given the DBMS contents, when someone inspects the stored passwords, then the passwords are not readable.

requirement_text: The main window shall list buildings monitored and summarizing the current diagnostic status of all contained monitored units.
user_story: As a monitoring operator, I want the main window to list the monitored buildings and summarize the current diagnostic status of all monitored units in them, so that I see the overall state.
technical_task: Show the monitored buildings in the main window together with a summary of the current diagnostic status of every monitored unit they contain.
acceptance_criteria: Given the main window, when it is displayed, then the monitored buildings are listed.
Given a listed building, when it is displayed, then the current diagnostic status of all its monitored units is summarized.

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall receive telemetry commands from both CTCs via the MPCC/CTC once every medium frame.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall (3.4.2.5) receive telemetry commands from both CTCs via the MPCC/CTC once every medium frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software to receive telemetry commands from both CTCs once every medium frame, so that commands are processed regularly.

acceptance_criteria: Given a medium frame, when it runs, then the FTSS software receives telemetry commands from both CTCs.
Given consecutive medium frames, when they run, then commands are received once in each frame.

Is the referenced chapter part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Chemists shall be able to view open prescriptions assigned to them based on pincode and update the status, with medicines delivered offline to patients.
user_story: As a chemist, I want to view open prescriptions assigned to me by pincode and update their status, so that I can track deliveries made offline to patients.

Given an open prescription, when the chemist updates its status, then the new status is saved.

requirement_text: The system shall provide screens to view tracked metrics, set goals, and configure monitoring settings.
user_story: As a user, I want screens to view tracked metrics, set goals and configure monitoring settings, so that I can follow my progress.
technical_task: Build three screens: one for tracked metrics, one for setting goals and one for configuring monitoring settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given tracked metrics, when the user opens the metrics screen, then the metrics are displayed.
Given the goals screen, when the user sets a goal, then the goal is saved.
Given the settings screen, when the user changes a monitoring setting, then the setting is saved.

requirement_text: The input data a timestamp and the fact that the status was reported by "case manager" and their MID are saved.
requirement_text_raw: The input data  a timestamp  and the fact that the status was reported by "case manager" and their MID are saved.
user_story: As a case manager, I want the input data, a timestamp, the fact that I reported the status and my MID saved, so that the report can be traced to me.
technical_task: Save the input data with a timestamp, a marker that the status was reported by a case manager, and the case manager's MID.
acceptance_criteria: Given a case manager reports a status, when the report is saved, then the input data and a timestamp are saved.
Given the saved report, when it is viewed, then it shows that it was reported by "case manager" and shows the MID.

requirement_text: The system shall enable the administrator to (1) add a new entry for an appointment type including its type name with up to 30 alpha characters and duration in the unit of minutes and (2) modify the duration in an existing entry .
requirement_text_raw: The system shall enable the administrator to (1) add a new entry for an appointment type  including its type name with up to 30 alpha characters and duration in the unit of minutes   and (2) modify the duration in an existing entry .
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add appointment types with a type name of up to 30 alpha characters and a duration in minutes, and to change the duration of an existing entry, so that appointments are scheduled correctly.
technical_task: Provide add and modify functions for appointment types: a name of up to 30 alpha characters, a duration in minutes, and a way to edit the duration of an existing entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new appointment type, when the administrator enters a name of up to 30 alpha characters and a duration in minutes, then the entry is added.
Given an existing appointment type, when the administrator changes its duration, then the entry shows the new duration.

requirement_text: The system shall provide uninterrupted functionality both with and without an internet connection. In offline mode, users should still be able to access certain features. In online mode, the system should operate smoothly.

What does "operate smoothly" mean in online mode?

requirement_text: The BMS may supervise the charge taken out of the battery while the contactors are closed due to this request.
user_story: As a battery system engineer, I want the BMS to be able to supervise the charge taken out of the battery while the contactors are closed because of this request, so that charge usage is monitored.

Given the contactors are open, when no request is active, then the supervision of this charge is not required.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to add type information to their data.
user_story: As a user, I want to add type information to my data, so that I can classify it.

acceptance_criteria: Given a data item, when the user adds type information, then the type is saved with the item.

requirement_text: The TCS shall have the capability to control and monitor multiple types of AVs.
user_story: As a controller operator, I want the TCS to control and monitor multiple types of AVs, so that I can manage a mixed fleet.

acceptance_criteria: Given AVs of different types, when the operator sends a command, then the TCS controls each type of AV.
Given AVs of different types, when the operator views them, then the TCS monitors each type of AV.
rationale: Role assumed: controller operator. The AV types are not listed.

requirement_text: Upon completion of logging a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure, the FTSS system shall consider the ICP failed and attempt recovery actions as stated in requirement 3.3.5.29.
requirement_text_raw: Upon completion of logging a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure, the FTSS system shall (3.3.2.44) consider the ICP failed and attempt recovery actions as stated in requirement 3.3.5.29.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS system to treat the ICP as failed and attempt recovery after logging a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure, so that failures are handled consistently.
technical_task: When logging of a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure completes, mark the ICP as failed and start the recovery actions defined in requirement 3.3.5.29.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure has been logged, when logging completes, then the FTSS system considers the ICP failed.
Given the ICP is considered failed, when logging completes, then recovery actions as stated in requirement 3.3.5.29 are attempted.

requirement_text: User shall be able to request transportation routes.
user_story: As a commuter, I want to request transportation routes, so that I can plan my trip.
technical_task: Add a route request function for transportation routes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a start and destination, when the user requests a route, then transportation routes are returned.
Given a returned route, when the user views it, then its details are shown.

requirement_text: News will be restricted to what is available in the feeds on the list of news RSS-feeds.
user_story: As a reader, I want news limited to the feeds on the list of news RSS feeds, so that I see only approved sources.

acceptance_criteria: Given the list of news RSS feeds, when news is displayed, then it comes only from those feeds.
Given a feed that is not on the list, when news is displayed, then nothing from that feed is shown.

requirement_text: When in billing mode, a surface computer shall display a representation of tip denominations that may be dragged into a payment.
requirement_text_raw: When in billing mode, a surface computer shall display a representation of tip  denominations that may be dragged into a payment.
user_story: As a waiter, I want a surface computer in billing mode to show tip denominations that I can drag into a payment, so that I can add a tip quickly.
technical_task: Show a representation of tip denominations on the surface computer in billing mode and make them draggable into a payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given the surface computer in billing mode, when the bill is displayed, then tip denominations are represented.
Given a tip denomination, when the user drags it into a payment, then it is added to the payment.

requirement_text: User shall expect the database to update data in less than 1 second to ensure timely information retrieval.
user_story: As a user, I want the database to update data in less than 1 second, so that the information I retrieve is current.

acceptance_criteria: Given a data update, when it is performed, then it completes in less than 1 second.
Given an update has completed, when the user retrieves the data, then the updated data is returned.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The workload for the measurement is not stated.

requirement_text: Search agents shall automatically send resumes matching specified criteria via email daily.
user_story: As a recruiter, I want search agents to email me resumes that match my criteria every day, so that I see new candidates without searching.
technical_task: Run search agents that match resumes against specified criteria and email the matches daily.
acceptance_criteria: Given specified criteria, when the daily run happens, then matching resumes are sent by email.
Given no resume matches, when the daily run happens, then no resumes are sent.

rationale: The text is a fragment that names an official and a section and states no behaviour.

Which section 20 is meant?

requirement_text: User shall determine brokerage by multiplying transaction amount by brokerage percentage.
user_story: As a broker, I want brokerage determined by multiplying the transaction amount by the brokerage percentage, so that charges are calculated consistently.
technical_task: Calculate brokerage as transaction amount times brokerage percentage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction amount and a brokerage percentage, when brokerage is determined, then it equals the amount multiplied by the percentage.
Given a zero transaction amount, when brokerage is determined, then the result is zero.

requirement_text: System shall support dataset deposition and management through integration with Virtual Research Environments and other familiar workflow tools.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to deposit and manage datasets through Virtual Research Environments and other familiar workflow tools, so that I work in the tools I already use.

acceptance_criteria: Given a Virtual Research Environment, when a researcher deposits a dataset from it, then the dataset is deposited in the system.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to enable two-factor authentication for added security.
user_story: As a user, I want the option to enable two-factor authentication, so that my account is more secure.

acceptance_criteria: Given a user's account settings, when the user enables two-factor authentication, then it is turned on.
Given two-factor authentication is on, when the user signs in, then a second factor is required.

requirement_text: The user interface shall be responsive, adapting to various devices and browsers.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface to adapt to my device and browser, so that it is usable wherever I open it.
technical_task: Make the layout responsive so it adapts to different devices and browsers.
acceptance_criteria: Given different screen sizes, when the interface is displayed, then it adapts to each.
Given different supported browsers, when the interface is displayed, then it works in each.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The supported devices and browsers are not listed.

requirement_text: Support Services shall switch to the redundant MPCC device to continue telemetry and/or remote commanding operations. Note that there are only two CTCs. CTC1 is connected to FCC1 and FCC3. CTC2 is connected to FCC2 and FCC4.
requirement_text_raw: Support Services shall [SRS299] switch to the redundant MPCC device to continue telemetry and/or remote commanding operations.  Note that there are only two CTCs.  CTC1 is connected to FCC1 and FCC3.  CTC2 is connected to FCC2 and FCC4.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Support Services to switch to the redundant MPCC device to continue telemetry and remote commanding, so that operations are not interrupted.
technical_task: Switch to the redundant MPCC device when needed so that telemetry and/or remote commanding operations can continue.
acceptance_criteria: Given the active MPCC device cannot be used, when Support Services reacts, then it switches to the redundant MPCC device.
Given the switch has happened, when operations continue, then telemetry and/or remote commanding keep working.

requirement_text: Customers shall be able to rate restaurants and delivery boys.
user_story: As a customer, I want to rate restaurants and delivery boys, so that my feedback is recorded.

acceptance_criteria: Given a restaurant, when a customer rates it, then the rating is saved.
Given a delivery boy, when a customer rates the delivery boy, then the rating is saved.

requirement_text: Selected articles from the chancellor’s office daily communications distribution, fed to RSS subscribers on the Get Real site. This feature requires X hours per week of web design resource for editing the URLs to the DSS feed.

requirement_text: User shall enter customer and product information for support.
user_story: As a support agent, I want to enter customer and product information, so that I can handle support cases.

acceptance_criteria: Given the support form, when the user enters customer information, then it is saved.
Given the support form, when the user enters product information, then it is saved.

requirement_text: System shall ensure privacy while displaying attendee information to trainers.
user_story: As an attendee, I want my information to be displayed to trainers in a way that protects my privacy, so that only necessary details are shared.
technical_task: Display attendee information to trainers with privacy protections applied.
acceptance_criteria: Given a trainer views attendees, when attendee information is displayed, then privacy is ensured.
Given an attendee detail not meant for trainers, when a trainer views the attendee, then that detail is not shown.

requirement_text: In case of multicast streams the CNG should support proxy functionalities to optimize the management of information related to signalling.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want the CNG to support proxy functionalities for multicast streams, so that signalling information is managed more efficiently.

acceptance_criteria: Given a multicast stream, when it passes through the CNG, then the CNG's proxy functionality is applied.
Given signalling information in a multicast stream, when it is processed, then the proxy functionality is used to manage it.

requirement_text: Upon CPU reset caused by power on, watchdog timer or by other means, Start Up shall execute the initial BIT (IBIT).
requirement_text_raw: Upon CPU reset caused by power on, watchdog timer or by other means, Start Up shall (3.3.2.1) execute the initial BIT (IBIT).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Start Up to run the initial BIT after any CPU reset, so that the CPU is tested on every restart.

acceptance_criteria: Given a CPU reset caused by power on, when Start Up runs, then the initial BIT (IBIT) is executed.
Given a CPU reset caused by the watchdog timer or other means, when Start Up runs, then the initial BIT (IBIT) is executed.

requirement_text: The system shall perform content processing tasks efficiently.

requirement_text: Applicants shall be automatically logged out after a period of inactivity to ensure security.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to be logged out automatically after a period of inactivity, so that my account stays secure.

rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. Which states "their" refers to is not named.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to store Data Packages in GitHub and automatically publish them to CKAN.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to store Data Packages in GitHub and have them published to CKAN automatically, so that publishing needs no manual steps.
technical_task: Support storing Data Packages in GitHub and publishing them to CKAN without manual action.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Data Package, when the user stores it in GitHub, then it is stored there.
Given a Data Package stored in GitHub, when publishing is triggered, then it is published to CKAN automatically.

requirement_text: The MultiMahjongClient will automate the picking up of a tile from the wall if the user has no other option.
user_story: As a player, I want the game to pick up a tile from the wall for me when I have no other option, so that the game continues.
technical_task: Automate picking a tile from the wall in the MultiMahjongClient when the user has no other option.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has no other option, when it is the user's turn, then the MultiMahjongClient picks up a tile from the wall.
Given the user has another option, when it is the user's turn, then the tile is not picked automatically.

requirement_text: The software shall be designed for cross-platform compatibility, ensuring it runs on Microsoft Windows, Apple Macintosh, Android phones, iPhones, and personal computers.
user_story: As a user, I want the software to run on Microsoft Windows, Apple Macintosh, Android phones, iPhones and personal computers, so that I can use my own device.
technical_task: Design the software to be cross-platform for Microsoft Windows, Apple Macintosh, Android phones, iPhones and personal computers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device running Microsoft Windows or Apple Macintosh, when the software is installed, then it runs.
Given an Android phone or an iPhone, when the software is installed, then it runs.

requirement_text: A hashing algorithm with a security strength equal to or greater than SHA-1 (Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA-1) as specified by the NIST in FIPS PUB 180-3 (October 2008)) should be used to verify that electronic health information has not been altered.
requirement_text_raw: A hashing algorithm with a security strength equal to or greater than SHA-1 (Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA-1) as specified by the NIST in FIPS PUB 180-3 (October  2008)) should be used to verify that electronic health information has not been altered.
user_story: As a security officer, I want a hashing algorithm at least as strong as SHA-1 used to verify that electronic health information has not been altered, so that tampering is detected.
technical_task: Verify the integrity of electronic health information with a hashing algorithm whose security strength is equal to or greater than SHA-1.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information, when its integrity is verified, then a hashing algorithm at least as strong as SHA-1 is used.
Given altered electronic health information, when its hash is checked, then the alteration is detected.

requirement_text: User shall receive adherence to SLAs for uptime and performance, including monitoring of database performance and alerts for potential issues.
rationale: The SLAs and targets are not given, and the sentence mixes several behaviours.
clarification_questions: Which SLAs and which uptime and performance targets apply?
What alerts should be sent, and to whom?

requirement_text: The system shall display dates and times in the user's local timezone.
user_story: As a user, I want dates and times shown in my local timezone, so that I don't have to convert them.
technical_task: Convert and display all dates and times in the user's local timezone.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user in a timezone, when a date and time is displayed, then it is shown in that user's local timezone.
Given two users in different timezones, when they view the same event, then each sees it in their own local time.

requirement_text: FDIR shall receive this information and, after two consecutive missed “heartbeats,” conclude that the ICP is failed.
requirement_text_raw: FDIR shall (3.3.5.2) receive this information and, after two consecutive missed “heartbeats,” conclude that the ICP is failed.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to conclude that the ICP has failed after two consecutive missed heartbeats, so that failed ICPs are detected.
technical_task: Have FDIR receive heartbeat information and declare the ICP failed after two consecutive missed heartbeats.
acceptance_criteria: Given two consecutive missed heartbeats, when FDIR evaluates the information, then it concludes that the ICP is failed.
Given one missed heartbeat, when FDIR evaluates the information, then it does not conclude that the ICP is failed.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "This information" is the heartbeat information.

requirement_text: System shall open a new window for users to compose and view messages, retrieving previous messages from the database.
user_story: As a user, I want a new window to compose and view messages with previous messages loaded from the database, so that I can see the conversation.
technical_task: Open a new window for composing and viewing messages that loads earlier messages from the database.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user wants to write or read messages, when the user opens messaging, then a new window opens.
Given the new window is open, when it loads, then previous messages are retrieved from the database and shown.

requirement_text: The solution should implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information solutions that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights as specified in 45 CFR 164.308(a)(4) .
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want access limited to persons or software programs that have been granted access rights, so that we meet 45 CFR 164.308(a)(4).
technical_task: Implement technical policies and procedures that allow access to electronic protected health information only to persons or software programs with granted access rights, as specified in 45 CFR 164.308(a)(4).
acceptance_criteria: Given a person or software program with granted access rights, when it requests electronic protected health information, then access is allowed.
Given a person or software program without granted access rights, when it requests electronic protected health information, then access is denied.

requirement_text: A user (a patient) chooses to display his or her appointments in the current month together with his or her office visit dates prescription dates and lab procedure dates of the current month on a calendar for the current month.
requirement_text_raw: A user (a patient) chooses to display his or her appointments in the current month together with his or her office visit dates  prescription dates  and lab procedure dates of the current month on a calendar for the current month.
user_story: As a patient, I want a calendar for the current month showing my appointments and my office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates, so that I can see my health schedule.
technical_task: Display a calendar of the current month showing the patient's appointments together with office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with appointments in the current month, when the patient opens the calendar, then the appointments are displayed.
Given office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates in the current month, when the patient opens the calendar, then those dates are displayed too.

requirement_text: The pressure compensation membrane is held closed by fingers and the test sample is submerged in water.
rationale: The sentence describes a test setup and gives no pass or fail criterion.
clarification_questions: Is this a test procedure or a requirement on the product?
What outcome must the pressure compensation membrane achieve under test?

requirement_text: System shall adopt a flexible service-based architecture to support future expansion and scalability.
user_story: As a system architect, I want a flexible service-based architecture, so that the system can expand and scale in the future.
technical_task: Adopt a service-based architecture so that new services can be added and capacity scaled.
acceptance_criteria: Given the architecture description, when it is reviewed, then the system is built from services.
Given a new service is needed, when it is added, then existing services need little or no change.
rationale: Role assumed: system architect. "Flexible" is not measured.

requirement_text: The solution should provide audit capabilities to capture solution events at the hardware and software architecture level.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want audit capabilities that capture events at the hardware and software architecture level, so that I can trace what happened.
technical_task: Capture solution events at both the hardware and the software architecture level in the audit function.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event at the hardware level, when it occurs, then it is captured by the audit capabilities.
Given an event at the software architecture level, when it occurs, then it is captured by the audit capabilities.

requirement_text: Memory alignment shall take no more than 1 second per Megabyte of data to be realigned.
requirement_text_raw: Memory alignment shall [SRS203] take no more than 1 second per Megabyte of data to be realigned.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want memory alignment to take no more than 1 second per Megabyte of data realigned, so that realignment time is bounded.
technical_task: Bound the memory alignment time to at most 1 second for each Megabyte of data being realigned.
acceptance_criteria: Given data to be realigned, when memory alignment runs, then it takes no more than 1 second per Megabyte.
Given a larger amount of data, when memory alignment runs, then the allowed time grows in proportion to the number of Megabytes.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The proportional criterion follows from the per-Megabyte limit.

requirement_text: The user ID and date or time stamp shall be recorded.
user_story: As an auditor, I want the user ID and a date or time stamp recorded, so that actions can be attributed.
technical_task: Record the user ID together with a date or time stamp for the audited action.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user performs an audited action, when the action is saved, then the user ID is recorded.
Given a user performs an audited action, when the action is saved, then a date or time stamp is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. Which actions are covered is not stated.

requirement_text: The prototype NEs shall use convection cooling.
requirement_text_raw: The prototype NEs shall (3.2.3.1.1.5) use convection cooling.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the prototype NEs to use convection cooling, so that they do not need forced cooling.
technical_task: Design the cooling of the prototype NEs around convection.
acceptance_criteria: Given a prototype NE, when its cooling design is reviewed, then it uses convection cooling.
Given a prototype NE in operation, when its cooling is inspected, then no other cooling method is relied on.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "shall use".

requirement_text: System shall read initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the system to read initialization data to find out the heating and cooling units, so that it knows which equipment exists.
technical_task: At start, read initialization data and derive the definitions of the heating and cooling units from it.
acceptance_criteria: Given initialization data, when the system starts, then it reads the data.
Given the data read, when the system initializes, then the definitions of heating and cooling units are derived from it.

requirement_text: User shall have access to continuous power to ensure uninterrupted operation.
rationale: The sentence puts a power supply on the user and gives no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is the system supposed to provide power, or is this a requirement on the user's environment?
What does "continuous power" mean in measurable terms?

requirement_text: System shall allow users to reset their passwords through a user-friendly and secure method. It should include verifying identity through security questions or sending verification codes to the registered email or phone number.
user_story: As a user who forgot my password, I want to reset it by verifying my identity, so that I can regain access securely.
technical_task: Provide a password reset that verifies identity through security questions or verification codes sent to the registered email or phone number.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when the user answers the security questions correctly, then the user can set a new password.
Given a user requests a password reset, when a verification code is sent to the registered email or phone number and entered correctly, then the user can set a new password.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "User-friendly" is not measured.

requirement_text: System shall display an error message and return the cash card if the account has insufficient funds.
user_story: As a cardholder, I want an error message and my cash card returned when the account has insufficient funds, so that I know why the transaction failed.
technical_task: Show an error message and eject the cash card when the account balance is insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account with insufficient funds, when the cardholder attempts a transaction, then an error message is displayed.
Given an account with insufficient funds, when the error message is shown, then the cash card is returned.

requirement_text: The system shall cater to 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall cater to 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm.'
user_story: As a facility manager, I want the system to serve 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm, so that staff can work at the same time.
technical_task: Support 10 simultaneous users between 9am and 5pm.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 users are connected between 9am and 5pm, when they use the system at the same time, then the system serves all of them.
Given the working window of 9am to 5pm, when the number of simultaneous users is 10, then the system continues to respond.

requirement_text: The sensor must not miss an object that changed its movement category from Moving to Accident for longer than 1 sensor cycle after the initial 4 sensor cycles after the accident, where a miss is an undelivered sensor object.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the sensor not to miss an object that changed its movement category from Moving to Accident for longer than 1 sensor cycle after the initial 4 sensor cycles, so that accident objects are tracked.
technical_task: Ensure the sensor delivers an object that changed from Moving to Accident, allowing a miss (an undelivered sensor object) of no longer than 1 sensor cycle after the initial 4 sensor cycles following the accident.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object changes from Moving to Accident, when 4 sensor cycles after the accident have passed, then the sensor does not miss the object for longer than 1 sensor cycle.
Given the sensor does not deliver the object, when this is counted, then it is counted as a miss.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. A miss is defined in the requirement as an undelivered sensor object.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall keep a minor frame count from 0 to 49.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS025] keep a minor frame count from 0 to 49.
user_story: As a software engineer, I want the scheduler to keep a minor frame count from 0 to 49, so that frames are numbered consistently.
technical_task: Maintain a minor frame counter in the scheduler that runs from 0 up to 49.
acceptance_criteria: Given the scheduler is running, when a minor frame starts, then the minor frame count is between 0 and 49.
Given the count has reached 49, when the next minor frame starts, then the count returns to 0.
rationale: Role assumed: software engineer. The wrap-around is an interpretation of a count from 0 to 49.

requirement_text: Data queries from the Presentation or the Business Logic layers shall be validated for appropriate use of query language and validated for appropriate quantity and quality of data input.
requirement_text_raw: Data queries from the Presentation or the Business Logic layers shall be validated for appropriate use of query language  and validated for appropriate quantity and quality of data input.
user_story: As a security engineer, I want data queries from the Presentation or Business Logic layers validated for query language use and for the quantity and quality of data input, so that bad queries are blocked.
technical_task: Validate every data query coming from the Presentation or Business Logic layers for appropriate use of the query language and for appropriate quantity and quality of input data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data query from the Presentation or the Business Logic layer, when it is received, then its use of the query language is validated.
Given a data query from either layer, when it is received, then the quantity and quality of its data input are validated.
rationale: Role assumed: security engineer. What counts as appropriate is not defined.

requirement_text: The system shall maintain consistent security through the use of passwords.
user_story: As a user, I want security to be maintained through the use of passwords, so that only I can access my account.
technical_task: Protect access with passwords as the security mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a password, when the user enters the correct password, then access is granted.
Given a user, when the user enters a wrong password, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Consistent" is read as passwords being required everywhere.

requirement_text: The system captures the reason for the "refill push" and the pharmacist requesting the refill.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want the reason for a refill push and the pharmacist requesting the refill captured, so that refill requests can be understood later.
technical_task: Capture the reason for each refill push and the pharmacist who requests the refill.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refill push, when it is made, then its reason is captured.
Given a refill request, when it is made, then the requesting pharmacist is captured.

requirement_text: The system shall be accessible to users both from within the application and through a web browser interface.
user_story: As a user, I want to use the system from within the application or through a web browser, so that I can choose how to reach it.
technical_task: Offer access both inside the application and through a web browser interface.
