acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when a user opens the system there, then the system is accessible.
Given a web browser, when a user opens the web interface, then the system is accessible.

requirement_text: The product shall be able to process 10 000 transactions per hour within two years of its launch. This number will increase to 20 000 by Release 2.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be able to process 10 000 transactions per hour within two years of its launch.  This number will increase to 20 000 by Release 2.'
user_story: As a business owner, I want the product to process 10 000 transactions per hour within two years of its launch and 20 000 by Release 2, so that capacity grows with the business.
technical_task: Size the product for 10 000 transactions per hour within two years of launch, rising to 20 000 by Release 2.
acceptance_criteria: Given two years after launch, when the product is under load, then it processes 10 000 transactions per hour.
Given Release 2, when the product is under load, then it processes 20 000 transactions per hour.

requirement_text: It shall be possible to reassign a task to a different rate group as a function of the mission mode.
requirement_text_raw: It shall (3.3.4.6) be possible to reassign a task to a different rate group as a function of the mission mode.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want to reassign a task to a different rate group depending on the mission mode, so that scheduling fits the mode.
technical_task: Allow a task's rate group to be changed according to the current mission mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task in a rate group, when the mission mode changes, then the task can be reassigned to a different rate group.
Given a mission mode, when a task is reassigned, then the task runs in its new rate group.

requirement_text: FABS user shall have validations run in a reasonable amount of time.
rationale: "A reasonable amount of time" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: How long is "a reasonable amount of time" for a validation run?
Which validations does this apply to?

requirement_text: For details see [PLGW_R-109] chapter "Setting of SCC installation flag" [SCC-5674].
rationale: The sentence only points to other documents and states no requirement.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced chapter specify?
Is the referenced content part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The product shall comply with insurance regulations regarding claims processing.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall comply with insurance regulations regarding claims processing.'
user_story: As a claims manager, I want the product to comply with insurance regulations on claims processing, so that claims are handled lawfully.
technical_task: Check the claims processing flow against the applicable insurance regulations and implement what they require.
acceptance_criteria: Given the claims processing flow, when it is reviewed against the insurance regulations, then it complies with them.
Given a claim, when it is processed, then the steps required by the insurance regulations are performed.
rationale: Role assumed: claims manager. The regulations are not named.

requirement_text: System shall provide real-time price updates.
user_story: As a trader, I want price updates in real time, so that I see current prices.
technical_task: Push price updates to the display as they happen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a price changes, when the change occurs, then the displayed price is updated.
Given the price display is open, when several updates arrive, then each is shown without a manual refresh.
rationale: Role assumed: trader. "Real-time" is not quantified.

requirement_text: Upon successful login, the user shall be able to browse the catalogue, search for items, or navigate to the Videos and Contact Us sections.
user_story: As a customer, I want to browse the catalogue, search for items or open the Videos and Contact Us sections after logging in, so that I can reach what I need.
technical_task: After a successful login, offer catalogue browsing, item search and navigation to the Videos and Contact Us sections.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when the user lands on the next page, then browsing the catalogue is available.
Given a successful login, when the user looks at the options, then searching for items and navigating to Videos and Contact Us are available.

requirement_text: The offset error of the EgoLane to the driven trajectory shall not be larger than the offset error of the DTR_LaneRadius to the driven trajectory within 90 % of the time period.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the EgoLane offset error to the driven trajectory never to exceed that of the DTR_LaneRadius within 90 % of the time period, so that EgoLane is at least as accurate.
technical_task: Verify that the offset error of the EgoLane to the driven trajectory is not larger than that of the DTR_LaneRadius within 90 % of the time period.
acceptance_criteria: Given a time period, when both offset errors are measured, then the EgoLane error is not larger than the DTR_LaneRadius error within 90 % of the period.
Given the EgoLane error exceeds the DTR_LaneRadius error for longer than the allowed part of the period, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The details on the SCO module integration process shall be agreed on between the contractor and client during a workshop upon project start.
rationale: The sentence describes a project agreement, not a behaviour of the system.
clarification_questions: What details of the SCO module integration process are to be agreed?
What must the system provide, as opposed to what the contractor and client agree?

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to manage tournaments by creating a unique ID for each new tournament, scheduling matches, and conducting one tournament at a time.
user_story: As an admin, I want to manage tournaments by creating a unique ID for each one, scheduling matches and running one tournament at a time, so that tournaments don't overlap.
technical_task: Provide tournament management that generates a unique ID per new tournament, schedules matches and allows only one tournament to be conducted at a time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new tournament, when the admin creates it, then it gets a unique ID.
Given a tournament in progress, when the admin tries to conduct another at the same time, then it is not allowed.

requirement_text: The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case.  This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'
user_story: As a dispute manager, I want the Disputes application to keep a detailed history of every user action on a dispute case, so that a complete audit trail exists.
technical_task: Record each action a user takes on a dispute case and keep the full history for audit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user acts on a dispute case, when the action is completed, then it is added to the case history.
Given a dispute case, when questions arise later, then the history shows every action taken on it.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access the manager homepage after login.
user_story: As a manager, I want to open the manager homepage after logging in, so that I reach my tools.
technical_task: Direct a user who logs in to the manager homepage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manager logs in, when login succeeds, then the manager homepage can be accessed.
Given a user without manager rights logs in, when login succeeds, then the manager homepage is not accessible.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. The second criterion is an assumption about who may see the page.

requirement_text: Details of the end of line alignment process depending on the component have to be agreed with OEM development and production.
rationale: The sentence says details must be agreed with others and states no component behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which details of the end of line alignment process need to be agreed?
What must the component or process do?

requirement_text: User shall be able to select their availability (employee function).
user_story: As an employee, I want to select my availability, so that I can be scheduled when I am free.
technical_task: Add an availability selection for the employee function.
acceptance_criteria: Given the employee function, when an employee selects their availability, then it is saved.
Given a saved availability, when the employee views it, then the selection is shown.

requirement_text: The System shall meet all applicable accounting standards. The final version of the System must successfully pass independent audit performed by a certified auditor.
requirement_text_raw: The System shall meet all applicable accounting standards.  The final version of the System must successfully pass independent audit performed by a certified auditor.'
user_story: As a finance director, I want the system to meet all applicable accounting standards and pass an independent audit by a certified auditor, so that its books can be trusted.
technical_task: Check the system against all applicable accounting standards and have the final version audited by a certified auditor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the applicable accounting standards, when the system is reviewed, then it meets all of them.
Given the final version of the system, when an independent audit by a certified auditor is performed, then the system passes it.
rationale: Role assumed: finance director. The standards are not named.

requirement_text: Upon tapping a specific date, the calendar shall display detailed descriptions in the lower screen section.
user_story: As a user, I want detailed descriptions in the lower screen section when I tap a date, so that I can see what is planned.
technical_task: Show detailed descriptions in the lower part of the screen when a calendar date is tapped.
acceptance_criteria: Given the calendar, when the user taps a specific date, then detailed descriptions are displayed in the lower screen section.
Given a date with nothing planned, when the user taps it, then no descriptions are shown.

requirement_text: System shall be able to read device information and initiate the authorization process.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to read my device information and start authorization, so that I can be granted access.
technical_task: Read device information and trigger the authorization process.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device, when the system reads its information, then the device information is available to the system.
Given the device information has been read, when the system proceeds, then the authorization process is started.

requirement_text: The sensor shall calculate the standard deviation of the estimated distance to the road border and report a correction value for which the reported distance to the road border may be larger.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the sensor to compute the standard deviation of the estimated distance to the road border and report a correction value, so that the distance is known with its uncertainty.
technical_task: Compute the standard deviation of the estimated distance to the road border and report a correction value by which the reported distance may be larger.
acceptance_criteria: Given estimates of the distance to the road border, when the sensor processes them, then it calculates their standard deviation.
Given the standard deviation, when the sensor reports, then it includes a correction value for which the reported distance may be larger.

requirement_text: In the calendar the date entry with a prescription date (i.e. the date of the office visit the medication was prescribed on) shall display a label for the medications prescribed (i.e. NDC see Data Format 6.6) in the prescription.
requirement_text_raw: In the calendar  the date entry with a prescription date (i.e.  the date of the office visit the medication was prescribed on) shall display a label for the medications prescribed (i.e.  NDC  see Data Format 6.6) in the prescription.
user_story: As a patient, I want a prescription date on my calendar to show a label for the medications prescribed at that visit, so that I know which medications were prescribed.
technical_task: Display on the calendar entry of a prescription date a label listing the medications prescribed in that prescription (by NDC, see Data Format 6.6).
acceptance_criteria: Given a date that is a prescription date, when the calendar is displayed, then the date entry shows a label for the medications prescribed.
Given a prescription, when the label is shown, then it identifies the medications by NDC as in Data Format 6.6.

requirement_text: System shall ensure that each doctor is mapped to one and only one specialty.
user_story: As a hospital administrator, I want each doctor mapped to exactly one specialty, so that doctors are listed consistently.
technical_task: Enforce a one-to-one mapping between a doctor and a specialty.
acceptance_criteria: Given a doctor, when the doctor is saved, then the doctor is mapped to one specialty.
Given a doctor who already has a specialty, when a second specialty is assigned, then the assignment is rejected.

requirement_text: The system shall provide summarized and detailed reports on user access usage logs etc.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall provide summarized and detailed reports on user access  usage logs  etc.
user_story: As an administrator, I want summarized and detailed reports on user access and usage logs, so that I can review activity.
technical_task: Produce summary reports and detailed reports based on user access and usage logs.
acceptance_criteria: Given usage logs, when the administrator requests a summary report, then summarized information is shown.
Given usage logs, when the administrator requests a detailed report, then detailed information is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Etc." means other logs may be included; they are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall experience smooth and efficient translation requests handling, even during concurrent usage, facilitated by effective concurrency control mechanisms.
rationale: "Smooth", "efficient" and "effective" are not measurable and no concurrency level is given.
clarification_questions: What counts as "smooth and efficient" handling of translation requests?
How many concurrent users must be supported?

requirement_text: System administration shall be performed using a different username than the one used for daily non-administrative activities.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want to use a different username for administration than for daily non-administrative work, so that admin rights are separate.
technical_task: Require administrators to perform system administration under a username separate from their daily account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a person who administers the system, when the person performs administration, then a username different from the daily one is used.
Given the daily non-administrative username, when the person tries to administer the system with it, then the action is not allowed.

requirement_text: System shall run on devices with less than 1GB RAM.
user_story: As a user with an older device, I want the system to run on devices with less than 1GB RAM, so that I don't need new hardware.
technical_task: Make the system run on devices that have less than 1GB of RAM.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device with less than 1GB RAM, when the system is started, then it runs.
Given a device with less than 1GB RAM, when the system is used, then it keeps working.
rationale: Role assumed: user with an older device.

requirement_text: Click 'Add' and select "Referral" from the drop-down list to begin a new Referral transaction.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to click Add and pick Referral from a drop-down list to begin a referral transaction, so that I can start a referral.
technical_task: Offer an Add button with a drop-down that includes Referral and starts a new Referral transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Given the screen, when the user clicks Add, then a drop-down list is shown that contains Referral.
Given the drop-down list, when the user selects Referral, then a new Referral transaction begins.

requirement_text: System shall adhere to usability standards outlined by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) for intuitive and user-friendly interface design.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface to follow the W3C usability standards, so that it is intuitive and user-friendly.
technical_task: Design the interface to adhere to the usability standards outlined by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).
acceptance_criteria: Given the interface, when it is reviewed against the W3C usability standards, then it adheres to them.
Given the interface design, when a reviewer checks it, then it follows the W3C guidance.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which W3C documents apply is not stated.

requirement_text: The timestamps shall be frozen during TNR until the realignment is complete.
requirement_text_raw: The timestamps shall (3.2.2.7.9) be frozen during TNR until the realignment is complete.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the timestamps frozen during TNR until realignment completes, so that time stays consistent.
technical_task: Hold the timestamps constant during TNR until the realignment is complete.
acceptance_criteria: Given TNR is in progress, when the timestamps are read, then they do not change.
Given the realignment completes, when TNR ends, then the timestamps resume.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. Resuming is an interpretation of "until".

requirement_text: User shall have access to a well-defined incident response plan and incident management procedures within the app to handle security incidents effectively, minimizing their impact.
rationale: "Well-defined", "effectively" and "minimizing" are not measurable and the content is not specified.
clarification_questions: What must the incident response plan and procedures contain?
How is "minimizing their impact" measured?

requirement_text: The system shall be able to perform periodic backups.
user_story: As an administrator, I want periodic backups, so that data can be restored if something fails.
technical_task: Schedule backups to run periodically.
acceptance_criteria: Given the backup schedule, when the scheduled time arrives, then a backup is performed.
Given a completed backup, when an administrator checks it, then the backup is available.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The period is not specified.

requirement_text: Databases shall be protected by username and password authentication.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want databases protected by username and password authentication, so that only authorized users connect.
technical_task: Require username and password authentication for access to the databases.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when a user connects to a database, then access is granted.
Given invalid credentials, when a user connects to a database, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The system shall maintain responsiveness during peak usage with minimal loading times for ebook browsing and opening.
rationale: "Responsiveness", "peak usage" and "minimal loading times" have no measurable values.
clarification_questions: What counts as peak usage and as "minimal" loading time?
What response time is required for browsing and opening ebooks?

requirement_text: If the patient has never stored a security question or answer the user is asked for the random password assigned on creation of the account.
requirement_text_raw: If the patient has never stored a security question or answer  the user is asked for the random password assigned on creation of the account.
user_story: As a patient who never stored a security question, I want to be asked for the random password assigned when my account was created, so that I can still verify myself.
technical_task: When the patient has not stored a security question or answer, ask the user for the random password assigned at account creation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient who has never stored a security question or answer, when the user is verified, then the user is asked for the random password assigned on creation of the account.
Given a patient who has stored a security question and answer, when the user is verified, then the random password is not asked for.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: User shall be able to register or sign up, providing necessary information.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to register by providing the necessary information, so that I can use the application.
technical_task: Offer registration that collects the required information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the user provides the necessary information, then an account is created.
Given the registration form, when required information is missing, then registration is not completed.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. The necessary fields are not listed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow publishers to publish data packages with cached resources on the registry server.
user_story: As a publisher, I want to publish data packages with cached resources on the registry server, so that others can access them.
technical_task: Allow publishers to publish data packages, including cached resources, to the registry server.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data package with cached resources, when the publisher publishes it, then it is available on the registry server.
Given a published data package, when it is retrieved, then its cached resources are included.

requirement_text: LOINC data from this file is added to a listing of allowable physical services (including laboratory procedures that an HCP can use).
user_story: As a clinic administrator, I want LOINC data from the file added to the listing of allowable physical services, so that HCPs can choose from them.
technical_task: Import the LOINC data from the file into the listing of allowable physical services, including laboratory procedures.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file with LOINC data, when it is processed, then the data is added to the listing of allowable physical services.
Given the listing, when an HCP opens it, then the LOINC entries, including laboratory procedures, can be used.

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to Mange accounts.
user_story: As an admin, I want to manage accounts, so that I can control who has access.
technical_task: Provide account management functions for admins.
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin, when the admin opens account management, then accounts are listed.
Given an account, when the admin changes it, then the change is saved.
rationale: Role stated: admin. The management actions are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall integrate with existing University systems such as LDAP for cost-effective administration.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the system to integrate with existing University systems such as LDAP, so that administration costs less.
technical_task: Connect the system to existing University systems, for example LDAP, to reuse their administration.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing University system such as LDAP, when the system is configured to use it, then the integration works.
Given the integration is in place, when an administrator manages users, then the existing University system is used for it.
rationale: Role assumed: system administrator. "Cost-effective" is not measured; the criteria check only the integration.

requirement_text: User shall be able to create a patient profile.
user_story: As a health worker, I want to create a patient profile, so that I can keep a patient's details.
technical_task: Add a form that creates a patient profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given the profile form, when the user enters patient details and saves, then a patient profile is created.
Given a created patient profile, when the user opens it, then the saved details are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: health worker. The profile fields are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall enforce limitations on duplicate registrations to maintain system integrity.
user_story: As an administrator, I want limits on duplicate registrations, so that the system stays consistent.
technical_task: Detect and limit duplicate registrations.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing registration, when a user tries to register again with the same details, then the duplicate is refused.
Given a new registration with different details, when the user registers, then it is accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. What counts as a duplicate is not defined; the criteria assume identical details.

requirement_text: The HCP can edit the patient according to data format 6.4 with all initial values (except patient MID) defaulting to null possibly and possibly 0 as appropriate.
requirement_text_raw: The HCP can edit the patient according to data format 6.4  with all initial values (except patient MID) defaulting to null possibly and possibly 0 as appropriate.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to edit the patient according to data format 6.4 with initial values defaulting to null, or 0 where appropriate, so that new records start clean.
technical_task: Let the HCP edit the patient following data format 6.4, setting all initial values except the patient MID to null by default, or to 0 where that is appropriate.
acceptance_criteria: Given the HCP edits a patient, when the edit screen opens, then the fields follow data format 6.4.
Given a patient with no entered values, when the edit screen opens, then all initial values except the patient MID default to null, or to 0 where appropriate.
rationale: Role stated: HCP. Which fields default to 0 is not given.

requirement_text: If the time-out expires before the other members have room in their input buffers, any member without room in their input buffer shall be ignored, the packet exchanged, and an IBNF time-out recorded.
requirement_text_raw: If the time-out expires before the other members have room in their input buffers, any member without room in their input buffer shall (3.2.2.6.16) be ignored, the packet exchanged, and an IBNF time-out recorded.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a member without room in its input buffer to be ignored, the packet exchanged and an IBNF time-out recorded when the time-out expires, so that the exchange completes.
technical_task: When the time-out expires before all members have room in their input buffers, ignore the members lacking room, exchange the packet and record an IBNF time-out.
acceptance_criteria: Given the time-out expires and a member has no room in its input buffer, when the exchange proceeds, then that member is ignored.
Given the time-out has expired, when the packet is exchanged, then an IBNF time-out is recorded.

requirement_text: User shall/will have access to a simple and intuitive user interface designed for ease of use, especially for elderly patients.
rationale: "Simple", "intuitive" and "ease of use" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How is "simple and intuitive" measured?
What specific needs of elderly patients must be met?

requirement_text: User can create profiles with health worker information, attaching usernames for identification, and supporting multiple users on a single device.
user_story: As a health worker, I want to create profiles with my information and a username, and share one device with other users, so that each person is identified.
technical_task: Support profiles with health worker information and usernames for identification, and allow multiple users on one device.
acceptance_criteria: Given a health worker, when a profile is created, then the health worker information and a username are saved.
Given one device, when several users create profiles, then each user is identified by their own username.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to access help content in both offline and online modes.
user_story: As a user, I want to open help content both offline and online, so that I can get help without a connection.
technical_task: Provide help content that can be opened with or without an internet connection.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is online, when the user opens help, then the help content is shown.
Given the user is offline, when the user opens help, then the help content is shown.

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to manage teams, including creating a unique ID for each team and managing team details.
user_story: As an admin, I want to manage teams with a unique ID for each and editable details, so that teams are kept organized.
technical_task: Provide team management that assigns a unique ID to each team and lets the admin edit team details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new team, when the admin creates it, then it gets a unique ID.
Given an existing team, when the admin edits its details, then the changes are saved.

requirement_text: The server shall have at least 500MB of free disk space even if the IDE is already installed.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the server to have at least 500MB of free disk space even when the IDE is installed, so that it keeps running.
technical_task: Ensure at least 500MB of free disk space on the server, with the IDE already installed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the IDE is installed on the server, when free disk space is checked, then at least 500MB is free.
Given free disk space below 500MB, when it is checked, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: A Data Publishing User shall be able to validate a CSV file before publishing.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to validate a CSV file before publishing, so that errors are found early.
technical_task: Add a validation step for CSV files that runs before publishing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a CSV file, when the Data Publishing User validates it, then the file is checked and the result is reported.
Given a CSV file that failed validation, when the user tries to publish, then the user sees the validation problems first.
rationale: Role stated: Data Publishing User. The validation rules are not given; the second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: System shall provide detailed information on summits for user understanding.
user_story: As an attendee, I want detailed information about summits, so that I understand what each one offers.
technical_task: Show a detail page with information for each summit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a summit, when the user opens it, then detailed information about the summit is shown.
Given two summits, when the user opens each, then each shows its own information.
rationale: Role assumed: attendee. What information counts as detailed is not stated.

requirement_text: The user must fill in the required fields—User Name and Display Name—in the User Information section at the time of creating/adding a new user.
user_story: As an administrator, I want User Name and Display Name to be required when I add a new user, so that every user has both.
technical_task: Make User Name and Display Name required fields in the User Information section when a user is created.
acceptance_criteria: Given the User Information section, when the administrator leaves User Name or Display Name empty and saves, then the user is not created.
Given the User Information section, when the administrator fills in both fields and saves, then the user is created.

requirement_text: During these corrections, the maximum azimuth alignment deviation signalized on bus must not be greater than before correction, with the exception that the maximum azimuth alignment deviation after compensation is verified to be larger.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the maximum azimuth alignment deviation signalized on the bus not to be greater during the corrections than before them, so that corrections do not make alignment worse.
technical_task: Keep the maximum azimuth alignment deviation signalized on the bus from exceeding its value before correction during the corrections, except where the deviation after compensation is verified to be larger.
acceptance_criteria: Given a correction is running, when the maximum azimuth alignment deviation on the bus is read, then it is not greater than before the correction.
Given the deviation after compensation is verified to be larger, when it is evaluated, then this is accepted as the stated exception.

requirement_text: User shall be able to delete a chemist/lab, only if no new prescription is pending.
user_story: As a user, I want to delete a chemist or lab only when no new prescription is pending, so that no prescription is left without one.
technical_task: Allow deletion of a chemist/lab only if it has no new prescription pending.
acceptance_criteria: Given a chemist/lab with no new prescription pending, when the user deletes it, then it is deleted.
Given a chemist/lab with a new prescription pending, when the user tries to delete it, then the deletion is not allowed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to pay bills by choosing payment options, selecting bill type (water, apartment, electricity), and entering the amount to make the payment.
user_story: As a resident, I want to pay bills by choosing a payment option, a bill type and an amount, so that I can settle water, apartment and electricity bills.
technical_task: Build a bill payment flow with payment option selection, a bill type choice of water, apartment or electricity, and amount entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bill payment screen, when the user selects a bill type, then water, apartment and electricity are offered.
Given a chosen payment option and bill type, when the user enters an amount and confirms, then the payment is made.

requirement_text: System shall be available at all times, with downtime limited to server maintenance.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available at all times, with downtime only for server maintenance, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Keep the system available continuously and limit downtime to server maintenance windows.
acceptance_criteria: Given normal operation, when a user opens the system, then it is available.
Given downtime occurs, when its cause is checked, then it was for server maintenance.
rationale: Role assumed: user. No availability percentage is given.

requirement_text: User shall be able to mark suspicious emails as spam by clicking on the spam button.
user_story: As an email user, I want to mark suspicious emails as spam with the spam button, so that they are filtered out.
technical_task: Add a spam button that marks a selected email as spam.
acceptance_criteria: Given a suspicious email, when the user clicks the spam button, then the email is marked as spam.
Given an email marked as spam, when the user views the inbox, then the email is no longer shown in it.
rationale: Role assumed: email user. The second criterion is an interpretation of marking as spam.

requirement_text: User shall access the system 24/7, with planned maintenance during off-peak hours.
user_story: As a user, I want to access the system 24/7, with planned maintenance in off-peak hours, so that I can use it whenever I need.
technical_task: Run the system around the clock and schedule planned maintenance for off-peak hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given any time of day, when a user opens the system, then it is accessible.
Given planned maintenance, when it is scheduled, then it takes place during off-peak hours.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Off-peak hours are not defined.

requirement_text: The details concerning EROTAN have to be implemented according to the EROTAN chapter of AV OBDAL [DI-1130].
rationale: The sentence points to another document for its content.
clarification_questions: What are the EROTAN details?
Which parts of the referenced chapter apply?

requirement_text: The course details shall include title, description, price, duration, instructor information, and enrollment details.
user_story: As a student, I want course details to include the title, description, price, duration, instructor information and enrollment details, so that I can choose a course.
technical_task: Include title, description, price, duration, instructor information and enrollment details in each course's details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a course, when the user opens its details, then the title, description, price and duration are shown.
Given a course, when the user opens its details, then the instructor information and enrollment details are shown.

requirement_text: It does not define protocol, interconnect, or connector details because these details are application-specific.
rationale: The sentence states what is not defined and gives no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What does "It" refer to?
Is this a requirement or a note on scope?

requirement_text: User shall be able to tweet a certain topic.
user_story: As a social media user, I want to tweet about a certain topic, so that I can share my views.
technical_task: Offer a tweet function for posting on a chosen topic.
acceptance_criteria: Given a topic, when the user composes a tweet about it, then the tweet is posted.
Given a posted tweet, when it is viewed, then it shows the topic.
rationale: Role assumed: social media user. "Certain topic" is read as a topic the user picks.

requirement_text: (C) Record the encryption status (enabled or disabled) of electronic health information locally stored on end-user devices by EHR technology in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(e)(3) unless the EHR technology prevents electronic health information from being locally stored on end-user devices (see 170.314(d)(7) of this section).
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the encryption status of locally stored electronic health information on end-user devices recorded, so that I know whether data is protected.
technical_task: Record whether electronic health information stored locally on end-user devices is encrypted, per the standard in 170.210(e)(3), unless the EHR technology prevents local storage (see 170.314(d)(7)).
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information stored locally on an end-user device, when it is stored, then its encryption status (enabled or disabled) is recorded.
Given EHR technology that prevents local storage of electronic health information, when the requirement is applied, then no encryption status needs to be recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The standard is only referenced; the section symbol in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed to facilitate future evolution and maintenance operations.
rationale: "Facilitate future evolution and maintenance" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What kinds of future evolution must the system accommodate?
How is ease of maintenance verified?

requirement_text: The ISYNC procedure shall terminate when all 5 NEs are synchronized, four NEs are synchronized (when only four NEs are powered), or after the time-out period.
requirement_text_raw: The ISYNC procedure shall (3.2.2.3.4) terminate when all 5 NEs are synchronized, four NEs are synchronized (when only four NEs are powered), or after the time-out period.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the ISYNC procedure to end when all 5 NEs are synchronized, when four NEs are synchronized and only four are powered, or when the time-out period passes, so that synchronization does not hang.
technical_task: End the ISYNC procedure when all 5 NEs are synchronized, when four NEs are synchronized and only four are powered, or when the time-out period ends.
acceptance_criteria: Given all 5 NEs are synchronized, when ISYNC checks, then the procedure terminates.
Given only four NEs are powered and all four are synchronized, when ISYNC checks, then the procedure terminates.
Given the time-out period has passed, when ISYNC checks, then the procedure terminates.

requirement_text: The system shall provide emergency communication options, including an emergency phone inside and outside the cabin.
user_story: As a passenger, I want emergency communication options, including an emergency phone inside and outside the cabin, so that I can call for help.
technical_task: Provide emergency communication, including an emergency phone inside the cabin and one outside it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the cabin, when it is inspected, then an emergency phone is available inside it.
Given the area outside the cabin, when it is inspected, then an emergency phone is available there.

requirement_text: User shall have a view showing all attendee information attached to their training node, so trainers can see class attendance.
user_story: As a trainer, I want a view of all attendee information attached to my training node, so that I can see class attendance.
technical_task: Provide a view that shows all attendee information linked to the user's training node.
acceptance_criteria: Given attendees attached to a training node, when the trainer opens the view, then all their information is shown.
Given an attendee not attached to that node, when the trainer opens the view, then the attendee is not shown.

requirement_text: Only authorized workers will be able to access the administrative panel.
user_story: As an administrator, I want only authorized workers to access the administrative panel, so that settings are protected.
technical_task: Restrict the administrative panel to authorized workers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized worker, when the worker opens the administrative panel, then access is granted.
Given a user who is not an authorized worker, when the user opens the administrative panel, then access is denied.

requirement_text: System shall restrict access to modules based on user roles, preventing students from updating marks.
user_story: As a school administrator, I want module access restricted by user role, so that students cannot update marks.
technical_task: Apply role-based access control to modules, denying students the ability to update marks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student, when the student tries to update marks, then the update is not allowed.
Given a user whose role permits it, when the user opens a module, then access is granted.

requirement_text: An FAQ page shall be provided in Webble to explain terms, functionality, and other relevant information.
user_story: As a new user of Webble, I want an FAQ page explaining terms, functionality and other relevant information, so that I can learn how it works.
technical_task: Add an FAQ page to Webble covering terms, functionality and other relevant information.
acceptance_criteria: Given Webble, when a user opens the FAQ page, then it explains terms and functionality.
Given the FAQ page, when a user reads it, then other relevant information is included.
rationale: Role assumed: new user of Webble.

requirement_text: The contractor shall be prepared that the client has the right to require additionally some special solutions for programming persistent ECU memories (e.g., for updating navigation maps).
user_story: As a contractor, I want to be prepared for the client to require additional special solutions for programming persistent ECU memories, so that I can deliver them when asked.
technical_task: Prepare to supply special solutions for programming persistent ECU memories on request, for example for updating navigation maps.
acceptance_criteria: Given the client requires an additional special solution for programming persistent ECU memories, when the request is made, then the contractor is able to provide it.
Given an update of navigation maps is requested, when it is handled, then it is treated as an example of such a solution.
rationale: Role assumed: contractor. The solutions are not specified.

requirement_text: System shall provide error handling and logging to identify and communicate import errors effectively.
user_story: As an administrator, I want error handling and logging for import errors, so that I can find and report problems.
technical_task: Add error handling and logging for imports that identify errors and report them to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given an import with an error, when the import runs, then the error is identified and logged.
Given an import error, when the import ends, then the error is communicated to the user.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Effectively" is not measured.

requirement_text: Once payment has been billed and received from secondary insurance it can be entered in the same way.
requirement_text_raw: Once payment has been billed and received from secondary insurance  it can be entered in the same way.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to enter payment received from secondary insurance the same way as other payments, so that billing is consistent.
technical_task: Allow payment billed and received from secondary insurance to be entered using the same procedure as the earlier payment entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given payment received from secondary insurance, when the clerk enters it, then it is entered in the same way as the earlier payment.
Given the payment has been entered, when the account is viewed, then it is recorded against the account.
rationale: Role assumed: billing clerk. "The same way" refers to a procedure described elsewhere.

requirement_text: While BCMChrgRq greater than 0 for longer than 5 seconds the signal ends.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the signal to end while BCMChrgRq stays greater than 0 for longer than 5 seconds, so that the request does not run on.
technical_task: End the signal when BCMChrgRq has been greater than 0 for longer than 5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given BCMChrgRq is greater than 0, when it stays so for longer than 5 seconds, then the signal ends.
Given BCMChrgRq is greater than 0, when it has done so for 5 seconds or less, then the signal does not end.

requirement_text: The system shall restrict the field to accept only numeric data entry.
user_story: As a user, I want the field to accept only numeric data, so that I cannot enter text by mistake.
technical_task: Restrict the field so only numeric characters are accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Given the field, when the user enters numeric data, then it is accepted.
Given the field, when the user enters non-numeric data, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which field is meant is not named.

requirement_text: The solution should enforce the most restrictive set of rights or privileges or accesses needed by users (or processes acting on behalf of users) for the performance of specified tasks.
user_story: As a security officer, I want users and processes acting for them to have only the most restrictive rights needed for their tasks, so that access is minimal.
technical_task: Enforce least privilege: grant users, and processes acting on their behalf, only the rights, privileges and accesses needed for the specified tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a specified task, when rights are assigned, then only those needed for the task are granted.
Given a process acting on behalf of a user, when it runs, then it has no more rights than the task requires.

requirement_text: The user interface should prioritize simplicity and avoid cluttering with excessive information to enhance usability.
rationale: "Simplicity" and "excessive" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "simplicity" mean in measurable terms?
How much information counts as "excessive"?

requirement_text: System shall enable users to view their signed-up summits for confirmation.
user_story: As an attendee, I want to view the summits I signed up for, so that I can confirm my registration.
technical_task: Show the signed-up summits of the user for confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user signed up for summits, when the user opens their summits, then those summits are listed.
Given a user who has signed up for no summits, when the user opens the list, then it is empty.

requirement_text: The system shall monitor timeliness of messages and alert users if certain time limits have been exceeded.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the system to monitor how timely messages are and alert me when certain time limits are exceeded, so that delayed messages are noticed.
technical_task: Monitor message timeliness and send an alert to users when time limits are exceeded.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message awaiting action, when a time limit is exceeded, then users are alerted.
Given a message handled within its time limit, when it is monitored, then no alert is raised.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The time limits are not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed for easy maintenance to quickly address any errors that occur in the project.
clarification_questions: What makes maintenance "easy", and what is "quickly"?
Which errors does the requirement cover?

requirement_text: User shall be able to access detailed context-sensitive help material for all actions and scenarios.
user_story: As a user, I want detailed context-sensitive help for all actions and scenarios, so that I can learn what to do at each point.
technical_task: Provide help material specific to the current action or scenario.
acceptance_criteria: Given any action, when the user asks for help, then help material for that action is shown.
Given any scenario, when the user asks for help, then help material for that scenario is shown.

requirement_text: User shall save the dividend released by each company for client information.
user_story: As a broker, I want to save the dividend released by each company, so that I can give clients this information.
technical_task: Store the dividend released by each company so it can be shown to clients.
acceptance_criteria: Given a company that releases a dividend, when the user saves it, then the dividend is stored for that company.
Given a stored dividend, when client information is prepared, then the dividend is available.

requirement_text: The system shall enforce data privacy and confidentiality measures to protect sensitive information handled within the command-line interface.
user_story: As a security officer, I want privacy and confidentiality measures for sensitive information handled in the command-line interface, so that data is protected.
technical_task: Apply data privacy and confidentiality controls to sensitive information used in the command-line interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive information is handled in the command-line interface, when it is displayed, then confidentiality measures are applied.
Given sensitive information in the command-line interface, when an unauthorized person tries to access it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The measures are not listed.

requirement_text: The Patient requests the closest hospitals so that only nearby hospitals are presented.
user_story: As a patient, I want to request the closest hospitals, so that only nearby hospitals are presented.
technical_task: Return only the closest hospitals when a patient requests hospitals.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient's location, when the patient requests hospitals, then the closest hospitals are presented.
Given a hospital that is far away, when the patient requests hospitals, then it is not presented.
rationale: Role stated: patient. "Closest" is not defined as a distance.

requirement_text: For details about video processing and transmission see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Video Processing and Transmission" .
requirement_text_raw: For details about video processing and transmission see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Video Processing and Transmission" [RD3649].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced specification say about video processing and transmission?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The system shall prompt customer with friend easy to read error messages.
rationale: The wording is unclear ("friend easy") and readability is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "friend easy to read" mean?
Which error messages are meant, and for which errors?

requirement_text: System shall display collection-level replication status.
user_story: As a repository manager, I want to see the collection-level replication status, so that I know whether collections are replicated.
technical_task: Display replication status at the collection level.
acceptance_criteria: Given a collection, when the user views it, then its replication status is displayed.
Given two collections with different replication states, when each is viewed, then each shows its own status.

requirement_text: The system shall be capable of responding in a loss-less manner to I/O and processing changes arising from Correlator mode changes.
user_story: As an observatory engineer, I want the system to respond without losing data to I/O and processing changes caused by Correlator mode changes, so that observations are not corrupted.
technical_task: Handle I/O and processing changes triggered by Correlator mode changes without loss of data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Correlator mode change, when I/O changes occur, then the system responds without data loss.
Given a Correlator mode change, when processing changes occur, then the system responds without data loss.

requirement_text: System shall verify user input from the database and proceed accordingly, logging the user into the home page.
user_story: As a user, I want my input verified against the database and to be logged in to the home page when it is correct, so that I reach my account.
technical_task: Check the user's input against the database and, if it matches, log the user in and show the home page.
acceptance_criteria: Given input that matches the database, when the user submits it, then the user is logged in to the home page.
Given input that does not match the database, when the user submits it, then the user is not logged in.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Proceed accordingly" is read as continuing to the home page on success.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to do the authentication process for login and payment through bankcard.
user_story: As a customer, I want to authenticate with my bankcard for login and payment, so that I can sign in and pay securely.
technical_task: Implement bankcard-based authentication for the login and payment processes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid bankcard, when the user logs in with it, then the user is authenticated.
Given a valid bankcard, when the user pays with it, then the payment is authenticated.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The authentication method for the card is not specified.

requirement_text: The THEMAS system shall be able to generate and record an event when a heating or cooling request is denied.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the THEMAS system to generate and record an event when a heating or cooling request is denied, so that denials can be reviewed.
technical_task: Create and store an event whenever a heating or cooling request is denied.
acceptance_criteria: Given a heating request is denied, when the denial occurs, then an event is generated and recorded.
Given a cooling request is denied, when the denial occurs, then an event is generated and recorded.

requirement_text: All letter requests must be formatted according to guidelines specified by the Print Letter Utility system.
user_story: As a clerk, I want all letter requests formatted according to the Print Letter Utility guidelines, so that letters print correctly.
technical_task: Format every letter request to follow the guidelines specified by the Print Letter Utility system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a letter request, when it is formatted, then it follows the guidelines of the Print Letter Utility system.
Given a letter request that does not follow the guidelines, when it is submitted, then it is not accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: clerk. The guidelines are not quoted.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability for attestation of attestable EMR content by the content's author.
user_story: As an author, I want to attest EMR content that I wrote, so that it is marked as verified by me.
technical_task: Let the content's author attest attestable EMR content.
acceptance_criteria: Given attestable EMR content, when its author attests it, then the attestation is recorded.
Given attestable EMR content, when someone other than its author tries to attest it, then the attestation is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician author. The second criterion follows from "by the content's author".

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide an API call which allows the application to specify which MPCC channels in a C&T FCR should be used for telemetry and/or command reception.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall (3.3.11.8) provide an API call which allows the application to specify which MPCC channels in a C&T FCR should be used for telemetry and/or command reception.
user_story: As an application developer, I want an FTSS API call to specify which MPCC channels in a C&T FCR are used for telemetry and/or command reception, so that I can select channels.
technical_task: Expose an FTSS API call through which an application chooses the MPCC channels of a C&T FCR used for telemetry and/or command reception.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application, when it calls the FTSS API with MPCC channels of a C&T FCR, then those channels are used for telemetry and/or command reception.
Given the FTSS API, when the application calls it, then the channels can be specified for telemetry, command reception or both.

requirement_text: System shall prioritize user-friendly interfaces for easy navigation and data entry.
rationale: "User-friendly" and "easy" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes an interface "user-friendly" in measurable terms?
Which navigation and data entry tasks does this cover?

requirement_text: The system shall enforce strong password management, requiring users to keep passwords confidential and unique for each service.
user_story: As a user, I want strong password management that keeps my passwords confidential and unique for each service, so that my accounts are safe.
technical_task: Enforce password rules that require users to keep passwords confidential and to use a unique password for each service.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user sets a password for a service, when the password matches one used for another service, then it is rejected.
Given a user sets a unique password, when it is saved, then it is accepted and stored confidentially.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Strong" is not defined; the criteria cover uniqueness and confidentiality.

requirement_text: All messages passed between CMCS system layers shall have both UTC and wall clock time stamp information appropriate for the message type.
user_story: As a system engineer, I want every message between CMCS system layers to carry UTC and wall clock time stamps suited to its type, so that messages can be ordered.
technical_task: Attach both a UTC time stamp and a wall clock time stamp, appropriate for the message type, to every message passed between CMCS system layers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message passed between CMCS system layers, when it is sent, then it carries a UTC time stamp.
Given a message passed between CMCS system layers, when it is sent, then it also carries a wall clock time stamp appropriate for its type.

requirement_text: System shall be able to display a No results found message when no search results are found.
user_story: As a user, I want to see a No results found message when my search finds nothing, so that I know the search worked.
technical_task: Display "No results found" when a search returns no results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search with no matching results, when the search completes, then a No results found message is displayed.
Given a search with matching results, when the search completes, then the results are shown and the message is not displayed.

requirement_text: System shall ensure compatibility with various data formats and standards for interoperability.
rationale: "Various data formats and standards" are not named.
clarification_questions: Which data formats and standards must be supported?
What interoperability scenarios are expected?

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall , if alignment is permitted, serially incorporate two new channels if they are powered on simultaneously.
requirement_text_raw: 2.     Redundancy Management shall [SRS236], if alignment is permitted, serially incorporate two new channels if they are powered on simultaneously.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to incorporate two newly powered channels one after the other when alignment is permitted, so that they join in order.
technical_task: When alignment is permitted and two new channels are powered on at the same time, incorporate them serially.
acceptance_criteria: Given alignment is permitted and two new channels are powered on simultaneously, when Redundancy Management incorporates them, then it incorporates them one after another.
Given alignment is not permitted, when two new channels are powered on, then this requirement does not apply.

requirement_text: The system shall display user-friendly, one-click selectable results in the list view.
user_story: As a user, I want results in the list view that I can select with one click, so that I can open them quickly.
technical_task: Make each result in the list view selectable with a single click.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list view, when results are displayed, then each result can be selected.
Given a result in the list view, when the user clicks it once, then it is selected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "User-friendly" is read as one-click selection.

requirement_text: No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.
user_story: As a claims manager, I want only users with an adjuster role to request recycled parts audits, so that audits are controlled.
technical_task: Allow only users with the adjuster role to request recycled parts audits.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the adjuster role, when the user requests a recycled parts audit, then the request is accepted.
Given a user without the adjuster role, when the user requests a recycled parts audit, then the request is refused.

requirement_text: The TCS shall receive, process, and present payload data to the operator so that the status of the payload can be determined.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want the TCS to receive, process and present payload data, so that I can determine the status of the payload.
technical_task: Receive and process payload data in the TCS and show it to the operator.
acceptance_criteria: Given payload data, when the TCS receives it, then it is processed.
Given processed payload data, when the operator opens the display, then the data is presented so the payload status can be determined.

requirement_text: Secure connection to an internal system shall be required for user login and identification.
user_story: As a user, I want a secure connection to an internal system for login and identification, so that my credentials are protected.
technical_task: Require a secure connection to the internal system for login and user identification.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user logs in, when the system connects to the internal system, then the connection is secure.
Given a connection that is not secure, when a user tries to log in, then login is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The type of secure connection is not specified.

requirement_text: Database keys connections passwords or other secrets are not stored in plain text.
requirement_text_raw: Database keys  connections  passwords  or other secrets are not stored in plain text.
user_story: As a security engineer, I want database keys, connections, passwords and other secrets never stored in plain text, so that they cannot be read if storage is exposed.
technical_task: Store database keys, connections, passwords and other secrets only in protected form.
acceptance_criteria: Given a secret such as a password, when it is stored, then it is not stored in plain text.
Given stored secrets, when the storage is inspected, then none is readable in plain text.

requirement_text: The product shall interface with the ChoiceParts system once per day at approximately 1:00 AM.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall interface with the ChoiceParts system once per day at approximately 1:00 AM.'
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the product to interface with the ChoiceParts system once per day at approximately 1:00 AM, so that data stays in sync.
technical_task: Schedule a daily interface run with the ChoiceParts system at approximately 1:00 AM.
acceptance_criteria: Given a normal day, when the time reaches approximately 1:00 AM, then the product interfaces with the ChoiceParts system.
Given a single day, when the interface has run, then it does not run again until the next day.

requirement_text: Memory alignment shall reset the watchdog timer such that, in the absence of a fault, the timer never expires and resets the processor.
requirement_text_raw: Memory alignment shall [SRS294] reset the watchdog timer such that, in the absence of a fault, the timer never expires and resets the processor.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want memory alignment to reset the watchdog timer so that it never expires without a fault, so that the processor is not reset needlessly.
technical_task: Have memory alignment reset the watchdog timer so that, with no fault, the timer does not expire and reset the processor.
acceptance_criteria: Given no fault is present, when memory alignment runs, then the watchdog timer is reset.
Given no fault is present, when time passes, then the watchdog timer never expires and the processor is not reset.

requirement_text: FTSS shall route messages to the proper virtual group(s) and socket.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS227] route messages to the proper virtual group(s) and socket.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to route messages to the proper virtual group or groups and socket, so that messages reach their destination.
technical_task: Route each message to the correct virtual group(s) and socket inside FTSS.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message addressed to a virtual group and socket, when FTSS routes it, then it is delivered to that virtual group and socket.
Given a message addressed to several virtual groups, when FTSS routes it, then it is delivered to each of them.

requirement_text: Additionally, FDIR shall reinitialize and integrate the NE.
requirement_text_raw: Additionally, FDIR shall (3.3.5.25) reinitialize and integrate the NE.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to reinitialize and integrate the NE, so that the NE rejoins the system.
technical_task: Have FDIR reinitialize the NE and then integrate it back into the configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE that needs recovery, when FDIR acts, then the NE is reinitialized.
Given a reinitialized NE, when FDIR continues, then the NE is integrated.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "Additionally" refers to preceding requirements not shown.

requirement_text: System shall display related items to the items already bought by the user.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to see items related to those I already bought, so that I can discover what goes with them.
technical_task: Recommend items related to the user's previous purchases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has bought items, when the user opens the recommendations, then items related to the bought items are displayed.
Given a user with no purchases, when the user opens the recommendations, then no purchase-based items are displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. How items are related is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall utilize a video splitter to divide large video files into smaller chunks for efficient processing within the system.
user_story: As a video editor, I want large video files split into smaller chunks, so that they are processed efficiently.
technical_task: Add a video splitter that divides large video files into smaller chunks before processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large video file, when it is processed, then the video splitter divides it into smaller chunks.
Given the chunks, when processing runs, then each chunk is processed within the system.
rationale: Role assumed: video editor. What counts as large is not stated.

requirement_text: Recreation of Inventory Quantity Adjustment for the period of previous 30 days shall take no more than 30min.
requirement_text_raw: Recreation of Inventory Quantity Adjustment for the period of previous 30 days shall take no more than 30min.'
user_story: As an inventory manager, I want to recreate an Inventory Quantity Adjustment for the previous 30 days in no more than 30min, so that I can fix records quickly.
technical_task: Limit recreation of the Inventory Quantity Adjustment for the previous 30 days to 30min.
acceptance_criteria: Given the previous 30 days of data, when the Inventory Quantity Adjustment is recreated, then it takes no more than 30min.
Given a recreation that takes longer than 30min, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Now you will see a block of available time slots for that provider's schedule.
rationale: The sentence reads as help text and says "Now" without context.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an instruction to the user?
What must the system show for the provider's schedule?

requirement_text: The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall achieve a 98\% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2\% of the available online time.'
user_story: As a user, I want the product to achieve 98% uptime and fail for no more than 2% of the available online time, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Meet 98% uptime and keep failures within 2% of the available online time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a measurement period, when uptime is calculated, then it is at least 98%.
Given the available online time, when failures are summed, then they are no more than 2% of it.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The measurement period is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to translate EML datasets to Data Packages.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to translate EML datasets to Data Packages, so that I can publish them in that format.
technical_task: Implement a conversion from EML datasets to Data Packages.
acceptance_criteria: Given an EML dataset, when the user starts the translation, then a Data Package is produced.
Given a produced Data Package, when it is compared with the EML dataset, then it contains the same dataset content.
rationale: Role assumed: data publisher. Content equivalence is an interpretation of "translate".

requirement_text: The Scheduler shall support three rate groups: 50 Hz (minor frame), 10 Hz (medium frame), and 1 Hz (major frame).
requirement_text_raw: The Scheduler shall (3.3.4.1) support three rate groups: 50 Hz (minor frame), 10 Hz (medium frame), and 1 Hz (major frame).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Scheduler to support three rate groups: 50 Hz (minor frame), 10 Hz (medium frame) and 1 Hz (major frame), so that tasks run at the right rates.
technical_task: Implement three rate groups in the Scheduler: 50 Hz as the minor frame, 10 Hz as the medium frame and 1 Hz as the major frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Scheduler, when a task is assigned to the 50 Hz rate group, then it runs once per minor frame.
Given the Scheduler, when tasks are assigned to the 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate groups, then they run once per medium frame and once per major frame respectively.

requirement_text: Click 'Expand' next to the desired Encounter to view it's details.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to click Expand next to an Encounter to see its details, so that I can review the encounter.
technical_task: Add an Expand control next to each Encounter that shows its details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of Encounters, when the user clicks Expand next to one, then its details are shown.
Given an expanded Encounter, when the user views it, then the details of only that Encounter are shown.

requirement_text: Interaction between users must be secured to maintain privacy.
rationale: "Interaction between users" and "secured" are too general to turn into testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What kinds of interaction between users are meant?
What does "secured" require (encryption, authentication, access control)?

requirement_text: If IBIT fails, the FTSS SW shall handle the failure as stated in the preceding IBIT requirements and in requirement 3.3.5.29’s table, FTPP Failure Response/Recovery Mechanisms.
requirement_text_raw: If IBIT fails, the FTSS SW shall (3.3.2.41) handle the failure as stated in the preceding IBIT requirements and in requirement 3.3.5.29’s table, FTPP Failure Response/Recovery Mechanisms.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software to handle an IBIT failure as stated in the preceding IBIT requirements and the requirement 3.3.5.29 table, so that failures get the defined response.
technical_task: Handle an IBIT failure in the FTSS SW as set out in the preceding IBIT requirements and in the table FTPP Failure Response/Recovery Mechanisms of requirement 3.3.5.29.
acceptance_criteria: Given IBIT fails, when the FTSS SW handles the failure, then it follows the preceding IBIT requirements.
Given IBIT fails, when the FTSS SW handles the failure, then it follows the table FTPP Failure Response/Recovery Mechanisms in requirement 3.3.5.29.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The referenced table is not shown.

requirement_text: The system shall perform a search on the [system name] user display name and user name columns in the user tables to find the user and verify the user’s existence.
rationale: The text contains an unfilled placeholder, "[system name]".
clarification_questions: What is the actual system name, given "[system name]" is a placeholder?
Which tables and columns are meant?

requirement_text: The scheduler shall provide an API call for an FCP application task to alert the scheduler of a vehicle mode change.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS019] provide an API call for an FCP application task to alert the scheduler of a vehicle mode change.
user_story: As an application developer, I want a scheduler API call to tell the scheduler of a vehicle mode change from an FCP application task, so that scheduling follows the mode.
technical_task: Provide a scheduler API call that an FCP application task uses to notify the scheduler of a vehicle mode change.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP application task, when it calls the API to report a vehicle mode change, then the scheduler is alerted.
Given the scheduler is alerted, when it processes the change, then it knows the vehicle mode has changed.

requirement_text: The flight NE shall be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein after being subjected to a total of six impact shocks, consisting of six shocks (one in each opposite direction) along each of three orthogonal axes.
requirement_text_raw: The flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.3.4.1) be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein after being subjected to a total of six impact shocks, consisting of six shocks (one in each opposite direction) along each of three orthogonal axes.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the flight NE to meet its performance requirements after six impact shocks, one in each opposite direction along each of three orthogonal axes, so that it survives launch handling.
technical_task: Design the flight NE to comply with all performance requirements after a total of six impact shocks, one in each direction along each of three orthogonal axes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flight NE has been subjected to a total of six impact shocks, one in each opposite direction along each of three orthogonal axes, when its performance is tested, then it complies with the performance requirements.
Given the flight NE after the shocks, when a performance requirement is checked, then it is met.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The reason (launch handling) is inferred.

requirement_text: Once every medium frame, the FTSS software shall accept a pointer from the telemetry program to the buffer space containing the telemetry data.
requirement_text_raw: Once every medium frame, the FTSS software shall (3.4.2.3) accept a pointer from the telemetry program to the buffer space containing the telemetry data.
user_story: As a software developer, I want the FTSS software to accept a pointer to the telemetry buffer from the telemetry program once every medium frame, so that telemetry data can be exchanged.
technical_task: Accept, once per medium frame, a pointer from the telemetry program to the buffer holding the telemetry data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a medium frame, when the telemetry program provides a pointer to the buffer space, then the FTSS software accepts it.
Given consecutive medium frames, when they run, then the pointer is accepted once in each frame.

requirement_text: User shall be informed about system failures through error messages displayed on the main screen.
user_story: As a user, I want to see error messages on the main screen when the system fails, so that I know something is wrong.
technical_task: Show system failure notifications as error messages on the main screen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a system failure, when it occurs, then an error message is displayed on the main screen.
Given no system failure, when the user views the main screen, then no failure message is displayed.

requirement_text: In case that the electronics for isolation measurement failed, a worst case value less than 100 Ohm / Volt is assumed (internal and external).
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want a worst case value of less than 100 Ohm / Volt to be assumed when the electronics for isolation measurement fail, so that safety is preserved.
technical_task: Assume a worst case isolation value of less than 100 Ohm / Volt, internal and external, when the isolation measurement electronics have failed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the electronics for isolation measurement have failed, when the isolation value is needed, then a worst case value of less than 100 Ohm / Volt is assumed.
Given the failure, when the assumption is applied, then it covers both the internal and the external values.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner will be compatible with a wide range of web browsers and devices commonly used by kids and their parents/guardians.
