rationale: "A wide range" and "commonly used" are not specific enough to test.
clarification_questions: Which browsers and devices make up "a wide range"?
What versions must be supported?

requirement_text: Colleges shall be able to register for exams at any time.
user_story: As a college administrator, I want to register for exams at any time, so that I am not limited by a registration window.
technical_task: Allow colleges to register for exams without a time restriction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a college, when it registers for an exam at any time of day, then the registration is accepted.
Given a college, when it registers on any day, then the registration is accepted.

requirement_text: The system shall confirm the successful creation of a new user account.
user_story: As a new user, I want confirmation that my account was created, so that I know registration worked.
technical_task: Show a confirmation after a user account is created successfully.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful account creation, when it completes, then a confirmation is shown.
Given a failed account creation, when it ends, then no success confirmation is shown.

requirement_text: The application shall be easy to maintain, with access restricted to a select group of authorized personnel to maintain integrity.
rationale: "Easy to maintain" is subjective and the authorized group is not named.
clarification_questions: What makes the application "easy to maintain" in measurable terms?
Which personnel form the "select group" and what access do they get?

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add a title for the new task.
user_story: As a user, I want to add a title to a new task, so that I can recognize it later.
technical_task: Add a title field to the new task form.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new task form, when the user enters a title and saves, then the task is saved with that title.
Given a saved task, when the user views it, then the title is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to purchase products using a valid credit card.
user_story: As a customer, I want to purchase products with a valid credit card, so that I can pay for my order.
technical_task: Accept valid credit cards as payment for product purchases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid credit card, when the customer pays, then the purchase is completed.
Given an invalid credit card, when the customer pays, then the purchase is not completed.

requirement_text: The website should have an African feel but should not alienate non-Africans. The website should use animation on pages which are describing the services to grab the users attention and encourage them to sign up.
requirement_text_raw: The website should have an African feel  but should not alienate non-Africans.  The website should use animation on pages which are describing the services  to grab the users attention and encourage them to sign up.'
rationale: "African feel", "alienate" and "grab attention" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes a website feel African without alienating non-Africans?
Which pages need animation, and how is attention measured?

requirement_text: Verification department employees shall verify and approve or disapprove applications upon receiving requests from agents.
user_story: As a verification officer, I want to verify and approve or disapprove applications when agents send requests, so that applications are checked.
technical_task: Let verification department employees verify applications received from agents and approve or disapprove them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request from an agent, when a verification department employee reviews the application, then the employee can verify it.
Given a verified application, when the employee decides, then the application is approved or disapproved.
rationale: Role stated: verification department employee and agent.

requirement_text: User shall enter the received OTP.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter the OTP I received, so that I can complete verification.
technical_task: Provide a field where the user enters the received OTP.
acceptance_criteria: Given an OTP has been sent, when the user enters it in the field, then the system accepts the entry for checking.
Given the OTP field, when the user leaves it empty and submits, then the system asks for the OTP.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Validating the OTP is covered by a separate requirement.

requirement_text: The system shall provide a backup and automatic restore facility using an online cloud database to store all user data upon permission, with the ability to restore the information on any device.
user_story: As a user, I want my data backed up to an online cloud database with my permission and restorable on any device, so that I don't lose it.
technical_task: Provide backup and automatic restore using an online cloud database for all user data with the user's permission, restorable on any device.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user gives permission, when a backup runs, then all user data is stored in the online cloud database.
Given a backup exists, when the user restores it on any device, then the information is restored.

requirement_text: System shall let the administrator add/remove categories on the website in under 5 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: System shall let the administrator add/remove categories on the website in under 5 minutes.'
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add or remove categories on the website in under 5 minutes, so that updates are quick.
technical_task: Ensure adding or removing a website category takes the administrator less than 5 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the administrator, when a category is added, then the task takes under 5 minutes.
Given the administrator, when a category is removed, then the task takes under 5 minutes.

requirement_text: A state change must only happen if the change condition is true longer than 50 milliseconds.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a state change to occur only when the change condition has been true for longer than 50 milliseconds, so that short glitches are ignored.
technical_task: Debounce state changes so they take effect only after the change condition holds for more than 50 milliseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change condition that is true for longer than 50 milliseconds, when the time passes, then the state change happens.
Given a change condition that is true for no more than 50 milliseconds, when the time passes, then no state change happens.

requirement_text: Memory scrubbing shall be executed without interfering with normal execution of applications tasks.
requirement_text_raw: Memory scrubbing shall (3.3.8.5) be executed without interfering with normal execution of applications tasks.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want memory scrubbing to run without interfering with the normal execution of application tasks, so that tasks are not disturbed.
technical_task: Run memory scrubbing so that it does not interfere with the normal execution of application tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory scrubbing is running, when application tasks execute, then they execute normally.
Given memory scrubbing is running, when it is compared with a run without scrubbing, then application task execution is not interfered with.

requirement_text: The system shall notify customers about the status of their insurance policies.
user_story: As a policyholder, I want to be notified about the status of my insurance policies, so that I know where they stand.
technical_task: Notify customers about the status of their insurance policies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a policy, when its status changes, then the customer is notified.
Given a customer with several policies, when statuses change, then the customer is notified about each policy.
rationale: Role assumed: policyholder. The notification channel is not stated.

requirement_text: The MET shall be initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame.
requirement_text_raw: The MET shall (3.3.10.5) be initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the MET initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame, so that elapsed time starts from a known value.
technical_task: Set the MET to zero when the first 50 Hz frame starts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system starts, when the first 50 Hz frame begins, then the MET is zero.
Given later 50 Hz frames, when they begin, then the MET is not reset to zero by this initialization.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "first".

requirement_text: Only managers are able to perform search queries for reservations by user. 100% of all search queries for reservations by user shall be from logons of only management logons.
requirement_text_raw: Only managers are able to perform search queries for reservations by user.  100\% of all search queries for reservations by user shall be from logons of only management logons.'
user_story: As a manager, I want only managers to search reservations by user, so that user reservation data stays restricted.
technical_task: Restrict search of reservations by user to management logons so that 100% of such searches come from management logons.
acceptance_criteria: Given a management logon, when it searches reservations by user, then the search is performed.
Given a logon that is not a management logon, when it tries to search reservations by user, then the search is refused.
rationale: Role stated: manager. The 100% figure is covered by the second criterion.

requirement_text: If a request is approved, the status will be marked as "Borrow" with an end date.
user_story: As a librarian, I want an approved request to be marked "Borrow" with an end date, so that I can see when the item is due back.
technical_task: When a request is approved, set its status to "Borrow" and store an end date.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request is approved, when the approval is saved, then its status is "Borrow".
Given a request is approved, when the approval is saved, then an end date is set on it.
rationale: Role assumed: librarian. How the end date is chosen is not stated.

requirement_text: Under all circumstances the sensor 's output pulses must be a true image of the moving target teeth, e.g. while change of rotational direction at any angle position, under vibration effects or at strong temperature change no "missing tooth" or additional pulse may occur, also after longer stop-periods and temperature changes (stop-start-mode of the engine).
user_story: As a sensor engineer, I want the sensor's output pulses to be a true image of the moving target teeth under all circumstances, so that no tooth is missed and no pulse is added.
technical_task: Verify that the output pulses stay a true image of the target teeth, with no "missing tooth" and no additional pulse, during direction changes at any angle position, vibration, strong temperature change and after longer stop periods.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change of rotational direction at any angle position, when the sensor outputs pulses, then no "missing tooth" or additional pulse occurs.
Given vibration or strong temperature change, when the sensor outputs pulses, then no "missing tooth" or additional pulse occurs.
Given longer stop periods and temperature changes in the stop-start-mode of the engine, when the sensor restarts, then no "missing tooth" or additional pulse occurs.
rationale: Role assumed: sensor engineer. "Strong" temperature change is not quantified.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to highlight text, add notes, and create bookmarks.
user_story: As a reader, I want to highlight text, add notes and create bookmarks, so that I can mark what matters.
technical_task: Add text highlighting, note taking and bookmark creation to the reading view.
acceptance_criteria: Given displayed text, when the user highlights a passage, then the highlight is saved.
Given displayed text, when the user adds a note or creates a bookmark, then the note or bookmark is saved.

requirement_text: The NE shall support at least two physical processors per FCR.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.3.2.2) support at least two physical processors per FCR.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the NE to support at least two physical processors per FCR, so that redundancy is possible.
technical_task: Design the NE with room for at least two physical processors for each FCR.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCR, when the NE is configured, then at least two physical processors are supported.
Given an FCR with two physical processors, when the NE starts, then both are recognized.

requirement_text: A successful login brings you to the appointment calendar.
user_story: As a patient, I want a successful login to bring me to the appointment calendar, so that I can see my appointments first.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the appointment calendar after a successful login.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the user logs in successfully, then the appointment calendar is displayed.
Given invalid credentials, when the user tries to log in, then the appointment calendar is not displayed.

requirement_text: HCP must enter the MID of a patient and then enter or edit demographic information with the exception of the patient's security question or password according to data format 6.1.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to enter a patient's MID and then enter or edit demographic information, except the security question and password, so that demographics are kept up to date.
technical_task: Require the patient's MID first, then allow entry and editing of demographic information per data format 6.1, excluding the security question and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given the HCP enters a patient's MID, when the MID is accepted, then demographic information can be entered or edited.
Given the demographic form, when the HCP edits it, then the patient's security question and password cannot be changed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow authorized users to update the directory.
user_story: As an authorized user, I want to update the directory, so that its entries stay current.
technical_task: Allow authorized users to change directory entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user updates the directory, then the change is saved.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to update the directory, then the update is refused.

requirement_text: All FCP processing channels (up to 4) shall be incorporated into the FCP virtual group as they become available, provided that recovery and memory alignment is allowed by the application software.
requirement_text_raw: All FCP processing channels (up to 4) shall (3.1.23) be incorporated into the FCP virtual group as they become available, provided that recovery and memory alignment is allowed by the application software.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want all FCP processing channels (up to 4) to join the FCP virtual group as they become available, if the application software allows recovery and memory alignment, so that capacity is used.
technical_task: Incorporate each FCP processing channel (up to 4) into the FCP virtual group as soon as it becomes available, provided recovery and memory alignment are allowed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a channel becomes available and recovery and memory alignment are allowed, when it is detected, then it is incorporated into the FCP virtual group.
Given recovery or memory alignment is not allowed by the application software, when a channel becomes available, then it is not incorporated.

requirement_text: The system shall be compatible with various operating systems and file formats.
rationale: "Various operating systems and file formats" are not named.
clarification_questions: Which operating systems and file formats must be supported?
Which versions are in scope?

requirement_text: Communication services shall detect message passing between application tasks living on the same virtual group and bypass the usage of the network element.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS051] detect message passing between application tasks living on the same virtual group and bypass the usage of the network element.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to detect message passing between tasks on the same virtual group and bypass the network element, so that local messages are quick.
technical_task: Detect messages between application tasks in the same virtual group and deliver them without using the network element.
acceptance_criteria: Given two application tasks on the same virtual group, when one sends a message to the other, then the message passing is detected.
Given such a message, when it is delivered, then the network element is not used.

requirement_text: All graphics will be in 16 bit colour.
user_story: As a user, I want all graphics in 16 bit colour, so that the display looks consistent.
technical_task: Render every graphic with 16 bit colour.
acceptance_criteria: Given any graphic in the application, when it is displayed, then it uses 16 bit colour.
Given the set of graphics, when they are reviewed, then none uses a different colour depth.

requirement_text: The contractor shall prepare the architecture to be able to introduce additional variants for certain countries, such as China.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the contractor to prepare the architecture for additional variants for certain countries, such as China, so that variants can be added later.
technical_task: Prepare the architecture so that additional country-specific variants, for example for China, can be introduced.
acceptance_criteria: Given the architecture, when a variant for a certain country is introduced, then it can be added without redesigning the architecture.
Given the architecture documentation, when it is reviewed, then it shows how additional country variants are introduced.
rationale: Role assumed: project manager. Which countries are covered beyond China is not stated.

requirement_text: The building, subsystems, and condition windows shall display the current time if the diagnostic tool is operating in real time.
user_story: As a technician, I want the building, subsystems and condition windows to show the current time while the diagnostic tool runs in real time, so that I can relate readings to time.
technical_task: Display the current time in the building, subsystems and condition windows when the diagnostic tool operates in real time.
acceptance_criteria: Given the diagnostic tool is operating in real time, when the building window is shown, then it displays the current time.
Given the diagnostic tool is operating in real time, when the subsystems and condition windows are shown, then they display the current time.

requirement_text: The system shall be user-friendly for various user roles (archivists, researchers, donors).
clarification_questions: What makes the system "user-friendly" for archivists, researchers and donors, measurably?
Do the three roles need different behaviour?

requirement_text: The system shall provide the ability for authorized administrators to assign restrictions or privileges to users or groups.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to assign restrictions or privileges to users or groups, so that access is controlled.
technical_task: Allow authorized administrators to assign restrictions and privileges to individual users and to groups.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized administrator, when the administrator assigns a privilege to a user, then the privilege applies to that user.
Given an authorized administrator, when the administrator assigns a restriction to a group, then it applies to the group's members.

requirement_text: The telemetry capability shall transfer the telemetry block from the FCP to the FCC-MPCC connected to the CTC.
requirement_text_raw: The telemetry capability shall [SRS149] transfer the telemetry block from the FCP to the FCC-MPCC connected to the CTC.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the telemetry capability to move the telemetry block from the FCP to the FCC-MPCC connected to the CTC, so that telemetry reaches the CTC.
technical_task: Transfer the telemetry block from the FCP to the FCC-MPCC that is connected to the CTC.
acceptance_criteria: Given a telemetry block on the FCP, when the telemetry capability runs, then the block is transferred to the FCC-MPCC.
Given the FCC-MPCC that is connected to the CTC, when the block arrives, then it is available for the CTC.

requirement_text: User shall experience continuous improvement in translation accuracy over time through machine learning algorithms analyzing user interactions and feedback.
rationale: "Continuous improvement" has no measurable target and the learning method is only loosely described.
clarification_questions: How is "continuous improvement" in translation accuracy measured?
Which accuracy metric and target should apply?

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to attribute record and display the identity of all users contributing to or finalizing a document or note including the date and time of entry (see appropriate criteria in IN.2.2 (Auditable Records)).
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide the ability to attribute record and display the identity of all users contributing to or finalizing a document or note  including the date and time of entry (see appropriate criteria in IN.2.2 (Auditable Records)).
user_story: As an auditor, I want the identity of every user contributing to or finalizing a document or note recorded and displayed with the date and time of entry, so that authorship is clear.
technical_task: Record and display the identity of all users who contribute to or finalize a document or note, along with the date and time of entry, following IN.2.2 (Auditable Records).
acceptance_criteria: Given a user contributes to a document or note, when the contribution is saved, then the user's identity and the date and time of entry are recorded.
Given a document or note, when it is displayed, then the identities of all contributors and of the user who finalized it are shown with the date and time of entry.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. The criteria in IN.2.2 are only referenced.

requirement_text: The timestamps shall be congruent across all members of the destination FCP.
requirement_text_raw: The timestamps shall (3.2.2.7.2) be congruent across all members of the destination FCP.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the timestamps to be congruent across all members of the destination FCP, so that they share the same time.
technical_task: Keep timestamps congruent on every member of the destination FCP.
acceptance_criteria: Given the members of the destination FCP, when their timestamps are compared, then they are congruent.
Given an operation that updates timestamps, when it completes, then all members of the destination FCP still have congruent timestamps.

requirement_text: Database will mark the account as inactive and user will not be able to log into the website.
requirement_text_raw: Database will mark the account as inactive  and user will not be able to log into the website.
user_story: As an administrator, I want an account marked inactive in the database to be unable to log in to the website, so that inactive users are locked out.
technical_task: Mark an account as inactive in the database and refuse website login for inactive accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account marked inactive, when the user tries to log in, then login is refused.
Given an account that is active, when the user tries to log in, then login is allowed.

requirement_text: If AC_InstantLineVoltage is smaller than 25 volts, the global variable shall be set to 0.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the global variable set to 0 when AC_InstantLineVoltage is smaller than 25 volts, so that low line voltage is flagged.
technical_task: Set the global variable to 0 whenever AC_InstantLineVoltage is below 25 volts.
acceptance_criteria: Given AC_InstantLineVoltage is smaller than 25 volts, when it is evaluated, then the global variable is set to 0.
Given AC_InstantLineVoltage is not smaller than 25 volts, when it is evaluated, then this rule does not set the variable to 0.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The name of the global variable is not given.

requirement_text: Each interrupt shall be preceded by the FCP writing the information listed in 3.4.1.1.1-6 to a shared memory block over the VME backplane bus to its counterpart ICP.
requirement_text_raw: Each interrupt shall (3.4.1.2.7) be preceded by the FCP writing the information listed in 3.4.1.1.1-6 to a shared memory block over the VME backplane bus to its counterpart ICP.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP to write the listed information to a shared memory block over the VME backplane bus before each interrupt, so that the ICP has the data it needs.
technical_task: Before every interrupt, write the information listed in 3.4.1.1.1-6 from the FCP to a shared memory block on the VME backplane bus for its counterpart ICP.
acceptance_criteria: Given an interrupt is about to be sent, when the FCP prepares it, then the information listed in 3.4.1.1.1-6 is written to the shared memory block.
Given the information is written, when the counterpart ICP reads the shared memory block, then it is available over the VME backplane bus.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The listed items are not given.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to create views that prohibit patients from accessing certain information according to organizational policy scope of practice and jurisdictional law.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide the ability to create views that prohibit patients from accessing certain information according to organizational policy  scope of practice  and jurisdictional law.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want to create views that stop patients from seeing certain information, so that disclosure follows policy and law.
technical_task: Support creating views that prohibit patients from accessing certain information according to organizational policy, scope of practice and jurisdictional law.
acceptance_criteria: Given a view that prohibits certain information, when a patient opens it, then the information is not shown.
Given the policy that applies, when a view is created, then it reflects the organizational policy, scope of practice and jurisdictional law.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The prohibited information is not listed.

requirement_text: Delivery boy shall be able to receive payment if the order is done with cash.
user_story: As a delivery boy, I want to receive payment when the order is paid in cash, so that I can collect what is owed.
technical_task: Let the delivery boy receive and record payment for cash orders.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order paid with cash, when the delivery boy delivers it, then the delivery boy can receive the payment.
Given an order paid by another method, when it is delivered, then no cash payment is requested.

requirement_text: The system shall deliver rapid responses to user requests under 24/7 operation for both internal and enforcement authority use (acceptable response time < 1 minute).
user_story: As an enforcement officer, I want rapid responses to my requests around the clock, with an acceptable response time of less than 1 minute, so that I can work without waiting.
technical_task: Operate 24/7 for internal and enforcement authority use and keep response time below 1 minute.
acceptance_criteria: Given any time of day, when a user makes a request, then the system responds.
Given a normal request, when the response time is measured, then it is less than 1 minute.
rationale: Role assumed: enforcement officer. "Rapid" is made concrete by the stated limit.

requirement_text: The SEP shall measure real-time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM).
requirement_text_raw: The SEP shall (3.3.10.13) measure real-time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the SEP to measure real time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM), so that timing is precise.
technical_task: Measure real time from the event in the SEP with an error of no more than 50 PPM.
acceptance_criteria: Given the event has occurred, when the SEP measures real time from it, then the accuracy is at most 50 PPM.
Given a measured time, when its error is evaluated, then it does not exceed 50 PPM.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "This event" is not identified in the sentence.

requirement_text: A display shall not require a user to log in.
user_story: As a viewer, I want a display to work without my logging in, so that I can see it right away.
technical_task: Let displays show their content without requiring a login.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display, when a user opens it without logging in, then it is shown.
Given a display, when it is opened, then no login prompt is presented.

requirement_text: User shall be able to see a list of sessions associated with sponsor attendees, to engage with sponsors.
user_story: As an attendee, I want to see a list of sessions associated with sponsor attendees, so that I can engage with the sponsors.
technical_task: Show the sessions linked to sponsor attendees.
acceptance_criteria: Given sponsor attendees with sessions, when a user opens the list, then the sessions associated with sponsor attendees are shown.
Given a session with no sponsor attendee, when a user opens the list, then it is not shown.

requirement_text: The platform shall experience minimal to no buffering during video playback.
rationale: "Minimal to no buffering" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What amount of buffering is "minimal"?
Under which network conditions should this hold?

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to change their information at any time.
user_story: As a user, I want to change my information at any time, so that it stays correct.
technical_task: Allow users to edit their stored information whenever they like.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in user, when the user edits their information at any time, then the change is saved.
Given a saved change, when the user views their information, then the new values are shown.

requirement_text: The BE shall be able to make time stamp adjustments as required by the observational mode and correlator output parameters.
user_story: As an observatory engineer, I want the BE to adjust time stamps as the observational mode and correlator output parameters require, so that data is correctly timed.
technical_task: Let the BE make time stamp adjustments driven by the observational mode and the correlator output parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Given an observational mode that requires a time stamp adjustment, when it is active, then the BE makes the adjustment.
Given correlator output parameters that require a time stamp adjustment, when they are set, then the BE makes the adjustment.

requirement_text: Fit Criterion: Dr Susan Poslusny and Karen Sysol are the only people who shall have access to the final class section scheduling for the system that interfaces with CampusConnect.
requirement_text_raw: Fit Criterion: Dr Susan Poslusny and Karen Sysol are the only people who shall have access to the final class section scheduling for the system that interfaces with CampusConnect.'
user_story: As a registrar, I want only Dr Susan Poslusny and Karen Sysol to have access to the final class section scheduling, so that the schedule stays controlled.
technical_task: Limit access to the final class section scheduling for the system that interfaces with CampusConnect to Dr Susan Poslusny and Karen Sysol.
acceptance_criteria: Given Dr Susan Poslusny or Karen Sysol, when the person opens the final class section scheduling, then access is granted.
Given any other user, when the user opens the final class section scheduling, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: registrar. The two named people come from the requirement.

requirement_text: Submittal of a change request project memo shall include an unambiguous clear technical description of the requested change including any details required for understanding reason, purpose and impact of the requested change as well as a risk assessment with regards of component timing, cost, quality, safety, weight, function and performance.
user_story: As a technical reviewer, I want a change request project memo to include an unambiguous technical description and a risk assessment, so that I can judge the change.
technical_task: Require every change request project memo to contain a clear technical description with the reason, purpose and impact of the change, and a risk assessment covering component timing, cost, quality, safety, weight, function and performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change request project memo, when it is submitted, then it contains an unambiguous clear technical description of the change including its reason, purpose and impact.
Given a change request project memo, when it is submitted, then it contains a risk assessment covering component timing, cost, quality, safety, weight, function and performance.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to add musical notes and rests to a score using the mouse.
user_story: As a composer, I want to add musical notes and rests to a score using the mouse, so that I can write music.
technical_task: Support placing musical notes and rests on a score with mouse input.
acceptance_criteria: Given a score, when the user clicks to place a note with the mouse, then the note is added to the score.
Given a score, when the user clicks to place a rest with the mouse, then the rest is added to the score.

requirement_text: The in this document used definition of contact open / closed relates to the logical state and not to the electrical status of the input signal.
rationale: The sentence defines how "open" and "closed" are used in a document and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a definition of terms?
Which signal behaviour must the system follow?

requirement_text: Clients shall be able to change their password.
user_story: As a client, I want to change my password, so that I can keep my account secure.
technical_task: Offer a password change function for clients.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in client, when the client enters a new password and confirms, then the password is changed.
Given the password has changed, when the client logs in again, then the new password is required.

requirement_text: The PayPal network must be available 24 hours a day to ensure continuous service availability.
user_story: As a customer, I want the PayPal network to be available 24 hours a day, so that I can pay at any time.
technical_task: Ensure the PayPal network is available for 24 hours every day.
acceptance_criteria: Given any hour of the day, when a customer pays through PayPal, then the network is available.
Given a full day, when availability is reviewed, then the network was available for 24 hours.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. No downtime allowance is stated.

requirement_text: The product shall have the ability to send meeting reminders to employees.
user_story: As an employee, I want to receive meeting reminders, so that I don't miss meetings.
technical_task: Send meeting reminders to employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scheduled meeting, when the reminder time comes, then a reminder is sent to the employee.
Given an employee who is not invited to the meeting, when the reminder time comes, then no reminder is sent.
rationale: Role assumed: employee. The reminder timing is not stated.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to implement a Chain of Trust agreement.
rationale: "Chain of Trust agreement" is named without describing what the solution must do.
clarification_questions: What does a Chain of Trust agreement have to contain?
Which parties and data does it cover?

requirement_text: The system shall provide security by encrypting user passwords stored in the database and protecting against online threats such as SQL injection attacks.
user_story: As a user, I want my stored passwords encrypted and the system protected against online threats such as SQL injection, so that my account is safe.
technical_task: Encrypt passwords stored in the database and add protection against online threats such as SQL injection attacks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user password, when it is stored in the database, then it is encrypted.
Given an SQL injection attempt, when it reaches the system, then it is blocked.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Other online threats are not listed.

requirement_text: If the requested appointment time does not conflict with any existing appointment for the LHCP the request is saved.
requirement_text_raw: If the requested appointment time does not conflict with any existing appointment for the LHCP  the request is saved.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want an appointment request saved only if it does not conflict with an existing appointment, so that my schedule has no overlaps.
technical_task: Save the appointment request when its time does not conflict with an existing appointment for the LHCP.
acceptance_criteria: Given a requested time that does not conflict with any existing appointment, when the request is submitted, then it is saved.
Given a requested time that conflicts with an existing appointment, when the request is submitted, then it is not saved.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The second criterion follows from "if it does not conflict".

requirement_text: When satisfied with your selections click 'Generate Report'.
requirement_text_raw: When satisfied with your selections  click 'Generate Report'.
rationale: The sentence is guidance for a user and describes no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an instruction to the user?
What must the system do when Generate Report is clicked?

requirement_text: User shall be able to access the application on all major web browsers without any slowdown, even during peak hours.
rationale: "All major web browsers", "any slowdown" and "peak hours" are not defined.
clarification_questions: Which browsers are the "major" ones?
What counts as "slowdown" and "peak hours"?

requirement_text: The system shall search for train schedules based on the provided origin and destination.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to search train schedules by origin and destination, so that I can plan my journey.
technical_task: Implement a train schedule search that takes an origin and a destination.
acceptance_criteria: Given an origin and a destination, when the traveler searches, then matching train schedules are listed.
Given an origin and destination with no train connection, when the traveler searches, then no schedules are listed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to respond to a limited number of profiles per day as a general job seeker.
clarification_questions: How many profiles per day count as "a limited number"?
What happens when the limit is reached?

requirement_text: The player clicks on the pushbutton "OK". The player statistics are recorded in the statistic file of the software, according to the requirement of the chapter 3.2.3.2.
user_story: As a player, I want my statistics recorded when I click "OK", so that my results are saved.
technical_task: Record the player statistics in the software's statistic file when the player clicks the "OK" pushbutton, per the requirement of chapter 3.2.3.2.
acceptance_criteria: Given the player clicks the pushbutton "OK", when the click is handled, then the player statistics are recorded.
Given the statistics are recorded, when the statistic file is opened, then it contains the player statistics.
rationale: Role stated: player. The chapter reference is kept as written.

requirement_text: A patient can click "View Full Calendar" link to view his or her appointments in the current month together with his or her office visit dates prescription dates and lab procedure dates in the current month displayed on a calendar for the current month .
requirement_text_raw: A patient can click "View Full Calendar" link to view his or her appointments in the current month together with his or her office visit dates  prescription dates  and lab procedure dates in the current month displayed on a calendar for the current month .
user_story: As a patient, I want to click "View Full Calendar" to see my appointments, office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates for the current month on a calendar, so that I have my month in one view.
technical_task: Add a "View Full Calendar" link that shows the current month's appointments and office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates on a calendar.
acceptance_criteria: Given the patient page, when the patient clicks "View Full Calendar", then a calendar for the current month is displayed.
Given the calendar for the current month, when it is displayed, then it shows the patient's appointments and office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates.

requirement_text: A customer shall be able to drag a tip denomination out of a bankcard payment or a cash payment.
requirement_text_raw: A customer shall be able to drag a tip denomination out of a bankcard payment  or a cash payment.
user_story: As a customer, I want to drag a tip denomination out of a bankcard payment or a cash payment, so that I can change my tip.
technical_task: Allow a tip denomination to be dragged out of either a bankcard payment or a cash payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bankcard payment with a tip denomination, when the customer drags the denomination out, then it is removed from the payment.
Given a cash payment with a tip denomination, when the customer drags the denomination out, then it is removed from the payment.

requirement_text: System shall be easily updatable for fixes and patches.
rationale: "Easily" is subjective and no update process or target is given.
clarification_questions: What does "easily updatable" mean (time, effort, downtime)?
How are fixes and patches delivered?

requirement_text: The back-end systems (multiple back-end systems may exist for a single card), which communicate with the cards, perform the verifications, and manage the off-card key databases, also shall be trusted.
user_story: As a security architect, I want the back-end systems that communicate with the cards, perform verifications and manage the off-card key databases to be trusted, so that card security does not depend on an untrusted back end.
technical_task: Establish and document trust for every back-end system that communicates with the cards, performs verifications or manages the off-card key databases, including when several back-end systems exist for one card.
acceptance_criteria: Given a back-end system that communicates with the cards, when it is assessed, then it is trusted.
Given a back-end system that performs verifications or manages the off-card key databases, when it is assessed, then it is trusted.
rationale: Role assumed: security architect. What makes a system "trusted" is not defined.

requirement_text: There will be no restriction in time or place for the use of the software built from the specifications produced under this contract.
user_story: As a licensee, I want no restriction in time or place on using the software built from the specifications, so that I can use it anywhere and for as long as I need.
technical_task: Release the software built under the contract without time or location limits on its use.
acceptance_criteria: Given the delivered software, when its license terms are reviewed, then they contain no time restriction.
Given the delivered software, when its license terms are reviewed, then they contain no restriction on the place of use.

requirement_text: System shall send order confirmation to the user and seller through email or SMS.
user_story: As a buyer, I want an order confirmation by email or SMS, so that I know my order was placed.
technical_task: Send an order confirmation to both the user and the seller by email or SMS.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order is placed, when it is completed, then an order confirmation is sent to the user by email or SMS.
Given an order is placed, when it is completed, then an order confirmation is also sent to the seller by email or SMS.
rationale: Role assumed: buyer. Which channel is used when is not stated.

requirement_text: Connector P1 pins 1 and 32 of row d shall be connected to +5V.
requirement_text_raw: Connector P1 pins 1 and 32 of row d shall (3.2.3.1.2.8) be connected to +5V.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want pins 1 and 32 of row d of connector P1 connected to +5V, so that power is supplied on those pins.
technical_task: Wire pins 1 and 32 of row d on connector P1 to +5V.
acceptance_criteria: Given connector P1, when pin 1 of row d is measured, then it is connected to +5V.
Given connector P1, when pin 32 of row d is measured, then it is connected to +5V.

requirement_text: Please refer to the "Telematic5.5 - Diagnostic Specification SV and SPV Display" for details.
requirement_text_raw: Please refer to the "Telematic5.5 - Diagnostic Specification SV and SPV Display" [RD4528] for details.
rationale: The sentence only refers to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Diagnostic Specification require?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: User shall be able to return items to the seller if not satisfied and provide feedback.
user_story: As a customer, I want to return items to the seller if I am not satisfied and give feedback, so that I can get a resolution.
technical_task: Provide a return function that sends items back to the seller, together with a feedback form.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item the customer is not satisfied with, when the customer returns it, then the return is sent to the seller.
Given a returned item, when the customer submits feedback, then the feedback is saved.

requirement_text: User shall be able to track the status of sent snaps, displaying "delivered" or "received" as appropriate.
user_story: As a user, I want to track the status of snaps I sent, shown as "delivered" or "received", so that I know if they arrived.
technical_task: Show the delivery status of each sent snap as "delivered" or "received", whichever applies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sent snap that has been delivered, when the user views its status, then "delivered" is displayed.
Given a sent snap that has been received, when the user views its status, then "received" is displayed.

requirement_text: The interrupts across all channels shall have a skew no greater than 330 microseconds.
requirement_text_raw: The interrupts across all channels shall (3.4.1.2.6) have a skew no greater than 330 microseconds.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want interrupts across all channels to have a skew of no more than 330 microseconds, so that channels stay in step.
technical_task: Keep the skew between interrupts on all channels to 330 microseconds or less.
acceptance_criteria: Given interrupts on all channels, when their skew is measured, then it is no greater than 330 microseconds.
Given a measured skew above 330 microseconds, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Users can search for available properties within their budget based on the area covered, city, location, price range, property type, property subtype, and purpose.
user_story: As a home buyer, I want to search available properties within my budget by area, city, location, price range, type, subtype and purpose, so that I find suitable homes.
technical_task: Implement a property search filtered by area covered, city, location, price range, property type, property subtype and purpose, limited to the user's budget.
acceptance_criteria: Given search filters for area, city, location, price range, property type, subtype and purpose, when the user searches, then matching available properties are listed.
Given a property priced above the user's budget, when the user searches, then it is not listed.

requirement_text: System shall store and display the user's comments.
user_story: As a user, I want my comments stored and displayed, so that they remain visible.
technical_task: Store each comment a user writes and display it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a comment is submitted, when it is saved, then it is stored.
Given a stored comment, when the user opens the page, then it is displayed.

requirement_text: A users manual, explaining how to install and operate the MultiMahjongClient, will be provided.
user_story: As a player, I want a users manual explaining how to install and operate the MultiMahjongClient, so that I can set it up and play.
technical_task: Write and ship a users manual that explains installation and operation of the MultiMahjongClient.
acceptance_criteria: Given the delivered software, when it is released, then a users manual is provided.
Given the users manual, when a player reads it, then it explains how to install and how to operate the MultiMahjongClient.

requirement_text: An OK indicator, appearing green, shall signify the absence of any diagnostic conditions.
user_story: As a technician, I want a green OK indicator when no diagnostic conditions exist, so that I can see at a glance that all is well.
technical_task: Show a green OK indicator when there are no diagnostic conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given there are no diagnostic conditions, when the screen is displayed, then an OK indicator appears in green.
Given at least one diagnostic condition, when the screen is displayed, then the OK indicator is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: technician. The second criterion follows from "the absence of any diagnostic conditions".

requirement_text: Sensitive data is not passed in query strings or form fields.
user_story: As a security engineer, I want sensitive data never passed in query strings or form fields, so that it is not exposed in URLs or logs.
technical_task: Keep sensitive data out of query strings and form fields.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data, when a request is sent, then the data is not in the query string.
Given sensitive data, when a form is submitted, then the data is not in a form field.
rationale: Role assumed: security engineer. The second criterion follows from the requirement's two named places.

requirement_text: System shall support LDAP authentication for user login.
user_story: As a user, I want to log in using LDAP authentication, so that I can use my directory account.
technical_task: Support LDAP authentication for user login.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid LDAP account, when the user logs in, then the user is authenticated through LDAP.
Given invalid LDAP credentials, when the user tries to log in, then login is refused.

requirement_text: System shall display the uploaded videos on the user's channel.
user_story: As a creator, I want my uploaded videos shown on my channel, so that viewers can find them.
technical_task: List a user's uploaded videos on that user's channel.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has uploaded videos, when the channel is opened, then the uploaded videos are displayed.
Given a user who has not uploaded videos, when the channel is opened, then no videos are listed.

requirement_text: The TCS shall allow the operator to command the flight behavior characteristics inherent to the selected AV.
user_story: As an operator, I want to command the flight behavior characteristics that belong to the selected AV, so that I can control it.
technical_task: Allow the operator to send commands for the flight behavior characteristics of the selected AV.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected AV, when the operator commands a flight behavior characteristic of that AV, then the command is sent.
Given a selected AV, when the operator tries to command a characteristic the AV does not have, then the command is not available.

requirement_text: A patient may have at most one height data point one weight data point and one pedometer data point in any one day reported by him or herself a UAP or a personal representative .
requirement_text_raw: A patient may have at most one height data point  one weight data point  and one pedometer data point in any one day  reported by him or herself  a UAP  or a personal representative .
user_story: As a patient, I want to report at most one height, one weight and one pedometer data point per day, so that daily records stay consistent.
technical_task: Allow no more than one height, one weight and one pedometer data point for a patient per day, reported by the patient, a UAP or a personal representative.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with no height data point for a day, when the patient, a UAP or a personal representative reports one, then it is saved.
Given a patient who already has a height, weight or pedometer data point for a day, when another of that kind is reported for the same day, then it is not accepted.
rationale: Role stated: patient, UAP, personal representative.

requirement_text: For Details about the support of GSM / GPRS radio technology the document `` Remote Vehicle Data Access '' shall be mandatory.
requirement_text_raw: For Details about the support of GSM / GPRS radio technology the document `` Remote Vehicle Data Access '' [RD4117] shall be mandatory.
rationale: The sentence declares a document mandatory and gives no requirement in itself.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced document "Remote Vehicle Data Access" require for GSM / GPRS support?
What exactly is mandatory?

requirement_text: A supervisor shall be able to do everything a waiter can.
user_story: As a supervisor, I want to do everything a waiter can do, so that I can cover for waiters.
technical_task: Grant supervisors every capability that waiters have.
acceptance_criteria: Given a function available to a waiter, when a supervisor uses it, then it is available to the supervisor too.
Given a supervisor, when the supervisor is compared with a waiter, then the supervisor has no less access.

requirement_text: Employee shall log into the system.
user_story: As an employee, I want to log in to the system, so that I can use it.
technical_task: Provide a login for employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given an employee with valid credentials, when the employee logs in, then access is granted.
Given an employee with invalid credentials, when the employee logs in, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The system shall allow archivists to mark individual and groups of files as restricted.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to mark individual files and groups of files as restricted, so that access to them is limited.
technical_task: Add a restricted flag that can be set on a single file or on a group of files.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file, when the archivist marks it as restricted, then it is restricted.
Given a group of files, when the archivist marks the group as restricted, then every file in it is restricted.

requirement_text: User shall receive safety training materials and awareness campaigns within the app, promoting safe behaviors and fostering a culture of responsibility among users.
rationale: The aims ("promoting safe behaviors", "fostering a culture") are not measurable and the content is not specified.
clarification_questions: Which safety topics and campaigns are to be provided?
How is a "culture of responsibility" measured?

requirement_text: The system shall log errors, warnings, and informational messages to an external log file on the application server.
user_story: As an operations engineer, I want errors, warnings and informational messages logged to an external log file on the application server, so that I can diagnose problems.
technical_task: Write error, warning and informational messages to a log file on the application server that is external to the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs, when it is handled, then it is written to the external log file on the application server.
Given a warning or informational message is produced, when it is handled, then it is written to the same log file.

requirement_text: Agricultural and animal product producers shall be able to add items for sale with product details such as product name, quantity, product rate, required place, and contact details.
user_story: As a producer, I want to add items for sale with name, quantity, rate, required place and contact details, so that buyers can find my products.
technical_task: Provide an item listing form for agricultural and animal products with product name, quantity, product rate, required place and contact details.
acceptance_criteria: Given the item listing form, when a producer fills in the product details and saves, then the item is listed for sale.
Given a listed item, when it is viewed, then it shows its name, quantity, rate, required place and contact details.
rationale: Role stated: agricultural and animal product producer.

requirement_text: The user is presented with a list of his or her messages in the message inbox.
user_story: As a user, I want to see a list of my messages in the message inbox, so that I can read them.
technical_task: Display the user's messages as a list in the message inbox.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with messages, when the user opens the inbox, then a list of the user's messages is displayed.
Given a user with no messages, when the user opens the inbox, then the list is empty.

requirement_text: The application itself will only have minimal logic and so there should be little to no issues with the computation required by the phone itself.
rationale: The sentence is a design statement and "little to no issues" has no measurable criterion.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement, or an observation about the application's design?
What computation limits must the phone satisfy?

requirement_text: The Disputes System must provide Search functionality allowing search by dispute case number, merchant account number, cardmember account number, and issuer number, with filtering options by date range, dispute type, case status, and reason code.
user_story: As a dispute analyst, I want to search disputes by case number, merchant account number, cardmember account number or issuer number and filter by date range, type, status and reason code, so that I can find cases quickly.
technical_task: Build Disputes System search on dispute case number, merchant account number, cardmember account number and issuer number, with filters for date range, dispute type, case status and reason code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dispute case number, merchant account number, cardmember account number or issuer number, when the analyst searches, then matching disputes are returned.
Given search results, when the analyst filters by date range, dispute type, case status or reason code, then only matching disputes remain.

requirement_text: An Izogn administrator must be able to update the category listings on the website within 2 minutes.
user_story: As an Izogn administrator, I want to update the category listings on the website within 2 minutes, so that changes are quick.
technical_task: Make updating the website's category listings possible for an Izogn administrator in 2 minutes or less.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Izogn administrator, when the administrator updates the category listings, then the update can be done within 2 minutes.
Given the updated category listings, when the website is viewed, then the new listings are shown.

requirement_text: The solution should conform to function IN.2.2 (Auditable Records) to provide audit information about additions and changes to the status of destinations and sources.
user_story: As an auditor, I want the solution to conform to function IN.2.2 (Auditable Records), so that I have audit information on additions and changes to the status of destinations and sources.
technical_task: Record audit information for additions and status changes of destinations and sources in line with function IN.2.2 (Auditable Records).
acceptance_criteria: Given a destination or source is added, when the addition is saved, then audit information is recorded.
Given the status of a destination or source changes, when the change is saved, then audit information is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. IN.2.2 is only referenced.

requirement_text: Each method shall include a description of its function and additional information for future use.
user_story: As a developer, I want each method to include a description of its function and additional information, so that future maintainers understand it.
technical_task: Document every method with a description of what it does and extra information for later use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a method in the code, when it is reviewed, then it includes a description of its function.
Given a method in the code, when it is reviewed, then it includes additional information for future use.
rationale: Role assumed: developer. What the additional information covers is not stated.

requirement_text: For details about required WLAN interface see also chapter "WLAN".
rationale: The sentence only points to another chapter.
clarification_questions: What does the chapter "WLAN" require of the WLAN interface?
Is the chapter part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The information and the search methods of the Student Handbook-app will be restricted depending on file format of the handbook-information.
user_story: As a student, I want the Student Handbook-app's information and search methods to depend on the format of the handbook information, so that I get search that suits the file.
technical_task: Restrict the information shown and the search methods offered in the Student Handbook-app according to the file format of the handbook information.
acceptance_criteria: Given handbook information in a given file format, when the student opens the app, then the information shown depends on that file format.
Given handbook information in a given file format, when the student searches, then only the search methods allowed for that file format are offered.
rationale: Role assumed: student. The formats and their restrictions are not listed.

requirement_text: The FTPP system shall not solely exceed these timing requirement budgets.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall not (3.1.5) solely exceed these timing requirement budgets.
rationale: The sentence refers to budgets defined elsewhere and its wording ("not solely exceed") is unclear.
clarification_questions: Which timing requirement budgets does "these" refer to?
What does "not solely exceed" mean?

requirement_text: Adobe Illustrator shall be compatible with a minimum processor of Intel Pentium 4 or AMD Athlon 64.
user_story: As a designer, I want Adobe Illustrator to be compatible with a minimum processor of Intel Pentium 4 or AMD Athlon 64, so that it runs on older machines.
technical_task: Ensure Adobe Illustrator runs on a processor at least as capable as an Intel Pentium 4 or an AMD Athlon 64.
acceptance_criteria: Given a computer with an Intel Pentium 4 processor, when Adobe Illustrator is installed, then it runs.
Given a computer with an AMD Athlon 64 processor, when Adobe Illustrator is installed, then it runs.

requirement_text: RAM scrub shall report detected errors to the application, congruently on all channels, via an API service for inclusion in the telemetry stream.
requirement_text_raw: RAM scrub shall [SRS044] report detected errors to the application, congruently on all channels, via an API service for inclusion in the telemetry stream.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want RAM scrub to report detected errors to the application through an API service, identically on all channels, so that errors appear in the telemetry stream.
technical_task: Report errors detected by RAM scrub to the application congruently on all channels through an API service for the telemetry stream.
acceptance_criteria: Given RAM scrub detects an error, when it reports, then the error is reported to the application through an API service.
Given the same error condition on several channels, when RAM scrub reports, then the report is congruent on all channels and can be included in the telemetry stream.

requirement_text: A batch program shall periodically predict diseases based on consultation requests using a machine learning algorithm and prioritize the requests.
user_story: As a doctor, I want a batch program to periodically predict diseases from consultation requests with a machine learning algorithm and prioritize the requests, so that urgent cases are seen first.
technical_task: Run a periodic batch program that uses a machine learning algorithm to predict diseases from consultation requests and orders the requests by priority.
acceptance_criteria: Given consultation requests, when the batch program runs, then it predicts diseases using a machine learning algorithm.
Given predicted diseases, when the batch program finishes, then the consultation requests are prioritized.
rationale: Role assumed: doctor. The run interval and the priority rule are not stated.

requirement_text: Complete the remainder of the form as necessary and click 'Save'.
rationale: The sentence is guidance to a user and has no stated system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a user instruction?
Which parts of the form are "the remainder" and which are necessary?

requirement_text: Users shall be able to contact doctors through email, phone calls, or SMS, providing accurate information for their queries.
user_story: As a patient, I want to contact doctors by email, phone call or SMS, so that I can ask my questions in my preferred way.
technical_task: Offer email, phone call and SMS as ways to contact doctors, and collect accurate information with the query.
acceptance_criteria: Given a doctor's contact options, when the user opens them, then email, phone call and SMS are offered.
Given a query, when the user submits it through a chosen channel, then the information provided is passed to the doctor.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. "Accurate" information cannot be verified by the system; the criteria only cover passing it on.

requirement_text: User shall be able to register for an individual or business account by providing email, creating password, and confirming password.
user_story: As a new user, I want to register for an individual or business account with an email, a password and a password confirmation, so that I can start using the service.
technical_task: Offer registration for individual and business accounts, asking for an email, a password and a password confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the user selects individual or business and provides an email, a password and a matching confirmation, then the account is created.
Given the registration form, when the confirmation does not match the password, then the account is not created.

requirement_text: The predicted power shall be based on the worst cell with the lowest voltage.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want the predicted power to be based on the worst cell with the lowest voltage, so that the prediction is conservative.
technical_task: Compute predicted power from the cell with the lowest voltage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a battery with cells at different voltages, when predicted power is calculated, then it is based on the cell with the lowest voltage.
Given the cell with the lowest voltage changes, when predicted power is calculated again, then it uses the new lowest cell.

requirement_text: The LHCP clicks this number to view the physiologic data monitoring details of his or her patients for the current date.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to click a number to view the physiologic data monitoring details of my patients for the current date, so that I can follow their readings.
technical_task: Make the number clickable so that it opens the physiologic data monitoring details of the LHCP's patients for the current date.
acceptance_criteria: Given the number is displayed, when the LHCP clicks it, then the physiologic data monitoring details of the LHCP's patients are shown.
Given the details are shown, when the LHCP reads them, then they are for the current date.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. What the number represents is not given.

requirement_text: An LHCP selects to view additional information for a patient.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to select to view additional information for a patient, so that I can see more detail.
technical_task: Add a selection that shows additional information for a patient.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when the LHCP selects to view additional information, then the additional information is displayed.
Given the additional information, when it is displayed, then it belongs to the selected patient.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. What the additional information includes is not stated.

requirement_text: If the solution provides the ability for direct entry by the patient then the solution should explicitly label the data as patient entered.
requirement_text_raw: If the solution provides the ability for direct entry by the patient  then the solution should explicitly label the data as patient entered.
user_story: As a clinician, I want data entered directly by the patient labeled as patient entered, so that I know where the data came from.
technical_task: When patients can enter data directly, label that data explicitly as patient entered.
acceptance_criteria: Given the solution allows direct entry by the patient, when a patient enters data, then the data is labeled as patient entered.
Given data entered by someone other than the patient, when it is displayed, then it is not labeled as patient entered.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall provide rate groups that execute at 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz., with a drift rate no greater than 50 microseconds per second, and with a jitter no greater than 330 microseconds.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS035] provide rate groups that execute at 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz., with a drift rate no greater than 50 microseconds per second, and with a jitter no greater than 330 microseconds.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to provide 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate groups with a drift rate of at most 50 microseconds per second and jitter of at most 330 microseconds, so that timing is dependable.
technical_task: Provide 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz rate groups in the scheduler with a drift rate no greater than 50 microseconds per second and a jitter no greater than 330 microseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given the scheduler, when the rate groups run, then there are rate groups executing at 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz.
Given a running rate group, when its timing is measured, then the drift rate is no greater than 50 microseconds per second and the jitter is no greater than 330 microseconds.

requirement_text: The THEMAS system shall use the information contained in the initialization data file to determine which heating and cooling units are part of the THEMAS system.
requirement_text_raw:
The THEMAS system shall use the information contained in the initialization data file to determine which heating and cooling
units are part of the THEMAS system.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the THEMAS system to use the initialization data file to determine which heating and cooling units belong to the system, so that it knows its equipment.
technical_task: Read the initialization data file at start and use it to decide which heating and cooling units are part of the THEMAS system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an initialization data file, when the THEMAS system starts, then it reads the file.
Given a heating or cooling unit listed in the file, when the system determines its units, then that unit is part of the THEMAS system.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to create an account by providing credentials and activating it via email.
user_story: As a new user, I want to create an account with credentials and activate it by email, so that my account is verified.
technical_task: Implement account creation with credentials followed by activation through an email.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user provides credentials, when the account is created, then an activation email is sent.
Given an activation email, when the user follows it, then the account is activated.

requirement_text: System shall handle errors effectively to prevent system failures.
rationale: "Effectively" and "errors" are too general to test.
clarification_questions: Which errors must be handled and how?
What makes error handling "effective"?

requirement_text: Authorization login shall be required when the software starts.
user_story: As a user, I want to log in with authorization when the software starts, so that only authorized people use it.
technical_task: Require an authorization login at software start.
acceptance_criteria: Given the software starts, when the user opens it, then a login for authorization is requested.
Given a user who has not logged in, when the user tries to use the software, then access is not granted.

requirement_text: The MET shall be congruent across all FCP members.
requirement_text_raw: The MET shall (3.3.10.9) be congruent across all FCP members.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the MET to be congruent across all FCP members, so that all share the same time.
technical_task: Keep the MET congruent on every FCP member.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP members, when their MET values are compared, then they are congruent.
Given an update to the MET, when it completes, then all FCP members still have congruent MET values.

requirement_text: User shall be prompted to verify their email upon registration for added security.
user_story: As a new user, I want to be prompted to verify my email when I register, so that my account is more secure.
technical_task: Prompt the user to verify their email address right after registration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user completes registration, when the account is created, then the user is prompted to verify their email.
Given an email that has not been verified, when the user views the account, then it is shown as unverified.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. The second criterion is an assumption about how verification status is shown.

requirement_text: System shall use Mapbox APIs for geolocation functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to use Mapbox APIs for geolocation, so that location features are provided by Mapbox.
technical_task: Integrate the Mapbox APIs to provide the geolocation functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Given a location feature, when a user uses it, then the geolocation is provided through the Mapbox APIs.
Given the implementation, when it is reviewed, then geolocation requests go to the Mapbox APIs.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which geolocation features are used is not stated.

requirement_text: The screen shall allow the moderator to filter/sort/view/edit/close sessions.
user_story: As a moderator, I want a screen to filter, sort, view, edit and close sessions, so that I can manage them.
technical_task: Build a moderator screen with filter, sort, view, edit and close actions for sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of sessions, when the moderator filters or sorts it, then the list is updated accordingly.
Given a session, when the moderator views, edits or closes it, then the action is carried out.

requirement_text: The public health agent can select to see the detail of a specific report.
user_story: As a public health agent, I want to select a report to see its details, so that I can review a specific report.
technical_task: Allow a public health agent to open the detail view of a specific report.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of reports, when the public health agent selects one, then the detail of that report is shown.
Given two reports, when the agent selects each, then each shows its own detail.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner shall implement backup and disaster recovery measures to prevent data loss in case of unforeseen events.
user_story: As a site owner, I want backup and disaster recovery measures, so that data is not lost in unforeseen events.
technical_task: Put backup and disaster recovery measures in place for Crafty kids corner.
acceptance_criteria: Given the site's data, when backups are made, then the data can be restored from them.
Given an unforeseen event, when it destroys the live data, then the data is recovered through the disaster recovery measures.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to create condo units and associate them with child parcels and addresses.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to create condo units and associate them with child parcels and addresses, so that units are linked to their land and location.
technical_task: Offer creation of condo units and linking of each unit to child parcels and addresses.
acceptance_criteria: Given a staff member, when a condo unit is created, then it is saved.
Given a condo unit, when the staff member associates it with child parcels and addresses, then the associations are saved.

requirement_text: Online registration and signup for memberships, job packages, postings, or resume database access shall be available.
user_story: As an employer, I want to register and sign up online for memberships, job packages, postings or resume database access, so that I can use these services.
technical_task: Provide online registration and signup for memberships, job packages, postings and resume database access.
acceptance_criteria: Given the website, when an employer opens the signup page, then registration is available for memberships, job packages, postings and resume database access.
Given an employer completing a signup, when it is submitted, then the signup is recorded.

requirement_text: The product shall be capable of handling up to 1000 concurrent requests.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the product to handle up to 1000 concurrent requests, so that it copes with busy periods.
technical_task: Size the product to process up to 1000 concurrent requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given 1000 concurrent requests, when they are sent, then the product handles them.
Given fewer than 1000 concurrent requests, when they are sent, then the product handles them.
rationale: Role assumed: operations manager. The required response time is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall ensure software meets defined quality attributes.
rationale: The quality attributes are not named and the user's role in ensuring them is unclear.
clarification_questions: Which quality attributes are "defined" and where?
How should the user ensure the software meets them?

requirement_text: Users must be prompted to change their PIN on first use for security.
user_story: As a new user, I want to be prompted to change my PIN on first use, so that my account is secure.
technical_task: Force a PIN change prompt the first time a user uses a PIN.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user using the PIN for the first time, when the user signs in, then the user is prompted to change the PIN.
Given a user who has already changed the PIN, when the user signs in, then no change prompt is shown.
