requirement_text: A patient chooses to view their patient specific instructions by selecting a link named "Patient Specific Instructions" under the View heading in the left hand menu .
user_story: As a patient, I want to select Patient Specific Instructions under the View heading in the left hand menu, so that I can read my instructions.
technical_task: Add a link named "Patient Specific Instructions" under the View heading in the left hand menu that opens the patient's instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the left hand menu, when the patient looks under the View heading, then a link named "Patient Specific Instructions" is shown.
Given the link, when the patient selects it, then the patient specific instructions are displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall be highly automatic to relieve the users of as many repetitive and tedious tasks as possible.
rationale: "Highly automatic" and "as many as possible" have no measurable criterion.
clarification_questions: Which repetitive and tedious tasks must be automated?
What does "as many as possible" mean as a testable target?

requirement_text: Web-based displays defined by the ASPERA-3 team shall be provided where any available ASPERA-3 data (as opposed to just the most current) can be used for science analysis.
user_story: As a scientist, I want web-based displays defined by the ASPERA-3 team that can use any available ASPERA-3 data, so that I can analyze more than the latest data.
technical_task: Provide web-based displays, as defined by the ASPERA-3 team, that can show any available ASPERA-3 data and not only the most current.
acceptance_criteria: Given available ASPERA-3 data, when a user opens a web-based display defined by the ASPERA-3 team, then the display is available.
Given older ASPERA-3 data, when a user selects it in a display, then it can be used for science analysis.

requirement_text: User shall be able to load a document with 50 activities and 50 connections within 1 second on the client side.
user_story: As a user, I want a document with 50 activities and 50 connections to load within 1 second on the client side, so that I can start working quickly.
technical_task: Make a document with 50 activities and 50 connections load in 1 second or less on the client side.
acceptance_criteria: Given a document with 50 activities and 50 connections, when the user loads it on the client side, then it loads within 1 second.
Given a load that takes longer than 1 second, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: If the error-condition existed longer than the pretime, it has to be logical false for at least the duration of the posttime to revoke the output signal.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want an error output to be revoked only after the error condition has been logically false for at least the posttime, so that short gaps do not clear it.
technical_task: Revoke the output signal when the error condition has been logically false for at least the posttime, if the error condition had existed longer than the pretime.
acceptance_criteria: Given the error condition existed longer than the pretime, when it has been logically false for at least the posttime, then the output signal is revoked.
Given the error condition existed longer than the pretime, when it has been logically false for less than the posttime, then the output signal is not revoked.

requirement_text: User shall input the received OTP for verification.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter the OTP I received for verification, so that my identity is confirmed.
technical_task: Provide an input for the received OTP in the verification step.
acceptance_criteria: Given the verification step, when the user enters the received OTP, then it is submitted for verification.
Given the OTP field, when it is left empty, then verification cannot be submitted.

requirement_text: The error type and its context data shall be made available to the application via an API call.
requirement_text_raw: The error type and its context data shall (3.3.12.4) be made available to the application via an API call.
user_story: As an application developer, I want the error type and its context data available through an API call, so that my application can react to errors.
technical_task: Expose the error type and its context data through an API call.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error has occurred, when the application calls the API, then the error type is returned.
Given an error has occurred, when the application calls the API, then the error's context data is returned.

requirement_text: Each quadrant of each floor shall have a thermostat which is to be used to provide temperature data to the THEMAS system. The initialization file shall contain a unique identifier for each thermostat that the system is to monitor. These identifiers shall be read from the initialization file and loaded into the THEMAS system during the initialization process.
user_story: As a building manager, I want a thermostat in each quadrant of each floor feeding temperature data to THEMAS, with unique identifiers loaded from the initialization file, so that THEMAS can monitor each one.
technical_task: Fit each quadrant of each floor with a thermostat, list a unique identifier per monitored thermostat in the initialization file, and load these identifiers into THEMAS during initialization.
acceptance_criteria: Given a quadrant of a floor, when the system is installed, then it has a thermostat that provides temperature data to the THEMAS system.
Given the initialization file, when the THEMAS system initializes, then it reads the unique identifier of each thermostat it is to monitor and loads it.

requirement_text: Customer shall be able to cancel an order and if canceled, money will be transferred to wallet to order food for next time (If Card Payment).
user_story: As a customer, I want to cancel an order and, for card payments, have the money moved to my wallet, so that I can order food next time.
technical_task: Provide order cancellation that credits the paid amount to the customer's wallet when the order was paid by card.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order paid by card, when the customer cancels it, then the money is transferred to the customer's wallet.
Given a canceled card order, when the customer orders food next time, then the wallet balance can be used.
rationale: Role stated: customer. Orders paid another way are not covered by the wallet transfer.

requirement_text: Require a traceable and auditable path from a claim payment or a transmission of a pay for performance payment to the clinical documentation supporting it.
user_story: As an auditor, I want a traceable path from a claim payment or pay for performance payment to its clinical documentation, so that payments can be audited.
technical_task: Link each claim payment and pay for performance payment to the clinical documentation that supports it and make the link traceable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a claim payment, when an auditor follows the path, then the clinical documentation that supports it is reached.
Given a transmission of a pay for performance payment, when an auditor follows the path, then the supporting clinical documentation is reached.

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide an API call to allow the ICP application to determine on which channel it resides.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS303] provide an API call to allow the ICP application to determine on which channel it resides.
user_story: As an application developer, I want an FTSS API call that tells the ICP application which channel it resides on, so that it knows its location.
technical_task: Provide an FTSS API call that returns the channel on which the calling ICP application resides.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ICP application on a channel, when it calls the API, then the channel on which it resides is returned.
Given ICP applications on different channels, when each calls the API, then each receives its own channel.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to complete processing of all onboard data, deliver the results to the End-to-End System and maintain availability for immediate resumption of operations once Correlator access is restored.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want all onboard data to be processed, the results delivered to the End-to-End System, and operations ready to resume once Correlator access returns, so that no data is lost.
technical_task: Complete processing of all onboard data, deliver the results to the End-to-End System, and stay available for immediate resumption of operations when Correlator access is restored.
acceptance_criteria: Given onboard data, when processing runs, then all of it is processed and the results are delivered to the End-to-End System.
Given Correlator access is restored, when operations are to resume, then the system is available for immediate resumption.

requirement_text: For details see "Feature List Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Tuner" .
requirement_text_raw: For details see "Feature List Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Tuner" [RD3593].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Feature List contain?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: User shall be able to see the most searched items on the title screen when starting the student handbook app.
user_story: As a student, I want to see the most searched items on the title screen when I start the handbook app, so that I can find popular information fast.
technical_task: Show the most searched items on the title screen of the student handbook app at startup.
acceptance_criteria: Given the student handbook app starts, when the title screen is displayed, then the most searched items are shown.
Given search activity changes, when the app is started again, then the shown items reflect the most searched ones.
rationale: Role assumed: student. How many items are shown is not stated.

requirement_text: The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.
requirement_text_raw: The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'
user_story: As a registrar, I want student management tasks to respond within 5 seconds and schedule generation within 30 seconds, so that I can work efficiently.
technical_task: Limit the response time of general student management tasks to 5 seconds and of schedule generation to 30 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a general student management task, when it is performed, then the response time is no longer than 5 seconds.
Given a schedule generation request, when it is performed, then the response time is no longer than 30 seconds.

requirement_text: User shall be able to tweet a certain event.
user_story: As a social media user, I want to tweet about a certain event, so that I can share it.
technical_task: Offer a tweet function for posting about an event.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event, when the user composes a tweet about it, then the tweet is posted.
Given a posted tweet, when it is viewed, then it refers to the event.

requirement_text: The system shall operate primarily offline, with networked authentication components functioning only when Radford University's systems are available.
user_story: As a student, I want the system to work mainly offline, with networked authentication working only when Radford University's systems are available, so that I can use it without a connection.
technical_task: Design the system to operate primarily offline and enable networked authentication components only when Radford University's systems are available.
acceptance_criteria: Given no network connection, when the user uses the system, then it operates offline.
Given Radford University's systems are not available, when networked authentication is attempted, then it does not function; and when they are available, then it functions.

requirement_text: If after the time PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime the relay is not closed (T30gStatusOpen equal 1) the error signal IODCCloseError has to be set to 1 for one cycle.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want IODCCloseError set to 1 for one cycle when the relay is not closed after PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime, so that a failed close is signalled.
technical_task: Set the error signal IODCCloseError to 1 for one cycle when T30gStatusOpen still equals 1 after PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime.
acceptance_criteria: Given PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime has elapsed and T30gStatusOpen equals 1, when the check runs, then IODCCloseError is set to 1 for one cycle.
Given the relay is closed after PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime, when the check runs, then IODCCloseError is not set.

requirement_text: System shall accommodate deposits of arbitrarily large files without size restrictions.
user_story: As a depositor, I want to deposit files of any size, so that I am not blocked by size limits.
technical_task: Accept deposits of arbitrarily large files without imposing a size limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a very large file, when a user deposits it, then it is accepted.
Given the deposit function, when its settings are reviewed, then no file size restriction exists.
rationale: Role assumed: depositor. "Arbitrarily large" is bounded in practice by storage, which the requirement does not mention.

requirement_text: The TCS shall have the functionality to transmit UAV mission plans to service specific mission planning systems.
user_story: As a mission planner, I want the TCS to transmit UAV mission plans to the mission planning systems that are specific to each service, so that plans reach the right system.
technical_task: Add a function in the TCS that sends UAV mission plans to service specific mission planning systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a UAV mission plan, when the operator transmits it, then it is sent to the service specific mission planning system.
Given a transmitted plan, when it arrives, then the receiving mission planning system holds the plan.

requirement_text: Logging in as a provider presents you with the Calendar page showing only that provider's schedule by default.
user_story: As a provider, I want logging in to show me the Calendar page with only my schedule by default, so that I see my own appointments first.
technical_task: Open the Calendar page after provider login with the schedule filtered to that provider by default.
acceptance_criteria: Given a provider logs in, when login completes, then the Calendar page is shown.
Given the Calendar page after provider login, when it loads, then it shows only that provider's schedule by default.

requirement_text: The system shall pre-filter images to remove artifacts.
user_story: As an image analyst, I want images pre-filtered to remove artifacts, so that analysis is not distorted.
technical_task: Add a pre-filtering step that removes artifacts from images before further processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given an image with artifacts, when it is pre-filtered, then the artifacts are removed.
Given an image without artifacts, when it is pre-filtered, then it is not changed in a way that adds artifacts.
rationale: Role assumed: image analyst. Which artifacts are removed is not stated.

requirement_text: After registration, users shall be directed to a profile customization page.
user_story: As a new user, I want to be directed to a profile customization page after registration, so that I can set up my profile.
technical_task: Redirect users to the profile customization page when registration finishes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user completes registration, when it ends, then the user is directed to a profile customization page.
Given the profile customization page, when the user opens it, then it allows changing the profile.

requirement_text: User shall seamlessly translate text input from one language to another in real-time, preserving meaning and conveying nuance effectively.
rationale: "Seamlessly", "real-time" and "conveying nuance effectively" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How is "seamless" translation measured, and what delay counts as real-time?
How are "preserving meaning" and "conveying nuance" assessed?

requirement_text: For details about operation modes see Specification Wireless Subsystem BR342 .
requirement_text_raw: For details about operation modes see Specification Wireless Subsystem BR342 [RD2459].
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What do the operation modes in the Wireless Subsystem specification require?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Movies shall be encoded and streamed via Windows Media Player 9.0.
requirement_text_raw: Movies shall be encoded and streamed via Windows Media Player 9.0.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want movies encoded and streamed via Windows Media Player 9.0, so that I can watch them in a supported player.
technical_task: Encode movies and stream them through Windows Media Player 9.0.
acceptance_criteria: Given a movie, when it is prepared for streaming, then it is encoded for Windows Media Player 9.0.
Given an encoded movie, when a viewer plays it, then it is streamed via Windows Media Player 9.0.

requirement_text: System shall implement robust security measures to protect users' personal information, ensuring user data confidentiality and integrity.
user_story: As a user, I want security measures that protect my personal information, so that its confidentiality and integrity are kept.
technical_task: Implement security measures that protect personal information from disclosure and from unauthorized change.
acceptance_criteria: Given personal information, when an unauthorized person tries to read it, then access is denied.
Given personal information, when an unauthorized person tries to change it, then the change is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Robust" is not measurable, so the criteria cover confidentiality and integrity only.

requirement_text: User shall be able to participate in one-to-one and group video chats.
user_story: As a user, I want to take part in one-to-one and group video chats, so that I can talk to others face to face.
technical_task: Support video chat between two users and among a group of users.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users, when they start a video chat, then they can see and hear each other.
Given a group of users, when they start a group video chat, then all participants take part.

requirement_text: Communication services shall restrict the use of "immediate" message passing services between virtual groups (from FCP to ICP) to tasks running in the highest rate group on the FCP. This restriction does NOT apply to the ICPs since they are running as simplex VGs.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS050] restrict the use of "immediate" message passing services between virtual groups (from FCP to ICP) to tasks running in the highest rate group on the FCP. This restriction does NOT apply to the ICPs since they are running as simplex VGs.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want "immediate" message passing between virtual groups from FCP to ICP restricted to tasks in the highest rate group on the FCP, so that only critical tasks use it.
technical_task: Allow "immediate" message passing services from the FCP to the ICP only for tasks running in the highest rate group on the FCP, and do not apply this restriction to the ICPs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task in the highest rate group on the FCP, when it uses "immediate" message passing to the ICP, then the use is allowed.
Given a task not in the highest rate group on the FCP, when it tries to use "immediate" message passing to the ICP, then the use is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The ICPs are exempt because they run as simplex VGs.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create embeddable data summaries for websites.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to create embeddable data summaries for websites, so that I can show my data on other sites.
technical_task: Generate embeddable data summaries that can be placed in a website.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when the user creates an embeddable summary, then embeddable code for the summary is produced.
Given the embeddable summary on a website, when a visitor opens the page, then the summary is displayed.

requirement_text: In the list of in transit lab procedures the Lab Technician can update the status to received when the sample has been received in his or her lab.
requirement_text_raw: In the list of in transit lab procedures   the Lab Technician can update the status to received when the sample has been received in his or her lab.
user_story: As a lab technician, I want to update the status of an in transit lab procedure to received when the sample arrives in my lab, so that its progress is tracked.
technical_task: Allow a Lab Technician to set the status of an in transit lab procedure to received once the sample has been received.
acceptance_criteria: Given a lab procedure in the in transit list, when the Lab Technician updates its status to received, then the status is saved.
Given a received sample, when the list is viewed, then the procedure shows the received status.

requirement_text: User shall be able to choose the type of conversation (video chat, messaging, file transfer, etc.) after selecting the user to communicate with.
user_story: As a user, I want to choose the type of conversation after selecting who to talk to, so that I can contact them the way I prefer.
technical_task: After a contact is selected, offer conversation types such as video chat, messaging and file transfer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has selected a person to communicate with, when the user opens the options, then conversation types such as video chat, messaging and file transfer are offered.
Given a conversation type is chosen, when the user confirms, then the conversation starts in that type.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The list in the requirement is open ("etc.").

requirement_text: A detailed history of the actions taken on the case including the date and the user that performed the action must be maintained for auditing purposes.
requirement_text_raw: A detailed history of the actions taken on the case  including the date and the user that performed the action must be maintained for auditing purposes.
user_story: As an auditor, I want a detailed history of actions on a case, with the date and user, so that the case can be audited.
technical_task: Maintain a history of every action on a case that records the date and the user who performed it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user acts on a case, when the action is completed, then the history records the action, its date and the user.
Given a case, when an auditor opens its history, then all recorded actions are shown with date and user.

requirement_text: The Project Team must permit reasonable adjustment to the user interfaces of new functionality by project stakeholders when project schedule permits those adjustments.
rationale: "Reasonable adjustment" and "when schedule permits" are not defined, and the sentence is about project conduct.
clarification_questions: How much adjustment is "reasonable" and who decides?
When does the project schedule "permit" adjustments?

requirement_text: Worst case scenario must be established by the contractor and approved by the client.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor to establish the worst case scenario and have me approve it, so that testing is based on an agreed case.
technical_task: Have the contractor define the worst case scenario and obtain the client's approval for it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the project, when the contractor defines the worst case scenario, then it is documented.
Given the documented worst case scenario, when the client reviews it, then it is approved or not approved by the client.
rationale: Role assumed: client, as stated. The scenario content is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall have a login functionality for doctors, patients, chemists, and labs, with default passwords set up by the admin, and users can change passwords and log in using their own credentials.
user_story: As an admin, I want login for doctors, patients, chemists and labs with default passwords I set, so that users can then change them and log in with their own credentials.
technical_task: Implement login for doctors, patients, chemists and labs, with admin-set default passwords, password change, and login with the user's own credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account with a default password set by the admin, when the user logs in with it, then access is granted.
Given a logged-in user, when the user changes the password, then the user can log in with the new password.
rationale: Role stated: admin and the four user types.

requirement_text: For further details see Specification Wireless Subsystem WSub-795 .
requirement_text_raw: For further details see Specification Wireless Subsystem WSub-795 [RD2459].
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Wireless Subsystem specification require?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The THEMAS system shall control the heating and cooling units that are defined as part of the THEMAS system.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the THEMAS system to control the heating and cooling units that belong to it, so that the temperature is managed.
technical_task: Have the THEMAS system operate the heating and cooling units defined as part of it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a heating or cooling unit defined as part of the THEMAS system, when the system needs to change the temperature, then it controls that unit.
Given a unit not defined as part of the THEMAS system, when the system runs, then it does not control it.

requirement_text: The Get Real site runs as an extension of the OUS site e.g. ~getreal.ous.edu~ Being part of the OUS domain will maximize Google and other search engine hits. The site runs on OSU servers.
user_story: As a site owner, I want the Get Real site to run as an extension of the OUS site on OSU servers, so that it benefits from the OUS domain in search engines.
technical_task: Host the Get Real site as an extension of the OUS site's domain on OSU servers.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Get Real site, when its address is checked, then it is under the OUS domain.
Given the Get Real site, when its hosting is checked, then it runs on OSU servers.
rationale: Role assumed: site owner. The search engine benefit is stated in the requirement as the reason.

requirement_text: The project Team must allow a reasonable time to conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) against the built functionalities prior to deploying the product to the production environment.
rationale: "Reasonable time" is not quantified and the sentence is about project planning.
clarification_questions: How long is a "reasonable time" for User Acceptance Testing?
Is this a requirement on the project plan or on the system?

requirement_text: The system shall be reliable and the network connectivity in the supermarket shall be stable for smooth operations and data flow.
clarification_questions: What reliability and connectivity targets (uptime, packet loss) are required?
What does "smooth operations" mean in measurable terms?

requirement_text: User shall be required to register the software with a serial key provided in the kit.
user_story: As a customer, I want to register the software with the serial key from the kit, so that my copy is activated.
technical_task: Require registration of the software with the serial key included in the kit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid serial key from the kit, when the user registers the software, then registration succeeds.
Given an invalid serial key, when the user tries to register, then registration is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion follows from "required".

requirement_text: User shall anticipate API responses in less than 2.5 seconds to maintain seamless application functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want API responses in less than 2.5 seconds, so that the application works without noticeable delay.
technical_task: Keep API response times under 2.5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API request, when the response is measured, then it arrives in less than 2.5 seconds.
Given a response that takes 2.5 seconds or longer, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Typical load is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall receive information about the number of rows to be published before deciding whether to publish for informed decision-making.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to see the number of rows to be published before I decide to publish, so that I can make an informed decision.
technical_task: Display the number of rows that will be published before the publish action is confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset ready to publish, when the user opens the publish step, then the number of rows to be published is shown.
Given the number of rows is shown, when the user has not confirmed, then nothing is published yet.

requirement_text: For the first permanent FCP failure, FDIR shall degrade the redundancy level of the FCP from 4 to 3.
requirement_text_raw: For the first permanent FCP failure, FDIR  shall (3.3.5.30) degrade the redundancy level of the FCP from 4 to 3.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to lower the FCP redundancy level from 4 to 3 on the first permanent FCP failure, so that the system continues with fewer channels.
technical_task: On the first permanent FCP failure, have FDIR degrade the FCP redundancy level from 4 to 3.
acceptance_criteria: Given the first permanent FCP failure, when FDIR responds, then it degrades the redundancy level of the FCP from 4 to 3.
Given an FCP with no permanent failure, when FDIR checks it, then the redundancy level stays at 4.

requirement_text: OR if (DDPHibernMdOpnRequest equal 1 AND DDPPreventHibernate equal 0)) for longer than PPNM_DDPOpenDelay then the Timer DDPTimerOpen is started and the internal signal DDPTimerOpenState is set to 1.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the timer DDPTimerOpen started and DDPTimerOpenState set to 1 when DDPHibernMdOpnRequest equals 1 and DDPPreventHibernate equals 0 for longer than PPNM_DDPOpenDelay, so that the open is delayed correctly.
technical_task: Start Timer DDPTimerOpen and set the internal signal DDPTimerOpenState to 1 when DDPHibernMdOpnRequest equals 1 and DDPPreventHibernate equals 0 for longer than PPNM_DDPOpenDelay.
acceptance_criteria: Given DDPHibernMdOpnRequest equals 1 and DDPPreventHibernate equals 0 for longer than PPNM_DDPOpenDelay, when the condition is evaluated, then DDPTimerOpen is started.
Given the same condition, when it is evaluated, then DDPTimerOpenState is set to 1.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The leading "OR" refers to an earlier condition not shown.

requirement_text: System shall load data from the database.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to load data from the database, so that I see stored information.
technical_task: Load the required data from the database when the system needs it.
acceptance_criteria: Given data in the database, when the system needs it, then the data is loaded.
Given the loaded data, when the user views it, then it matches what is stored in the database.

requirement_text: After a successful precharging procedure the second contactor is closed and the precharging current is interrupted.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want the second contactor closed and the precharging current interrupted after a successful precharging procedure, so that the circuit is fully connected.
technical_task: After a successful precharging procedure, close the second contactor and interrupt the precharging current.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful precharging procedure, when it completes, then the second contactor is closed.
Given a successful precharging procedure, when the second contactor is closed, then the precharging current is interrupted.

requirement_text: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.
user_story: As a new user, I want to create a Gmail account by giving my name, gender, password, mobile number and location, so that I can start using Gmail.
technical_task: Provide an account creation form that collects name, gender, password, mobile number and location.
acceptance_criteria: Given the form, when the user enters name, gender, password, mobile number and location and submits, then the account is created.
Given the form, when required details are missing, then the account is not created.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. "Like" suggests the list may not be complete.

requirement_text: The product shall be able to handle 10 000 concurrent users within 2 years of the initial launch.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be able to handle 10 000 concurrent users within 2 years of the initial launch.'
user_story: As a business owner, I want the product to handle 10 000 concurrent users within 2 years of the initial launch, so that it supports expected growth.
technical_task: Plan capacity so the product can handle 10 000 concurrent users within 2 years of the initial launch.
acceptance_criteria: Given 2 years after the initial launch, when 10 000 users are connected at once, then the product handles them.
Given 10 000 concurrent users, when they use the product, then it continues to respond.

requirement_text: The system shall allow for user ID and password input.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter my user ID and password, so that I can sign in.
technical_task: Provide input fields for user ID and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user opens it, then fields for user ID and password are shown.
Given the fields, when the user enters a user ID and password, then they are accepted as input.

requirement_text: User shall enter their full name and date for last time authorization.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter my full name and the date for the last time authorization, so that the authorization is recorded.
technical_task: Ask for the user's full name and a date when performing the last time authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Given the authorization step, when the user enters a full name and a date, then they are accepted.
Given the authorization step, when the full name or date is missing, then authorization is not completed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What "last time authorization" refers to is not explained.

requirement_text: User shall accommodate a minimum of 10,000 records of clients in the database.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want the database to hold at least 10,000 client records, so that it supports our client base.
technical_task: Size the database to store a minimum of 10,000 client records.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10,000 client records, when they are stored, then the database accepts them all.
Given 10,000 client records stored, when a record is requested, then it is returned.

requirement_text: Then this person's electronic records are accessible via the iTrust Medical Records system.
requirement_text_raw: Then  this person's electronic records are accessible via the iTrust Medical Records system.
rationale: The sentence is a fragment that depends on a previous step not given.
clarification_questions: Who is "this person" and what comes before "Then"?
What must the system do to make the records accessible?

requirement_text: The system shall provide clear and informative messages to users.
rationale: "Clear and informative" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes a message "clear and informative"?
Which messages does this cover?

requirement_text: Applicants shall be advised to change their passwords monthly.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to be advised to change my password monthly, so that my account stays secure.
technical_task: Prompt applicants every month to change their password.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant whose password is a month old, when the applicant signs in, then the applicant is advised to change it.
Given an applicant who changed the password within the month, when the applicant signs in, then no advice is shown.
rationale: Role stated: applicant. Advising is not forcing a change.

requirement_text: System maintains an audit trail of errors and exceptions.
user_story: As a system operator, I want an audit trail of errors and exceptions, so that I can review failures.
technical_task: Record every error and exception in an audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs, when it is handled, then it is recorded in the audit trail.
Given an exception occurs, when it is handled, then it is recorded in the audit trail.

requirement_text: The application shall be HTML and scripting language-based, allowing end users to use the system on any web browser and any hardware platform available now or in the future.
user_story: As an end user, I want the application to be HTML and scripting language based, so that I can use it on any web browser and any hardware platform, now or later.
technical_task: Build the application on HTML and a scripting language so it runs in any web browser on any hardware platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given a web browser, when the user opens the application, then it works.
Given a hardware platform that supports a web browser, when the user opens the application, then it works.
rationale: Role assumed: end user. "Any ... in the future" cannot be tested directly.

requirement_text: The counter shall increase monotonically after that, except during TNR.
requirement_text_raw: The counter shall (3.2.2.7.8) increase monotonically after that, except during TNR.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the counter to increase monotonically afterwards except during TNR, so that time never runs backwards.
technical_task: Make the counter increase monotonically after that point, except while TNR is in progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given the counter is running outside TNR, when it is read repeatedly, then each value is not smaller than the previous one.
Given TNR is in progress, when the counter is read, then it may change differently from monotonic increase.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "After that" refers to an earlier event not shown.

requirement_text: System shall display the full news report after a user chooses the corresponding news title.
user_story: As a reader, I want to see the full news report after choosing its title, so that I can read the story.
technical_task: Display the full news report when its title is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of news titles, when the user selects a title, then the full news report is displayed.
Given two titles, when the user selects each, then each shows its own report.

requirement_text: 100% of saved user preferences shall be restored when system comes back online.
requirement_text_raw: 100\% of saved user preferences shall be restored when system comes back online.'
user_story: As a user, I want 100% of my saved preferences restored when the system comes back online, so that I don't lose my settings.
technical_task: Restore all saved user preferences when the system restarts.
acceptance_criteria: Given saved user preferences, when the system comes back online, then 100% of them are restored.
Given a restored preference, when the user views it, then it has the saved value.

requirement_text: The application shall render images and effects efficiently to maintain a productive workflow.
clarification_questions: What counts as rendering "efficiently"?
Which images and effects, and what workflow time targets apply?

requirement_text: All information transmitted for the purposes of supporting claims or pay for performance payments will be logged in an audit file that cannot subsequently be changed by a user or administrator of the EHR solution.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want all information sent to support claims or pay for performance payments logged in an audit file that no user or administrator can change, so that the log can be trusted.
technical_task: Log all information transmitted for claims or pay for performance payments in an audit file that users and administrators of the EHR solution cannot modify.
acceptance_criteria: Given information is transmitted to support a claim or a pay for performance payment, when it is sent, then it is logged in the audit file.
Given the audit file, when a user or administrator of the EHR solution tries to change it, then the change is not allowed.

requirement_text: System shall be easy to upgrade.
clarification_questions: What makes the system "easy to upgrade" in measurable terms (time, steps, downtime)?
Which upgrades are in scope?

requirement_text: The operational NEs shall enter a "working group" TNR routine when the FCPs request to send a TNR packet.
requirement_text_raw: The operational NEs shall (3.2.2.4.3) enter a "working group" TNR routine when the FCPs request to send a TNR packet.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the operational NEs to enter a "working group" TNR routine when the FCPs request to send a TNR packet, so that TNR packets are handled.
technical_task: Make the operational NEs enter the "working group" TNR routine whenever the FCPs request to send a TNR packet.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCPs request to send a TNR packet, when the request is made, then the operational NEs enter a "working group" TNR routine.
Given no FCP requests to send a TNR packet, when the NEs run, then they do not enter the "working group" TNR routine.

requirement_text: The server shall have a supported version of a common Linux distribution (Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.10, CentOS, Debian, or RHEL).
user_story: As an administrator, I want the server to run a supported version of a common Linux distribution, so that it receives updates.
technical_task: Run the server on a supported version of Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.10, CentOS, Debian or RHEL.
acceptance_criteria: Given the server, when its operating system is checked, then it is one of Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.10, CentOS, Debian or RHEL.
Given the chosen distribution, when its version is checked, then it is a supported version.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The list is taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: The Khan Academy platform shall offer instructional resources in mathematics.
user_story: As a student, I want instructional resources in mathematics on the Khan Academy platform, so that I can learn the subject.
technical_task: Offer instructional resources in mathematics on the Khan Academy platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given the platform, when a user browses subjects, then mathematics is offered.
Given the mathematics section, when a user opens it, then instructional resources are shown.

requirement_text: The BE shall be able to initiate a processing task on any Backend processor.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the BE to start a processing task on any Backend processor, so that work can be placed anywhere.
technical_task: Let the BE initiate a processing task on every Backend processor.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Backend processor, when the BE initiates a processing task on it, then the task starts there.
Given several Backend processors, when the BE initiates a task on each, then each task starts on its processor.

requirement_text: The system shall allow the user to modify the date exclusion set of an already submitted meeting response.
user_story: As a meeting participant, I want to change the date exclusion set of a meeting response I already submitted, so that I can correct my availability.
technical_task: Allow editing of the date exclusion set of a meeting response that has already been submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a submitted meeting response, when the user changes its date exclusion set, then the change is saved.
Given a changed date exclusion set, when the response is viewed, then it shows the new exclusions.

requirement_text: The website should use Flash to provide animation on the home page.
requirement_text_raw: The website should use Flash to provide animation on the home page.'
user_story: As a visitor, I want animation on the home page using Flash, so that the page feels lively.
technical_task: Implement the home page animation with Flash.
acceptance_criteria: Given the home page, when it is displayed in a browser that supports Flash, then an animation is shown.
Given the home page implementation, when it is reviewed, then the animation is provided with Flash.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. "Should" makes this a recommendation.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to update match statistics, including match date and result, and display the updated statistics.
user_story: As a league organizer, I want to update match statistics including match date and result and see the updated statistics, so that records are current.
technical_task: Support updating match statistics, including match date and result, and display the result of the update.
acceptance_criteria: Given a match, when the organizer updates its date and result, then the match statistics are saved.
Given updated match statistics, when they are viewed, then the updated statistics are displayed.

requirement_text: In case of unmanaged services, user shall be able to access a QoS configuration function implemented in the CNG.
user_story: As a network user, I want to access a QoS configuration function in the CNG for unmanaged services, so that I can set quality of service.
technical_task: Implement a QoS configuration function in the CNG that users can access when services are unmanaged.
acceptance_criteria: Given unmanaged services, when the user opens the CNG configuration, then a QoS configuration function is accessible.
Given the QoS configuration function, when the user changes a setting, then the setting is applied in the CNG.
rationale: Role assumed: network user. The settings are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall offer comprehensive documentation for installation, configuration, and usage, as well as troubleshooting guides and FAQs for resolving common issues.
user_story: As an administrator, I want documentation for installation, configuration and usage with troubleshooting guides and FAQs, so that I can solve common issues.
technical_task: Write documentation covering installation, configuration and usage, plus troubleshooting guides and FAQs for common issues.
acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when it is reviewed, then it covers installation, configuration and usage.
Given the documentation, when it is reviewed, then it includes troubleshooting guides and FAQs for common issues.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Comprehensive" is not measured.

requirement_text: After a message is sent the LHCP is directed to to his or her message outbox.
requirement_text_raw: After a message is sent  the LHCP is directed to to his or her message outbox.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to be directed to my message outbox after sending a message, so that I can see it was sent.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the message outbox once a message is sent.
acceptance_criteria: Given an LHCP sends a message, when sending completes, then the LHCP is directed to the message outbox.
Given the message outbox, when it is displayed, then the sent message is listed.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: System shall provide read-only access to archival descriptions.
user_story: As a researcher, I want read-only access to archival descriptions, so that I can look but not change them.
technical_task: Provide read-only access to archival descriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given an archival description, when a user views it, then it is displayed.
Given an archival description, when a user tries to change it through this access, then the change is not allowed.

requirement_text: System shall provide comprehensive session information associated with sponsors.
clarification_questions: What session information is "comprehensive"?
How are sessions associated with sponsors?

requirement_text: System shall ensure 24/7 availability of the interface and maximal security of the network.
rationale: "Maximal security" is not measurable and the interface is not named.
clarification_questions: What does "maximal security" of the network mean in testable terms?
Which interface is meant?

requirement_text: System shall display a stylistic map view in the application.
user_story: As a user, I want a stylistic map view in the application, so that the map matches the look of the app.
technical_task: Add a stylized map view to the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user opens the map, then a stylistic map view is displayed.
Given the map view, when it is shown, then it is part of the application.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Stylistic" is not defined.

requirement_text: System shall provide functionality for users to assign Location information to Containers.
user_story: As a records officer, I want to assign Location information to Containers, so that I know where each is kept.
technical_task: Add a Location field to Containers that users can fill in.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Container, when the user assigns Location information, then it is saved with the Container.
Given a Container with Location information, when it is viewed, then the Location is shown.

requirement_text: Only administrators can activate a pre-paid card.
requirement_text_raw: Only administrators can activate a pre-paid card.'
user_story: As an administrator, I want only administrators to activate a pre-paid card, so that cards are controlled.
technical_task: Limit pre-paid card activation to administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator activates a pre-paid card, then the card is activated.
Given a user who is not an administrator, when the user tries to activate a pre-paid card, then it is refused.

requirement_text: The system shall implement measures to prevent unauthorized physical or digital access.
user_story: As a security officer, I want measures that prevent unauthorized physical or digital access, so that the system is protected.
technical_task: Implement controls that block unauthorized physical access and unauthorized digital access.
acceptance_criteria: Given a person without authorization, when the person attempts digital access, then access is denied.
Given a person without authorization, when the person attempts physical access, then access is prevented.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The measures are not specified.

requirement_text: The system shall allow camp administrators to add parents for camper enrollment.
user_story: As a camp administrator, I want to add parents for camper enrollment, so that campers can be enrolled.
technical_task: Allow camp administrators to add parents to the camper enrollment process.
acceptance_criteria: Given a camper being enrolled, when the camp administrator adds a parent, then the parent is linked to the enrollment.
Given an enrollment with a parent, when it is viewed, then the parent is shown.

requirement_text: System provides an audit trail and viewable history of all transactions including but not limited to user’s login ID date and time stamp.
requirement_text_raw: System provides an audit trail and viewable history of all transactions including but not limited to  user’s login ID  date  and time stamp.
user_story: As an auditor, I want an audit trail and viewable history of all transactions, including login ID and date and time stamp, so that I can review activity.
technical_task: Keep an audit trail and a viewable history of every transaction, including at least the user's login ID and a date and time stamp.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction, when it is completed, then the audit trail records the user's login ID and a date and time stamp.
Given the audit trail, when an auditor opens the history, then all transactions are viewable.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. "Not limited to" means other fields may be recorded.

requirement_text: User shall be able to connect via IP address.
user_story: As a user, I want to connect via an IP address, so that I can reach the system directly.
technical_task: Allow connections to be made using an IP address.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid IP address, when the user connects with it, then the connection is established.
Given an invalid IP address, when the user tries to connect, then the connection is not established.

requirement_text: The system shall be highly available and accessible for data access and management.
clarification_questions: What availability percentage counts as "highly available"?
Which data access and management functions does this cover?

requirement_text: The Scheduler shall detect 50 Hz, 10 Hz, and 1 Hz frame overruns at the next frame following the end of their respective rate boundaries.
requirement_text_raw: The Scheduler shall (3.3.4.12) detect 50 Hz, 10 Hz, and 1 Hz frame overruns at the next frame following the end of their respective rate boundaries.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Scheduler to detect 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz frame overruns at the next frame after the end of their rate boundaries, so that overruns are caught promptly.
technical_task: Have the Scheduler detect overruns of the 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz frames at the next frame following the end of each rate boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 50 Hz frame overruns its rate boundary, when the next frame starts, then the Scheduler detects the overrun.
Given a 10 Hz or 1 Hz frame overruns its rate boundary, when the next frame starts, then the Scheduler detects the overrun.

requirement_text: The system shall manage the entire software lifecycle, including version control, download, activation, and retrieval.
user_story: As a release manager, I want the system to manage the whole software lifecycle, including version control, download, activation and retrieval, so that software is handled in one place.
technical_task: Manage the software lifecycle, including version control, download, activation and retrieval.
acceptance_criteria: Given a software version, when it is managed, then version control is available.
Given a software version, when a user downloads, activates or retrieves it, then each action is supported.

requirement_text: The BE shall trap, flag and repair infs, NaNs, underflows, overflows and other computation errors.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the BE to trap, flag and repair infs, NaNs, underflows, overflows and other computation errors, so that bad values do not spread.
technical_task: Detect, flag and correct infs, NaNs, underflows, overflows and other computation errors in the BE.
acceptance_criteria: Given a computation produces an inf, NaN, underflow or overflow, when the BE detects it, then it is trapped and flagged.
Given a trapped computation error, when the BE handles it, then it is repaired.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. How repair is done is not described.

requirement_text: User shall/will have access to a system with a mean time between failures of at least 500 hours.
user_story: As a user, I want a system with a mean time between failures of at least 500 hours, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Engineer and verify the system for a mean time between failures of at least 500 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system in operation, when its mean time between failures is calculated, then it is at least 500 hours.
Given a calculated mean time between failures below 500 hours, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to view change history for a particular record or data set in accordance with users’ scope of practice organizational policy or jurisdictional law.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide the ability to view change history for a particular record or data set in accordance with users’ scope of practice  organizational policy  or jurisdictional law.
user_story: As a records manager, I want to view the change history of a record or data set according to scope of practice, organizational policy or jurisdictional law, so that changes can be reviewed.
technical_task: Provide a change history view for a particular record or data set that follows the user's scope of practice, organizational policy or jurisdictional law.
acceptance_criteria: Given a record or data set that has been changed, when an authorized user opens its change history, then the changes are shown.
Given a user whose scope of practice or policy does not permit it, when the user opens the change history, then it is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: records manager. The policies are not specified.

requirement_text: A tablet shall allow a waiter to process a payment using cash.
user_story: As a waiter, I want to process a payment in cash on a tablet, so that I can take cash payments at the table.
technical_task: Support cash payment processing on the waiter's tablet.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bill on the tablet, when the waiter processes a payment using cash, then the payment is recorded.
Given a recorded cash payment, when the bill is viewed, then it shows the cash payment.

requirement_text: System shall secure all information in the library database and transactions, providing authentication for all users and restricting access to authenticated users only.
user_story: As a librarian, I want all library database information and transactions secured, with access limited to authenticated users, so that library data is protected.
technical_task: Require authentication for all users and restrict access to the library database and its transactions to authenticated users.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated user, when the user accesses the library database or a transaction, then access is granted.
Given a user who is not authenticated, when the user tries to access the library database or a transaction, then access is denied.

requirement_text: All details of technical values according to ambient temperature of 23°C ± 5°C (RT) and nominal voltage of 13,5 V ± 0,5 V at the ECU.
rationale: The sentence names a test condition and no behaviour, and refers to values defined elsewhere.
clarification_questions: What must the system do with "all details of technical values"?
Which technical values are meant, and what are the tolerances?

requirement_text: Backplane connector form factors shall be in accordance with the VME64 with extensions (5 row P1 and P2) draft standard.
requirement_text_raw: Backplane connector form factors shall (3.2.3.1.2.5) be in accordance with the VME64 with extensions (5 row P1 and P2) draft standard.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the backplane connector form factors to follow the VME64 draft standard with extensions (5 row P1 and P2), so that boards are compatible.
technical_task: Design the backplane connectors to comply with VME64 and its extensions, using 5 row P1 and P2 connectors.
acceptance_criteria: Given the backplane connectors, when their form factor is checked, then it conforms to the VME64 draft standard with extensions.
Given connectors P1 and P2, when they are inspected, then they are 5 row connectors.

requirement_text: This section addresses the following: (I) numbering plan requirements; standardised telephone numbers; group numbers; calls from external networks to the EIRENE network.
requirement_text_raw: 9.1.2 This section addresses the following: (I) numbering plan requirements; standardised telephone numbers; group numbers; calls from external networks to the EIRENE network.
rationale: The sentence only lists the topics a section covers.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a section summary?
What must the system provide for numbering plans, group numbers and calls from external networks?

requirement_text: The program shall support taking roll for class sizes of up to 100 students while maintaining performance requirements.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to take roll for classes of up to 100 students without losing performance, so that attendance is quick.
technical_task: Support roll taking for class sizes of up to 100 students while meeting the performance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a class of up to 100 students, when the teacher takes roll, then the program supports it.
Given a class of 100 students, when roll is taken, then the performance requirements are still met.
rationale: Role assumed: teacher. The performance requirements are defined elsewhere.

requirement_text: To clear the failure, FDIR shall request the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to that FCR.
requirement_text_raw: To clear the failure, FDIR shall (3.3.5.15) request the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to that FCR.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to ask the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to the FCR to clear a failure, so that the failure is cleared.
technical_task: Have FDIR send a request to the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to the failed FCR in order to clear the failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failure of an FCR, when FDIR tries to clear it, then it requests the Vehicle/Mission Manager to cycle power to that FCR.
Given the request has been made, when the Vehicle/Mission Manager acts on it, then power is cycled to that FCR.

requirement_text: The system shall scan documents and convert them into digital files (e.g., PDF, JPG, PNG) as specified by the user.
user_story: As an office worker, I want to scan documents and convert them to digital files such as PDF, JPG or PNG as I choose, so that I can store them electronically.
technical_task: Scan documents and convert the scans into digital files in a format selected by the user, for example PDF, JPG or PNG.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scanned document, when the user selects a format such as PDF, JPG or PNG, then a file in that format is produced.
Given a scanned document, when the conversion completes, then the digital file contains the scanned content.

requirement_text: System shall notify the user upon successful sharing of the video.
user_story: As a user, I want to be notified when my video has been shared successfully, so that I know it worked.
technical_task: Send a notification to the user after a video is shared successfully.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video is shared successfully, when sharing completes, then the user is notified.
Given sharing fails, when it ends, then no success notification is sent.

requirement_text: Clients shall be able to calculate fare.
user_story: As a client, I want to calculate the fare, so that I know the cost before I commit.
technical_task: Provide a fare calculation function for clients.
acceptance_criteria: Given trip details, when the client requests a fare calculation, then a fare is shown.
Given different trip details, when the client requests a fare calculation, then the fare reflects those details.
rationale: Role stated: client. How the fare is computed is not described.

requirement_text: Software tools and pre-built applications that do not have source code available shall come with a complete diagnostic package and customer support.
user_story: As a customer, I want software tools and pre-built applications without available source code to come with a diagnostic package and customer support, so that I can resolve problems.
technical_task: Deliver every software tool and pre-built application that has no source code available together with a complete diagnostic package and customer support.
acceptance_criteria: Given a software tool or pre-built application without source code, when it is delivered, then it comes with a complete diagnostic package.
Given a software tool or pre-built application without source code, when it is delivered, then customer support is provided for it.
