requirement_text: The user shall be able to filter their view by Academic Year/Term or Current.
user_story: As a student, I want to filter my view by Academic Year/Term or Current, so that I see only the period I need.
technical_task: Add a filter for Academic Year/Term and a Current option to the view.
acceptance_criteria: Given the view, when the user selects an Academic Year/Term, then only items from it are shown.
Given the view, when the user selects Current, then only current items are shown.

requirement_text: A dynamic behaviour of blending from short to long and vice versa is strongly recommended.
rationale: "Strongly recommended" makes it optional and the behaviour is not described.
clarification_questions: Is the blending behaviour required or only recommended?
What does blending from short to long and back mean, and what must the system do?

requirement_text: Acknowledgement of roll received must be returned within 8 seconds.
user_story: As a teacher, I want the acknowledgement of a received roll to come back within 8 seconds, so that I know the roll was recorded.
technical_task: Return the acknowledgement that the roll was received within 8 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a roll is submitted, when it is received, then the acknowledgement is returned within 8 seconds.
Given an acknowledgement that takes longer than 8 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: If the longitudinally nearest object classified as TRUCK or CAR leaves the detection field of the sensor, relating objects classified as MULTIPLE have to be labelled still as MULTIPLE.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want objects labelled MULTIPLE to stay MULTIPLE when the nearest TRUCK or CAR leaves the detection field, so that labels remain consistent.
technical_task: Keep objects classified as MULTIPLE labelled as MULTIPLE after the longitudinally nearest object classified as TRUCK or CAR leaves the sensor's detection field.
acceptance_criteria: Given the longitudinally nearest object classified as TRUCK or CAR leaves the detection field, when the sensor updates, then related objects classified as MULTIPLE are still labelled MULTIPLE.
Given a related object classified as MULTIPLE, when the nearest object leaves, then the label does not change.

requirement_text: FABS user shall not receive DABS banner messages and vice versa.
user_story: As a FABS user, I want not to receive DABS banner messages, and the reverse, so that I only see messages meant for me.
technical_task: Show DABS banner messages only to DABS users and FABS banner messages only to FABS users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a FABS user, when banner messages are displayed, then no DABS banner message is shown.
Given a DABS user, when banner messages are displayed, then no FABS banner message is shown.
rationale: Role stated: FABS user. "Vice versa" is read as DABS users not receiving FABS messages.

requirement_text: If the system includes hardware the system shall include documentation that covers the expected physical environment necessary for proper secure and reliable operation of the system including: electrical HVAC sterilization and work area.
requirement_text_raw: If the system includes hardware  the system shall include documentation that covers the expected physical environment necessary for proper secure and reliable operation of the system including: electrical  HVAC  sterilization  and work area.
user_story: As a facility manager, I want documentation of the expected physical environment for any hardware in the system, so that it operates securely and reliably.
technical_task: Include documentation of the expected physical environment (electrical, HVAC, sterilization and work area) when the system includes hardware.
acceptance_criteria: Given a system that includes hardware, when its documentation is reviewed, then it covers the expected physical environment.
Given the physical environment documentation, when it is read, then it covers electrical, HVAC, sterilization and work area.

requirement_text: The system shall implement comprehensive security measures to safeguard users from harm.
rationale: "Comprehensive security measures" and "harm" are not defined.
clarification_questions: Which security measures are required?
What harm to users is meant and how is protection verified?

requirement_text: The system shall allow for addition or deletion of instructors, students, and classes while incorporating new semesters.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add or delete instructors, students and classes when introducing new semesters, so that records stay current.
technical_task: Support adding and deleting instructors, students and classes as part of incorporating a new semester.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new semester, when the administrator adds an instructor, a student or a class, then it is saved.
Given a new semester, when the administrator deletes an instructor, a student or a class, then it is removed.

requirement_text: The FDIR shall be able to discriminate between permanent and non-permanent faults.
requirement_text_raw: The FDIR shall (3.3.5.13) be able to discriminate between permanent and non-permanent faults.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to distinguish permanent from non-permanent faults, so that recovery fits the fault.
technical_task: Classify each detected fault in FDIR as permanent or non-permanent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a permanent fault, when FDIR evaluates it, then it is identified as permanent.
Given a non-permanent fault, when FDIR evaluates it, then it is identified as non-permanent.

requirement_text: The Application Provider is responsible for Returning receipts for load, install, delete, and extradition, according to the Card Issuer's policy.
user_story: As a card issuer, I want the Application Provider to return receipts for load, install, delete and extradition according to my policy, so that each operation is confirmed.
technical_task: Make the Application Provider responsible for returning receipts for load, install, delete and extradition as the Card Issuer's policy requires.
acceptance_criteria: Given a load, install, delete or extradition operation, when it completes, then the Application Provider returns a receipt.
Given the Card Issuer's policy, when a receipt is returned, then it follows that policy.
rationale: Role assumed: card issuer. The policy itself is not described.

requirement_text: User shall be able to download the Skype application from an application store or similar service on their mobile phone without any charge.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want to download Skype from an application store or similar service without any charge, so that I can use it for free.
technical_task: Make the Skype application available for free download from an application store or similar service on mobile phones.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mobile phone, when the user looks for Skype in an application store or similar service, then it can be downloaded.
Given the download, when the user downloads Skype, then no charge is made.

requirement_text: The system shall be available at all times, allowing user access via a web browser, except during server downtime.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available at all times through a web browser, except during server downtime, so that I can use it whenever needed.
technical_task: Keep the system continuously available through a web browser outside of server downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Given the server is up, when a user opens the system in a web browser, then it is available.
Given server downtime, when a user opens the system, then unavailability is accepted as the stated exception.

requirement_text: The FTPP system shall configure the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card to halt processing if any of the MPE tests, mentioned in Table 3.3.2.3, ICP/PMC1553 IBIT Table, fail.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall (3.3.2.35) configure the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card to halt processing if any of the MPE tests, mentioned in Table 3.3.2.3, ICP/PMC1553 IBIT Table, fail.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTPP system to configure the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card to halt processing if any of the MPE tests fail, so that a card failing its tests does not keep running.
technical_task: Configure the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card so processing halts when any of the MPE tests listed in Table 3.3.2.3 fail.
acceptance_criteria: Given an MPE test in Table 3.3.2.3, when it fails, then the Radstone ICP/PMC1553 card halts processing.
Given all MPE tests in Table 3.3.2.3 pass, when the card runs, then processing continues.

requirement_text: The system shall provide the ability to record the user ID and date of all updates to the problem or diagnosis list.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the user ID and date recorded for every update to the problem or diagnosis list, so that changes can be attributed.
technical_task: Record the user ID and date for each update made to the problem list or diagnosis list.
acceptance_criteria: Given an update to the problem list, when it is saved, then the user ID and date are recorded.
Given an update to the diagnosis list, when it is saved, then the user ID and date are recorded.

requirement_text: User shall be able to send instant messages to any contact on their WhatsApp list, with delivery notifications displayed.
user_story: As a WhatsApp user, I want to send instant messages to any contact on my list and see delivery notifications, so that I know they arrived.
technical_task: Allow instant messages to any contact in the user's list and display a delivery notification for each message.
acceptance_criteria: Given a contact on the user's list, when the user sends an instant message, then the message is sent to the contact.
Given a sent message, when it is delivered, then a delivery notification is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: WhatsApp user, as named in the requirement.

requirement_text: If a condition to activate the PLC chipset is present (for details see [PLGW_R-109] chapter "Starting the PLC modem" [SCC-6187]) the component shall go to state "PLC enabled".
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the component to go to state "PLC enabled" when a condition to activate the PLC chipset is present, so that the PLC modem starts.
technical_task: Switch the component to the state "PLC enabled" whenever a condition to activate the PLC chipset is present.
acceptance_criteria: Given a condition to activate the PLC chipset is present, when the component evaluates it, then the component goes to state "PLC enabled".
Given no condition to activate the PLC chipset is present, when the component evaluates it, then the component does not go to state "PLC enabled".
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The conditions are described in a referenced chapter.

requirement_text: User shall receive the product list within 2 seconds of requesting it, ensuring a responsive interface.
user_story: As a customer, I want to receive the product list within 2 seconds of asking for it, so that the interface feels responsive.
technical_task: Deliver the product list within 2 seconds of a request.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request for the product list, when the response is measured, then the list is received within 2 seconds.
Given a response that takes longer than 2 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Is there no vehicle traction standby release from level2 for a time longer than a calibratable time (1 second) after rising edge of T50, then the vehicle traction standby release (FBA_E2) will be irreversibly deactivated for the current driving cycle and an error will be stored in failure memory.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want the vehicle traction standby release irreversibly deactivated for the driving cycle, with an error stored, when no release comes from level2 within the calibratable time of 1 second after the rising edge of T50, so that a faulty release is not used.
technical_task: Deactivate the vehicle traction standby release (FBA_E2) irreversibly for the current driving cycle and store an error in failure memory when there is no standby release from level2 for longer than the calibratable time of 1 second after the rising edge of T50.
acceptance_criteria: Given no vehicle traction standby release from level2 for longer than the calibratable time of 1 second after the rising edge of T50, when the time has passed, then FBA_E2 is irreversibly deactivated for the current driving cycle.
Given the same condition, when FBA_E2 is deactivated, then an error is stored in failure memory.

requirement_text: The solution should implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
user_story: As a security officer, I want technical security measures that guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information in transit, so that it is protected on the network.
technical_task: Implement technical security measures against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information transmitted over an electronic communications network.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic protected health information on an electronic communications network, when an unauthorized party tries to access it, then access is prevented.
Given electronic protected health information being transmitted, when it is sent, then the security measures are applied.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The measures are not specified.

requirement_text: The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System. This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant‘s accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.  This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant‘s accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.'
user_story: As a dispute analyst, I want the Disputes application to interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System and send all adjustment requests there, so that account adjustments can be requested.
technical_task: Connect the Disputes application to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System and route every adjustment request for cardmember and merchant accounts through it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dispute needing an account adjustment, when the Disputes application requests it, then the request is sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.
Given any adjustment request, when it is sent, then it goes only to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.
rationale: Role assumed: dispute analyst. The garbled apostrophe in the source was read as "merchant's".

requirement_text: User shall view and respond to posts from other users.
user_story: As a user, I want to view and respond to posts from other users, so that I can take part in discussions.
technical_task: Show posts from other users and allow replies to them.
acceptance_criteria: Given posts from other users, when the user opens the feed, then the posts are shown.
Given a post, when the user responds, then the response is saved and shown with the post.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall configure each ICP to continue processing if any of the Power-up or Initial BIT tests fail.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS289] configure each ICP to continue processing if any of the Power-up or Initial BIT tests fail.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS to configure each ICP to keep processing if any Power-up or Initial BIT test fails, so that a test failure does not stop the ICP.
technical_task: Configure each ICP so processing continues when a Power-up or Initial BIT test fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Power-up test fails on an ICP, when the ICP is configured by the FTSS, then it continues processing.
Given an Initial BIT test fails on an ICP, when the ICP is configured by the FTSS, then it continues processing.

requirement_text: System shall be able to seamlessly integrate metadata from external sources into DMPs.
rationale: "Seamlessly" is subjective and the external sources are not named.
clarification_questions: What does "seamlessly" mean in measurable terms?
Which external sources and which metadata fields are involved?

requirement_text: Upon successful login, user shall be able to send and receive emails.
user_story: As a user, I want to send and receive emails after logging in, so that I can communicate.
technical_task: Enable sending and receiving email once login succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when the user composes an email and sends it, then it is sent.
Given a successful login, when an email arrives, then the user can receive it.

requirement_text: A patient is presented with a listing of all immunizations for which he or she has been administered in the last 12 months.
user_story: As a patient, I want a list of all immunizations I received in the last 12 months, so that I know my recent vaccinations.
technical_task: Display the list of immunizations administered to the patient in the last 12 months.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with immunizations in the last 12 months, when the patient opens the list, then those immunizations are listed.
Given an immunization older than 12 months, when the patient opens the list, then it is not listed.

requirement_text: A patient either chooses to input his or her physiologic measurements (blood pressure possibly and possibly glucose levels) or to input his or her weight height possibly and possibly pedometer readings .
requirement_text_raw: A patient either chooses to input his or her physiologic measurements (blood pressure possibly and possibly glucose levels)   or to input his or her weight  height  possibly and possibly pedometer readings .
user_story: As a patient, I want to enter either my physiologic measurements or my weight, height and pedometer readings, so that my record is current.
technical_task: Offer two input choices: physiologic measurements (blood pressure and optionally glucose levels) or weight, height and optional pedometer readings.
acceptance_criteria: Given the input options, when the patient chooses physiologic measurements, then blood pressure and glucose levels can be entered.
Given the input options, when the patient chooses weight and height, then weight, height and pedometer readings can be entered.
rationale: Role stated: patient. "Possibly" marks the glucose levels and pedometer readings as optional.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to save the new task by tapping "Save" after filling in all the fields.
user_story: As a user, I want to save the new task by tapping Save after filling in all the fields, so that the task is stored.
technical_task: Add a Save button that stores the new task once all fields are filled in.
acceptance_criteria: Given all fields of a new task are filled in, when the user taps Save, then the task is saved.
Given a field is empty, when the user taps Save, then the task is not saved.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion follows from "after filling in all the fields".

requirement_text: The solution should provide the capability to document or record that identity-proofing was completed and the method used to verify (i.e. check photo id prior relationship or verification of information an individual knows or can produce) consistent with the recommendations of the Confidentiality or Privacy or Security Workgroup of the American Health Information Community.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide the capability to document or record that identity-proofing was completed and the method used to verify (i.e.  check photo id  prior relationship  or verification of information an individual knows or can produce) consistent with the recommendations of the Confidentiality or Privacy or Security Workgroup of the American Health Information Community.
user_story: As a registrar, I want to record that identity-proofing was completed and the method used, so that the proof can be audited.
technical_task: Provide a way to document that identity-proofing was done and which verification method was used, such as checking a photo ID, a prior relationship or verification of known information.
acceptance_criteria: Given identity-proofing has been completed, when the user records it, then the completion is saved.
Given identity-proofing has been recorded, when the record is viewed, then the verification method used is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: registrar. The recommendations of the workgroup are only referenced.

requirement_text: System shall keep error tracking logs to aid users.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to keep error tracking logs, so that problems can be investigated.
technical_task: Keep error tracking logs for the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs, when it is handled, then it is written to the error tracking log.
Given the error tracking log, when a user opens it, then the recorded errors are available.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How the logs aid users is not described.

requirement_text: When answer to the security question is typed in the answer should not appear on the screen (similar to how a password normally appears) and the answer should be confirmed (by the patient or personal health representative) before it is saved.
requirement_text_raw: When answer to the security question is typed in  the answer should not appear on the screen (similar to how a password normally appears) and the answer should be confirmed (by the patient or personal health representative) before it is saved.
user_story: As a patient, I want my security answer hidden as I type it and confirmed before it is saved, so that nobody can read it over my shoulder.
technical_task: Mask the security question answer as it is typed, like a password, and require confirmation by the patient or personal health representative before saving it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the patient types the answer to the security question, when it is typed, then it does not appear on the screen.
Given an answer has been typed, when the patient or personal health representative confirms it, then the answer is saved.
rationale: Role stated: patient or personal health representative.

requirement_text: The SD Card Slot shall support all kinds of SD / MMC Cards with smaller form factors (e.g. mini SD) via adapter.
user_story: As a device user, I want the SD card slot to support all kinds of SD / MMC cards with smaller form factors via an adapter, so that I can use my smaller cards.
technical_task: Make the SD card slot accept SD / MMC cards with smaller form factors, for example mini SD, through an adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Given an SD or MMC card with a smaller form factor and an adapter, when it is inserted in the slot, then it is supported.
Given a mini SD card in an adapter, when it is inserted, then it can be used.

requirement_text: The Operations Management & Communication capabilities should conform to the IN 1.7 Secure Data Routing requirements when solution data exchanges with other sources or destinations of data to ensure that the exchange occurs only among authorized senders and receivers.
user_story: As a security officer, I want the Operations Management & Communication capabilities to follow the IN 1.7 Secure Data Routing requirements, so that data is exchanged only among authorized senders and receivers.
technical_task: Make the Operations Management & Communication capabilities conform to the IN 1.7 Secure Data Routing requirements when solution data is exchanged with other sources or destinations.
acceptance_criteria: Given solution data is exchanged with another source or destination, when the exchange takes place, then it is only among authorized senders and receivers.
Given a sender or receiver that is not authorized, when it tries to take part in an exchange, then it is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. IN 1.7 is only referenced.

requirement_text: The system shall allow searching for resources based on various metadata criteria.
clarification_questions: Which metadata criteria can be used to search?
Which resources are searched?

requirement_text: User shall utilize Client ID and Demat account number for quick data retrieval.
rationale: "Quick" is not measurable and the retrieved data is not named.
clarification_questions: What does "quick" retrieval mean in measurable terms?
What data is retrieved with the Client ID and Demat account number?

requirement_text: For details see [PLGW_R-109] chapter "MAC address configuration" [SCC-2891].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced chapter on MAC address configuration require?
Is the referenced chapter part of this requirement?

requirement_text: System shall encrypt transactions to protect them from unauthorized interception.
user_story: As a customer, I want my transactions encrypted, so that they cannot be intercepted by unauthorized parties.
technical_task: Encrypt transactions in transit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction is sent, when it travels over the network, then it is encrypted.
Given an unauthorized party intercepts a transaction, when it reads the data, then the data cannot be understood.

requirement_text: System shall offer a registration form for users.
user_story: As a new user, I want a registration form, so that I can create an account.
technical_task: Provide a registration form for users.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration page, when the user opens it, then a registration form is shown.
Given the registration form, when the user fills it in and submits, then the registration is submitted.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. The form fields are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall have a screen to view the location of all ATMs of the same bank.
user_story: As a bank customer, I want a screen showing the location of all ATMs of my bank, so that I can find the nearest one.
technical_task: Provide a screen that displays the locations of all ATMs belonging to the same bank.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bank with ATMs, when the user opens the ATM screen, then the locations of all of that bank's ATMs are shown.
Given ATMs of another bank, when the user opens the screen, then they are not shown.

requirement_text: The system shall provide continued access in case of server failure.
user_story: As a user, I want to keep access to the system when a server fails, so that I can continue working.
technical_task: Provide failover so users keep access when a server fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given a server fails, when a user requests access, then access is still provided.
Given a server failure, when the user continues working, then the user is not forced to log in again from scratch.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an assumption about session continuity.

requirement_text: The system shall define what data can be entered, how it should be formatted, and any rules for validating the data.
rationale: The sentence says the system shall define rules without stating any, so there is nothing concrete to implement or test.
clarification_questions: Which data fields, formats and validation rules are meant?
Who defines them: the system, the administrator or the user?

requirement_text: For software exceptions, the FTPP system shall then transfer control to a user specified exception handling routine, if one is provided.
requirement_text_raw: For software exceptions, the FTPP system shall (3.3.12.2) then transfer control to a user specified exception handling routine, if one is provided.
user_story: As a software developer, I want control transferred to my exception handling routine on a software exception, if I provide one, so that I can handle the error myself.
technical_task: After a software exception, transfer control to the user specified exception handling routine when one is provided.
acceptance_criteria: Given a software exception and a user specified exception handling routine, when the FTPP system handles the exception, then control is transferred to that routine.
Given a software exception and no user specified routine, when the FTPP system handles the exception, then no transfer to a user routine takes place.

requirement_text: Developer shall ensure the historical FPDS data loader includes both extracted historical data and FPDS feed data for comprehensive data analysis.
user_story: As a data analyst, I want the historical FPDS data loader to include both extracted historical data and FPDS feed data, so that I can analyze the full data set.
technical_task: Make the historical FPDS data loader load both the extracted historical data and the FPDS feed data.
acceptance_criteria: Given extracted historical data, when the loader runs, then it is loaded.
Given FPDS feed data, when the loader runs, then it is loaded together with the extracted historical data.
rationale: Role stated: developer ensures it; benefit goes to analysts. "Comprehensive" is read as the two named sources.

requirement_text: System shall open a new window with options such as account, privacy, and language settings.
user_story: As a user, I want a new window with account, privacy and language settings, so that I can change them in one place.
technical_task: Open a new window that offers account, privacy and language settings, among other options.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user opens the settings, then a new window opens.
Given the new window, when the user looks at it, then it offers account, privacy and language settings.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means more options may exist.

requirement_text: The solution should implement a process for creating a unique User ID (i.e. user name) and performing authentication when granting remote access to a workforce member.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want a process to create a unique User ID and authenticate a workforce member when granting remote access, so that remote users are identified.
technical_task: Implement a process that creates a unique User ID (user name) and authenticates the workforce member when remote access is granted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a workforce member who needs remote access, when remote access is granted, then a unique User ID is created for the member.
Given a workforce member requesting remote access, when access is granted, then the member is authenticated first.

requirement_text: User shall have the ability to search for specific emails using keywords or filters.
user_story: As an email user, I want to search for specific emails by keywords or filters, so that I can find them quickly.
technical_task: Provide email search by keyword and by filter.
acceptance_criteria: Given a keyword, when the user searches, then matching emails are listed.
Given a filter, when the user applies it, then only matching emails are listed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to capture hearing decisions for enforcement.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to capture hearing decisions for enforcement, so that decisions are recorded.
technical_task: Add a function that records hearing decisions for enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hearing, when a staff member captures its decision, then the decision is saved.
Given a saved hearing decision, when it is opened, then it shows the captured decision.

requirement_text: To prevent unauthorized access, restaurant owner accounts will be locked for 30 minutes after three failed login attempts, disabling login functionality during that period.
user_story: As a restaurant owner, I want my account locked for 30 minutes after three failed login attempts, so that unauthorized people cannot guess my password.
technical_task: Lock a restaurant owner account for 30 minutes after three failed login attempts and disable login during that time.
acceptance_criteria: Given three failed login attempts on a restaurant owner account, when the third attempt fails, then the account is locked for 30 minutes.
Given a locked account, when login is attempted during the 30 minutes, then login is not possible.

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide an API call which allows the application to take an FCR out of the permanently failed state and place it back in the initial recovery state.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall (3.3.5.37) provide an API call which allows the application to take an FCR out of the permanently failed state and place it back in the initial recovery state.
user_story: As an application developer, I want an FTSS API call to take an FCR out of the permanently failed state and put it in the initial recovery state, so that a failed FCR can be recovered.
technical_task: Provide an FTSS API call that moves an FCR from the permanently failed state back into the initial recovery state.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCR in the permanently failed state, when the application calls the API, then the FCR leaves the permanently failed state.
Given the FCR has left the permanently failed state, when the API call completes, then the FCR is in the initial recovery state.

requirement_text: System shall utilize the Dropzone JavaScript library for drag-and-drop functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want drag-and-drop upload, so that I can add files easily.
technical_task: Use the Dropzone JavaScript library to implement drag-and-drop.
acceptance_criteria: Given the page, when the user drags a file onto the drop area, then the file is accepted.
Given the implementation, when it is reviewed, then drag-and-drop uses the Dropzone JavaScript library.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What is dropped is not stated; files are assumed from the library's usual use.

requirement_text: The developed website must be highly reliable and secure to prevent any leakage of applicant information.
rationale: "Highly reliable and secure" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What reliability target (for example uptime) is required?
Which security measures must prevent leakage of applicant information?

requirement_text: User shall/will receive clear error messages and guidance in case of input errors.
clarification_questions: What makes an error message "clear"?
What guidance should be given for which input errors?

requirement_text: The CNG may support mechanisms supporting nomadism of the users and their subscribed services from one physical customer environment to another.
user_story: As a subscriber, I want the CNG to support mechanisms for moving my services from one customer environment to another, so that my services follow me.
technical_task: Optionally support mechanisms in the CNG for nomadism of users and their subscribed services between physical customer environments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user and a subscribed service in one physical customer environment, when the user moves to another environment, then the CNG supports using the service there.
Given the CNG without such mechanisms, when it is assessed, then this is acceptable because the support is optional.
rationale: Role assumed: subscriber. "May" makes the support optional.

requirement_text: The system shall be secure and protect user privacy by following data security best practices.
rationale: "Best practices" are not named, so the requirement cannot be tested.
clarification_questions: Which data security best practices are meant?
How is privacy protection verified?

requirement_text: System shall support the creation and editing of Rights Management statements with appropriate permissions.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to create and edit Rights Management statements with the right permissions, so that rights information is accurate.
technical_task: Support creating and editing Rights Management statements, restricted to users with appropriate permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the appropriate permissions, when the user creates or edits a Rights Management statement, then it is saved.
Given a user without the appropriate permissions, when the user tries to edit a Rights Management statement, then the edit is refused.

requirement_text: The solution should provide HIPAA records and compliance reports.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want HIPAA records and compliance reports, so that I can show compliance.
technical_task: Generate HIPAA records and HIPAA compliance reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given system activity, when the compliance officer requests HIPAA records, then they are provided.
Given system activity, when the compliance officer requests a compliance report, then it is generated.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The report contents are not specified.

requirement_text: System shall facilitate easy customization of the Web interface graphics/colors.
clarification_questions: What does "easy" customization of web interface graphics and colors mean?
Who customizes them and how often?

requirement_text: User shall be able to see a displayed set of topics when performing a search as described in requirement UCAR602.
user_story: As a user, I want to see a displayed set of topics while searching, as described in requirement UCAR602, so that I can narrow my search.
technical_task: Display a set of topics during a search as described in requirement UCAR602.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user starts a search, when the search screen is displayed, then a set of topics is displayed.
Given the displayed topics, when they are compared with requirement UCAR602, then they match its description.
rationale: Role assumed: user. UCAR602 is only referenced.

requirement_text: The User shall be able to view the hyperlinks and descriptions listed.
user_story: As a user, I want to see the listed hyperlinks and their descriptions, so that I know where each leads.
technical_task: Display the list of hyperlinks together with their descriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of hyperlinks, when the user opens it, then the hyperlinks are shown.
Given a hyperlink in the list, when it is displayed, then its description is shown with it.

requirement_text: An HCP can remove a previously created lab procedure for a given office visit.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to remove a lab procedure I created for an office visit, so that wrong orders are withdrawn.
technical_task: Allow removal of a previously created lab procedure from a given office visit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a lab procedure created for an office visit, when the HCP removes it, then it is no longer part of the visit.
Given a different office visit, when the HCP removes a procedure from one visit, then the other visit is unchanged.

requirement_text: The solution should identify and authenticate specific devices before establishing a connection.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want specific devices identified and authenticated before a connection is made, so that only known devices connect.
technical_task: Identify and authenticate each device before establishing a connection.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device that is identified and authenticated, when it requests a connection, then the connection is established.
Given a device that is not authenticated, when it requests a connection, then no connection is established.

requirement_text: System shall be able to change the buttons used in the user interfaces of the sub-apps and main application, excluding external resources.
user_story: As a designer, I want to change the buttons in the user interfaces of the sub-apps and the main application, except external resources, so that I can restyle them.
technical_task: Make the buttons used in the sub-apps and the main application changeable, excluding buttons from external resources.
acceptance_criteria: Given a button in a sub-app or the main application, when the designer changes it, then the new button is used.
Given a button from an external resource, when the designer tries to change it, then it is not changed.

requirement_text: User shall expect secure transactions with SSL encryption.
user_story: As a customer, I want my transactions secured with SSL encryption, so that my payment details are protected.
technical_task: Protect all transactions with SSL encryption.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction, when it is sent, then it uses SSL encryption.
Given a connection without SSL encryption, when a transaction is attempted, then it is not processed.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "secure transactions".

requirement_text: When the chosen patient satisfies the preconditions of the chosen chronic disease the LHCP is provided with a warning message if that patient exhibits three or more risk factors.
requirement_text_raw: When the chosen patient satisfies the preconditions of the chosen chronic disease   the LHCP is provided with a warning message if that patient exhibits three or more risk factors.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want a warning message when the chosen patient meets the preconditions of the chosen chronic disease and shows three or more risk factors, so that I can act early.
technical_task: Show the LHCP a warning when the chosen patient satisfies the preconditions of the chosen chronic disease and exhibits three or more risk factors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient who satisfies the preconditions of the chronic disease and has three or more risk factors, when the LHCP chooses the patient and disease, then a warning message is shown.
Given a patient with fewer than three risk factors, when the LHCP chooses the patient and disease, then no warning is shown.

requirement_text: Time Management shall initialize SEP to zero within one minor cycle of the time when the vehicle/mission manager software has notified the FTSS software that the X-38 vehicle is released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System.
requirement_text_raw: Time Management shall (3.3.10.12) initialize SEP to zero within one minor cycle of the time when the vehicle/mission manager software has notified the FTSS software that the X-38 vehicle is released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Time Management to initialize SEP to zero within one minor cycle of the FTSS being told that the X-38 is released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System, so that separation timing starts correctly.
technical_task: Set SEP to zero within one minor cycle after the vehicle/mission manager software notifies the FTSS software that the X-38 vehicle is released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS software has been notified that the X-38 vehicle is released, when one minor cycle has not yet elapsed since the notification, then SEP is initialized to zero.
Given the notification of release, when one minor cycle has elapsed, then SEP has already been initialized to zero.

requirement_text: The P-Codes of possibly necessary various software lines within the program are identical with each delivery.
rationale: The sentence is hard to interpret ("possibly necessary various software lines") and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which P-Codes and which software lines are meant?
What must be identical in each delivery, and how is it checked?

requirement_text: System shall support multiple users simultaneously in the intra mailing system.
user_story: As an employee, I want the intra mailing system to support multiple users at the same time, so that colleagues can use it together.
technical_task: Make the intra mailing system handle several simultaneous users.
acceptance_criteria: Given several users logged in at the same time, when they use the intra mailing system, then all of them are supported.
Given one user's activity, when other users are active, then it is not blocked by them.
rationale: Role assumed: employee. The number of users is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall notify the sender if the requested user is unavailable.
user_story: As a sender, I want to be notified when the user I tried to reach is unavailable, so that I know the message was not delivered.
technical_task: Notify the sender when the requested user is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the requested user is unavailable, when the sender tries to reach the user, then the sender is notified.
Given the requested user is available, when the sender tries to reach the user, then no unavailability notice is sent.

requirement_text: Tracking number function requirement also applies to transfers of information from the EMR solution to a billing solution where these are separate or otherwise independently functioning solutions.
rationale: The sentence extends another requirement that is not given.
clarification_questions: Which tracking number function requirement is meant?
What must happen in transfers from the EMR solution to a billing solution?

requirement_text: Clinical site information shall include (but not be limited to) the name of the site, contact person, and contact information.
user_story: As a coordinator, I want clinical site information to include the site name, contact person and contact information, so that I can reach the site.
technical_task: Store clinical site information with at least the name of the site, a contact person and contact information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clinical site, when its information is entered, then the name of the site, contact person and contact information can be saved.
Given a saved clinical site, when it is viewed, then its name, contact person and contact information are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: coordinator. "But not be limited to" means other fields may be included.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to select a due date by tapping on the Date field and choosing a date from the pop-up calendar.
user_story: As a user, I want to pick a due date by tapping the Date field and choosing from a pop-up calendar, so that I can set deadlines easily.
technical_task: Open a pop-up calendar when the Date field is tapped and set the due date from the chosen date.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new task form, when the user taps the Date field, then a pop-up calendar appears.
Given the pop-up calendar, when the user chooses a date, then it is set as the due date.

requirement_text: TCS shall provide the capability to monitor specific telemetry elements real-time, and record all telemetry elements for future review and processing.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want to monitor specific telemetry elements in real time and have all telemetry elements recorded for later review, so that I can follow and analyze the mission.
technical_task: Provide real-time monitoring of selected telemetry elements and recording of every telemetry element for later review and processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given specific telemetry elements, when the operator monitors them, then their values are shown in real time.
Given all telemetry elements, when they are received, then they are recorded for future review and processing.

requirement_text: System shall segment view and download statistics by country and sector to demonstrate broader impact.
user_story: As a program manager, I want view and download statistics segmented by country and sector, so that I can show broader impact.
technical_task: Break view and download statistics down by country and by sector.
acceptance_criteria: Given view and download data, when statistics are shown, then they can be segmented by country.
Given view and download data, when statistics are shown, then they can be segmented by sector.

requirement_text: ASPERA-3 and MEX OA IDFS data and any APAF-generated intermediate files of ASPERA-3 and MEX OA cleaned-up telemetry shall be provided to all ASPERA-3 Co-Is.
user_story: As an ASPERA-3 Co-I, I want ASPERA-3 and MEX OA IDFS data and the APAF-generated intermediate files of cleaned-up telemetry, so that I can do my analysis.
technical_task: Deliver ASPERA-3 and MEX OA IDFS data and any APAF-generated intermediate files of ASPERA-3 and MEX OA cleaned-up telemetry to all ASPERA-3 Co-Is.
acceptance_criteria: Given ASPERA-3 and MEX OA IDFS data, when it is provided, then it is available to all ASPERA-3 Co-Is.
Given APAF-generated intermediate files of cleaned-up telemetry, when they are provided, then they are available to all ASPERA-3 Co-Is.

requirement_text: The HCP can indicate the patient has passed away providing an appropriate diagnosis code.
requirement_text_raw: The HCP can indicate the patient has passed away  providing an appropriate diagnosis code.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to record that a patient has passed away with an appropriate diagnosis code, so that the record shows the patient's status.
technical_task: Allow the HCP to mark a patient as deceased and enter an appropriate diagnosis code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when the HCP indicates the patient has passed away and enters a diagnosis code, then the status is saved.
Given the HCP indicates a patient has passed away, when no diagnosis code is entered, then the indication is not completed.
rationale: Role stated: HCP. The second criterion follows from "providing an appropriate diagnosis code".

requirement_text: The language of the product shall accommodate all of the target market countries. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the language of the product is acceptable.
requirement_text_raw: The language of the product shall accommodate all of the target market countries. 90\% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the language of the product is acceptable.'
user_story: As a customer in any target market country, I want the product language to suit my country, so that I find it acceptable.
technical_task: Provide product language suited to every target market country and confirm acceptability by surveying respondents in each country.
acceptance_criteria: Given a target market country, when the product is used there, then its language is suited to that country.
Given survey respondents from each target market country, when the results are counted, then 90% find the language of the product acceptable.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. "Acceptable" is judged by the survey.

requirement_text: The search for the preferred repair facility should be completed within 8 seconds.
user_story: As a policyholder, I want the search for the preferred repair facility to finish within 8 seconds, so that I am not kept waiting.
technical_task: Complete the search for the preferred repair facility within 8 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search for the preferred repair facility, when it is performed, then it completes within 8 seconds.
Given a search that takes longer than 8 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: policyholder. "Should" makes this a recommended limit.

requirement_text: If the maximum value is reported on bus, the deviation of the reported distance is equal or larger than 2.8m and function reactions should be plausibilized using independent information.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want function reactions to be plausibilized with independent information when the maximum value is reported on the bus and the deviation is 2.8m or more, so that implausible reactions are avoided.
technical_task: When the maximum value is reported on the bus and the deviation of the reported distance is equal to or larger than 2.8m, plausibilize function reactions with independent information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the maximum value is reported on the bus and the deviation of the reported distance is equal to or larger than 2.8m, when a function reaction is triggered, then it is plausibilized using independent information.
Given a deviation smaller than 2.8m, when a function reaction is triggered, then this requirement does not apply.

requirement_text: The FCP watchdog timer shall remain active during memory re-alignment.
requirement_text_raw: The FCP watchdog timer shall (3.3.5.38) remain active during memory re-alignment.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP watchdog timer to stay active during memory re-alignment, so that a hang is still detected.
technical_task: Keep the FCP watchdog timer running throughout memory re-alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory re-alignment is in progress, when the FCP watchdog timer is checked, then it is active.
Given memory re-alignment has completed, when the FCP watchdog timer is checked, then it is still active.

requirement_text: User shall be able to manage the user portfolio, providing access to new users and deleting inactive employees.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to manage the user portfolio, giving access to new users and deleting inactive employees, so that access stays current.
technical_task: Provide portfolio management that grants access to new users and removes inactive employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when the administrator adds the user to the portfolio, then the user is given access.
Given an inactive employee, when the administrator deletes the employee, then the employee is removed from the portfolio.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to register for a new LPG connection using the system.
user_story: As a household customer, I want to register for a new LPG connection using the system, so that I can get a connection.
technical_task: Offer registration for a new LPG connection in the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when a user starts a registration for a new LPG connection, then the registration form is shown.
Given a completed registration, when it is submitted, then the request for a new LPG connection is recorded.

requirement_text: The Prescription form includes a search function for looking up a particular type of medication.
user_story: As a clinician, I want a search function in the Prescription form to look up a type of medication, so that I can find medications quickly.
technical_task: Add a medication search function to the Prescription form.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Prescription form, when the user enters a type of medication in the search, then matching medications are listed.
Given the Prescription form, when the user opens it, then the search function is available.

requirement_text: User shall specify software requirements and dependencies.
user_story: As a software owner, I want to specify software requirements and dependencies, so that they are documented.
technical_task: Provide a way for users to enter software requirements and dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Given the specification screen, when the user enters a software requirement, then it is saved.
Given the specification screen, when the user enters a dependency, then it is saved.

requirement_text: The solution should support standards-based encryption mechanisms when encryption is used for secure data exchange.
user_story: As a security officer, I want standards-based encryption mechanisms whenever encryption is used for secure data exchange, so that exchanges stay interoperable and secure.
technical_task: Use standards-based encryption mechanisms wherever encryption is applied to secure data exchange.
acceptance_criteria: Given a secure data exchange that uses encryption, when its encryption mechanism is reviewed, then it is standards-based.
Given a secure data exchange, when it is reviewed, then it does not use a proprietary non-standard encryption mechanism.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall rely on the order used in adding tasks to a rate group to determine the task priorities.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS039] rely on the order used in adding tasks to a rate group to determine the task priorities.
user_story: As a software developer, I want the scheduler to use the order in which tasks were added to a rate group as their priorities, so that priority is predictable.
technical_task: Derive task priorities in a rate group from the order in which tasks were added.
acceptance_criteria: Given tasks added to a rate group in a certain order, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then they follow that order.
Given a different order of adding the same tasks, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then the priorities follow the new order.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. Which order gets the higher priority is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall tolerate faults and inform the user if the connection to the internet, GPS device, or other inputs are disrupted.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to tolerate faults and tell me when the internet, GPS device or other inputs are disrupted, so that I know why something is not working.
technical_task: Continue operating under input disruptions and notify the user when the internet connection, the GPS device or other inputs are disrupted.
acceptance_criteria: Given the internet connection is disrupted, when it happens, then the user is informed.
Given the GPS device or another input is disrupted, when it happens, then the user is informed and the system keeps running.

requirement_text: System shall allow only one antivirus to be installed on a single device at a time.
user_story: As a device owner, I want only one antivirus installed on a device at a time, so that antivirus programs do not conflict.
technical_task: Allow only one antivirus to be installed on a single device at any time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device with no antivirus, when one is installed, then the installation succeeds.
Given a device that already has an antivirus, when a second one is installed, then the installation is not allowed.

requirement_text: The system shall use industry-standard, commonly available, and widely used operating system, message passing middleware, and programming languages.
rationale: "Industry-standard, commonly available and widely used" are not specific or measurable.
clarification_questions: Which operating system, middleware and programming languages are meant?
What makes something "industry-standard" and "widely used"?

requirement_text: The FTPP system shall be two fault tolerant for any two non-simultaneous hardware faults through out all phases of the X-38 mission (i.e., from power on to power off, without degradation).
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall (3.1.17) be two fault tolerant for any two non-simultaneous hardware faults through out all phases of the X-38 mission (i.e., from power on to power off, without degradation).
user_story: As a mission manager, I want the FTPP system to be two fault tolerant for any two non-simultaneous hardware faults during all phases of the X-38 mission without degradation, so that the mission continues after faults.
technical_task: Design the FTPP system to tolerate any two non-simultaneous hardware faults, from power on to power off, without degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a first hardware fault at any phase of the X-38 mission, when it occurs, then the FTPP system continues without degradation.
Given a second hardware fault that does not occur at the same time as the first, when it occurs, then the FTPP system still operates without degradation.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to manage Subjects.
user_story: As a user, I want to manage Subjects, so that I can keep them up to date.
technical_task: Provide management functions for Subjects.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Subject, when the user manages it, then the change is saved.
Given the list of Subjects, when the user opens it, then the Subjects are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The management actions are not listed.

requirement_text: Only registered realtors shall be able to access the system.
requirement_text_raw: Only registered realtors shall be able to access the system.'
user_story: As a realtor, I want only registered realtors to access the system, so that the system is limited to genuine users.
technical_task: Restrict system access to registered realtors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered realtor, when the realtor logs in, then access is granted.
Given a person who is not a registered realtor, when the person tries to access the system, then access is denied.

requirement_text: System shall recommend similar items based on the user's buying pattern.
user_story: As a shopper, I want similar items recommended from my buying pattern, so that I find things I may like.
technical_task: Recommend items similar to those suggested by the user's buying pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a buying pattern, when the user opens the recommendations, then similar items are shown.
Given a user with no buying pattern, when the user opens the recommendations, then no pattern-based items are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. How similarity is defined is not stated.

requirement_text: An HCP chooses Office Visit Reminders and then to identify chronic patients who need an office visit older patients who need a flu shot or any patient who is overdue for an immunization .
requirement_text_raw: An HCP chooses Office Visit Reminders and then to identify chronic patients who need an office visit   older patients who need a flu shot   or any patient who is overdue for an immunization .
user_story: As an HCP, I want to choose Office Visit Reminders to identify chronic patients who need an office visit, older patients who need a flu shot and patients overdue for an immunization, so that I can remind them.
technical_task: Offer an Office Visit Reminders option that identifies chronic patients needing an office visit, older patients needing a flu shot and patients overdue for an immunization.
acceptance_criteria: Given the HCP chooses Office Visit Reminders, when the option is selected, then chronic patients who need an office visit can be identified.
Given the HCP chooses Office Visit Reminders, when the option is selected, then older patients who need a flu shot and patients overdue for an immunization can be identified.
rationale: Role stated: HCP. The age for "older" is not stated.

requirement_text: The solution should conform to Auditable Records to audit all changes to other business rules.
user_story: As an auditor, I want all changes to other business rules audited, so that rule changes can be traced.
technical_task: Record an audit entry for every change to business rules other than those already covered, following Auditable Records.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change to a business rule, when the change is saved, then an auditable record of the change is created.
Given the audit records, when an auditor opens them, then the changes to business rules can be found.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. "Other business rules" refers to rules covered elsewhere.

requirement_text: Recycling facility shall communicate directly with site admin to address any issues or concerns.
user_story: As a recycling facility operator, I want to communicate directly with the site admin about issues or concerns, so that problems are resolved.
technical_task: Provide a direct communication channel between the recycling facility and the site admin.
acceptance_criteria: Given a recycling facility with an issue, when it contacts the site admin, then the message reaches the site admin directly.
Given a message from the site admin, when it is sent to the recycling facility, then the facility receives it.
rationale: Role stated: recycling facility and site admin. The channel type is not specified.

requirement_text: System shall generate weekly rosters for employees (administrator function).
user_story: As an administrator, I want to generate weekly rosters for employees, so that everyone knows their shifts.
technical_task: Add an administrator function that generates a weekly roster for employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given employees, when the administrator generates the roster for a week, then a weekly roster is produced.
Given a generated weekly roster, when an employee views it, then it shows that employee's assignments.

requirement_text: Users shall input a unique username.
user_story: As a new user, I want to input a unique username, so that I can be identified.
technical_task: Require a username that is not used by any other user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a username that no other user has, when the user inputs it, then it is accepted.
Given a username that already exists, when the user inputs it, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. The second criterion follows from "unique".

requirement_text: HEC rules shall be implemented while creating the system.
rationale: "HEC rules" are referenced but not defined.
clarification_questions: What are the HEC rules and where are they defined?
How is conformity to them verified?

requirement_text: Increased RAM shall improve the software's ability to handle complex projects, multiple layers, and large file sizes.
user_story: As a designer, I want more RAM to improve the software's ability to handle complex projects, multiple layers and large files, so that I can work on bigger projects.
technical_task: Make the software use added RAM to handle complex projects, multiple layers and large file sizes better.
acceptance_criteria: Given a computer with more RAM, when a complex project is opened, then the software handles it better than with less RAM.
Given a project with multiple layers or a large file, when more RAM is available, then the software handles it better.
rationale: Role assumed: designer. "Improve" is relative; no target is given.

requirement_text: System shall verify the user's social media account details and share the video link.
user_story: As a user, I want my social media account details verified and the video link shared, so that my video is posted.
technical_task: Verify the user's social media account details and then share the video link.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid social media account details, when the user shares a video, then the details are verified and the video link is shared.
Given invalid account details, when the user shares a video, then the link is not shared.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to choose a restaurant type from a list and see the results on a map.
user_story: As a diner, I want to choose a restaurant type from a list and see results on a map, so that I find places nearby.
technical_task: Provide a list of restaurant types and show matching restaurants on a map.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of restaurant types, when the user chooses one, then the results are shown.
Given the results, when they are displayed, then they appear on a map.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed for extensibility, maintainability, and open-source release.
rationale: "Extensibility" and "maintainability" are not measurable and the release is not described.
clarification_questions: What makes the design extensible and maintainable in testable terms?
What must be done for the open-source release (license, repository)?

requirement_text: Communication services shall detect a babbling NE or ICP within 20 milliseconds of the receipt of the first erroneous packet.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS235] detect a babbling NE or ICP within 20 milliseconds of the receipt of the first erroneous packet.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want communication services to detect a babbling NE or ICP within 20 milliseconds of the first erroneous packet, so that a faulty unit is isolated quickly.
technical_task: Detect a babbling NE or ICP within 20 milliseconds after the first erroneous packet is received.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE or ICP sends erroneous packets, when the first erroneous packet is received, then communication services detect it as babbling within 20 milliseconds.
Given detection takes longer than 20 milliseconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to manage queries regarding videos and respond to user queries.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to manage queries about videos and respond to users, so that users get answers.
technical_task: Provide an administrator view to manage video queries and send responses to users.
acceptance_criteria: Given queries about videos, when the administrator opens the list, then the queries are shown.
Given a query, when the administrator responds, then the response is sent to the user.

requirement_text: 100% of customers will be able to receive automatic software updates transmitted to the installed product.
user_story: As a customer, I want automatic software updates sent to my installed product, so that it stays current.
technical_task: Deliver software updates automatically to every installed product so that 100% of customers can receive them.
acceptance_criteria: Given an installed product, when an update is released, then it is transmitted to the product automatically.
Given all customers, when an update is released, then 100% of them can receive it.

requirement_text: If the torque actuator implements a lower break torque than the break torque request because the [transmission] is not closed then the torque actuator must send this information (`` stop break torque '').
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the torque actuator to report "stop break torque" when it applies a lower break torque than requested because the transmission is not closed, so that the limitation is known.
technical_task: Send the information "stop break torque" from the torque actuator whenever it implements a lower break torque than requested because the transmission is not closed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the transmission is not closed and the torque actuator implements a lower break torque than requested, when this happens, then it sends "stop break torque".
Given the torque actuator implements the requested break torque, when this happens, then "stop break torque" is not sent.

requirement_text: System shall maintain an unalterable audit trail capturing actions taken on critical entities, users initiating actions, and date/time of events.
user_story: As an auditor, I want an unalterable audit trail of actions on critical entities, the users who initiated them and the date and time, so that activity can be reviewed.
technical_task: Maintain a tamper-proof audit trail recording actions on critical entities, the initiating users and the date and time of each event.
acceptance_criteria: Given an action on a critical entity, when it is performed, then the audit trail records the action, the initiating user and the date and time.
Given an entry in the audit trail, when someone tries to change it, then the change is not allowed.

requirement_text: As a minimum the TCS LOS data terminal control modes shall include acquisition, autotrack, search,manual point, omni directional, as well as directional modes of operation, if applicable to the selected data link.
user_story: As an operator, I want the TCS LOS data terminal control modes to include acquisition, autotrack, search, manual point, omni directional and directional modes, so that I can control the terminal in each.
technical_task: Provide at least the control modes acquisition, autotrack, search, manual point, omni directional and directional in the TCS LOS data terminal control, where applicable to the selected data link.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected data link for which the modes apply, when the operator opens the control modes, then acquisition, autotrack, search, manual point, omni directional and directional modes are available.
Given a selected data link for which a mode does not apply, when the operator opens the control modes, then that mode need not be offered.
rationale: Role assumed: operator. "As a minimum" means more modes may exist.

requirement_text: The administrator will store (1) the National Drug Code (The National Drug Code (NDC) is a universal product identifier used in the United States for drugs intended for human use.
rationale: The sentence is cut off after item (1) and the parenthesis is never closed.
clarification_questions: What does the administrator store besides the National Drug Code (item (1))?
What is the complete sentence, since the parenthesis is not closed?
