requirement_text_raw: However, the FTSS SW shall (3.3.2.42) notify the application software if the 5th ICP’s heartbeat ceases to exist.
user_story: As a software developer, I want the FTSS SW to notify the application software when the 5th ICP's heartbeat ceases, so that the application knows the ICP is gone.
technical_task: Send a notification to the application software when the heartbeat of the 5th ICP stops.
acceptance_criteria: Given the heartbeat of the 5th ICP ceases, when the FTSS SW detects it, then the application software is notified.
Given the heartbeat of the 5th ICP continues, when the FTSS SW checks it, then no notification is sent.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. The garbled apostrophe in the source was read as "ICP's".

requirement_text: Resumes will be imported directly from an existing database.
user_story: As a recruiter, I want resumes imported directly from an existing database, so that I do not enter them again.
technical_task: Import resumes directly from an existing database.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing database of resumes, when the import runs, then the resumes are imported.
Given an imported resume, when it is viewed, then it matches the source record.

requirement_text: The FTPP system shall be capable of powering up and operating with any combination of 3 of the 5 FCR's active.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall (3.1.18) be capable of powering up and operating with any combination of 3 of the 5 FCR's active.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTPP system to power up and operate with any combination of 3 of the 5 FCRs active, so that it works with reduced hardware.
technical_task: Support power-up and operation with any 3 of the 5 FCRs active.
acceptance_criteria: Given any combination of 3 of the 5 FCRs active, when the FTPP system powers up, then it powers up.
Given any combination of 3 of the 5 FCRs active, when the FTPP system operates, then it operates.

requirement_text: The sensor shall deliver fewer than 1 false alarm sensor object with Obj_LongDoubleFusion_Qual set continuously to 1 equal LOW or 2 equal HIGH per hour in all ODAs, where the number of sensor cycles the false alarm is delivered as sensor object is less than or equal to 2.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the sensor to deliver fewer than 1 false alarm sensor object per hour in all ODAs, so that false alarms are rare.
technical_task: Limit false alarm sensor objects with Obj_LongDoubleFusion_Qual continuously set to 1 (LOW) or 2 (HIGH) to fewer than 1 per hour in all ODAs, counting only false alarms delivered for no more than 2 sensor cycles.
acceptance_criteria: Given Obj_LongDoubleFusion_Qual set continuously to 1 (LOW) or 2 (HIGH), when the sensor runs in all ODAs, then it delivers fewer than 1 false alarm sensor object per hour.
Given a false alarm delivered as a sensor object, when its duration is counted, then it is counted if it lasts less than or equal to 2 sensor cycles.

requirement_text: Reintegration of an FCP shall be completed in at most 1.5 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: Reintegration of an FCP shall (3.3.5.21) be completed in at most 1.5 minutes.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want reintegration of an FCP completed in at most 1.5 minutes, so that capacity returns quickly.
technical_task: Complete reintegration of an FCP within 1.5 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP to be reintegrated, when reintegration runs, then it completes in at most 1.5 minutes.
Given a reintegration that takes longer than 1.5 minutes, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to create users, departments, and courses.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to create users, departments and courses, so that the institution's structure is in the system.
technical_task: Provide administrator functions to create users, departments and courses.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator creates a user, a department or a course, then it is saved.
Given a saved user, department or course, when it is listed, then it is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to contact administrators for feedback or assistance.
user_story: As a user, I want to contact administrators for feedback or assistance, so that I can get help.
technical_task: Offer a way for users to send feedback or assistance requests to administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user sends feedback to an administrator, then the administrator receives it.
Given a user, when the user asks for assistance, then the request reaches an administrator.

requirement_text: If the button press is shorter than the LIN cycle time, the signal is to be set to `` TRUE '' for one communication cycle.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the signal set to "TRUE" for one communication cycle when a button press is shorter than the LIN cycle time, so that short presses are not lost.
technical_task: Set the signal to "TRUE" for one communication cycle whenever the button press is shorter than the LIN cycle time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a button press shorter than the LIN cycle time, when it is detected, then the signal is set to "TRUE" for one communication cycle.
Given a button press that is not shorter than the LIN cycle time, when it is detected, then this rule does not apply.

requirement_text: Premium Users shall be permitted to make up to 66 calls per day.
user_story: As a premium user, I want to make up to 66 calls per day, so that I have a defined allowance.
technical_task: Limit Premium Users to 66 calls per day.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Premium User who has made fewer than 66 calls today, when the user makes a call, then it is allowed.
Given a Premium User who has made 66 calls today, when the user tries another call, then it is refused.

requirement_text: The Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.7 (Secure Data Routing) to ensure that the exchange occurs only among authorized senders and receivers.
requirement_text_raw: The  Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.7 (Secure Data Routing)  to ensure that the exchange occurs only among authorized senders and receivers.
user_story: As a security officer, I want the Clinical Decision Support capability to conform to function IN.1.7 (Secure Data Routing), so that data is exchanged only among authorized senders and receivers.
technical_task: Make the Clinical Decision Support capability follow function IN.1.7 (Secure Data Routing) so exchanges involve only authorized senders and receivers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an exchange of data by the Clinical Decision Support capability, when it takes place, then it is only among authorized senders and receivers.
Given a sender or receiver that is not authorized, when it tries to take part, then it is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. IN.1.7 is only referenced.

requirement_text: System shall be able to verify if the user is situated within a 1-mile radius of the campus.
user_story: As a campus administrator, I want the system to verify whether a user is within a 1-mile radius of the campus, so that location-restricted features are limited to nearby users.
technical_task: Check whether the user's location is within a 1-mile radius of the campus.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user within a 1-mile radius of the campus, when the system verifies the location, then the user is recognized as inside the radius.
Given a user farther than 1 mile from the campus, when the system verifies the location, then the user is recognized as outside the radius.
rationale: Role assumed: campus administrator. What the result is used for is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall be able to add a new chemist or lab, with only one lab allowed per pincode.
user_story: As a user, I want to add a new chemist or lab, with only one lab allowed per pincode, so that coverage is not duplicated.
technical_task: Allow adding a chemist or lab and reject a second lab for the same pincode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pincode with no lab, when the user adds a lab, then the lab is added.
Given a pincode that already has a lab, when the user adds another lab for it, then the addition is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to update or edit their profile appearance.
user_story: As a user, I want to update my profile appearance, so that it looks the way I want.
technical_task: Allow users to edit the appearance of their profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's profile, when the user edits its appearance, then the change is saved.
Given a saved appearance change, when the profile is viewed, then the new appearance is shown.

requirement_text: System shall enable role-based access control to enforce appropriate permissions for different user roles.
user_story: As an administrator, I want role-based access control, so that each role has the right permissions.
technical_task: Implement role-based access control that assigns permissions per user role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a role, when the user performs an action permitted for that role, then the action is allowed.
Given a user with a role, when the user performs an action not permitted for that role, then the action is denied.

requirement_text: The software shall allow users to create precise and intricate designs more easily with a touch-screen enabled tablet/monitor.
rationale: "More easily", "precise" and "intricate" are relative and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How much easier should designs be to create compared with what?
Which touch-screen devices and what precision are meant?

requirement_text: As an option to AAA-batteries the supplier shall propose a concept with smaller batteries.
user_story: As a client, I want the supplier to propose a concept with smaller batteries as an option to AAA batteries, so that I can compare alternatives.
technical_task: Have the supplier propose, as an option, a concept using batteries smaller than AAA.
acceptance_criteria: Given the supplier's proposal, when it is reviewed, then it offers AAA batteries as the baseline.
Given the supplier's proposal, when it is reviewed, then it also includes a concept with smaller batteries as an option.

requirement_text: System shall maintain data elements and rules up to date.
rationale: "Data elements and rules" and "up to date" are not specified.
clarification_questions: Which data elements and rules must be kept up to date?
How often and by whom?

requirement_text: The TCS will interface with external systems to conduct mission coordination and operations.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want the TCS to interface with external systems, so that missions can be coordinated and operated together.
technical_task: Provide interfaces from the TCS to external systems for mission coordination and operations.
acceptance_criteria: Given an external system, when the TCS communicates with it, then mission coordination information is exchanged.
Given an external system, when the TCS communicates with it, then operations information is exchanged.
rationale: Role assumed: mission operator. The external systems are not named.

requirement_text: There shall be built-in support on the NE for voted resets, including a special packet type for executing the primitive.
requirement_text_raw: There shall (3.2.2.5.1) be built-in support on the NE for voted resets, including a special packet type for executing the primitive.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want built-in NE support for voted resets, including a special packet type to execute the primitive, so that resets can be coordinated.
technical_task: Build voted reset support into the NE, including a special packet type used to execute the voted reset primitive.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE, when a voted reset is requested, then the NE supports executing it.
Given a voted reset, when it is executed, then a special packet type is used to carry out the primitive.

requirement_text: For defects that cannot be reproduced with the current release and which relate to an earlier release, the contractor shall create at least one test case that verifies the defect in the earlier release.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor to create a test case that verifies a defect in the earlier release when it cannot be reproduced in the current one, so that the defect can still be checked.
technical_task: For each defect that cannot be reproduced with the current release and relates to an earlier release, create at least one test case that verifies the defect in the earlier release.
acceptance_criteria: Given a defect that cannot be reproduced with the current release and relates to an earlier release, when the contractor handles it, then at least one test case is created.
Given the test case, when it is run against the earlier release, then it verifies the defect.

requirement_text: System shall provide a secure environment for user interaction with the command-line interface.
user_story: As a user, I want a secure environment for interacting with the command-line interface, so that my commands and data are protected.
technical_task: Secure the environment in which the command-line interface is used.
acceptance_criteria: Given the command-line interface, when a user interacts with it, then the interaction takes place in a secure environment.
Given an unauthorized person, when the person tries to use the command-line interface, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The security measures are not specified.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to provide written feedback, rate the app, and share their thoughts after installation.
user_story: As a user, I want to write feedback, rate the app and share my thoughts after installing it, so that developers know my opinion.
technical_task: Offer feedback entry, rating and sharing of thoughts after installation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the app is installed, when the user writes feedback, then the feedback is saved.
Given the app is installed, when the user rates the app or shares thoughts, then the rating or thoughts are saved.

requirement_text: The system shall allow applicants to resubmit revised plans.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to resubmit revised plans, so that I can correct my application.
technical_task: Allow applicants to submit a revised version of their plans.
acceptance_criteria: Given a submitted application, when the applicant resubmits revised plans, then the revised plans are saved.
Given revised plans, when the application is viewed, then the revised plans are shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access the control panel based on their role as administrator, employer, or job seeker.
user_story: As a user, I want to open the control panel according to my role as administrator, employer or job seeker, so that I see the functions that suit my role.
technical_task: Provide a control panel whose access and content depend on whether the user is an administrator, an employer or a job seeker.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the role administrator, employer or job seeker, when the user opens the control panel, then the panel for that role is shown.
Given a user without any of these roles, when the user tries to open the control panel, then access is denied.
rationale: The three roles are stated in the requirement. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: System shall customize the user's homepage based on previous interactions, including wish-list additions, page views, and previous searches.
user_story: As a shopper, I want my homepage customized from my wish-list additions, page views and previous searches, so that I see items that interest me.
technical_task: Personalize the user's homepage using their wish-list additions, page views and previous searches.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with wish-list additions, page views and previous searches, when the user opens the homepage, then the homepage is customized using them.
Given a user with no history, when the user opens the homepage, then the default homepage is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: System shall allow users to search for buses using destination, boarding place, and date of journey, displaying available buses according to user requirements.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to search for buses by destination, boarding place and date of journey and see the available buses, so that I can choose one that suits me.
technical_task: Implement a bus search by destination, boarding place and date of journey that lists the available buses matching the user's requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a destination, a boarding place and a date of journey, when the user searches, then the available buses matching them are displayed.
Given no bus available for the entered details, when the user searches, then no buses are displayed.

requirement_text: The website shall prevent its data from being corrupted when incorrect data is entered in.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall prevent its data from being corrupted when incorrect data is entered in.'
user_story: As a site owner, I want the website to stop incorrect input from corrupting its data, so that stored data stays reliable.
technical_task: Validate and reject incorrect input so that it cannot damage stored data.
acceptance_criteria: Given incorrect data is entered, when it is submitted, then it is rejected and the stored data is unchanged.
Given correct data is entered, when it is submitted, then it is stored.
rationale: Role assumed: site owner. What counts as incorrect data is not defined.

requirement_text: The system shall store camper records from previous years for reference.
user_story: As a camp director, I want camper records from previous years stored, so that I can refer to them.
technical_task: Retain camper records of past years and make them available for reference.
acceptance_criteria: Given camper records from a previous year, when a new year starts, then the records are still stored.
Given a stored previous-year record, when the camp director opens it, then it can be viewed.

requirement_text: System shall maintain updated descriptions of datasets throughout the project lifecycle.
user_story: As a data steward, I want dataset descriptions kept up to date through the project lifecycle, so that they stay accurate.
technical_task: Keep dataset descriptions current throughout the project lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset whose content changes, when the change is made, then its description can be updated.
Given a dataset, when it is viewed at any stage of the project lifecycle, then its description is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: data steward. How updates are triggered is not stated.

requirement_text: Managers shall be able to delete tasks from the system.
user_story: As a manager, I want to delete tasks from the system, so that outdated tasks are removed.
technical_task: Allow managers to delete tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task, when a manager deletes it, then it is removed from the system.
Given a user who is not a manager, when the user tries to delete a task, then it is not deleted.
rationale: Role stated: manager. The second criterion follows from "Managers shall".

requirement_text: System shall verify the mobile number and prompt for first name and last name.
user_story: As a new user, I want my mobile number verified and to be asked for my first and last name, so that my account details are complete.
technical_task: Verify the entered mobile number and prompt for first name and last name.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mobile number, when the user submits it, then the system verifies it.
Given a verified mobile number, when the user continues, then the system prompts for first name and last name.

requirement_text: Workers shall be able to view rewards.
user_story: As a worker, I want to view rewards, so that I know what I have earned.
technical_task: Display the rewards available to workers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a worker with rewards, when the worker opens the rewards page, then the rewards are shown.
Given a worker with no rewards, when the worker opens the rewards page, then it shows that there are none.

requirement_text: The operational requirement for direct mode is to: (I) provide short range fall-back communications between train drivers and trackside personnel in the event of failure of mobile telephony services normally available; provide short range communications for railway personnel operating in remote areas where no mobile telephony facilities are available.
requirement_text_raw: 15.1.1 The operational requirement for direct mode is to: (I) provide short range fall-back communications between train drivers and trackside personnel in the event of failure of mobile telephony services normally available; provide short range communications for railway personnel operating in remote areas where no mobile telephony facilities are available.
user_story: As a train driver, I want short range fall-back communications with trackside personnel when mobile telephony fails, and for railway personnel in remote areas without mobile telephony, so that communication is possible.
technical_task: Provide a direct mode for short range communications between train drivers and trackside personnel when mobile telephony is unavailable or has failed, including in remote areas without mobile telephony.
acceptance_criteria: Given mobile telephony services have failed, when a train driver calls trackside personnel, then short range direct mode communication is possible.
Given a remote area with no mobile telephony facilities, when railway personnel communicate, then short range direct mode communication is possible.
rationale: Role assumed: train driver. The two cases come from the requirement.

requirement_text: System shall allow the administrator to register members by manually inputting their information into the system.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to register members by entering their information manually, so that members can be added without self-registration.
technical_task: Provide a form for the administrator to register a member with manually entered information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the administrator enters a member's information and saves, then the member is registered.
Given the saved member, when the member list is opened, then the member is listed.

requirement_text: The system shall acknowledge user actions with confirmation to ensure application reliability for business purposes.
user_story: As a user, I want each of my actions acknowledged with a confirmation, so that I know the application received it.
technical_task: Show a confirmation after every user action.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user performs an action, when the action completes, then a confirmation is shown.
Given an action that fails, when it ends, then no success confirmation is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The business reliability aim is not measurable, so the criteria cover the confirmation.

requirement_text: Plug-in API will be well-documented for plug-in developers.
clarification_questions: What makes the Plug-in API "well-documented" in testable terms?
Which parts of the API must be documented?

requirement_text: System shall be able to place a marker for each historical site on the map, including the site name, a short description, and a link to the sites page.
user_story: As a visitor, I want a marker on the map for each historical site with its name, a short description and a link to its page, so that I can explore the sites.
technical_task: Place a map marker for every historical site that shows the site name, a short description and a link to the site's page.
acceptance_criteria: Given historical sites, when the map is displayed, then a marker is shown for each site.
Given a marker, when the visitor opens it, then the site name, a short description and a link to the site's page are shown.

requirement_text: System shall utilize cryptographic techniques for user authentication (future version).
user_story: As a user, I want cryptographic techniques used for authentication in a future version, so that my login is stronger.
technical_task: Plan the use of cryptographic techniques for user authentication in a future version.
acceptance_criteria: Given the future version, when a user authenticates, then cryptographic techniques are used.
Given the current version, when it is reviewed, then this requirement is not yet required to be in place.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The requirement is marked as a future version.

requirement_text: If the vehicle possesses a variable partition window between the front seat row and the rear seat row, the system shall apply the last mode principle on InCarCom front-to-rear if the partition window is not closed.
user_story: As a passenger, I want the last mode principle applied front-to-rear on InCarCom when the partition window is not closed, so that communication behaves consistently.
technical_task: For vehicles with a variable partition window between the front and rear seat rows, apply the last mode principle on InCarCom from front to rear while the partition window is not closed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vehicle with a variable partition window and the window is not closed, when InCarCom front-to-rear is used, then the last mode principle is applied.
Given a vehicle without a variable partition window, when InCarCom is used, then this requirement does not apply.
rationale: Role assumed: passenger. The last mode principle is not defined in the sentence.

requirement_text: The system shall accept the product identification parameter and new price for the product as input.
user_story: As a shop manager, I want to enter a product identification parameter and a new price, so that I can change a product's price.
technical_task: Accept a product identification parameter and a new price as inputs for a price change.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product identification parameter and a new price, when they are submitted, then the system accepts both inputs.
Given a missing product identification parameter or price, when the input is submitted, then it is not accepted.

requirement_text: The SEP shall have a resolution of 20 msec. for 50 Hz tasks, 100 msec for 10 Hz tasks, and 1 second for 1 Hz tasks.
requirement_text_raw: The SEP shall (3.3.10.14) have a resolution of 20 msec. for 50 Hz tasks, 100 msec for 10 Hz tasks, and 1 second for 1 Hz tasks.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the SEP resolution to be 20 msec. for 50 Hz tasks, 100 msec for 10 Hz tasks and 1 second for 1 Hz tasks, so that timing is fine enough for each rate.
technical_task: Configure the SEP resolution per rate: 20 msec. for 50 Hz tasks, 100 msec for 10 Hz tasks and 1 second for 1 Hz tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 50 Hz task, when SEP resolution is checked, then it is 20 msec.
Given a 10 Hz task or a 1 Hz task, when SEP resolution is checked, then it is 100 msec or 1 second respectively.

requirement_text: The system shall be available to users 24/7 with minimal downtime.
clarification_questions: What availability percentage and downtime are acceptable?
How much downtime is "minimal"?

requirement_text: The flight NE shall be designed and constructed so that no part of any component shifts in setting, position, or adjustment.
requirement_text_raw: The flight NE  shall (3.2.3.1.3.2)  be designed and constructed so that no part of any component shifts in setting, position, or adjustment.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the flight NE built so that no part of any component shifts in setting, position or adjustment, so that it stays stable under flight conditions.
technical_task: Design and construct the flight NE so that no component part can change its setting, position or adjustment.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flight NE, when its components are inspected after exposure to its environment, then no part has shifted in setting.
Given the flight NE, when its components are inspected, then no part has shifted in position or adjustment.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The environment for the inspection is not stated.

requirement_text: The throttle is to be implemented in such a way that in the entire operating temperature and operating voltage range each angle position between completely open and closed can be accessed.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want every angle position between completely open and closed reachable on the throttle across the entire temperature and voltage range, so that it can be controlled fully.
technical_task: Implement the throttle so each angle position between completely open and closed can be reached over the entire operating temperature and operating voltage range.
acceptance_criteria: Given any operating temperature and operating voltage within range, when an angle position between completely open and closed is requested, then the throttle can reach it.
Given the complete range, when the extremes are tested, then every angle position is still accessible.

requirement_text: Once a request to turn on or off a heating or cooling unit, the THEMAS system shall provide the necessary control signal for the unit.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the THEMAS system to provide the control signal to a heating or cooling unit when a request to turn it on or off is made, so that the unit responds.
technical_task: Send the required control signal to the heating or cooling unit when a request to turn it on or off arrives.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request to turn on a heating or cooling unit, when the request is made, then the THEMAS system provides the control signal for the unit.
Given a request to turn off a heating or cooling unit, when the request is made, then the THEMAS system provides the control signal for the unit.
rationale: Role assumed: building manager. The sentence is incomplete ("Once a request ...").

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to define transitions and animations for slides within a presentation.
user_story: As a presenter, I want to define transitions and animations for slides, so that my presentation looks the way I want.
technical_task: Provide settings for transitions and animations on each slide of a presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a slide, when the user defines a transition, then the transition is applied to the slide.
Given a slide, when the user defines an animation, then the animation is applied to the slide.

requirement_text: User data will be encrypted using industry-standard encryption algorithms, including payment information and personal data.
user_story: As a user, I want my data, including payment information and personal data, encrypted with industry-standard algorithms, so that it is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt user data, including payment information and personal data, using industry-standard encryption algorithms.
acceptance_criteria: Given payment information, when it is stored, then it is encrypted with an industry-standard algorithm.
Given personal data, when it is stored, then it is encrypted with an industry-standard algorithm.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The algorithms are not named.

requirement_text: The system shall support multicast protocols for sending multicast messages, requiring compatible routers, network cards, and operating systems.
user_story: As a network administrator, I want the system to support multicast protocols for sending multicast messages, with compatible routers, network cards and operating systems, so that multicast works.
technical_task: Support multicast protocols for sending multicast messages and require compatible routers, network cards and operating systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given compatible routers, network cards and operating systems, when a multicast message is sent, then it is delivered using a multicast protocol.
Given a component that is not compatible with multicast, when a multicast message is sent, then multicast delivery is not guaranteed.
rationale: Role assumed: network administrator. The second criterion is an interpretation of "requiring compatible" components.

requirement_text: The system shall implement user authentication and access controls based on user roles (e.g., standard user, administrator).
user_story: As an administrator, I want user authentication and role-based access controls, so that standard users and administrators get different permissions.
technical_task: Implement user authentication and access controls based on roles such as standard user and administrator.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with valid credentials, when the user logs in, then the user is authenticated and gets the permissions of the user's role.
Given a standard user, when the user tries an administrator action, then it is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The roles in brackets are examples.

requirement_text: The list should now display all billables from the selected date range.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want the list to show all billables from the selected date range, so that I can review them.
technical_task: Update the list to display all billables within the selected date range.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected date range, when the list is displayed, then it shows all billables in that range.
Given a billable outside the selected date range, when the list is displayed, then it is not shown.

requirement_text: An employee will be able to successfully use the product within a few minutes.
rationale: "A few minutes" and "successfully use the product" are not defined.
clarification_questions: How many minutes count as "a few minutes"?
Which tasks must an employee be able to do successfully?

requirement_text: The platform shall have a community app showcasing data visualization examples.
user_story: As a researcher, I want a community app showing data visualization examples, so that I can see what is possible.
technical_task: Add a community app to the platform that showcases data visualization examples.
acceptance_criteria: Given the platform, when a user opens the community app, then data visualization examples are shown.
Given a data visualization example, when a user opens it, then it is displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall perform automatic plankton size/orientation detection in Plankton Portal images.
user_story: As a plankton researcher, I want automatic detection of plankton size and orientation in Plankton Portal images, so that I do not measure them by hand.
technical_task: Detect plankton size and orientation automatically in Plankton Portal images.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Plankton Portal image with plankton, when the system processes it, then plankton size is detected.
Given a Plankton Portal image with plankton, when the system processes it, then plankton orientation is detected.

requirement_text: The system shall rotate the picture by 90 degrees.
user_story: As a user, I want to rotate a picture by 90 degrees, so that it is shown the right way up.
technical_task: Add a function that rotates a picture by 90 degrees.
acceptance_criteria: Given a picture, when the user rotates it, then it is turned by 90 degrees.
Given a rotated picture, when it is displayed, then it shows the new orientation.

requirement_text: In the ingame screen, users can choose emote buttons by touching them, and upon selection, the chosen emote shall be displayed to the other user.
user_story: As a player, I want to choose an emote button on the in-game screen and have it shown to the other user, so that I can react during the game.
technical_task: Show emote buttons on the in-game screen and display the selected emote to the other user.
acceptance_criteria: Given the in-game screen, when the player touches an emote button, then the emote is chosen.
Given an emote has been chosen, when it is selected, then it is displayed to the other user.

requirement_text: All error messages must be meaningful and accompanied by explanatory text.
rationale: "Meaningful" is subjective and the explanatory text is not specified.
clarification_questions: What makes an error message "meaningful"?
What must the explanatory text contain?

requirement_text: User shall be able to manage settings such as alternate email address, phone number, preferred language, or password.
user_story: As a user, I want to manage settings such as my alternate email address, phone number, preferred language or password, so that my profile stays current.
technical_task: Provide a settings page for alternate email address, phone number, preferred language and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given the settings page, when the user changes the alternate email address, phone number or preferred language, then the change is saved.
Given the settings page, when the user changes the password, then the new password is saved.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means more settings may exist.

requirement_text: Name of the contractor shall be written smaller than the name of the Client.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor's name written smaller than my name, so that the client is more prominent.
technical_task: Set the contractor's name in a smaller size than the client's name.
acceptance_criteria: Given a document with both names, when it is displayed, then the contractor's name is smaller than the client's name.
Given the two names, when their sizes are compared, then the client's name is the larger.

requirement_text: Special fit bolt will be used for mounting.
user_story: As a mechanical engineer, I want special fit bolts used for mounting, so that the mounting is accurate.
technical_task: Use special fit bolts for mounting.
acceptance_criteria: Given the mounting, when it is assembled, then special fit bolts are used.
Given the finished assembly, when it is inspected, then no standard bolts are used for the mounting.
rationale: Role assumed: mechanical engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: System shall adhere to specified quality attributes such as security and portability.
rationale: The quality attributes are only named as examples and have no criteria.
clarification_questions: Which quality attributes are "specified" and where?
What measurable criteria apply to security and portability?

requirement_text: User shall be able to block system access for a user by entering their card number.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to block system access for a user by entering their card number, so that lost or misused cards cannot be used.
technical_task: Allow a user to block system access for another user by entering that user's card number.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid card number, when the user enters it to block access, then system access is blocked for the card's user.
Given a blocked card number, when its user tries to access the system, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to activate the appropriate heating or cooling unit based on a predefined temperature differential between the current temperature and setting.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the right heating or cooling unit activated based on a predefined temperature differential, so that the temperature reaches the setting.
technical_task: Activate the heating or cooling unit that fits the difference between the current temperature and the setting, using a predefined temperature differential.
acceptance_criteria: Given the current temperature is below the setting by the predefined differential, when the system evaluates it, then the heating unit is activated.
Given the current temperature is above the setting by the predefined differential, when the system evaluates it, then the cooling unit is activated.
rationale: Role assumed: building manager. The differential value is not given.

requirement_text: User shall have an ALFRED device easily adaptable for users with visual or hearing impairments.
user_story: As a user with a visual or hearing impairment, I want an ALFRED device that is easy to adapt to my needs, so that I can use it.
technical_task: Provide adaptation options in the ALFRED device for users with visual or hearing impairments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a visual impairment, when the user adapts the ALFRED device, then the visual output is adjusted.
Given a user with a hearing impairment, when the user adapts the ALFRED device, then the audio output is adjusted.
rationale: Role assumed: user with an impairment. "Easily" is not measured and the adaptations are not listed.

requirement_text: The Mission Elapsed Time shall have a drift rate of at worst 50 PPM.
requirement_text_raw: The Mission Elapsed Time shall [SRS218] have a drift rate of at worst 50 PPM.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Mission Elapsed Time drift rate to be at worst 50 PPM, so that elapsed time is accurate.
technical_task: Keep the drift rate of the Mission Elapsed Time within 50 PPM.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Mission Elapsed Time is running, when its drift rate is measured, then it is at worst 50 PPM.
Given a drift rate above 50 PPM, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall reintegrate a failed FCP processor with the FCP virtual group when alignment is permitted and when the processor failure is not permanent.
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS110] reintegrate a failed FCP processor with the FCP virtual group when alignment is permitted and when the processor failure is not permanent.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to reintegrate a failed FCP processor with the FCP virtual group when alignment is permitted and the failure is not permanent, so that capacity is restored.
technical_task: Reintegrate a failed FCP processor into the FCP virtual group when alignment is permitted and the processor failure is not permanent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failed FCP processor with a non-permanent failure and alignment is permitted, when Redundancy Management handles it, then the processor is reintegrated with the FCP virtual group.
Given a permanent failure or alignment is not permitted, when Redundancy Management handles the processor, then it is not reintegrated.

requirement_text: If a light system damping of the DTR sensor is observed, but no relevant influence on the system functionality is present (all object data etc. are still determined and transmitted) the condition DTR_SysDamp equal ``1''/INC_DAMP is sent and a connected near range sensor system can sensitise the damping detection with this information if necessary.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want DTR_SysDamp equal 1 / INC_DAMP sent when the DTR sensor shows light system damping without relevant influence on functionality, so that a near range sensor can use it.
technical_task: When light system damping of the DTR sensor is observed and all object data are still determined and transmitted, send DTR_SysDamp equal 1 / INC_DAMP so a connected near range sensor system can sensitise its damping detection if necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Given light system damping of the DTR sensor with no relevant influence on system functionality, when it is observed, then DTR_SysDamp equal 1 / INC_DAMP is sent.
Given DTR_SysDamp equal 1 / INC_DAMP is sent, when a near range sensor system is connected, then it can sensitise its damping detection with this information.

requirement_text: The administrator shall have the capability to modify the expected range of sensed data against which the data will be validated.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to modify the expected range of sensed data used for validation, so that validation matches the sensor.
technical_task: Provide a setting that lets the administrator change the expected range against which sensed data is validated.
acceptance_criteria: Given the validation settings, when the administrator changes the expected range, then the new range is saved.
Given sensed data, when it is validated, then it is checked against the current expected range.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed for intuitive use by first-time users.
clarification_questions: How is "intuitive use by first-time users" measured?
What tasks must a first-time user complete without help?

requirement_text: The FCP shall configure ICP simplex virtual groups for each channel in the FCP virtual group.
requirement_text_raw: The FCP shall [SRS296] configure ICP simplex virtual groups for each channel in the FCP virtual group.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP to configure ICP simplex virtual groups for each channel in the FCP virtual group, so that each channel has its virtual group.
technical_task: Configure one ICP simplex virtual group on the FCP for every channel in the FCP virtual group.
acceptance_criteria: Given a channel in the FCP virtual group, when the FCP configures the ICPs, then an ICP simplex virtual group is configured for it.
Given several channels in the FCP virtual group, when the FCP configures the ICPs, then each channel has its own ICP simplex virtual group.

requirement_text: The system shall have a user-friendly interface that is intuitive and easy to navigate for users with varying technical skills.
clarification_questions: What does "user-friendly" and "easy to navigate" mean in measurable terms?
Which technical skill levels must be covered?

requirement_text: Broadcast primitives shall not be available on ICPs.
requirement_text_raw: Broadcast primitives shall (3.3.6.10) not be available on ICPs.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want broadcast primitives not to be available on ICPs, so that ICPs cannot broadcast.
technical_task: Disable broadcast primitives on ICPs.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ICP, when a broadcast primitive is used on it, then it is not available.
Given an ICP, when its available primitives are listed, then broadcast primitives are not included.

requirement_text: The Project Team must demonstrate mockups of UI changes to project stakeholders early in the development process.
rationale: "Early in the development process" is not defined.
clarification_questions: How early in the development process must mockups be shown?
Which UI changes and which stakeholders are meant?

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to integrate with Netbeans IDE 7.2.1 for Java development and MySQL Query Browser for database management.
user_story: As a developer, I want the application to integrate with Netbeans IDE 7.2.1 for Java development and MySQL Query Browser for database management, so that I can use my tools.
technical_task: Support integration with Netbeans IDE 7.2.1 for Java development and with MySQL Query Browser for database management.
acceptance_criteria: Given Netbeans IDE 7.2.1, when a developer uses it for Java development, then the application integrates with it.
Given MySQL Query Browser, when a developer uses it for database management, then the application integrates with it.

requirement_text: Upon submission, the system shall validate and check for duplicate or invalid entries.
user_story: As a user, I want my submission checked for duplicate or invalid entries, so that bad data is not saved.
technical_task: On submission, validate the entries and check them for duplicates and invalid values.
acceptance_criteria: Given a submission with an invalid entry, when it is submitted, then the invalid entry is detected.
Given a submission with a duplicate entry, when it is submitted, then the duplicate is detected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What happens after detection is not stated.

requirement_text: In case of hardware failure or database corruption, users shall be redirected to a replacement page.
user_story: As a user, I want to be redirected to a replacement page when hardware fails or the database is corrupted, so that I see a clear page instead of an error.
technical_task: Redirect users to a replacement page in case of hardware failure or database corruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hardware failure, when a user requests a page, then the user is redirected to a replacement page.
Given database corruption, when a user requests a page, then the user is redirected to a replacement page.

requirement_text: System shall ensure that transactions reflect accurately in databases without any data loss.
user_story: As an account holder, I want transactions to be reflected accurately in the databases without data loss, so that my records are correct.
technical_task: Write every transaction to the databases completely and accurately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction, when it completes, then it is reflected accurately in the databases.
Given a series of transactions, when they are all complete, then none of their data is missing from the databases.

requirement_text: LHCPs can edit or delete future appointments .
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to edit or delete future appointments, so that my schedule stays correct.
technical_task: Allow an LHCP to change or remove appointments that lie in the future.
acceptance_criteria: Given a future appointment, when the LHCP edits it, then the changes are saved.
Given a future appointment, when the LHCP deletes it, then it is removed.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The limit to future appointments is taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: The system shall provide guidance to new publishers after signup.
user_story: As a new publisher, I want guidance after signing up, so that I know how to start publishing.
technical_task: Show guidance to publishers right after signup.
acceptance_criteria: Given a publisher who has just signed up, when signup completes, then guidance is shown.
Given the guidance, when the publisher reads it, then it explains how to get started as a publisher.
rationale: Role stated: new publisher. The content of the guidance is not described.

requirement_text: Click on a person's name to edit their contact information or click 'Add New' to enter a new contact into your address book.
requirement_text_raw: Click on a person's name to edit their contact information  or click 'Add New' to enter a new contact into your address book.
user_story: As a user, I want to click a person's name to edit their contact information, or click Add New to enter a new contact in my address book, so that my contacts stay current.
technical_task: Make names in the address book open for editing and provide an Add New control for new contacts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the address book, when the user clicks a person's name, then the contact information can be edited.
Given the address book, when the user clicks Add New, then a new contact can be entered.

requirement_text: In the Twitter settings menu, the system shall allow the user to delete their saved username and password for Twitter.
user_story: As a user, I want to delete my saved Twitter username and password in the Twitter settings menu, so that my credentials are no longer stored.
technical_task: Add an option in the Twitter settings menu that deletes the saved Twitter username and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given saved Twitter credentials, when the user deletes them in the Twitter settings menu, then the saved username and password are removed.
Given the credentials were deleted, when the user opens the settings, then no saved username or password is shown.

requirement_text: The LHCP is provided a bar chart of diagnosis counts during the specified time period as well as a yes or no answer on whether an epidemic is occurring during any consecutive two weeks during the time period.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want a bar chart of diagnosis counts for a time period and a yes or no answer on whether an epidemic occurs in any two consecutive weeks, so that I can spot outbreaks.
technical_task: Show a bar chart of diagnosis counts for the specified time period and a yes or no indicator on whether an epidemic is occurring during any two consecutive weeks of that period.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specified time period, when the LHCP requests the report, then a bar chart of diagnosis counts is shown.
Given the same time period, when the report is shown, then it includes a yes or no answer on whether an epidemic is occurring during any two consecutive weeks of the period.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The epidemic rule is not defined in the sentence.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to handle complaints regarding content by providing solutions or forwarding the issue to the related department and communicating the solution to the user.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to handle content complaints by providing a solution or forwarding the issue to the related department and telling the user the solution, so that complaints are resolved.
technical_task: Provide complaint handling in which the administrator resolves a content complaint or forwards it to the related department and communicates the solution to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a content complaint, when the administrator resolves it, then the solution is communicated to the user.

Given a content complaint that the administrator cannot resolve, when the administrator forwards it to the related department, then the department receives it and the solution is later communicated to the user.

requirement_text: User shall be able to delete an activity by selecting it on the canvas and clicking the "Delete" button on the user GUI.
user_story: As a user, I want to delete an activity by selecting it on the canvas and clicking the Delete button, so that I can remove activities I no longer need.
technical_task: Add a Delete button to the GUI that removes the activity selected on the canvas.
acceptance_criteria: Given an activity selected on the canvas, when the user clicks the Delete button, then the activity is deleted.
Given no activity selected on the canvas, when the user clicks the Delete button, then nothing is deleted.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to evaluate consistency with the comprehensive plan during application reviews.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to evaluate consistency with the comprehensive plan during application reviews, so that approvals follow the plan.
technical_task: Add a consistency evaluation against the comprehensive plan to the application review process.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application under review, when staff evaluate it, then they can record whether it is consistent with the comprehensive plan.
Given the review of an application, when it is completed, then the consistency evaluation is part of the review.

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to display offers for specific restaurant.
user_story: As an admin, I want to display offers for a specific restaurant, so that customers see its offers.
technical_task: Allow the admin to publish and show offers for a chosen restaurant.
acceptance_criteria: Given a restaurant, when the admin adds an offer for it, then the offer is displayed for that restaurant.
Given two restaurants, when an offer is added for one, then it is not displayed for the other.

requirement_text: Data collection devices (e.g. – handheld devices etc.) synchronize with the System securely using authentication authorization and encryption mechanisms.
requirement_text_raw: Data collection devices (e.g. – handheld devices  etc.) synchronize with the System securely using authentication  authorization and encryption mechanisms.
user_story: As a security officer, I want data collection devices such as handheld devices to synchronize with the System using authentication, authorization and encryption, so that synchronization is secure.
technical_task: Secure synchronization of data collection devices with the System using authentication, authorization and encryption mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data collection device, when it synchronizes with the System, then it is authenticated and authorized first.
Given a synchronization, when data is transferred, then it is encrypted.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The garbled example in the source text is not used.

requirement_text: System shall be able to manage bills for clients, including clearance receipt, freight fare, and delivery charges, and maintain complete records of payments.
user_story: As a logistics clerk, I want to manage bills for clients including clearance receipt, freight fare and delivery charges, and keep complete payment records, so that billing is traceable.
technical_task: Implement bill management for clients covering clearance receipt, freight fare and delivery charges, and store complete payment records.
acceptance_criteria: Given a client, when the clerk creates a bill, then clearance receipt, freight fare and delivery charges can be included.
Given a payment is made on a bill, when it is recorded, then it is kept in the client's payment records.

requirement_text: Agricultural exports shall be able to post information for users to view by entering agricultural news, books, and technology developments for display.
user_story: As an agricultural exporter, I want to post agricultural news, books and technology developments for users to view, so that information is shared.
technical_task: Provide posting of agricultural news, books and technology developments that other users can view.
acceptance_criteria: Given an agricultural exporter, when the exporter enters agricultural news, books or technology developments, then they are saved for display.
Given posted information, when users open the page, then it is displayed to them.
rationale: Role stated: agricultural exporter ("Agricultural exports" in the source).

requirement_text: System shall ensure efficient email communication for trainers via the website.
rationale: "Efficient" is not measurable and the email functions are not specified.
clarification_questions: What does "efficient" mean for email communication (delivery time, volume)?
Which email functions must the website provide for trainers?

requirement_text: The details described in Other Applicable Document SPEC LV 124-2, Appendix A [LH-5383] shall be taken into account when conducting the tests.
rationale: The sentence only refers to another document.
clarification_questions: What do SPEC LV 124-2 Appendix A require for the tests?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: For a velocity equal or larger than 266 km/h (corrected speedometer velocity which is displayed to the driver) this bit is set to `` 1 ''.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want a bit set to 1 for corrected speedometer velocities of 266 km/h or more, so that high speed is signalled.
technical_task: Set the bit to 1 when the corrected speedometer velocity shown to the driver is equal to or larger than 266 km/h.
acceptance_criteria: Given a corrected speedometer velocity of 266 km/h or more, when it is displayed to the driver, then the bit is set to 1.
Given a corrected speedometer velocity below 266 km/h, when it is displayed to the driver, then the bit is not set to 1 by this rule.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. Which bit is meant is not stated in the sentence.

requirement_text: User shall be able to log out securely.
user_story: As a user, I want to log out securely, so that nobody can use my session afterwards.
technical_task: Provide a logout function that ends the session securely.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in user, when the user logs out, then the session is ended.
Given a logged-out session, when someone uses the old session, then access is denied.

requirement_text: Communication services shall provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes". "Pipes" provide fast data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group when minimal data latency is necessary.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS048] provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes". "Pipes" provide fast data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group when minimal data latency is necessary.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to provide "immediate" message passing in the form of "pipes", so that data moves quickly between virtual groups when latency must be minimal.
technical_task: Provide "immediate" message passing as "pipes" for fast data throughput between virtual groups or within one virtual group when minimal data latency is needed.
acceptance_criteria: Given two virtual groups, when an application uses a "pipe", then data passes between them.
Given a single virtual group, when an application uses a "pipe", then data passes within it.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. How fast "fast" is is not specified.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to view the Menu from the dashboard.
user_story: As a user, I want to view the Menu from the dashboard, so that I can see what is on offer.
technical_task: Link the Menu from the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given the dashboard, when the user opens it, then the Menu can be accessed.
Given the dashboard, when the user selects the Menu, then the Menu is displayed.

requirement_text: The status of a laboratory procedure has been updated (UC26 S3).
requirement_text_raw: The status of a laboratory procedure has been updated (UC26  S3).
rationale: The sentence reports a completed status update (UC26 S3) and states no behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a statement of a result rather than a requirement?
What must the system do when the status of a laboratory procedure is updated?

requirement_text: The user shall be able to set notification parameters for an assignment.
user_story: As a student, I want to set notification parameters for an assignment, so that I am reminded the way I choose.
technical_task: Add notification settings to each assignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an assignment, when the user sets notification parameters, then they are saved.
Given saved notification parameters, when the assignment is due, then notifications follow them.
rationale: Role assumed: student. Which parameters exist is not listed.

requirement_text: The system shall prioritize traveler privacy regarding location tracking within the mobility domain.
rationale: "Prioritize" is not testable and the behaviour is not specified.
clarification_questions: What does "prioritize privacy" require in testable terms?
Which location tracking data and mobility domain functions are involved?

requirement_text: System shall confirm all transactions with the customer’s web browser.
user_story: As a customer, I want transactions confirmed with my web browser, so that I know they went through.
technical_task: Send a confirmation of each transaction to the customer's web browser.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed transaction, when it finishes, then a confirmation is shown in the customer's web browser.
Given a failed transaction, when it ends, then no confirmation of success is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The garbled apostrophe in the source was read as "customer's".

requirement_text: System shall tolerate existing datasets if their properties are different but compatible when creating a dataset as part of app deployment.
user_story: As an app developer, I want existing datasets with different but compatible properties to be tolerated when a dataset is created during app deployment, so that deployment does not fail needlessly.
technical_task: When creating a dataset during app deployment, accept an existing dataset if its properties differ from the requested ones but are compatible.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing dataset whose properties differ but are compatible, when the app is deployed, then the existing dataset is accepted.
Given an existing dataset whose properties are incompatible, when the app is deployed, then it is not accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: app developer. What counts as compatible is not defined.

requirement_text: CNG shall be able to classify intra-LAN traffic that is simply bridged by the CNG itself within the CPN.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want the CNG to classify intra-LAN traffic that it simply bridges within the CPN, so that such traffic can be handled by class.
technical_task: Classify intra-LAN traffic that the CNG bridges itself within the CPN.
acceptance_criteria: Given intra-LAN traffic bridged by the CNG within the CPN, when it passes through, then the CNG classifies it.
Given traffic not bridged by the CNG itself, when it passes through, then this requirement does not apply.
rationale: Role assumed: network engineer. The classes are not listed.

requirement_text: The product shall retain the customer's buying preferences and information.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall retain the customer's buying preferences and information.'
user_story: As a customer, I want the product to remember my buying preferences and information, so that I don't have to enter them again.
technical_task: Store each customer's buying preferences and information for later use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer's buying preferences and information, when they are entered, then they are stored.
Given a returning customer, when the customer uses the product again, then the stored preferences and information are available.

requirement_text: - `` 99 '': object is closer than the nominal distance (very ciritical, CPA warning in IC).
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the value 99 signalled when an object is closer than the nominal distance, so that a critical situation is flagged.
technical_task: Output the value 99 when an object is closer than the nominal distance, as a very critical condition with a CPA warning in the instrument cluster.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object closer than the nominal distance, when the sensor reports, then the value 99 is output.
Given the value 99, when it is received, then it indicates a very critical condition with a CPA warning in the instrument cluster.

requirement_text: The application should be installable on Microsoft or Unix platforms and compatible with browsers such as IE, Firefox, Chrome, Opera, or Safari.
user_story: As a user, I want to install the application on Microsoft or Unix platforms and use it with browsers such as IE, Firefox, Chrome, Opera or Safari, so that I can use my usual setup.
technical_task: Make the application installable on Microsoft and Unix platforms and compatible with the browsers IE, Firefox, Chrome, Opera and Safari.

Given IE, Firefox, Chrome, Opera or Safari, when the application is used in it, then it works.

requirement_text: An HCP chooses to refer a patient to another receiving HCP through the referral feature on a patient's office visit page (UC11).
user_story: As an HCP, I want to refer a patient to another receiving HCP through the referral feature on the patient's office visit page, so that the patient gets further care.
technical_task: Add a referral feature on the patient's office visit page that sends a patient to another receiving HCP (UC11).
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient's office visit page, when the HCP chooses to refer the patient, then the HCP can select a receiving HCP.
Given a selected receiving HCP, when the HCP confirms the referral, then the patient is referred to that HCP.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to update transactional parcel pins to reference the GIS layer for split or merged parcels.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to update transactional parcel pins to reference the GIS layer for split or merged parcels, so that records match the map.
technical_task: Allow staff to update the transactional parcel pins so they reference the GIS layer for parcels that are split or merged.
acceptance_criteria: Given a split parcel, when staff update its transactional parcel pins, then they reference the GIS layer.
Given a merged parcel, when staff update its transactional parcel pins, then they reference the GIS layer.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to extract data for administrative purposes.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to extract data for administrative purposes, so that I can use it in reports.
technical_task: Provide a data extraction function for administrative purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given data in the solution, when an authorized administrator requests an extraction, then the data is extracted.
Given an extraction, when it completes, then the extracted data is available to the administrator.

requirement_text: The available recycled parts information and their suppliers shall be returned to the user.
user_story: As a customer, I want to be shown the available recycled parts and their suppliers, so that I can choose where to buy.
technical_task: Return the list of available recycled parts together with their suppliers.
acceptance_criteria: Given available recycled parts, when the user requests them, then the parts are returned.
Given an available recycled part, when it is returned, then its supplier information is returned with it.

requirement_text: For a transient NE failure, FDIR shall mask the failed NE.
requirement_text_raw: For a transient NE failure, FDIR shall (3.3.5.24) mask the failed NE.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to mask a failed NE after a transient failure, so that the system continues without it.
technical_task: Mask the failed NE in FDIR when the NE failure is transient.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transient NE failure, when FDIR handles it, then the failed NE is masked.

clarification_questions: What does "smoothly" mean and what response time counts as "minimal delay"?

acceptance_criteria: Given an order and the engaged menu, when the customer drags a special dietary requirement onto the order, then it is added to the order.

Given the Finish Window with Statistics, when the player completes it, then the entries are recorded.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to clear all assignments for a particular class.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to clear all assignments for a particular class, so that I can reset it.

acceptance_criteria: Given a class with assignments, when the user clears all assignments, then none remain for that class.
Given another class, when the user clears one class, then the other class's assignments are unchanged.

acceptance_criteria: Given the Disputes user interface, when it is reviewed against the corporate standards, then it complies.
Given the user interface screens, when they are reviewed, then they comply for both internal and external use.

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to access online shopping opportunities.
user_story: As a customer, I want to access online shopping opportunities, so that I can buy online.
technical_task: Provide access to the online shopping functions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user opens the shopping area, then online shopping options are shown.
Given an online shopping option, when the user selects it, then it opens.

requirement_text: The FTPP system shall be able to accommodate power up of all 5 channels and maintain all 5 NEs active, assuming no failures.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall (3.1.19) be able to accommodate power up of all 5 channels and maintain all 5 NEs active, assuming no failures.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTPP system to power up all 5 channels and keep all 5 NEs active when there are no failures, so that full capacity is available.
technical_task: Enable power-up of all 5 channels and keep all 5 NEs active, assuming no failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given no failures, when the FTPP system powers up, then all 5 channels are powered up.
Given all 5 channels are powered up with no failures, when the system runs, then all 5 NEs remain active.

requirement_text: The system shall allow batch ingest of ETDs with embargo and permission settings.
user_story: As a librarian, I want batch ingest of ETDs with embargo and permission settings, so that many theses are loaded at once.
technical_task: Support batch ingest of ETDs together with embargo and permission settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given a batch of ETDs, when the librarian ingests it, then all ETDs in the batch are ingested.
Given an ETD with embargo and permission settings, when it is ingested, then the settings are applied.

requirement_text: The homepage of Apollo hospitals system shall serve as the main interface for users.
user_story: As a patient, I want the Apollo hospitals homepage to be the main interface, so that I can start from one place.
technical_task: Design the homepage of the Apollo hospitals system as the main entry point for users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user opens the Apollo hospitals system, when the system loads, then the homepage is shown as the main interface.
Given the homepage, when a user looks for system functions, then they can be reached from it.

requirement_text: ATM cabinet cover shall be made of fiberglass for security purposes.
user_story: As a bank operator, I want the ATM cabinet cover made of fiberglass, so that the cabinet is protected.
technical_task: Specify fiberglass as the material of the ATM cabinet cover.
acceptance_criteria: Given the ATM cabinet cover, when its material is checked, then it is fiberglass.
Given the ATM cabinet, when it is delivered, then no cover of another material is fitted.

requirement_text: System shall restore data if a database crash occurs.
user_story: As an administrator, I want data restored after a database crash, so that no data is permanently lost.
technical_task: Restore the database data when a crash occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a database crash, when it happens, then the data is restored.
Given the data has been restored, when users access it, then it matches the state before the crash.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The restore point is not stated.

requirement_text: The component shall have special diagnostic modes for end of line testing, calibration and input/output value testing.
user_story: As a test engineer, I want special diagnostic modes for end of line testing, calibration and input/output value testing, so that the component can be tested and calibrated.
technical_task: Provide diagnostic modes in the component for end of line testing, calibration and input/output value testing.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component, when end of line testing is performed, then a special diagnostic mode for it is available.
Given the component, when calibration or input/output value testing is performed, then a special diagnostic mode for each is available.

requirement_text: The solution should be stable and will operate for sustained amounts of time without interruption.

What counts as an interruption?

requirement_text: This allows you to easily spot many types of errors such as appointments with missing encounters encounters with missing appointments missing charges and authorizations or justifications that are required but not done.
requirement_text_raw: This allows you to easily spot many types of errors  such as appointments with missing encounters  encounters with missing appointments  missing charges  and authorizations or justifications that are required but not done.
rationale: The sentence describes a benefit of an unnamed feature and states no behaviour.
