Is this a requirement or a description of a benefit?

requirement_text: The system shall utilize an object store (S3) for storing large video files.
user_story: As a content creator, I want large video files stored in an object store (S3), so that storage scales.
technical_task: Store large video files in an S3 object store.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large video file, when it is uploaded, then it is stored in the S3 object store.
Given a video stored in the object store, when it is requested, then it is retrieved from the object store.
rationale: Role assumed: content creator. What counts as large is not stated.

requirement_text: The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be easy to use. 90\% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'
user_story: As an employee, I want to reserve a conference room easily, so that 90% of users can do so within 5 minutes of using the product.
technical_task: Design the reservation flow so that 90% of users can reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a group of users new to the product, when they try to reserve a conference room, then 90% succeed within 5 minutes.
Given fewer than 90% succeed within 5 minutes, when the results are evaluated, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: employee. "Easy to use" is made testable by the 90% and 5 minute figures.

requirement_text: The system shall encrypt data items to prevent unauthorized access, tampering, and eavesdropping.
user_story: As a user, I want data items encrypted, so that nobody can access, tamper with or eavesdrop on them.
technical_task: Encrypt data items to protect them from unauthorized access, tampering and eavesdropping.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data item, when it is stored or sent, then it is encrypted.
Given an encrypted data item, when an unauthorized party tries to read or change it, then it is not readable and tampering is not possible without detection.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Tampering" protection by encryption alone is not guaranteed; the criterion states the intended outcome.

requirement_text: System shall handle over one thousand simultaneous user requests.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to handle over one thousand simultaneous requests, so that it stays responsive under load.
technical_task: Support more than one thousand simultaneous user requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given more than one thousand simultaneous user requests, when they are submitted, then the system handles them.
Given exactly one thousand simultaneous requests, when they are submitted, then the system handles them.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The response time under load is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall identify and generate appropriate event data for each event occurrence.
user_story: As a system operator, I want appropriate event data identified and generated for each event, so that events are recorded properly.
technical_task: Generate the appropriate event data whenever an event occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event occurs, when it is detected, then event data appropriate for the event is generated.
Given two different events, when both occur, then each gets its own event data.
rationale: Role assumed: system operator. What is "appropriate" is not defined.

requirement_text: A list of disputes meeting search criteria must be provided, differentiating by color-coded status.
user_story: As a dispute analyst, I want a list of disputes matching my search criteria with color-coded status, so that I can see the status at a glance.
technical_task: Return the disputes that meet the search criteria and differentiate them by color-coded status.
acceptance_criteria: Given search criteria, when the analyst searches, then a list of the matching disputes is provided.
Given disputes with different statuses, when the list is shown, then each status is displayed in its own color.

requirement_text: System shall enable customers to compare and choose products from the available options.
user_story: As a customer, I want to compare and choose products from the available options, so that I can pick the best one.
technical_task: Provide product comparison and selection among the available options.
acceptance_criteria: Given several products, when the customer compares them, then their details are shown side by side.
Given the comparison, when the customer chooses a product, then the product is selected.

requirement_text: User shall be able to render the scene at a minimum of 30 frames per second.
user_story: As a user, I want to render the scene at a minimum of 30 frames per second, so that playback is smooth.
technical_task: Render the scene at 30 frames per second or more.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene being rendered, when the frame rate is measured, then it is at least 30 frames per second.
Given a frame rate below 30 frames per second, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: User details and data should be stored securely in a database provided by the server.
user_story: As a user, I want my details and data stored securely in a database provided by the server, so that they are protected.
technical_task: Store user details and data in a secured database provided by the server.
acceptance_criteria: Given user details and data, when they are saved, then they are stored in the database provided by the server.
Given the stored data, when an unauthorized party tries to read it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The security mechanism is not specified.

acceptance_criteria: Given data is entered or sent, when the action completes, then a record shows the source cannot deny it.
Given data is received, when the receipt completes, then a record shows the receiver cannot deny it.

acceptance_criteria: Given a vendor, when the administrator communicates with the vendor, then the message is delivered.

user_story: As a traveler, I want relevant intelligence items cached for 12 hours, or longer if I like them, so that I can see them again quickly.
technical_task: Store relevant intelligence items in a cache that expires them after 12 hours, unless a traveler has liked them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a relevant intelligence item in the cache, when 12 hours have passed and no traveler has liked it, then it expires.
Given a relevant intelligence item liked by a traveler, when 12 hours have passed, then it is kept longer.

acceptance_criteria: Given a submitted meeting response, when the user modifies its date preference set, then the change is saved.

requirement_text: User shall be able to see an error message if the system is low on resources.

Given the system has enough resources, when the user is using it, then no such error message is shown.

acceptance_criteria: Given electronic protected health information transmitted electronically, when it is improperly modified, then the modification is detected.

requirement_text: The system shall encrypt sensitive data (patient information, prescriptions) at rest and in transit.
user_story: As a patient, I want my sensitive data, such as patient information and prescriptions, encrypted at rest and in transit, so that it stays private.

acceptance_criteria: Given patient information or a prescription, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given patient information or a prescription, when it is transmitted, then it is encrypted.

requirement_text: User shall have a registered email linked to the software.

technical_task: Require a registered email address to be linked to each user of the software.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user of the software, when the account is set up, then a registered email is linked to it.
Given a user without a registered email, when the user tries to proceed, then the user is asked to register one.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation of "shall have".

requirement_text: Enter the appropriate parameters such as the date of service and click 'Search' to bring up a list of all invoices (claims) matching the requested parameters.
requirement_text_raw: Enter the appropriate parameters  such as the date of service  and click 'Search' to bring up a list of all invoices (claims) matching the requested parameters.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to enter parameters such as the date of service and click Search to see all matching invoices (claims), so that I can find a claim.
technical_task: Provide a search with parameters such as date of service that lists all invoices (claims) matching them.
acceptance_criteria: Given search parameters such as the date of service, when the user clicks Search, then a list of all invoices (claims) matching the parameters is shown.
Given parameters that match no invoice, when the user clicks Search, then the list is empty.

requirement_text: It shall be possible to modify the CT whenever any of this information is changed by using a CT update primitive in a synchronous and atomic manner.
requirement_text_raw: It shall (3.2.2.2.3) be possible to modify the CT whenever any of this information is changed by using a CT update primitive in a synchronous and atomic manner.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want to modify the CT with a CT update primitive whenever the information changes, in a synchronous and atomic manner, so that the CT stays consistent.
technical_task: Provide a CT update primitive that modifies the CT synchronously and atomically whenever the information it holds changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the information in the CT changes, when the CT update primitive is used, then the CT is modified.
Given the CT update primitive is running, when it modifies the CT, then it does so synchronously and atomically.

requirement_text: The solution de-identification capability should include: Internet Protocol (IP) address numbers.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want the de-identification capability to include IP address numbers, so that they are removed from shared data.
technical_task: Add Internet Protocol (IP) address numbers to the identifiers handled by the de-identification capability.
acceptance_criteria: Given data containing an IP address number, when it is de-identified, then the IP address number is removed.
Given de-identified data, when it is reviewed, then no IP address number remains.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to authenticate to the application using their Radford University username and password.
user_story: As a student, I want to authenticate with my Radford University username and password, so that I can sign in with my existing account.
technical_task: Support authentication with Radford University usernames and passwords.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid Radford University username and password, when the user signs in, then the user is authenticated.
Given an invalid username or password, when the user signs in, then authentication fails.

requirement_text: The product shall be able to be installed in any operating environment within 2 days.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be able to be installed in any operating environment within 2 days.'
user_story: As an administrator, I want the product installable in any operating environment within 2 days, so that deployment is quick.
technical_task: Make the product installable in any operating environment in 2 days or less.
acceptance_criteria: Given any operating environment, when the product is installed, then the installation is completed within 2 days.
Given an installation that takes longer than 2 days, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall notify the application on the ICP, via an API call, 2 minor frames prior to an alignment.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS295] notify the application on the ICP, via an API call, 2 minor frames prior to an alignment.
user_story: As an application developer, I want the FTSS to notify the application on the ICP through an API call 2 minor frames before an alignment, so that my application can prepare.
technical_task: Send an API call notification to the application on the ICP 2 minor frames before each alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an alignment is scheduled, when 2 minor frames remain before it, then the FTSS notifies the application on the ICP through an API call.
Given more than 2 minor frames remain before an alignment, when the FTSS checks, then it has not yet sent the notification.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed for high performance with optimized server queries, instantaneous screen transitions, and sub-second cost-division computation.
rationale: "High performance" and "instantaneous" are not measurable and only the cost-division computation has a rough limit.
clarification_questions: What response times count as "high performance", "instantaneous" and "sub-second" for each operation?
Which server queries are to be optimized?

requirement_text: The service shall be able to show the seating arrangement and available seats, allowing users to book the desired number of seats.
user_story: As a customer, I want to see the seating arrangement and available seats and book the number of seats I want, so that I can choose where to sit.
technical_task: Show the seating arrangement with available seats and let users book a chosen number of seats.
acceptance_criteria: Given a service with seating, when the user opens it, then the seating arrangement and available seats are shown.
Given available seats, when the user books the desired number of seats, then those seats are booked.

requirement_text: The solution should allow an authorized user to flag a medication as "Do not substitute" e.g. substitution never allowed for the no sugar or no alcohol mouthwash.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should allow an authorized user to flag a medication as "Do not substitute"  e.g. substitution never allowed for  the no sugar or no alcohol mouthwash.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want to flag a medication as "Do not substitute", so that substitution is never allowed for it.
technical_task: Let an authorized user mark a medication as "Do not substitute" and block substitution for flagged medications.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user flags a medication as "Do not substitute", then the flag is saved.
Given a medication flagged "Do not substitute", when a substitution is attempted, then it is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: pharmacist; the requirement says authorized user. The no sugar or no alcohol mouthwash is an example.

requirement_text: The FAU class ensures security-relevant events are logged and identifies what information should be included in those logs.
rationale: The sentence refers to "the FAU class" and states no concrete behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the system log, and which information must each log entry include?
Is the FAU class a reference to another standard?

requirement_text: The probability threshold for an azimuthal side lobe detection may be higher than for the determination of the signal DTR_Obj_X_LongFusion_Qual / DTR_Obj_X_LongFunc_Qual to enable a pedestrian detection in connection with camera fusion at an early stage.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the probability threshold for azimuthal side lobe detection to be allowed higher than that for DTR_Obj_X_LongFusion_Qual and DTR_Obj_X_LongFunc_Qual, so that pedestrians are detected early with camera fusion.
technical_task: Allow a higher probability threshold for azimuthal side lobe detection than for determining DTR_Obj_X_LongFusion_Qual and DTR_Obj_X_LongFunc_Qual, to enable early pedestrian detection with camera fusion.
acceptance_criteria: Given azimuthal side lobe detection, when its probability threshold is set, then it may be higher than the threshold for determining the signals DTR_Obj_X_LongFusion_Qual and DTR_Obj_X_LongFunc_Qual.
Given camera fusion, when the higher threshold is used, then pedestrian detection is enabled at an early stage.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. "May" makes the higher threshold permitted, not mandatory.

requirement_text: Hint: A monitoring of SNA, DEFAULT values or OutOfRange of the operating parameters is only present as long as no values could be stored successfully in the NVM.
rationale: The sentence is labelled "Hint" and describes when monitoring exists without a behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or only a hint?
What must the system do when values cannot be stored in the NVM?

requirement_text: The system shall provide a social messaging platform where users can create and manage groups with chat functionalities.
user_story: As a user, I want a social messaging platform where I can create and manage groups with chat, so that I can talk with several people.
technical_task: Build a social messaging platform with group creation, group management and chat.
acceptance_criteria: Given the platform, when a user creates a group, then the group is created.
Given a group, when members use chat, then their messages are shown to the group.

requirement_text: User shall access fallback mechanisms in situations where offline resources are unavailable, assisting in understanding foreign language content.
user_story: As a user reading foreign language content, I want fallback mechanisms when offline resources are unavailable, so that I can still understand the content.
technical_task: Provide fallback mechanisms that are used when offline resources are unavailable to help the user understand foreign language content.
acceptance_criteria: Given offline resources are unavailable, when the user views foreign language content, then a fallback mechanism is offered.
Given a fallback mechanism, when the user uses it, then it assists in understanding the foreign language content.
rationale: Role assumed: user reading foreign language content. The fallback mechanisms are not described.

requirement_text: If the validation succeeds, user shall be redirected to the "Password reset" page.
user_story: As a user, I want to be taken to the Password reset page after my validation succeeds, so that I can set a new password.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the "Password reset" page when validation succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: Given validation succeeds, when it completes, then the user is redirected to the "Password reset" page.
Given validation fails, when it completes, then the user is not redirected to the "Password reset" page.

requirement_text: The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests.  This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2.  The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the product to handle up to 1 000 concurrent requests, rising to 2 000 by Release 2, including peak scheduling times, so that busy periods are covered.
technical_task: Support up to 1 000 concurrent requests, increasing to 2 000 by Release 2, including at peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon.
acceptance_criteria: Given up to 1 000 concurrent requests, when they are submitted, then the product handles them.
Given Release 2, when 2 000 concurrent requests are submitted at a peak scheduling time such as early morning or late afternoon, then the product handles them.

requirement_text: The fault is intended to detect the signal being in a range between its possible logical states open and closed.
rationale: The sentence says what a fault is intended to detect, without a required behaviour or the signal's name.
clarification_questions: What must the system do when the signal is between open and closed?
Which fault and which signal are meant?

requirement_text: The details of the circuit design and their dimensions shall be coordinated with the client.
user_story: As a client, I want the circuit design details and dimensions coordinated with me, so that I agree to them.
technical_task: Coordinate the details of the circuit design and their dimensions with the client.
acceptance_criteria: Given the circuit design details and dimensions, when they are prepared, then they are coordinated with the client.
Given coordinated details, when the design proceeds, then the client has agreed to them.
rationale: Role assumed: client. The form of coordination is not described.

requirement_text: Only IT team members can access and maintain database servers locally.
user_story: As an IT manager, I want only IT team members to access and maintain database servers locally, so that servers are protected.
technical_task: Restrict local access to and maintenance of the database servers to IT team members.
acceptance_criteria: Given an IT team member, when the member accesses a database server locally, then access is granted.
Given a person who is not an IT team member, when the person tries local access, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The system shall be secure and protect scanned documents from unauthorized access using encryption and access controls.
user_story: As a user, I want scanned documents protected from unauthorized access with encryption and access controls, so that my documents are private.
technical_task: Encrypt scanned documents and apply access controls to them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scanned document, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given a user without access rights, when the user tries to open a scanned document, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The flight NE shall be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein while non-operating in an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia.
requirement_text_raw: The flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.3.6.1) be designed to be capable of complying with all the performance requirements specified herein while non-operating in an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the flight NE to comply with all performance requirements after non-operating exposure to an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia, so that it survives storage and transport.
technical_task: Design the flight NE to meet all performance requirements after being non-operating in an atmosphere of 8 to 18 Psia.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flight NE has been non-operating at 8 Psia, when it is tested, then it complies with the performance requirements.
Given the flight NE has been non-operating at 18 Psia, when it is tested, then it complies with the performance requirements.

requirement_text: An API User shall be able to persistently store visualization states.
user_story: As an API user, I want to store visualization states persistently, so that I can restore them later.
technical_task: Offer an API function that saves a visualization state so that it persists.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visualization state, when the API user stores it, then it is saved persistently.
Given a stored visualization state, when the system restarts, then the state is still available.

requirement_text: System shall keep session track of user activity.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the system to keep track of user activity in sessions, so that I can see what users did.
technical_task: Record user activity for each session.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user session, when the user acts, then the activity is recorded for that session.
Given a recorded session, when an administrator reviews it, then the user's activity is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. What activity is tracked is not specified.

requirement_text: Dean shall be able to view details of all users (students, faculty, etc.).
user_story: As a dean, I want to view the details of all users such as students and faculty, so that I can oversee the institution.
technical_task: Let the dean see the details of every user, including students and faculty.
acceptance_criteria: Given the dean, when the dean opens the user list, then the details of all users are shown.
Given a user who is not the dean, when the user tries to open the full user details, then access is denied.
rationale: Role stated: dean. The second criterion follows from "Dean shall".

requirement_text: The variable oil pressure control valve is a proportional valve which can set every position from fully open to fully closed.
rationale: The sentence describes a valve and states no behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a description of a component or a requirement?
What must the system do with the oil pressure control valve?

requirement_text: System shall facilitate easy sponsorship registration and payment.
user_story: As a sponsor, I want to register as a sponsor and pay, so that I can support the event.
technical_task: Provide sponsorship registration with payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sponsorship page, when a sponsor registers, then the registration is saved.
Given a registered sponsor, when the sponsor pays, then the payment is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: sponsor. "Easy" is not measured.

requirement_text: Connections for chats and calls must remain uninterrupted.
user_story: As a user, I want chat and call connections to stay up, so that conversations are not cut off.
technical_task: Keep chat and call connections running without interruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given an active chat or call, when it is in progress, then the connection stays up.
Given a short network disturbance, when it occurs during a chat or call, then the connection is kept or restored without ending the conversation.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Uninterrupted" is read as staying connected; the disturbance criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: Restaurants shall be able to receive orders from customers.
user_story: As a restaurant owner, I want to receive orders from customers, so that I can prepare them.
technical_task: Deliver customer orders to the restaurant.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer places an order, when it is submitted, then the restaurant receives it.
Given several orders, when they are submitted, then the restaurant receives each of them.

requirement_text: System shall allow creation, updating, and deletion of state-specific data elements such as acts, sections, castes, tribes, etc.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to create, update and delete state-specific data elements such as acts, sections, castes and tribes, so that state data stays correct.
technical_task: Provide create, update and delete functions for state-specific data elements, including acts, sections, castes and tribes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a state-specific data element, when the administrator creates it, then it is saved.
Given an existing state-specific data element, when the administrator updates or deletes it, then the change is applied.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Etc." means other elements may exist.

requirement_text: User shall have a managed backup protocol for the Neurohub system as a system administrator.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want a managed backup protocol for the Neurohub system, so that data can be recovered.
technical_task: Define and operate a managed backup protocol for Neurohub.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Neurohub system, when backups are due, then the managed backup protocol is followed.
Given a backup made by the protocol, when it is checked, then it can be used to recover the Neurohub data.

requirement_text: Admin shall update the timing of bus arrival and departure, as well as its location.
user_story: As an admin, I want to update the arrival and departure times and the location of buses, so that passengers see current information.
technical_task: Provide admin functions to update bus arrival times, departure times and locations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bus, when the admin updates its arrival or departure time, then the new time is saved.
Given a bus, when the admin updates its location, then the new location is saved.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to attach files to emails, with a file size limit of 25 MB.
user_story: As an email user, I want to attach files to emails with a size limit of 25 MB, so that I can send documents.
technical_task: Allow attachments to emails and limit the file size to 25 MB.
acceptance_criteria: Given an email, when the user attaches a file of 25 MB or less, then the file is attached.
Given an email, when the user attaches a file larger than 25 MB, then the file is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to search for restaurants by price range (minimum and maximum) with results displayed in a list view by default.
user_story: As a diner, I want to search for restaurants by minimum and maximum price, with results in a list by default, so that I find places in my budget.
technical_task: Add a price range search with a minimum and a maximum and show the results in a list view by default.
acceptance_criteria: Given a minimum and a maximum price, when the user searches, then restaurants within the range are shown.
Given search results, when they are displayed without changing the view, then they appear in a list view.

requirement_text: There shall be a network connection between SwRI and NISN.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want a network connection between SwRI and NISN, so that the two sites can exchange data.
technical_task: Establish a network connection between SwRI and NISN.
acceptance_criteria: Given SwRI and NISN, when the connection is set up, then a network connection exists between them.
Given the connection, when data is sent from one site, then the other site receives it.

requirement_text: System shall generate logs of user bank account details, account updates with date, time, and changes, and fixed asset schedules.
user_story: As an accountant, I want logs of user bank account details, account updates with date, time and changes, and fixed asset schedules, so that financial activity can be traced.
technical_task: Generate logs for user bank account details, for account updates (date, time and changes) and for fixed asset schedules.
acceptance_criteria: Given user bank account details, when they are used or changed, then a log is generated.
Given an account update, when it is made, then a log records the date, time and changes.
rationale: Role assumed: accountant. Fixed asset schedules are logged as stated.

requirement_text: Only collision estimators shall search for recycled parts.
user_story: As a claims manager, I want only collision estimators to search for recycled parts, so that searches are limited to the right role.
technical_task: Restrict recycled parts search to collision estimators.
acceptance_criteria: Given a collision estimator, when the estimator searches for recycled parts, then the search is performed.
Given a user who is not a collision estimator, when the user tries to search for recycled parts, then the search is refused.

requirement_text: System shall enforce business rules, allowing blog owners to manage only their own blogs and not interfere with others'.
user_story: As a blog owner, I want to manage only my own blogs and not interfere with others', so that blogs stay separate.
technical_task: Enforce a business rule that blog owners manage only blogs they own.
acceptance_criteria: Given a blog owner, when the owner manages their own blog, then the action is allowed.
Given a blog owned by someone else, when the blog owner tries to manage it, then the action is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to use automated backup scheduling for ensuring data availability.
user_story: As an administrator, I want automated backup scheduling, so that data stays available.
technical_task: Offer scheduling of automated backups.
acceptance_criteria: Given a backup schedule, when the scheduled time arrives, then a backup runs automatically.
Given a completed backup, when it is checked, then the data can be restored from it.

requirement_text: The Technical Owner/Lead shall provide signoff before any [SYSTEM NAME] build can be deployed to the production environment.
rationale: The text contains an unfilled placeholder, "[SYSTEM NAME]".
clarification_questions: What is the actual system name, given "[SYSTEM NAME]" is a placeholder?
How is the sign-off recorded?

requirement_text: The website should cater to all tribes in Nigeria.
requirement_text_raw: The website should cater to all tribes in Nigeria.'
user_story: As a visitor from any tribe, I want the website to cater to all tribes in Nigeria, so that everyone is included.
technical_task: Design the website's content and language to serve all tribes in Nigeria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor from any tribe in Nigeria, when the visitor uses the website, then the content is suitable for the visitor.
Given the website content, when it is reviewed, then it does not exclude any tribe in Nigeria.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. "Cater to" is not defined, so the criteria are review-based.

requirement_text: Time Management shall provide a utility timer.
requirement_text_raw: Time Management shall (3.3.10.23) provide a utility timer.
user_story: As a software developer, I want Time Management to provide a utility timer, so that I can measure intervals.
technical_task: Offer a utility timer from Time Management.
acceptance_criteria: Given Time Management, when an application requests a utility timer, then a utility timer is provided.
Given a utility timer, when it is used, then it can measure elapsed time.

requirement_text: The number with a '-' in the 'Prv' column indicates the number of insurance companies for which this invoice is awaiting payment.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want a number with a '-' in the Prv column to show how many insurance companies the invoice still awaits payment from, so that I can follow open claims.
technical_task: Show, in the Prv column, a number marked with '-' that counts the insurance companies from which the invoice awaits payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invoice awaiting payment from insurance companies, when the Prv column is displayed, then it shows a number with a '-'.
Given the number, when it is read, then it indicates how many insurance companies the invoice awaits payment from.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to check for new software releases and download them manually through the mobile phone.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want to check for new software releases and download them manually on my phone, so that I decide when to update.
technical_task: Provide a check for new software releases and a manual download on mobile phones.
acceptance_criteria: Given the mobile phone, when the user checks for new releases, then available releases are shown.
Given a new release, when the user chooses to download it, then it is downloaded.

requirement_text: Tasks within a rate group shall be executed in the order in which the mission manager registers the tasks.
requirement_text_raw: Tasks within a rate group shall (3.3.4.7) be executed in the order in which the mission manager registers the tasks.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want tasks in a rate group executed in the order the mission manager registers them, so that execution is predictable.
technical_task: Run the tasks of a rate group in the order of their registration by the mission manager.
acceptance_criteria: Given tasks registered in a rate group in a certain order, when the rate group runs, then they execute in that order.
Given a different registration order, when the rate group runs, then the tasks execute in the new order.

requirement_text: Drexel staff's office locations, contact information, and positions will have accuracy greater than 70%.
user_story: As a student, I want Drexel staff's office locations, contact information and positions to be accurate more than 70% of the time, so that I can rely on them.
technical_task: Keep the accuracy of Drexel staff's office locations, contact information and positions above 70%.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sample of staff entries, when office locations, contact information and positions are checked, then more than 70% are accurate.
Given accuracy of 70% or lower, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: If the value of abs (ISPBatVoltFilt1 / ISPBatCurr_A) is equal or higher than PPNM_BCDBatTermMax for longer than PPNM_BCDBatTermDT, then BCDDynRes is set to 200, independent of the actual values of ISPLastValidRdi_mOhm or RdiRevFilt.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want BCDDynRes set to 200 when the filtered voltage/current ratio stays at or above PPNM_BCDBatTermMax for longer than PPNM_BCDBatTermDT, so that a fixed value is used when the measurement is unreliable.
technical_task: Set BCDDynRes to 200 when abs (ISPBatVoltFilt1 / ISPBatCurr_A) is equal or higher than PPNM_BCDBatTermMax for longer than PPNM_BCDBatTermDT, independent of the actual values of ISPLastValidRdi_mOhm or RdiRevFilt.
acceptance_criteria: Given abs (ISPBatVoltFilt1 / ISPBatCurr_A) is equal or higher than PPNM_BCDBatTermMax for longer than PPNM_BCDBatTermDT, when it is evaluated, then BCDDynRes is set to 200.
Given the same condition, when ISPLastValidRdi_mOhm or RdiRevFilt change, then BCDDynRes is still set to 200.

requirement_text: The Teams app shall be designed for high availability, ensuring minimal disruption in case of individual service outages.
user_story: As a user, I want the Teams app to stay available when individual services fail, so that I can keep working.
technical_task: Design the Teams app for high availability so that an individual service outage causes minimal disruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given an individual service outage, when it occurs, then the Teams app remains available.
Given an individual service outage, when it occurs, then disruption to the user is minimal.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Minimal disruption" is not measured.

requirement_text: User inputs and commands shall be validated to prevent unauthorized access or malicious actions within the system.
user_story: As a security engineer, I want user inputs and commands validated, so that unauthorized access and malicious actions are prevented.
technical_task: Validate every user input and command before it is processed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user input or command, when it is received, then it is validated.
Given a malicious input or command, when it fails validation, then it is rejected.

requirement_text: Interfacing with the courts during the prosecution of cases is an integral part of the responsibilities of police personnel.
requirement_text_raw:
Interfacing with the courts during the prosecution of cases is an integral part of the
responsibilities of police personnel.
rationale: The sentence describes a responsibility of police personnel and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a statement about police duties?
What must the system do to support interfacing with the courts?

requirement_text: The system shall collect and store user data in accordance with privacy regulations and user consent.
user_story: As a user, I want my data collected and stored according to privacy regulations and my consent, so that my privacy is respected.
technical_task: Collect and store user data only in line with privacy regulations and the user's consent.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has given consent, when data is collected, then it is stored in line with privacy regulations.
Given the user has not given consent, when data collection is attempted, then no data is collected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The regulations are not named.

requirement_text: After successfully completing IBIT, the software shall continue with the initialization of VxWorks and FTSS software.
requirement_text_raw: After successfully completing IBIT, the software shall (3.3.2.3) continue with the initialization of VxWorks and FTSS software.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the software to continue with the initialization of VxWorks and the FTSS software after IBIT completes successfully, so that startup proceeds in order.
technical_task: After IBIT completes successfully, continue the initialization of VxWorks and FTSS software.
acceptance_criteria: Given IBIT completes successfully, when the software continues, then the initialization of VxWorks proceeds.
Given IBIT completes successfully, when the initialization of VxWorks proceeds, then the initialization of FTSS software follows.

requirement_text: User shall be able to rely on the system's stability and robustness.
rationale: "Stability" and "robustness" are not measurable as written.
clarification_questions: What measurable stability and robustness targets apply (uptime, error rate)?
Which failures must the system withstand?

requirement_text: User shall be able to accommodate a high number of books and users without any faults.
user_story: As a librarian, I want the system to hold a high number of books and users without faults, so that it scales with the library.
technical_task: Ensure the system works correctly with a high number of books and users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a high number of books, when the system is used, then it works without faults.
Given a high number of users, when they use the system, then it works without faults.
rationale: Role assumed: librarian. "High number" is not quantified, so the criteria cannot name a size.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to process inter-faculty transfer requests initiated by authorized users and approved by faculty groups or higher levels.
user_story: As a faculty member, I want to process inter-faculty transfer requests started by authorized users and approved by faculty groups or higher levels, so that transfers are handled properly.
technical_task: Implement processing of inter-faculty transfer requests that authorized users initiate and faculty groups or higher levels approve.
acceptance_criteria: Given an inter-faculty transfer request initiated by an authorized user, when it is submitted, then the system processes it for approval.
Given a transfer request approved by a faculty group or a higher level, when the approval is recorded, then the transfer is completed.

requirement_text: Students added to a cohort shall be eligible for the cohort’s Program of Study.
user_story: As a registrar, I want students added to a cohort to be eligible for the cohort's Program of Study, so that they follow the right program.
technical_task: Make students added to a cohort eligible for the Program of Study of that cohort.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student added to a cohort, when the addition is saved, then the student is eligible for the cohort's Program of Study.
Given a student not in the cohort, when eligibility is checked, then the student is not made eligible through the cohort.
rationale: Role assumed: registrar. The garbled apostrophe in the source was read as "cohort's".

requirement_text: All management software functions shall take optimal advantage of all language, compiler and system features and resources to reduce overheads to the minimum practical level.
clarification_questions: What counts as "optimal advantage" and the "minimum practical level" of overhead?
Which language, compiler and system features are meant?

requirement_text: The Disputes application shall manipulate and view business data. Users will not have direct access to data files or databases.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application shall manipulate and view business data. Users will not have direct access to data files or databases.'
user_story: As a data owner, I want users to work with business data through the Disputes application only, so that nobody touches the data files or databases directly.
technical_task: Let the Disputes application manipulate and show business data and deny users direct access to data files and databases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user of the Disputes application, when the user works with business data, then the data is viewed and manipulated through the application.
Given a user, when the user tries to open the data files or databases directly, then access is denied.

requirement_text: System shall provide information and tools for users to specify security measures for data.
user_story: As a user, I want information and tools to specify security measures for my data, so that I can protect it as I choose.
technical_task: Provide information and tools that let users specify security measures for their data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the security settings, when the user opens them, then information about the available security measures is shown.
Given the tools, when the user specifies a security measure for data, then it is saved and applied to that data.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which measures exist is not stated.

requirement_text: The administrator will be able to view system statistics and generate reports based on selected criteria.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to view system statistics and generate reports based on selected criteria, so that I can monitor the system.
technical_task: Provide a statistics view and report generation filtered by criteria the administrator selects.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system has recorded activity, when the administrator opens the statistics, then system statistics are shown.
Given selected criteria, when the administrator generates a report, then the report is based on those criteria.

requirement_text: System shall communicate with the database via a wireless Ethernet system.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the system to communicate with the database over a wireless Ethernet system, so that it needs no cable.
technical_task: Connect the system to the database through a wireless Ethernet system.
acceptance_criteria: Given the wireless Ethernet system is available, when the system needs data, then it communicates with the database over it.
Given the system's configuration, when it is reviewed, then the database connection uses the wireless Ethernet system.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The reason (no cable) is inferred.

requirement_text: System shall send a message to the main developer team if the serial key is invalid.
user_story: As a developer on the main team, I want a message when a serial key is invalid, so that I am told about invalid key attempts.
technical_task: Send a message to the main developer team whenever an invalid serial key is detected.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid serial key, when it is entered, then a message is sent to the main developer team.
Given a valid serial key, when it is entered, then no such message is sent.
rationale: Role assumed: main developer team member.

requirement_text: System shall be able to provide a list of the 3 nearest sites, sorted alphabetically by name, with links to their respective pages.
user_story: As a visitor, I want a list of the 3 nearest sites sorted alphabetically by name with links to their pages, so that I can open them.
technical_task: List the 3 nearest sites in alphabetical order by name, each with a link to its page.
acceptance_criteria: Given the visitor's position, when the list is requested, then the 3 nearest sites are shown.
Given the 3 nearest sites, when they are listed, then they are sorted alphabetically by name and each has a link to its page.

requirement_text: 100% of all search queries for reservations by user shall be from logons of only management logons.
user_story: As a manager, I want all search queries for reservations by user to come from management logons only, so that user data stays restricted.
technical_task: Allow reservation searches by user only from management logons, so that 100% of such queries come from them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a management logon, when it searches reservations by user, then the search is performed.
Given a logon that is not a management logon, when it searches reservations by user, then the search is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. The 100% figure is covered by the second criterion.

requirement_text: System shall authenticate users using Django's authentication module and session-based authentication.
user_story: As a user, I want to be authenticated through Django's authentication module with session-based authentication, so that I stay logged in during my session.
technical_task: Use Django's authentication module and session-based authentication to authenticate users.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the user logs in, then the user is authenticated through Django's authentication module.
Given a logged-in user, when the user makes further requests in the session, then the session-based authentication keeps the user authenticated.

requirement_text: The system shall function on a processor with a minimum clock speed of 1.6 GHz.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to work on a processor with a minimum clock speed of 1.6 GHz, so that I can run it on modest hardware.
technical_task: Support processors with a clock speed of at least 1.6 GHz.
acceptance_criteria: Given a processor running at 1.6 GHz, when the system is run, then it functions.
Given a processor running above 1.6 GHz, when the system is run, then it functions.

requirement_text: System's back-end databases shall be encrypted to protect customer data.
user_story: As a customer, I want the back-end databases encrypted, so that my data is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt the back-end databases.
acceptance_criteria: Given customer data in a back-end database, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given the database files, when someone reads them without the key, then the customer data cannot be understood.

requirement_text: System shall require users to have Java plug-ins enabled and CSS functioning properly.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to require Java plug-ins enabled and CSS working properly, so that its pages work correctly.
technical_task: Require Java plug-ins to be enabled and CSS to function properly in the user's browser.
acceptance_criteria: Given Java plug-ins are enabled and CSS functions, when the user uses the system, then it works.
Given Java plug-ins are disabled or CSS does not function, when the user uses the system, then the user is told what is required.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an assumption about how the requirement is enforced.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall provide a method for a task to be scheduled as a 50 Hz "helper" task for source congruency input exchanges and voted output exchanges that starts in a particular minor frame but runs only during every 5th or 50th minor frame, effectively running at a lower, sub-rate, 10 Hz or 1 Hz, respectively.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS042] provide a method for a task to be scheduled as a 50 Hz "helper" task for source congruency input exchanges and voted output exchanges that starts in a particular minor frame but runs only during every 5th or 50th minor frame, effectively running at a lower, sub-rate, 10 Hz or 1 Hz, respectively.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a method to schedule a task as a 50 Hz helper task that starts in a given minor frame but runs only every 5th or 50th minor frame, so that it effectively runs at 10 Hz or 1 Hz.
technical_task: Provide a scheduler method for a 50 Hz helper task, used for source congruency input exchanges and voted output exchanges, that starts in a chosen minor frame and runs only during every 5th or 50th minor frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given a helper task scheduled to run every 5th minor frame, when the scheduler runs, then it executes at 10 Hz.
Given a helper task scheduled to run every 50th minor frame, when the scheduler runs, then it executes at 1 Hz.

requirement_text: The parameters logged includes user or system account ID date or time stamp event source IP address error or event code and type.
requirement_text_raw: The parameters logged includes user or system account ID  date or time stamp  event source  IP address  error or event code and type.
user_story: As a security auditor, I want the logged parameters to include the account ID, time stamp, event source IP address, and error or event code and type, so that events can be investigated.
technical_task: Log the user or system account ID, date or time stamp, event source IP address, and error or event code and type for each event.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event, when it is logged, then the user or system account ID and a date or time stamp are recorded.
Given an event, when it is logged, then the event source IP address and the error or event code and type are recorded.

requirement_text: The FDIR shall place all fault and recovery information in shared memory for inclusion in the frames that will be telemetred and recorded by the CTC.
requirement_text_raw: The FDIR shall (3.3.5.17) place all fault and recovery information in shared memory for inclusion in the frames that will be telemetred and recorded by the CTC.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to put all fault and recovery information in shared memory for the frames the CTC telemeters and records, so that it appears in telemetry.
technical_task: Write all fault and recovery information into shared memory so it is included in the frames telemetered and recorded by the CTC.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fault or a recovery action, when FDIR handles it, then the information is placed in shared memory.
Given information in shared memory, when the frames are built, then it is included in the frames telemetered and recorded by the CTC.

requirement_text: System shall provide functionality to list all students enrolled in a particular year.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to list all students enrolled in a particular year, so that I can see each year's students.
technical_task: Provide a list of the students enrolled in a chosen year.
acceptance_criteria: Given a year, when the administrator requests the list, then all students enrolled in that year are shown.
Given a student enrolled in another year, when the list for a year is shown, then that student is not listed.

requirement_text: User shall search for locations using city names for weather information.
user_story: As a user, I want to search for locations by city name to get weather information, so that I can see the weather there.
technical_task: Offer a location search by city name that returns weather information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a city name, when the user searches, then the matching location is found.
Given a found location, when the user opens it, then its weather information is shown.

requirement_text: Communication services shall provide the capability to create "pipe"s which "broadcast" their messages to all virtual groups.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS069] provide the capability to create "pipe"s which "broadcast" their messages to all virtual groups.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to create "pipe"s that "broadcast" their messages to all virtual groups, so that one send reaches every group.
technical_task: Let communication services create "pipe"s whose messages are "broadcast" to all virtual groups.
acceptance_criteria: Given a "pipe" created for broadcast, when a message is sent into it, then every virtual group receives the message.
Given several virtual groups, when a message is broadcast, then none of them is skipped.

requirement_text: System shall search for and display related FAQs based on user-entered keywords.
user_story: As a user, I want related FAQs found and shown from the keywords I enter, so that I get help quickly.
technical_task: Search the FAQs by user-entered keywords and display the related ones.
acceptance_criteria: Given keywords entered by the user, when the user searches, then related FAQs are displayed.
Given keywords that match no FAQ, when the user searches, then no FAQs are displayed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to save a document of similar size within 0.5 seconds.
user_story: As a user, I want to save a document of similar size within 0.5 seconds, so that saving does not interrupt me.
technical_task: Make saving a document of similar size take no more than 0.5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a document of similar size, when the user saves it, then saving completes within 0.5 seconds.
Given a save that takes longer than 0.5 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Similar size" refers to a reference size not given.

requirement_text: User shall be able to offer withdrawal transactions.
user_story: As a bank operator, I want to offer withdrawal transactions, so that customers can withdraw money.
technical_task: Provide withdrawal transactions for users to offer.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account, when the user offers a withdrawal transaction, then it is available for use.
Given an offered withdrawal transaction, when a customer uses it, then the withdrawal is carried out.
rationale: Role assumed: bank operator. "Offer" is read as making the transaction available.

requirement_text: User shall be able to search for a person by department.
user_story: As a user, I want to search for a person by department, so that I can find colleagues.
technical_task: Add a person search that filters by department.
acceptance_criteria: Given a department, when the user searches for people, then the people in that department are listed.
Given a department with no people, when the user searches, then the list is empty.

requirement_text: System shall log transaction IDs securely and update log files accordingly.
user_story: As a security auditor, I want transaction IDs logged securely and the log files updated accordingly, so that transactions can be traced.
technical_task: Write transaction IDs to log files in a secure way and keep the log files up to date.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction, when it is processed, then its transaction ID is added to the log file.
Given the log file, when an unauthorized user tries to read or change it, then access is denied.

requirement_text: All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.
requirement_text_raw: All credit card information will be secured on the server  and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators.  Information will be encrypted in the database.'
user_story: As a customer, I want my credit card information kept on the server, encrypted, and accessible only by authorized Izogn administrators, so that it is safe.
technical_task: Secure credit card information on the server, encrypt it in the database and limit access to authorized Izogn administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given credit card information, when it is stored in the database, then it is encrypted.
Given a user who is not an authorized Izogn administrator, when the user tries to access credit card information, then access is denied.

requirement_text: A sending HCP edits a previously created patient referral as long as the referral has not been viewed by the receiving HCP.
user_story: As a sending HCP, I want to edit a referral I created as long as the receiving HCP has not viewed it, so that I can correct it in time.
technical_task: Allow the sending HCP to edit a previously created patient referral until the receiving HCP has viewed it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a referral not yet viewed by the receiving HCP, when the sending HCP edits it, then the changes are saved.
Given a referral already viewed by the receiving HCP, when the sending HCP tries to edit it, then the edit is not allowed.

requirement_text: The patient or representative chooses one of these DLHCP and types the subject (up to 100 characters) and text of a message (up to 1000 characters) and clicks the send button.
requirement_text_raw: The patient or representative chooses one of these DLHCP and types the subject (up to 100 characters) and text of a message (up to 1000 characters)  and clicks the send button.
user_story: As a patient, I want to choose one of these DLHCPs, type a subject of up to 100 characters and a message of up to 1000 characters and click send, so that I can contact the provider.
technical_task: Provide a message form with a DLHCP selection, a subject field limited to 100 characters, a text field limited to 1000 characters and a send button.
acceptance_criteria: Given the message form, when the patient chooses a DLHCP, types a subject of up to 100 characters and a message of up to 1000 characters and clicks send, then the message is sent.
Given a subject longer than 100 characters or a message longer than 1000 characters, when the patient enters it, then the extra characters are not accepted.

requirement_text: The solution should implement a policy to encrypt backup and archival media; ensure that policies direct the user of encryption technologies of the appropriate strength.
user_story: As a security officer, I want a policy to encrypt backup and archival media with encryption of appropriate strength, so that backups stay confidential.
technical_task: Define and enforce a policy that requires encryption of backup and archival media and directs users to use encryption technologies of appropriate strength.
acceptance_criteria: Given backup or archival media, when it is created, then it is encrypted under the policy.
Given the policy, when it is reviewed, then it directs the use of encryption technologies of appropriate strength.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. "Appropriate strength" is not defined.

requirement_text: The NTC and the contact wires must be protected against exhaust gases, fuel traces and oil by a closed housing.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the NTC and the contact wires protected against exhaust gases, fuel traces and oil by a closed housing, so that they are not damaged.
technical_task: Enclose the NTC and the contact wires in a closed housing that protects them from exhaust gases, fuel traces and oil.
acceptance_criteria: Given the NTC and the contact wires, when the assembly is inspected, then they are inside a closed housing.
Given exposure to exhaust gases, fuel traces or oil, when the assembly is tested, then the NTC and contact wires are protected.

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall take at most 1 msec of a 50 Hz minor frame.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall (3.3.4.18) take at most 1 msec of a 50 Hz minor frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software to take at most 1 msec of a 50 Hz minor frame, so that application tasks have time to run.
technical_task: Limit the processing time of the FTSS software to 1 msec in each 50 Hz minor frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 50 Hz minor frame, when the FTSS software runs, then it uses no more than 1 msec.
Given a measured use above 1 msec, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The administrator has authenticated himself or herself in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC3).
user_story: As an administrator, I want to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system, so that I can carry out administrative work (UC3).
technical_task: Require the administrator to authenticate in the iTrust Medical Records system before administrative use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator with valid credentials, when the administrator logs in, then the administrator is authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system.
Given an administrator who is not authenticated, when the administrator tries administrative work, then it is not allowed.
rationale: Role stated: administrator. The sentence states a precondition of use case UC3.

requirement_text: System shall use transaction management software (BMS version 2.0), card management software (CMS version 3.0), and Yamaha codecs.
user_story: As a system owner, I want the system to use transaction management software (BMS version 2.0), card management software (CMS version 3.0) and Yamaha codecs, so that its components are known.
technical_task: Build the system on transaction management software BMS version 2.0, card management software CMS version 3.0 and Yamaha codecs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when its components are listed, then it uses BMS version 2.0 for transaction management.
Given the system, when its components are listed, then it uses CMS version 3.0 for card management and Yamaha codecs.

requirement_text: Perfective Maintenance: New features may be added post product delivery.
rationale: The sentence describes a kind of maintenance and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a description of the maintenance type?
Which new features may be added, and what must the system do to allow it?

requirement_text: Further details on proposed ADC and task timing and interrupt strategy is provided in the SWIO Specification.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the SWIO Specification say about ADC and task timing and the interrupt strategy?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.'
user_story: As a security officer, I want only authorized users to log on to the Disputes application, so that disputes data is protected.
technical_task: Allow logon to the Disputes application only for authorized users.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user logs on, then access is granted.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to log on, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create a presentation by adding slides, defining content, and applying formatting.
user_story: As a presenter, I want to create a presentation by adding slides, defining content and applying formatting, so that I can prepare my talk.
technical_task: Provide presentation creation with slide addition, content definition and formatting.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new presentation, when the user adds a slide, then the slide is added.
Given a slide, when the user defines content and applies formatting, then the content and formatting are saved.

requirement_text: The website shall be attractive to all audiences. The website shall appear to be fun and the colors should be bright and vibrant.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall be attractive to all audiences.  The website shall appear to be fun and the colors should be bright and vibrant.'
clarification_questions: What makes a website "attractive", "fun", "bright" and "vibrant" in measurable terms?
Which audiences are meant by "all audiences"?

requirement_text: 100% of merchant services representatives shall be able to successfully perform a follow up action on a dispute case on the first encounter after completing the training course.
requirement_text_raw: 100\% of merchant services representatives shall be able to successfully perform a follow up action on a dispute case on the first encounter after completing the training course.'
user_story: As a merchant services representative, I want to be able to perform a follow up action on a dispute case on my first encounter after training, so that I can work independently.
technical_task: Design the follow-up action and train representatives so that 100% of merchant services representatives can perform a follow up action on a dispute case on the first encounter after the training course.
acceptance_criteria: Given merchant services representatives who completed the training course, when each performs a follow up action on a dispute case for the first time, then 100% succeed.
Given a representative who does not succeed on the first encounter, when results are evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Remark: The possibility to overrun or underrun an object can mostly be determined not until a longer observation time which is not given in any case for detections coming from road border objects like guide posts.
rationale: The sentence is labelled "Remark" and states a limitation, not behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a remark about observation time?
What must the sensor do for guide posts and similar road border objects?

requirement_text: While streaming a movie buffering should only occur if there is latency in the user's connection.
requirement_text_raw: While streaming a movie  buffering should only occur if there is latency in the user's connection.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want buffering to occur while streaming a movie only when my connection has latency, so that playback is smooth otherwise.
technical_task: Limit buffering during movie streaming to cases of latency in the user's connection.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's connection without latency, when a movie is streamed, then buffering does not occur.
Given latency in the user's connection, when a movie is streamed, then buffering may occur.

requirement_text: The system shall minimize user errors and make error recovery effortless.
rationale: "Minimize" and "effortless" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How many user errors count as "minimized" and what makes recovery "effortless"?
Which errors does this cover?

requirement_text: User shall/will be informed in advance of scheduled maintenance to minimize downtime.
user_story: As a user, I want to be told in advance about scheduled maintenance, so that downtime affects me less.
technical_task: Notify users ahead of scheduled maintenance.
acceptance_criteria: Given scheduled maintenance, when it is planned, then users are informed before it starts.
Given no scheduled maintenance, when users use the system, then no maintenance notice is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How far in advance is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall be able to manage privacy and data settings.
user_story: As a user, I want to manage my privacy and data settings, so that I control what is shared.
technical_task: Provide a settings area for privacy and data settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given the settings, when the user opens privacy and data settings, then they are shown.
Given a changed setting, when the user saves it, then it is applied.

requirement_text: System shall integrate with CRIS for impact analysis and funding linkage purposes.
user_story: As a research administrator, I want the system to integrate with CRIS for impact analysis and funding linkage, so that research outputs are linked to funding.
technical_task: Integrate the system with CRIS to support impact analysis and linking to funding.
acceptance_criteria: Given CRIS, when the system is integrated with it, then data can be exchanged for impact analysis.
Given CRIS, when the system is integrated with it, then data can be exchanged for funding linkage.

requirement_text: User shall be able to view and update the details of an existing specialty.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to view and update the details of an existing specialty, so that specialty information stays current.
technical_task: Provide view and update screens for the details of an existing specialty.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing specialty, when the user opens it, then its details are shown.
Given an existing specialty, when the user updates its details, then the changes are saved.

requirement_text: The solution should prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing mechanisms and provide an explicit indication of use to the local users.
user_story: As a security officer, I want remote activation of collaborative computing mechanisms prohibited and local users shown when they are in use, so that nobody is observed unknowingly.
technical_task: Block remote activation of collaborative computing mechanisms and show the local users an explicit indication whenever a mechanism is in use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a collaborative computing mechanism, when a remote party tries to activate it, then the activation is refused.
Given a collaborative computing mechanism in use, when it is active, then an explicit indication is shown to the local users.

requirement_text: The system shall determine when to interrupt a volunteer and suggest intervention method (text, image, video).
user_story: As a coordinator, I want the system to decide when to interrupt a volunteer and suggest how, by text, image or video, so that volunteers are reached in a suitable way.
technical_task: Determine when a volunteer should be interrupted and suggest an intervention method among text, image and video.
acceptance_criteria: Given a situation that needs attention, when the system evaluates it, then it determines whether to interrupt the volunteer.
Given a decision to interrupt, when the system suggests an intervention method, then the suggestion is text, image or video.
rationale: Role assumed: coordinator. The decision rule is not described.

requirement_text: The system shall smartly categorize tasks and group all similar ones together.
rationale: "Smartly" and "similar" are subjective and no criteria are given.
clarification_questions: What does "smartly" categorize mean and by which criteria are tasks similar?
What categories exist?

requirement_text: The nearest object to estimated vehicle path has the nearest lateral position to the estimated vehicle path but is still on the left lane.
rationale: The sentence defines which object counts as nearest and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the sensor do with the nearest object to the estimated vehicle path?
Is this a definition of a term rather than a requirement?

requirement_text: See internet for more details (for example Subversion, GIT, Perforce ,..)
rationale: The sentence points to the internet for details and gives only examples.
clarification_questions: What do the internet resources specify?
Which version control tools (Subversion, GIT, Perforce) are required?

requirement_text: The system shall encrypt collection data and maintain checksums for verification.
user_story: As a curator, I want collection data encrypted and checksums kept for verification, so that data stays private and its integrity can be checked.
technical_task: Encrypt collection data and maintain checksums that can be used to verify it.
acceptance_criteria: Given collection data, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given collection data with a checksum, when it is verified, then the checksum confirms whether the data is unchanged.

requirement_text: System shall provide a user interface familiar to depositors, integrating seamlessly with existing University systems.
user_story: As a depositor, I want a familiar user interface that integrates with existing University systems, so that I can deposit without learning something new.
technical_task: Design a user interface that is familiar to depositors and integrates with existing University systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a depositor, when the user opens the interface, then it follows the layout of existing University systems.
Given an existing University system, when the interface is used, then it integrates with that system.
rationale: Role stated: depositor. "Familiar" and "seamlessly" are read as following existing University conventions, which is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The system shall generate reports on storage consumption by financial contact.
user_story: As a storage administrator, I want reports on storage consumption by financial contact, so that I can see who uses what.
technical_task: Generate storage consumption reports grouped by financial contact.
acceptance_criteria: Given stored data linked to financial contacts, when a report is generated, then storage consumption is shown for each financial contact.
Given a financial contact with no stored data, when the report is generated, then its consumption is shown as none.

requirement_text: After installing the Application from iTunes or the App store the user will be asked to login.
user_story: As a new user, I want to be asked to log in after installing the application from iTunes or the App store, so that I can start using it.
technical_task: Show a login prompt the first time the application starts after it is installed from iTunes or the App store.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application was installed from iTunes or the App store, when the user starts it, then the user is asked to log in.
Given the login prompt, when the user logs in successfully, then the user can use the application.

requirement_text: The system upon detection of inactivity of an interactive session shall prevent further viewing and access to the system by that session by terminating the session or by initiating a session lock that remains in effect until the user reestablishes access using appropriate identification and authentication procedures.
requirement_text_raw: The system upon detection of inactivity of an interactive session shall prevent further viewing and access to the system by that session by terminating the session  or by initiating a session lock that remains in effect until the user reestablishes access using appropriate identification and authentication procedures.
user_story: As a security officer, I want an inactive interactive session ended or locked until the user re-authenticates, so that unattended sessions cannot be used.
technical_task: On detecting inactivity of an interactive session, either terminate the session or lock it until the user reestablishes access through identification and authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Given an interactive session with detected inactivity, when the system reacts, then the session is terminated or locked.
Given a locked session, when the user reestablishes access with appropriate identification and authentication, then the session lock is lifted.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The inactivity period is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall set the book status to Available if the book is not currently borrowed, allowing members to reserve it.
user_story: As a library member, I want a book shown as Available when it is not borrowed so that I can reserve it, so that I can plan my borrowing.
technical_task: Set the book status to Available when the book is not currently borrowed and allow members to reserve it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a book that is not currently borrowed, when its status is shown, then it is Available.
Given a book with Available status, when a member requests a reservation, then the book can be reserved.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create, join, and leave groups for shared expense management.
user_story: As a user, I want to create, join and leave groups for shared expenses, so that I can split costs with others.
technical_task: Provide group creation, joining and leaving for shared expense management.
acceptance_criteria: Given the group function, when a user creates a group, then the group is created.
Given an existing group, when a user joins or leaves it, then the membership is updated.
