requirement_text: User shall be able to modify all fields of an asset except IDs, and bulk entry files can be used for modifications.
user_story: As an asset manager, I want to modify all fields of an asset except its ID, and use bulk entry files for modifications, so that I can update many assets at once.
technical_task: Allow editing of all asset fields other than the ID, including through bulk entry files.
acceptance_criteria: Given an asset, when the user modifies a field other than the ID, then the change is saved.
Given an asset, when the user tries to modify its ID, then the change is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: asset manager. The bulk entry file format is not described.

requirement_text: An LHCP chooses to view the physiologic data monitoring details.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view the physiologic data monitoring details, so that I can follow my patients' readings.
technical_task: Add a function that shows the physiologic data monitoring details to the LHCP.
acceptance_criteria: Given physiologic data being monitored, when the LHCP chooses to view the details, then the physiologic data monitoring details are shown.
Given the details are shown, when the LHCP reads them, then they correspond to the monitored data.

requirement_text: User shall operate efficiently with a minimum processor speed of 500MHz.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to run efficiently on a processor of at least 500MHz, so that it works on modest hardware.
technical_task: Support processors with a minimum speed of 500MHz.
acceptance_criteria: Given a processor with a speed of 500MHz, when the system is run, then it operates.
Given a processor faster than 500MHz, when the system is run, then it operates.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Efficiently" is not measured.

requirement_text: The sending HCP may edit the priority of the referral possibly and possibly the referral notes.
user_story: As a sending HCP, I want to edit the priority of a referral and possibly its notes, so that the referral reflects the urgency.
technical_task: Let the sending HCP edit the priority of a referral and, optionally, the referral notes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a referral, when the sending HCP edits its priority, then the new priority is saved.
Given a referral, when the sending HCP edits the referral notes, then the notes are saved.
rationale: Role stated: sending HCP. "May" and "possibly" make the editing of notes optional.

requirement_text: User shall be able to view and update the details of an existing chemist/lab, with pincode remaining unchanged.
user_story: As a user, I want to view and update the details of an existing chemist or lab without changing its pincode, so that location data stays consistent.
technical_task: Allow viewing and updating of chemist/lab details while keeping the pincode fixed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing chemist or lab, when the user opens it, then its details are shown.
Given an existing chemist or lab, when the user updates its details, then the changes are saved and the pincode stays the same.

requirement_text: The system must be safely housed in a physically secure cabin.
user_story: As a facility manager, I want the system housed safely in a physically secure cabin, so that it is protected from tampering.
technical_task: Install the system in a cabin that is physically secure.
acceptance_criteria: Given the installed system, when its location is inspected, then it is in a cabin.
Given the cabin, when its security is reviewed, then it is physically secure.
rationale: Role assumed: facility manager. What makes the cabin "physically secure" is not defined.

requirement_text: Applicants' accessibility shall be ensured in all possible ways.
rationale: "In all possible ways" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What accessibility standard or measurable criteria apply for applicants?
What does "in all possible ways" cover?

requirement_text: Employers and recruiters shall be able to create multiple resume agents to receive daily emails matching their keywords.
user_story: As a recruiter, I want to create several resume agents that email me daily the resumes matching my keywords, so that I see new candidates each day.
technical_task: Allow employers and recruiters to create multiple resume agents, each sending a daily email of matching resumes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a recruiter, when the recruiter creates resume agents with different keywords, then all agents are saved.
Given a resume agent, when the daily run happens, then an email with the resumes matching its keywords is sent.

requirement_text: The system shall allow browsing video thumbnails and segments.
user_story: As a viewer, I want to browse video thumbnails and segments, so that I can find a part of a video.
technical_task: Offer browsing of video thumbnails and video segments.
acceptance_criteria: Given videos, when the user browses, then video thumbnails are shown.
Given a video, when the user browses its segments, then the segments are shown.

requirement_text: In this context the entertainment sources radio, television, and optical drive are of special interest.
rationale: The sentence says which sources are of interest and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the system do with the entertainment sources radio, television and optical drive?
Is this a requirement or an observation?

requirement_text: Each NE and flight cable assembly shall be identified by a part or type number and a unique serial number, consistent with the configuration management system and the specification for the contract.
requirement_text_raw: Each NE and flight cable assembly shall (3.2.4.2) be identified by a part or type number and a unique serial number, consistent with the configuration management system and the specification for the contract.
user_story: As a configuration manager, I want each NE and flight cable assembly identified by a part or type number and a unique serial number, so that it matches the configuration management system.
technical_task: Mark every NE and flight cable assembly with a part or type number and a unique serial number consistent with the configuration management system and the contract specification.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE or flight cable assembly, when it is inspected, then it carries a part or type number and a serial number.
Given two assemblies, when their serial numbers are compared, then they differ.

requirement_text: The LHCP views a list of requests he or she has made for reports with the status and pertinent information about the requests.
requirement_text_raw: The LHCP views a list of requests he or she has made for reports  with the status and pertinent information about the requests.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view a list of the report requests I made with their status and pertinent information, so that I can follow them.
technical_task: Display a list of the LHCP's report requests with their status and pertinent information.
acceptance_criteria: Given report requests made by an LHCP, when the LHCP opens the list, then the requests are shown with their status.
Given a request in the list, when it is displayed, then pertinent information about it is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to view the application logo and affiliate logos upon startup.
user_story: As a user, I want to see the application logo and affiliate logos at startup, so that I know whose application it is.
technical_task: Display the application logo and the affiliate logos when the application starts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application starts, when the first screen is displayed, then the application logo is shown.
Given the application starts, when the first screen is displayed, then the affiliate logos are shown.

requirement_text: Camera hardware and image quality shall be chosen appropriately in order to be able to display objects at maximum range of the specified ODAs.
rationale: "Chosen appropriately" and the maximum range are not specified.
clarification_questions: What is the maximum range of the specified ODAs?
What image quality and camera hardware values count as "appropriate"?

requirement_text: The Proposer shall monitor the computing systems (24 by 7) and communications circuits to report and alert on compromised system health security availability and capacity.
requirement_text_raw: The Proposer shall monitor the computing systems (24 by 7) and communications circuits to report and alert on compromised system health  security  availability and capacity.
user_story: As a security manager, I want the computing systems and communications circuits monitored around the clock, with alerts on compromised health, security, availability and capacity, so that problems are noticed quickly.
technical_task: Monitor the computing systems and communications circuits continuously (24 by 7) and report and alert on compromised system health, security, availability and capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Given the computing systems and communications circuits, when they are in operation at any time (24 by 7), then they are monitored.
Given compromised system health, security, availability or capacity, when it is detected, then it is reported and an alert is raised.
rationale: Role assumed: security manager; the Proposer carries out the monitoring.

requirement_text: The product will be available for licensing as a one-server two-five servers or five-or-more servers license.
requirement_text_raw: The product will be available for licensing as a one-server  two-five servers  or five-or-more servers license.'
user_story: As a customer, I want the product offered with a one-server, two-five servers or five-or-more servers license, so that I can choose one that fits my setup.
technical_task: Offer three license options: one server, two to five servers, and five or more servers.
acceptance_criteria: Given the licensing options, when a customer views them, then a one-server license is available.
Given the licensing options, when a customer views them, then a two-five servers license and a five-or-more servers license are available.

requirement_text: Final 8D must be available incl. proposed changes not longer than 4 weeks.
user_story: As a client, I want the final 8D with proposed changes available within 4 weeks, so that corrective actions can start promptly.
technical_task: Deliver the final 8D report, including proposed changes, within 4 weeks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a problem that requires an 8D, when 4 weeks have passed, then the final 8D including proposed changes is available.
Given an 8D delivered later than 4 weeks, when it is reviewed, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: client. The start of the 4 weeks is not stated.

requirement_text: Authorized personnel only, such as admins, shall access private data, and users shall only view their user page with valid credentials.
user_story: As an administrator, I want only authorized personnel such as admins to access private data and users to see only their own page with valid credentials, so that private data is protected.
technical_task: Restrict private data to authorized personnel and let users view only their own user page after authenticating with valid credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given authorized personnel such as an admin, when they request private data, then access is granted.
Given a user with valid credentials, when the user opens another user's page, then access is denied and only their own page is shown.

requirement_text: In all error cases, Support Services shall attempt to choose an error-free FCC-MPCC path, switching back and forth between channels if necessary.
requirement_text_raw: In all error cases, Support Services shall [SRS222] attempt to choose an error-free FCC-MPCC path, switching back and forth between channels if necessary.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Support Services to choose an error-free FCC-MPCC path in all error cases, switching between channels if needed, so that communication continues.
technical_task: On any error, make Support Services select an error-free FCC-MPCC path and switch back and forth between channels when necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error case, when Support Services reacts, then it attempts to choose an error-free FCC-MPCC path.
Given the current path is not error-free, when necessary, then Support Services switches between channels.

requirement_text: User shall filter rankings based on different criteria such as category or time period.
user_story: As a user, I want to filter rankings by criteria such as category or time period, so that I see the ranking I care about.
technical_task: Add filters for category and time period to the rankings view.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ranking, when the user filters by category, then only entries of that category are shown.
Given a ranking, when the user filters by time period, then only entries of that period are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means more criteria may exist.

requirement_text: Stockify shall achieve a two-second response time for user requests under normal load conditions.
user_story: As a user, I want Stockify to answer my requests within two seconds under normal load, so that it feels responsive.
technical_task: Keep Stockify's response time for user requests at two seconds under normal load.
acceptance_criteria: Given normal load conditions, when a user sends a request, then Stockify responds within two seconds.
Given a response that takes longer than two seconds under normal load, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Normal load" is not defined.

requirement_text: End of the game (see chapter 3.2.2.1) or menu selection.
rationale: The text is a fragment with no stated behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must happen at the end of the game or on menu selection?
Which chapter 3.2.2.1 behaviour is meant?

requirement_text: User shall expect continuous system availability.
clarification_questions: What availability percentage counts as "continuous"?
What downtime, if any, is allowed?

requirement_text: Discrete outputs shall implement software controlled switches which when open (Off) result in a logical low signal level or when closed (On) results in a logical high signal level of the associated processor pins.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want discrete outputs to use software controlled switches giving a low level when open and a high level when closed, so that the processor pins show the output state.
technical_task: Implement discrete outputs as software controlled switches where open (Off) gives a logical low and closed (On) gives a logical high on the associated processor pins.
acceptance_criteria: Given a discrete output switch that is open (Off), when the processor pin is read, then it shows a logical low signal level.
Given a discrete output switch that is closed (On), when the processor pin is read, then it shows a logical high signal level.

requirement_text: Resumes will be hidden from specific companies.
user_story: As a job seeker, I want my resume hidden from specific companies, so that they cannot see it.
technical_task: Hide resumes from companies that are excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Given a resume hidden from a specific company, when that company searches resumes, then the resume is not shown.
Given a company that is not excluded, when it searches resumes, then the resume can be shown.

requirement_text: Preferred repair facility ratings should be saved within 5 seconds.
user_story: As a policyholder, I want my ratings of preferred repair facilities saved within 5 seconds, so that I don't have to wait.
technical_task: Save preferred repair facility ratings within 5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a rating, when the user saves it, then it is saved within 5 seconds.
Given a save that takes longer than 5 seconds, when it is measured, then the recommendation is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: policyholder. "Should" makes the limit a recommendation.

requirement_text: User shall be able to download videos by clicking the download button and view them afterward.
user_story: As a viewer, I want to download videos with the download button and view them afterward, so that I can watch offline.
technical_task: Add a download button for videos and allow the downloaded videos to be viewed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video, when the user clicks the download button, then the video is downloaded.
Given a downloaded video, when the user opens it, then it can be viewed.

requirement_text: The patient chooses "My Expired Prescription Reports" and is presented with a list of the patient's expired prescriptions sorted by start date (the later date is ranked earlier closer to the top).
requirement_text_raw: The patient chooses "My Expired Prescription Reports" and is presented with a list of the patient's expired prescriptions   sorted by start date (the later date is ranked earlier closer to the top).
user_story: As a patient, I want to choose "My Expired Prescription Reports" and see my expired prescriptions sorted by start date with the later dates first, so that I can review them.
technical_task: Offer a "My Expired Prescription Reports" option that lists the patient's expired prescriptions sorted by start date, latest first.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with expired prescriptions, when the patient chooses "My Expired Prescription Reports", then the expired prescriptions are listed.
Given the list, when it is displayed, then prescriptions with later start dates appear closer to the top.

requirement_text: Remote access may be offered if agreed to by the organization subject to the aforementioned protocols and suitable authentication.
user_story: As an administrator, I want remote access offered when the organization agrees, subject to the protocols and suitable authentication, so that remote work is possible safely.
technical_task: Allow remote access if the organization has agreed, subject to the stated protocols and suitable authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Given the organization has agreed to remote access, when a user connects remotely with suitable authentication under the protocols, then access is granted.
Given the organization has not agreed or authentication is not suitable, when a user connects remotely, then access is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "May" makes the offer optional. The protocols are not listed.

requirement_text: Users shall set a secure password complying with password constraints.
user_story: As a user, I want to set a secure password that meets the password constraints, so that my account is protected.
technical_task: Enforce password constraints when users set a password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a password that meets the constraints, when the user sets it, then it is accepted.
Given a password that does not meet the constraints, when the user sets it, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The constraints are not listed.

requirement_text: A fake email is sent to the LHCP alerting the user that a new message has arrived.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want an email alert that a new message has arrived, so that I know to check my messages.
technical_task: Send the LHCP an email alerting that a new message has arrived.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new message has arrived for an LHCP, when it is delivered, then an email alerting the LHCP is sent.
Given no new message, when time passes, then no alert email is sent.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. "Fake" is read as an alert email that does not contain the message itself, which is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The system shall allow administrators to delete any course/event.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to delete any course or event, so that outdated ones are removed.
technical_task: Allow administrators to delete any course or event.
acceptance_criteria: Given a course or event, when an administrator deletes it, then it is removed.
Given a user who is not an administrator, when the user tries to delete a course or event, then it is not deleted.

requirement_text: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information when exchanged in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(a)(2).
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want electronic health information encrypted and decrypted when exchanged according to the standard in 170.210(a)(2), so that exchanges are secure.
technical_task: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information at exchange using the standard specified in 170.210(a)(2).
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information to be exchanged, when it is sent, then it is encrypted in accordance with 170.210(a)(2).
Given encrypted electronic health information, when it is received, then it can be decrypted in accordance with the same standard.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The standard is only referenced; the section symbol in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: The maximum time-out value shall be 327.68 microseconds (256 counts of the least significant bit of the fault tolerant clock which is 1.28 microseconds).
requirement_text_raw: The maximum time-out value shall (3.2.2.3.7) be 327.68 microseconds (256 counts of the least significant bit of the fault tolerant clock which is 1.28 microseconds).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the maximum time-out value to be 327.68 microseconds, so that waiting is bounded.
technical_task: Set the maximum time-out to 327.68 microseconds, equal to 256 counts of the least significant bit of the fault tolerant clock (1.28 microseconds).
acceptance_criteria: Given a time-out, when its value is set, then it does not exceed 327.68 microseconds.
Given the least significant bit of the fault tolerant clock of 1.28 microseconds, when 256 counts are made, then they equal the maximum time-out value.

requirement_text: The system shall have a fast scanning and conversion speed to minimize user wait time.
user_story: As a user, I want fast scanning and conversion, so that I wait as little as possible.
technical_task: Optimize scanning and conversion to reduce user wait time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a document to scan, when the user starts scanning, then scanning and conversion are performed.
Given scanning and conversion, when they run, then user wait time is kept as short as the system can achieve.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Fast" is not measured, so the criteria are qualitative.

requirement_text: The utility timer shall have an accuracy equal to or better than 50 PPM.
requirement_text_raw: The utility timer shall [SRS247] have an accuracy equal to or better than 50 PPM.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the utility timer accuracy to be 50 PPM or better, so that timing is dependable.
technical_task: Give the utility timer an accuracy of 50 PPM or better.
acceptance_criteria: Given the utility timer, when its accuracy is measured, then it is equal to or better than 50 PPM.
Given an accuracy worse than 50 PPM, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Envelope depository shall meet specified dimensions.
rationale: The dimensions are referred to but not given.
clarification_questions: Which dimensions does "specified dimensions" refer to?
Where are the dimensions specified?

requirement_text: The product will require collaboration with a database management system (DBMS). The DBMS may be located on the same machine as the product or on a separate machine residing on the same computer network.
requirement_text_raw: The product will require collaboration with a database management system (DBMS).  The DBMS may be located on the same machine as the product or on a separate machine residing on the same computer network.'
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the product to work with a DBMS located on the same machine or on a separate machine on the same network, so that I can choose the deployment.
technical_task: Integrate the product with a database management system that is local or on another machine in the same computer network.
acceptance_criteria: Given a DBMS on the same machine as the product, when the product runs, then it collaborates with the DBMS.
Given a DBMS on a separate machine on the same computer network, when the product runs, then it collaborates with the DBMS.

requirement_text: Every maintenance team number shall be based on an association of: (M) service area identifier; type of maintenance team (speciality code); maintenance team identifier.
requirement_text_raw: 9.2.4.2 Every maintenance team number shall be based on an association of: (M) service area identifier; type of maintenance team (speciality code); maintenance team identifier.
user_story: As a railway operator, I want every maintenance team number built from the service area identifier, the maintenance team type (speciality code) and the maintenance team identifier, so that teams can be identified.
technical_task: Form each maintenance team number from a service area identifier, the type of maintenance team (speciality code) and a maintenance team identifier.
acceptance_criteria: Given a maintenance team, when its number is formed, then it contains the service area identifier.
Given a maintenance team, when its number is formed, then it also contains the type of maintenance team (speciality code) and the maintenance team identifier.

requirement_text: The system's reliability shall be primarily dependent on a continuously maintained and updated database backup that reflects the latest changes.
rationale: The sentence states a dependency and no testable target.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement that backups must be continuous, or a statement about reliability?
What reliability target applies?

requirement_text: Both patients and LHCPs can view a list of their upcoming appointments .
user_story: As a patient, I want to view a list of my upcoming appointments, so that I know when to attend.
technical_task: Show patients and LHCPs a list of their upcoming appointments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient or LHCP with upcoming appointments, when the user opens the list, then the upcoming appointments are shown.
Given a past appointment, when the list is displayed, then it is not shown.

requirement_text: User shall receive a message for any successful or unsuccessful action performed.
user_story: As a user, I want a message for every successful or unsuccessful action, so that I know the result.
technical_task: Display a message after every action stating whether it succeeded or failed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an action that succeeds, when it completes, then a success message is shown.
Given an action that fails, when it ends, then a failure message is shown.

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to schedule matches by specifying the date, time, and location, as well as reschedule matches due to bad weather conditions.
user_story: As a league admin, I want to schedule matches by date, time and location and reschedule them for bad weather, so that games go ahead at suitable times.
technical_task: Implement match scheduling with date, time and location fields and a reschedule option used when weather is bad.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new match, when the admin enters a date, a time and a location, then the match is scheduled.
Given a scheduled match affected by bad weather conditions, when the admin reschedules it, then the match has the new date and time.

requirement_text: A Platform Administrator shall be able to hide public datasets.
user_story: As a platform administrator, I want to hide public datasets, so that they are no longer visible to the public.
technical_task: Give Platform Administrators a way to switch a public dataset to hidden.
acceptance_criteria: Given a public dataset, when a Platform Administrator hides it, then the public can no longer see it.
Given a user who is not a Platform Administrator, when the user tries to hide a public dataset, then it is not hidden.

requirement_text: The product shall be free of computer viruses.
user_story: As a user, I want the product to be free of computer viruses, so that my computer is not harmed.
technical_task: Scan the product and its deliverables for computer viruses before release.
acceptance_criteria: Given the product package, when it is scanned with a virus scanner before release, then no computer virus is found.
Given a computer virus is found in the product, when it is reported, then the product is not released.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which scanner is used is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to input using either touch screen or keypad methods.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter input by touch screen or keypad, so that I can use whichever suits me.
technical_task: Accept input from both a touch screen and a keypad.
acceptance_criteria: Given a touch screen, when the user enters input on it, then the input is accepted.
Given a keypad, when the user enters input on it, then the input is accepted.

requirement_text: System shall ensure accessibility across all major web browsers available on the market without restrictions.
rationale: "All major web browsers" and "without restrictions" are not defined.
clarification_questions: Which browsers count as "major" and which versions?
What does "without restrictions" mean in testable terms?

requirement_text: The system shall provide separate interfaces for students, faculty, and administrators.
user_story: As a user, I want separate interfaces for students, faculty and administrators, so that each group sees what it needs.
technical_task: Build three separate interfaces: one for students, one for faculty and one for administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student, when the student logs in, then the student interface is shown.
Given a faculty member or an administrator, when the person logs in, then the faculty interface or the administrator interface is shown respectively.
rationale: Role assumed: user of any of the three groups.

requirement_text: Settings shall include notification settings, app language change, and help menu.
user_story: As a user, I want settings for notifications, app language and a help menu, so that I can adjust the app.
technical_task: Create a Settings screen that includes notification settings, language change and a help menu.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Settings screen, when the user opens it, then notification settings, app language change and a help menu are available.
Given the app language setting, when the user changes the language, then the app is displayed in the chosen language.

requirement_text: The NE shall keep track of the grouping of physical processors into virtual groups. This mapping is contained in the Configuration Table (CT).
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.2.2.1) keep track of the grouping of physical processors into virtual groups. This mapping is contained in the Configuration Table (CT).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the NE to keep track of how physical processors are grouped into virtual groups, using the Configuration Table (CT), so that the grouping is known.
technical_task: Maintain the mapping of physical processors to virtual groups in the NE and hold it in the Configuration Table (CT).
acceptance_criteria: Given physical processors grouped into virtual groups, when the NE operates, then it tracks the grouping.
Given the grouping, when the Configuration Table (CT) is read, then it contains the mapping.

requirement_text: The responsible organization shall define the specific details of the test protocol, considering the intended purpose of this evaluation, battery system design and location, facility availability, and the safety of test personnel and equipment.
user_story: As a project lead, I want the responsible organization to define the test protocol details, considering purpose, battery system design and location, facility availability and safety, so that tests are planned properly.
technical_task: Have the responsible organization define the specific details of the test protocol, taking into account the intended purpose, battery system design and location, facility availability and the safety of test personnel and equipment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an evaluation to be performed, when the test protocol is prepared, then the responsible organization defines its specific details.
Given the test protocol, when it is reviewed, then it takes into account purpose, battery system design and location, facility availability and safety of personnel and equipment.

requirement_text: Administrator shall review and approve/deny leave requests.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to review and approve or deny leave requests, so that leave is managed.
technical_task: Provide a review screen for leave requests with approve and deny actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a leave request, when the administrator approves it, then the request is marked approved.
Given a leave request, when the administrator denies it, then the request is marked denied.

requirement_text: User shall be able to create purchase orders for medicines from authorized distributors, specifying details like quantity and expiration dates.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want to create purchase orders for medicines from authorized distributors with quantity and expiration dates, so that I can restock.
technical_task: Provide a purchase order form for medicines that records the authorized distributor, quantity and expiration dates.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized distributor, when the user creates a purchase order for medicines, then the order is saved.
Given a purchase order, when it is created, then it records details such as quantity and expiration dates.
rationale: Role assumed: pharmacist. "Details like" means more details may exist.

requirement_text: Login failures valid authentication and log outs are also logged .
requirement_text_raw: Login failures  valid authentication  and log outs are also logged .
user_story: As a security auditor, I want login failures, valid authentications and log outs logged, so that access can be reviewed.
technical_task: Record login failures, successful authentications and log outs in the log.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failed login, when it happens, then it is logged.
Given a valid authentication or a log out, when it happens, then it is logged.

requirement_text: Lettering of the supplier 's name and supplier identification shall be designed smaller than the OEM-identification.
user_story: As an OEM, I want the supplier's lettering and identification designed smaller than the OEM identification, so that the OEM brand is dominant.
technical_task: Design the supplier name lettering and supplier identification smaller than the OEM identification.
acceptance_criteria: Given the product marking, when the supplier's name lettering is measured, then it is smaller than the OEM identification.
Given the product marking, when the supplier identification is measured, then it is smaller than the OEM identification.

requirement_text: User shall specify desired report criteria, and the system shall display the report accordingly.
user_story: As a user, I want to specify report criteria and see the report accordingly, so that I get the information I need.
technical_task: Let the user enter report criteria and display a report built from them.
acceptance_criteria: Given report criteria entered by the user, when the user requests the report, then the report is displayed according to the criteria.
Given different criteria, when the user requests the report again, then the report changes accordingly.

requirement_text: Social travel application shall allow users to select, define, record, or import routes.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to select, define, record or import routes, so that I can plan and share them.
technical_task: Provide functions to select, define, record and import routes in the social travel application.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user selects or defines a route, then the route is saved.
Given the application, when the user records or imports a route, then the route is added.

requirement_text: An administrator chooses to maintain the standards list for immunizations diagnoses allowable drugs or allowable physical services .
requirement_text_raw: An administrator chooses to maintain the standards list for immunizations   diagnoses   allowable drugs   or allowable physical services .
user_story: As an administrator, I want to maintain the standards list for immunizations, diagnoses, allowable drugs and allowable physical services, so that clinicians use approved values.
technical_task: Provide maintenance of the standards lists for immunizations, diagnoses, allowable drugs and allowable physical services.
acceptance_criteria: Given a standards list, when the administrator adds or changes an entry, then the list is updated.
Given the lists, when the administrator opens them, then lists for immunizations, diagnoses, allowable drugs and allowable physical services are available.

requirement_text: User shall login to access the examiner portal.
user_story: As an examiner, I want to log in to the examiner portal, so that I can access my functions.
technical_task: Require login to access the examiner portal.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid examiner login, when the user logs in, then the examiner portal opens.
Given no login, when the user tries to open the examiner portal, then access is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to remove items from their listings by tapping Remove Item.
user_story: As a seller, I want to remove items from my listings by tapping Remove Item, so that sold items disappear.
technical_task: Add a Remove Item control that deletes an item from the user's listings.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item in the user's listings, when the user taps Remove Item, then the item is removed from the listings.
Given an item removed, when the listings are viewed, then it is no longer shown.

requirement_text: The system must be recoverable in case of any failures or problems.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the system to be recoverable after failures or problems, so that service can be restored.
technical_task: Provide recovery procedures that restore the system after a failure or problem.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failure, when recovery is performed, then the system is restored to working order.
Given a problem, when recovery is performed, then the system resumes operation.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Any" failure cannot be covered completely, so the criteria describe recovery in general.

requirement_text: User shall be able to copy items by selecting them and clicking the "Copy" button.
user_story: As a user, I want to copy items by selecting them and clicking Copy, so that I can duplicate them quickly.
technical_task: Add a Copy button that duplicates the selected items.
acceptance_criteria: Given selected items, when the user clicks the Copy button, then copies of the items are created.
Given no selected items, when the user clicks the Copy button, then no copy is made.

requirement_text: Sub-apps and their launchers in the main app shall be deleted by a qualified programmer.
user_story: As a qualified programmer, I want to delete sub-apps and their launchers from the main app, so that unused ones are removed.
technical_task: Allow only a qualified programmer to delete sub-apps together with their launchers in the main app.
acceptance_criteria: Given a qualified programmer, when the programmer deletes a sub-app, then the sub-app and its launcher are removed from the main app.
Given a user who is not a qualified programmer, when the user tries to delete a sub-app, then it is not deleted.

requirement_text: The system shall comply with relevant data privacy regulations based on usage (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the system to comply with the data privacy regulations that apply to its use, such as GDPR or HIPAA, so that we meet legal duties.
technical_task: Identify the data privacy regulations that apply to the system's usage, for example GDPR and HIPAA, and implement what they require.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system's usage, when applicable data privacy regulations such as GDPR or HIPAA are identified, then the system meets their requirements.
Given a regulation that applies, when the system is reviewed, then no requirement of that regulation is violated.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The regulations' content is not given.

requirement_text: System shall respond to citizen inquiries with minimal turnaround time.
clarification_questions: What turnaround time counts as "minimal" for citizen inquiries?
Which kinds of inquiries does this cover?

requirement_text: For details concerning Software Quality Gates see separate chapter.
rationale: The sentence only points to another chapter.
clarification_questions: What do the Software Quality Gates require?
Is the separate chapter part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The FTSS API shall define a methodology for segregating and managing congruent aligned, congruent initialized, and non-congruent memory such that congruent aligned memory is aligned and congruent initialized memory is initialized during channel recovery. Non-congruent memory is not modified during realignment.
requirement_text_raw: 1.     The FTSS API shall [SRS046] define a methodology for segregating and managing congruent aligned, congruent initialized, and non-congruent memory such that congruent aligned memory is aligned and congruent initialized memory is initialized during channel recovery.  Non-congruent memory is not modified during realignment.
user_story: As a software developer, I want the FTSS API to define how congruent aligned, congruent initialized and non-congruent memory are segregated and managed, so that memory behaves correctly during recovery and realignment.
technical_task: Define in the FTSS API a methodology for segregating and managing congruent aligned, congruent initialized and non-congruent memory, with aligned and initialized memory handled during channel recovery and non-congruent memory left unmodified during realignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given channel recovery, when the methodology is applied, then congruent aligned memory is aligned and congruent initialized memory is initialized.
Given realignment, when the methodology is applied, then non-congruent memory is not modified.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to remove videos by entering the video name and receive confirmation of successful removal.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to remove videos by entering the video name and get a confirmation, so that I know the removal worked.
technical_task: Add a removal function that deletes a video by name and shows a confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing video, when the administrator enters its name and removes it, then the video is removed.
Given a video removed, when the removal completes, then a confirmation of successful removal is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall adhere to relevant banking and financial industry regulations, including Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the system to adhere to banking and financial regulations, including Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements, so that we stay compliant.
technical_task: Implement the KYC and AML requirements and other relevant banking and financial industry regulations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new customer, when the account is opened, then the Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements are applied.
Given financial transactions, when they are processed, then the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements are applied.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. Other relevant regulations are not listed.

requirement_text: The LHCP views his or her message inbox.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view my message inbox, so that I can read my messages.
technical_task: Provide a message inbox view for the LHCP.
acceptance_criteria: Given an LHCP with messages, when the LHCP opens the message inbox, then the messages are shown.
Given an LHCP with no messages, when the LHCP opens the inbox, then it is empty.

requirement_text: TCS shall notify the operator when AV performance parameters are out of limits.
user_story: As an operator, I want the TCS to notify me when AV performance parameters are out of limits, so that I can react.
technical_task: Send a notification to the operator whenever an AV performance parameter leaves its limits.
acceptance_criteria: Given an AV performance parameter is out of limits, when the TCS detects it, then the operator is notified.
Given all AV performance parameters are within limits, when the TCS checks them, then no notification is sent.
rationale: Role assumed: operator. The limits are not given.

requirement_text: System shall have a logical interface for ease of use and common tasks.
user_story: As a user, I want a logical interface for common tasks, so that I can use the system easily.
technical_task: Arrange the interface so that common tasks follow a logical flow.
acceptance_criteria: Given a common task, when the user performs it, then the steps follow a logical order.
Given the interface, when it is reviewed, then common tasks are reachable without detours.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Logical" and "ease of use" are not measured.

requirement_text: System administrators shall have control over dropdown lists and list boxes throughout the site.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want control over dropdown lists and list boxes throughout the site, so that I can keep their values current.
technical_task: Let administrators edit the values of every dropdown list and list box on the site.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dropdown list or list box, when the administrator adds or removes a value, then the list reflects the change.
Given dropdown lists across the site, when the administrator edits one, then the edit is available everywhere that list is used.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to retrieve data about mapped elements from the database.
user_story: As a system, I want to retrieve data about mapped elements from the database, so that mapped elements can be displayed.
technical_task: Query the database for data about mapped elements.
acceptance_criteria: Given mapped elements in the database, when the system requests data about them, then the data is retrieved.
Given a mapped element, when its data is retrieved, then it matches the database record.
rationale: Role assumed: the system itself, since no user is named.

requirement_text: The system shall function as a high availability computer for real-time tasks including correlation, hardware management, and remote updates.
user_story: As an observatory engineer, I want the system to work as a high availability computer for correlation, hardware management and remote updates, so that these real-time tasks keep running.
technical_task: Provide the system as a high availability computer that handles real-time tasks including correlation, hardware management and remote updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given a real-time correlation task, when the system runs it, then the task is carried out.
Given hardware management or a remote update, when it is requested, then the system carries it out.
rationale: Role assumed: observatory engineer. "High availability" is not quantified.

requirement_text: System shall ensure the security of user accounts, employing measures such as encryption, password complexity requirements, and protection against brute-force attacks.
user_story: As a user, I want my account secured with encryption, password complexity requirements and protection against brute-force attacks, so that nobody can take it over.
technical_task: Secure user accounts with encryption, password complexity rules and protection against brute-force attacks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user sets a password, when it does not meet the complexity requirements, then it is rejected.
Given repeated failed login attempts, when a brute-force attack is detected, then further attempts are blocked.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means other measures are possible.

requirement_text: User shall select desired data format and export criteria, and the system shall export data accordingly.
user_story: As a user, I want to choose a data format and export criteria and have the data exported accordingly, so that I get the data I need.
technical_task: Offer data export with a selectable format and selectable export criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a chosen data format and export criteria, when the user exports, then the data is exported in that format and matches the criteria.
Given different export criteria, when the user exports again, then the exported data changes accordingly.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall , during memory alignment, configure the NE to mask out the processor being re-synchronized.
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS281], during memory alignment, configure the NE to mask out the processor being re-synchronized.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to mask out the processor being re-synchronized during memory alignment, so that it does not disturb the NE.
technical_task: During memory alignment, configure the NE to mask out the processor that is being re-synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory alignment is in progress, when a processor is being re-synchronized, then Redundancy Management configures the NE to mask it out.
Given memory alignment is not in progress, when no processor is being re-synchronized, then no masking is required by this rule.

requirement_text: Upon start of the roll program, roll information shall be displayed on the instructor’s Pocket PC within 10 seconds.
user_story: As an instructor, I want roll information on my Pocket PC within 10 seconds of starting the roll program, so that I can begin right away.
technical_task: Display the roll information on the instructor's Pocket PC no later than 10 seconds after the roll program starts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the instructor starts the roll program, when 10 seconds have passed, then the roll information is displayed on the Pocket PC.
Given a display that takes longer than 10 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role stated: instructor. The garbled apostrophe was read as "instructor's".

requirement_text: The drug desired to be prescribed is checked against the patient's drug allergies.
user_story: As a physician, I want the drug I want to prescribe checked against the patient's drug allergies, so that I avoid harmful prescriptions.
technical_task: Check each drug selected for prescribing against the patient's recorded drug allergies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a drug the patient is allergic to, when the physician selects it for prescribing, then the allergy is detected.
Given a drug the patient is not allergic to, when the physician selects it, then no allergy is reported.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to check the status of all books, including whether they have been issued or reserved, and view their details.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to check the status of all books, whether issued or reserved, and view their details, so that I know where each book is.
technical_task: Provide a status view of all books showing issued and reserved state and a details view.
acceptance_criteria: Given books in the library, when the administrator opens the status view, then each book's status is shown, including whether it is issued or reserved.
Given a book in the list, when the administrator selects it, then its details are displayed.

requirement_text: The system should be accessible on various devices (mobile app implies mobile accessibility).
user_story: As a user, I want the system accessible on various devices, so that I can use it on my mobile as well.
technical_task: Make the system usable on several device types, including mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mobile device, when the user opens the system, then it is accessible.
Given another supported device type, when the user opens the system, then it is accessible.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The devices are only implied by the mobile app; the exact list is not given.

requirement_text: The software assumes the use of a tool like Tomcat for connecting web pages and the database.
rationale: The sentence states an assumption about tooling and does not require specific behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is Tomcat required, or is it only an example ("a tool like Tomcat")?
What must connect the web pages and the database?

requirement_text: Traceability needs to be ensure for the product, further details via Quality workshop.
rationale: The sentence defers the details to a workshop and gives no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What does traceability need to cover for the product?
What will the Quality workshop decide?

requirement_text: User shall be able to purchase credits using credit card or PayPal account.
user_story: As a customer, I want to buy credits with a credit card or a PayPal account, so that I can pay the way I prefer.
technical_task: Offer credit card and PayPal account as payment methods for buying credits.
acceptance_criteria: Given a credit card, when the user buys credits with it, then the purchase is completed.
Given a PayPal account, when the user buys credits with it, then the purchase is completed.

requirement_text: Each flight NE shall be conduction-cooled.
requirement_text_raw: Each flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.2.12) be conduction-cooled.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want each flight NE to be conduction-cooled, so that it needs no airflow.
technical_task: Design each flight NE for conduction cooling.
acceptance_criteria: Given a flight NE, when its cooling design is reviewed, then it is conduction-cooled.
Given a flight NE in operation, when its cooling is inspected, then it does not depend on convection or forced airflow.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "conduction-cooled".

requirement_text: The user shall be able to cancel booked tickets if they need to change their travel dates.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to cancel booked tickets when I need to change my travel dates, so that I can rebook.
technical_task: Provide a cancel function for booked tickets.
acceptance_criteria: Given a booked ticket, when the user cancels it, then the booking is cancelled.
Given a cancelled ticket, when the user views their bookings, then it is no longer active.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create proxy Data Packages for reliable data sources.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to create proxy Data Packages for reliable data sources, so that I can reference them without copying.
technical_task: Support creation of proxy Data Packages that point to reliable data sources.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reliable data source, when the user creates a proxy Data Package for it, then the Data Package is created.
Given a proxy Data Package, when it is opened, then it refers to the data source.
rationale: Role assumed: data publisher. What "reliable" means is not defined.

requirement_text: The restaurant owner login system must always prevent unauthorized access by notifying users of failed login attempts with non-existent accounts.
user_story: As a restaurant owner, I want to be notified of failed login attempts with non-existent accounts, so that I can spot unauthorized access attempts.
technical_task: Notify users when a login attempt fails because the account does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: Given a login attempt with a non-existent account, when it fails, then the user is notified of the failed attempt.
Given a login attempt with an existing account and correct credentials, when it succeeds, then no failed-attempt notification is sent.
rationale: Role stated: restaurant owner. "Always prevent unauthorized access" cannot be guaranteed; the criteria test the notification.

requirement_text: System shall be able to process transaction requests on a device and send a message indicating the success or failure of the transaction.
user_story: As a user, I want transaction requests processed on my device and a message telling me whether they succeeded, so that I know the outcome.
technical_task: Process transaction requests on a device and send a success or failure message.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction request, when it is processed on the device, then a message states that it succeeded.
Given a transaction request that fails, when it ends, then a message states that it failed.

requirement_text: Further details on proposed PWM strategy is provided in the SW Specification.
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What does the SW Specification say about the PWM strategy?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The system shall allow camp administrators to suspend campers for behavioral issues.
user_story: As a camp administrator, I want to suspend campers for behavioral issues, so that I can manage conduct.
technical_task: Provide a suspend function for campers that administrators can apply for behavioral issues.
acceptance_criteria: Given a camper with behavioral issues, when the camp administrator suspends the camper, then the camper is marked as suspended.
Given a suspended camper, when the camp is administered, then the camper's suspension is shown.

requirement_text: All TV amplifiers without automatic gain control have also be checked similarly.
rationale: The sentence depends on an earlier check that is not given and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What exactly was checked on the TV amplifiers with automatic gain control, and how?
What does "similarly" refer to?

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to access the system using specified pincodes (zones).
user_story: As a user, I want to access the system using specified pincodes (zones), so that I only see my zone.
technical_task: Control access to the system by the specified pincodes (zones).
acceptance_criteria: Given a user in a specified pincode zone, when the user accesses the system, then access is granted for that zone.
Given a pincode that is not specified, when a user tries to access the system with it, then access is not granted.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion follows from "specified pincodes".

requirement_text: System shall ensure availability 24/7, informing users and preventing them from continuing in case of unexpected failures.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available 24/7 and to be told and stopped from continuing when an unexpected failure occurs, so that I don't proceed on a broken system.
technical_task: Keep the system available 24/7 and, on an unexpected failure, inform users and stop them from continuing.
acceptance_criteria: Given any time of day, when a user opens the system, then it is available.
Given an unexpected failure, when it occurs, then users are informed and cannot continue.

requirement_text: System shall be able to allow new users to register and create accounts.
user_story: As a new user, I want to register and create an account, so that I can use the system.
technical_task: Provide registration and account creation for new users.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when a new user submits valid details, then an account is created.
Given the registration form, when a new user submits invalid details, then no account is created.

requirement_text: Access to editing booking, billing, and car information shall be limited to authorized personnel.
user_story: As a rental manager, I want access to editing booking, billing and car information limited to authorized personnel, so that records stay correct.
technical_task: Restrict editing of booking, billing and car information to authorized personnel.
acceptance_criteria: Given authorized personnel, when they edit booking, billing or car information, then the edit is saved.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to edit that information, then the edit is refused.

requirement_text: In the event of remote Deck Lid lid release, the ITS monitoring is interrupted until the Deck Lid is closed again.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want the ITS monitoring interrupted during a remote Deck Lid release until the Deck Lid is closed again, so that opening the lid does not trigger false alarms.
technical_task: Suspend the ITS monitoring when the Deck Lid is released remotely and resume it when the Deck Lid is closed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Deck Lid is released remotely, when the release occurs, then the ITS monitoring is interrupted.
Given the ITS monitoring is interrupted because of a remote release, when the Deck Lid is closed again, then the interruption ends.
rationale: Role assumed: vehicle engineer. The resume criterion follows from "until".

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create, schedule, track, and manage tasks related to sales activities.
user_story: As a salesperson, I want to create, schedule, track and manage tasks related to sales activities, so that I stay organized.
technical_task: Provide task creation, scheduling, tracking and management for sales activities.
acceptance_criteria: Given the task function, when a user creates a task related to a sales activity, then it is saved.
Given a task, when a user schedules, tracks or manages it, then the changes are applied.

requirement_text: User shall be able to initialize parameters (t, k, m, n) and set the parameters during the initialization process.
user_story: As a user, I want to initialize parameters (t, k, m, n) and set them during initialization, so that the algorithm starts with my values.
technical_task: Provide an initialization step in which the parameters t, k, m and n can be entered and set.
acceptance_criteria: Given the initialization step, when the user enters values for t, k, m and n, then the parameters are set.
Given the parameters have been set, when initialization completes, then they are used by the system.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The meaning of the parameters is not described.

requirement_text: User shall perform weekly roster of employees.
user_story: As a manager, I want to prepare a weekly roster of employees, so that shifts are planned.
technical_task: Provide weekly roster creation for employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given employees, when the user prepares a weekly roster, then the roster is saved.
Given a saved weekly roster, when it is opened, then it shows the employees' assignments.
rationale: Role assumed: manager; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: When the radio is first powered on, the language that appears on the display shall be the default one set by the national railway. (M) Select mobile radio network.
requirement_text_raw:
When the radio is first powered on, the language that appears on the display shall be 
the default one set by the national railway. (M) 
Select mobile radio network.
user_story: As a railway driver, I want the display language to be the default one set by the national railway when the radio is first powered on, and to select the mobile radio network, so that the radio is ready to use.
technical_task: Show the display in the language the national railway set as default when the radio is first powered on, and offer selection of the mobile radio network.
acceptance_criteria: Given the radio is powered on for the first time, when the display starts, then it uses the default language set by the national railway.
Given the radio is powered on, when the user opens network settings, then a mobile radio network can be selected.
rationale: Role assumed: railway driver. The "(M)" tag is kept out of the behaviour.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall issue the 50 Hz interrupt to all the ICPs with a skew no greater than 330 microseconds.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS191] issue the 50 Hz interrupt to all the ICPs with a skew no greater than 330 microseconds.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to issue the 50 Hz interrupt to all ICPs with a skew of no more than 330 microseconds, so that they stay in step.
technical_task: Send the 50 Hz interrupt from the scheduler to every ICP so that the skew between ICPs is at most 330 microseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given the 50 Hz interrupt is issued, when it reaches all ICPs, then the skew between them is no greater than 330 microseconds.
Given a skew above 330 microseconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: SSL is used to protect authentication cookies.
user_story: As a security officer, I want SSL used to protect authentication cookies, so that they cannot be stolen in transit.
technical_task: Send authentication cookies only over SSL.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authentication cookie, when it is sent, then it is sent over SSL.
Given a connection without SSL, when an authentication cookie would be sent, then it is not sent.

requirement_text: When the task restart begins, the FTSS shall provide a mechanism to signal the task to execute its startup recovery actions, including updating the I-Load data and pre-stored last good data state.
requirement_text_raw: When the task restart begins, the FTSS shall (3.3.4.15) provide a mechanism to signal the task to execute its startup recovery actions, including updating the I-Load data and pre-stored last good data state.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to signal a task at restart to run its startup recovery actions, including updating the I-Load data and the pre-stored last good data state, so that the task recovers correctly.
technical_task: When a task restart begins, give a mechanism that signals the task to execute startup recovery actions, including updating I-Load data and the pre-stored last good data state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task restart begins, when FTSS handles it, then the task is signalled to execute its startup recovery actions.
Given the startup recovery actions run, when they complete, then the I-Load data and the pre-stored last good data state have been updated.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to generate asset reports based on location.
user_story: As an asset manager, I want asset reports by location, so that I can see where assets are.
technical_task: Generate asset reports grouped by location.
acceptance_criteria: Given assets at several locations, when the user generates a report, then assets are shown per location.
Given a location with no assets, when the report is generated, then it shows no assets for that location.

requirement_text: The system shall provide textual descriptions or alternative functionalities for all non-text media like images and videos.
user_story: As a user who cannot see images or videos, I want textual descriptions or alternative functionalities for all non-text media, so that I can access the content.
technical_task: Provide a textual description or an alternative function for every image and video.
acceptance_criteria: Given an image, when it is displayed, then a textual description or alternative function is available.
Given a video, when it is displayed, then a textual description or alternative function is available.
rationale: Role assumed: user needing accessibility support.

requirement_text: System shall allow up to three reattempts for unsuccessful login and display supported languages for successful login.
user_story: As a user, I want up to three reattempts after an unsuccessful login and to see the supported languages after a successful login, so that I can sign in and choose a language.
technical_task: Allow at most three reattempts after an unsuccessful login and display the supported languages after a successful login.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unsuccessful login, when the user retries, then up to three reattempts are allowed.
Given a successful login, when it completes, then the supported languages are displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What happens after the third failed reattempt is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall be able to facilitate fund transfers between accounts.
user_story: As a customer, I want to transfer funds between accounts, so that I can move my money.
technical_task: Provide a fund transfer function between accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given two accounts and sufficient funds, when the customer transfers funds, then the amount is moved from one account to the other.
Given insufficient funds, when the customer tries to transfer, then the transfer is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: The admin or user can log in to the system with their unique username and password.

requirement_text: FTSS shall , in ICP and FCP IBIT failure cases that allow processing to continue, after saving the results of IBIT for reporting to the application, in the first minor frame after Startup or recovery, consider the FCR to be failed, and start performing recovery actions for the FCR.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS290], in ICP and FCP IBIT failure cases that allow processing to continue, after saving the results of IBIT for reporting to the application, in the first minor frame after Startup or recovery, consider the FCR to be failed, and start performing recovery actions for the FCR.

requirement_text: Synchronous communication shall be in the form of messages enqueued for transmission at the start of the next rate group frame and dequeued for reading by the recipient task within the next rate group frame after it is received.
requirement_text_raw: Synchronous communication shall (3.3.6.1) be in the form of messages enqueued for transmission at the start of the next rate group frame and dequeued for reading by the recipient task within the next rate group frame after it is received.

acceptance_criteria: Given a message to send, when synchronous communication is used, then it is enqueued for transmission at the start of the next rate group frame.

requirement_text: The solution should not allow deletions or alteration of the contents of the audit log.
user_story: As an auditor, I want the audit log not to allow deletion or alteration of its contents, so that it can be trusted.

Given an entry in the audit log, when someone tries to alter it, then the alteration is refused.

requirement_text: Data of the user should be regularly synchronized between their device and the database for auto save functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want my data synchronized regularly between my device and the database, so that auto save works.

Given a device that restarts, when the user returns, then the auto-saved data is available.

requirement_text: The HCP can graph height or weight of the patient over the last 3 calendar years .

acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with height data, when the HCP requests a graph, then height over the last 3 calendar years is shown.
Given a patient with weight data, when the HCP requests a graph, then weight over the last 3 calendar years is shown.

Which accessibility and which restrictions are meant?

requirement_text: The solution should support the pharmacist verification of all medications prior to their being dispensed.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should support the pharmacist verification of all  medications prior to their being dispensed.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want to verify all medications before they are dispensed, so that errors are caught.

acceptance_criteria: Given a medication that the pharmacist has not verified, when dispensing is attempted, then it is not allowed.
Given a medication verified by the pharmacist, when dispensing is attempted, then it is allowed.

requirement_text: In case of a failure, a re-initialization of program will be done.
user_story: As a user, I want the program re-initialized after a failure, so that it can continue.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to retrieve each item of structured health care information discretely within patient context.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to retrieve each item of structured health care information discretely within the patient context, so that I see exactly the data I need.

acceptance_criteria: Given a patient and a structured health care information item, when the clinician requests it, then that item is retrieved by itself.
Given a different patient, when the clinician requests the item, then it is retrieved only for the chosen patient.

requirement_text: Each conference room reservation in the system will contain the same information as was entered by the user.
user_story: As an employee, I want each conference room reservation to contain exactly what I entered, so that nothing is changed.

acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters reservation information, when the reservation is saved, then it contains the same information.
Given a saved reservation, when it is displayed, then it shows the information as entered.

requirement_text: The application shall be able to notify the user when an assignment is close to its due date.
user_story: As a student, I want to be notified when an assignment is close to its due date, so that I don't miss it.
technical_task: Send a notification as an assignment's due date approaches.
acceptance_criteria: Given an assignment with a due date, when it is close to the due date, then the user is notified.
Given an assignment that is not close to its due date, when the user uses the application, then no due-date notification is sent.

requirement_text: System shall support a variety of media file and text-based formats.
rationale: "A variety of formats" are not named.

requirement_text: Database backup and multiple admin setup with file access privileges shall be available.
user_story: As an administrator, I want database backup and several admins with file access privileges, so that data is protected and work is shared.
technical_task: Provide database backup and the ability to set up multiple administrators with file access privileges.
acceptance_criteria: Given the database, when a backup is run, then the backup is created.
Given several administrators, when they are set up, then each has file access privileges.

requirement_text: Flight hardware shall be fabricated using radiation-hardened and/or radiation tolerant components.
requirement_text_raw: Flight hardware shall (3.2.3.1.2.13) be fabricated using radiation-hardened and/or radiation tolerant components.
user_story: As a mission engineer, I want flight hardware built from radiation-hardened and/or radiation tolerant components, so that it survives the radiation environment.

acceptance_criteria: Given the flight hardware, when its components are reviewed, then each is radiation-hardened or radiation tolerant.

rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.

Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The scoreboard syndromes shall be located in the third longword of the input information block buffer cell.
requirement_text_raw: The scoreboard syndromes shall (3.2.2.6.5) be located in the third longword of the input information block buffer cell.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scoreboard syndromes located in the third longword of the input information block buffer cell, so that they are found at a fixed place.

acceptance_criteria: Given an input information block buffer cell, when it is read, then the scoreboard syndromes are in its third longword.
Given an input information block buffer cell, when another longword is read, then it does not hold the scoreboard syndromes.

requirement_text: The streaming server will have anti-virus software to prevent infection of malicious viruses.

Given a malicious virus, when it reaches the streaming server, then the anti-virus software detects it.

requirement_text: A surface computer must not dismiss an engaged menu unless the customer requests it.
requirement_text_raw: A surface computer must not dismiss an engaged menu unless the customer  requests it.
user_story: As a customer, I want an engaged menu not to disappear unless I ask for it, so that I can finish what I'm doing.

acceptance_criteria: Given an engaged menu, when the customer has not requested dismissal, then the menu stays open.
Given an engaged menu, when the customer requests dismissal, then the menu is dismissed.

requirement_text: Further details regarding HV-Interface in agreement with the client.

requirement_text: The BE system shall be able to ensure the secure delivery of all internal messages.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the BE system to deliver all internal messages securely, so that messages are not exposed or changed.
technical_task: Secure the delivery of every internal message in the BE system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an internal message, when the BE system delivers it, then the delivery is secure.
Given an unauthorized party on the delivery path, when it tries to read or alter a message, then it cannot.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The security mechanism is not specified.

requirement_text: The MultiMahjongClient will have a graphical user interface that the user will be able to interact with using a mouse and a keyboard.

acceptance_criteria: Given the MultiMahjongClient, when the user starts it, then a graphical user interface is displayed.
Given the graphical user interface, when the user interacts with it, then both a mouse and a keyboard can be used.

requirement_text: The system shall allow members to specify their role (Practitioner, Trainer, etc.).
user_story: As a member, I want to specify my role, such as Practitioner or Trainer, so that my profile shows what I do.
technical_task: Add a role selection to member profiles with options including Practitioner and Trainer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member profile, when the member specifies a role, then the role is saved.
Given the role selection, when the member opens it, then roles such as Practitioner and Trainer are offered.
