requirement_text: If the vehicle possesses a variable partition window, InCarCom is active when the partition window is not closed.
user_story: As a passenger, I want InCarCom active when the partition window is not closed in a vehicle that has a variable partition window, so that communication works when the window is open.
technical_task: Keep InCarCom active whenever the variable partition window is not closed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vehicle with a variable partition window that is not closed, when InCarCom is used, then it is active.
Given a vehicle without a variable partition window, when InCarCom is used, then this requirement does not apply.

requirement_text: The login interface shall include a "Forgot Password?" link.
user_story: As a user who forgot my password, I want a Forgot Password? link on the login page, so that I can recover my account.
technical_task: Add a "Forgot Password?" link to the login interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login interface, when it is displayed, then it includes a "Forgot Password?" link.
Given the link, when the user selects it, then the password recovery starts.
rationale: Role assumed: user who forgot the password. What happens after selecting the link is an assumption.

requirement_text: The system shall allow indicating relationships between collections and objects.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to indicate relationships between collections and objects, so that related items are linked.
technical_task: Provide a way to record a relationship between a collection and an object.
acceptance_criteria: Given a collection and an object, when the user indicates a relationship between them, then it is saved.
Given a saved relationship, when the collection or object is viewed, then the relationship is shown.

requirement_text: The overall accuracy shall be calculated by dividing total number of correct answers by the number of questions asked.
user_story: As a student, I want the overall accuracy calculated as the number of correct answers divided by the number of questions asked, so that I know my score.

acceptance_criteria: Given a set of questions asked and the correct answers among them, when accuracy is calculated, then it equals the total number of correct answers divided by the number of questions asked.
Given no correct answers, when accuracy is calculated, then the result is zero.

requirement_text: The platform shall offer embedded visualization color customization.
user_story: As an analyst, I want to customize the colors of embedded visualizations, so that they match my needs.

acceptance_criteria: Given an embedded visualization, when the user changes its colors, then the new colors are applied.

user_story: As an LHCP, I want to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system, so that I can use it (UC3).

acceptance_criteria: Given an LHCP with valid credentials, when the LHCP logs in, then the LHCP is authenticated.

user_story: As a user, I want to add or change the Subject Name, so that subjects are labelled correctly.
technical_task: Allow the Subject Name to be entered and edited.
acceptance_criteria: Given a subject, when the user adds a Subject Name, then it is saved.
Given a subject with a Subject Name, when the user changes it, then the new name is saved.

user_story: As a job seeker, I want recent jobs shown on the homepage, so that I see new openings first.
technical_task: Display recent jobs on the homepage.
acceptance_criteria: Given recently posted jobs, when the homepage is displayed, then they are shown.
Given a job that is no longer recent, when the homepage is displayed, then it is not among the recent jobs.
rationale: Role assumed: job seeker. What counts as recent is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall provide CRUD functionality for archival descriptions.
user_story: As an archivist, I want create, read, update and delete functions for archival descriptions, so that I can maintain them.
technical_task: Implement CRUD operations for archival descriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new archival description, when the user creates it, then it is saved and can be read.
Given an existing archival description, when the user updates or deletes it, then the change is applied.

user_story: As an editor, I want the Article Manager to run on my PC and use an Access database, so that I can manage articles locally.
technical_task: Run the Article Manager on the editor's PC with an Access database.
acceptance_criteria: Given the editor's PC, when the Article Manager is started, then it runs on it.

user_story: As a security officer, I want EMR data encrypted and decrypted when it is exchanged over a non-secure link, so that it cannot be read in transit.

acceptance_criteria: Given EMR data to be sent over a non-secure link, when it is sent, then it is encrypted.

acceptance_criteria: Given an object or data exchange, when it takes place, then an audit record with a time stamp is created.

acceptance_criteria: Given the Twitter settings menu, when the user enters and saves a username and password, then they are stored.

acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the user requests access, then access is granted.

acceptance_criteria: Given collections, when the user browses, then the collections are listed.

user_story: As a user, I want to find instructions easily, with user help available in 90% of the system, so that I get guidance when needed.

requirement_text: There shall be no data loss or loss of data integrity during share buying or selling transactions.

acceptance_criteria: Given a share buying transaction, when it completes, then no data is lost and data integrity is kept.

rationale: Role assumed: viewer. The degree symbol in the source is garbled and read as 360°.

requirement_text: If the game is not saved, a dialog box is displayed that asks to the player if he wants to save the game. Two choices are possible : "Yes" and "No". If "Yes" is selected, the action "Save" is processed and the main window disappeared. If "No" is selected, the main window disappeared.
user_story: As a player, I want to be asked whether to save the game when it is not saved, with Yes or No choices, so that I don't lose progress by mistake.
technical_task: Show a save dialog with Yes and No when the game is not saved: on Yes, save and close the main window; on No, close the main window.
acceptance_criteria: Given the game is not saved, when the player leaves, then a dialog box asks whether to save the game with the two choices "Yes" and "No".
Given the dialog box, when "Yes" is selected, then the action "Save" is processed and the main window disappears, and when "No" is selected, then the main window disappears.

requirement_text: The number of menus and the hierarchical structure depends strongly on the number of features requested (for more details, see feature requests in this document).
rationale: The sentence states a dependency between menus and features without specifying behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an observation?
What must the menus provide and how many features are requested?

requirement_text: The supplier is responsible for closing all open interfaces resulting from the removing of functions in the supplier software.
user_story: As a client, I want the supplier to close all open interfaces left by removing functions from the supplier software, so that no loose interfaces remain.
technical_task: Make the supplier close every interface left open by the removal of functions in the supplier software.
acceptance_criteria: Given a function removed from the supplier software, when its interfaces are reviewed, then no open interface from it remains.
Given the supplier software after removals, when it is delivered, then all resulting open interfaces are closed.

requirement_text: The website shall utilize HTTPS protocol to enhance security during data transmission.
user_story: As a user, I want the website to use HTTPS, so that my data is protected in transit.
technical_task: Serve the website over the HTTPS protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Given the website, when a user opens it, then the connection uses HTTPS.
Given data sent by a user, when it is transmitted, then it is sent over HTTPS.

requirement_text: A Data Consuming User shall be able to download view state images.
user_story: As a data consumer, I want to download view state images, so that I can use them offline.
technical_task: Provide a download for view state images.
acceptance_criteria: Given a view state image, when the Data Consuming User selects download, then the image is downloaded.
Given a downloaded view state image, when it is opened, then it shows the view state.

requirement_text: An HCP is able to create a patient or disable a selected patient .
requirement_text_raw: An HCP is able to create a patient  or disable a selected patient .
user_story: As an HCP, I want to create a patient or disable a selected patient, so that records are kept current.
technical_task: Offer functions to create a patient and to disable a selected patient.
acceptance_criteria: Given the HCP enters patient details, when the HCP creates the patient, then the patient is saved.
Given a selected patient, when the HCP disables the patient, then the patient is disabled.

requirement_text: V Mart shall handle expected and unexpected errors to prevent loss of information and minimize downtime.
user_story: As a customer, I want V Mart to handle expected and unexpected errors, so that information is not lost and downtime is minimized.
technical_task: Handle expected and unexpected errors in V Mart in a way that prevents loss of information.
acceptance_criteria: Given an expected error occurs, when V Mart handles it, then no information is lost.
Given an unexpected error occurs, when V Mart handles it, then no information is lost and downtime is kept as short as possible.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. How much downtime is acceptable is not stated.

requirement_text: Click on the name of the new file to view it.
user_story: As a user, I want to click the name of a new file to view it, so that I can open it quickly.
technical_task: Make the name of each new file a link that opens the file.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new file, when the user clicks its name, then the file is displayed.
Given two new files, when the user clicks each name, then each opens its own file.

requirement_text: The product shall display room equipment according to search parameters.
user_story: As an employee, I want the product to display room equipment according to my search parameters, so that I can find rooms that have what I need.
technical_task: Show the equipment of rooms that match the search parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Given search parameters, when the user searches, then the room equipment matching them is displayed.
Given parameters that match no room equipment, when the user searches, then no equipment is displayed.

requirement_text: The notification center also displays a list of the patient and patient representee upcoming appointments the information of his or her designated HCP and the number of unread messages from his or her message inbox number of new referrals (UC33) and number of unviewed completed lab procedures (UC26).
requirement_text_raw: The notification center also displays a list of the patient and patient representee upcoming appointments   the information of his or her designated HCP   and the number of unread messages from his or her message inbox   number of new referrals (UC33)  and number of unviewed completed lab procedures (UC26).
user_story: As a patient, I want a notification center that lists my upcoming appointments, my designated HCP's information, my unread messages, my new referrals and my unviewed completed lab procedures, so that I see what needs attention.
technical_task: Extend the notification center with the upcoming appointments, the designated HCP's information, the number of unread messages, the number of new referrals (UC33) and the number of unviewed completed lab procedures (UC26).
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient or patient representee, when the notification center is opened, then upcoming appointments and the information of the designated HCP are shown.
Given the notification center, when it is opened, then the number of unread messages, the number of new referrals and the number of unviewed completed lab procedures are shown.
rationale: Role stated: patient or patient representee.

requirement_text: The solution should restrict validation of orders to authorized personnel only.
user_story: As a pharmacy manager, I want validation of orders restricted to authorized personnel, so that orders are checked by qualified people.
technical_task: Allow only authorized personnel to validate orders.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized person, when the person validates an order, then the validation is recorded.
Given a person who is not authorized, when the person tries to validate an order, then it is refused.

requirement_text: User shall post intelligence items with required spatial index and optional meta-data.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to post intelligence items with a required spatial index and optional meta-data, so that others can find them by location.
technical_task: Offer a posting form for intelligence items with a required spatial index and optional meta-data.
acceptance_criteria: Given an intelligence item with a spatial index, when the user posts it, then it is saved.
Given an intelligence item without a spatial index, when the user posts it, then it is not saved.
rationale: Role assumed: traveler. The second criterion follows from "required spatial index".

requirement_text: The system shall be able to scale to accommodate an increasing number of users and forms.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the system to scale as the number of users and forms grows, so that it keeps working.
technical_task: Design the system so capacity can grow with the number of users and forms.
acceptance_criteria: Given an increasing number of users, when the load grows, then the system accommodates them.
Given an increasing number of forms, when the amount grows, then the system accommodates them.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. No target numbers are given.

requirement_text: User shall enjoy maximal security measures implemented in the application to prevent unauthorized access.
rationale: "Maximal security measures" are not specific or measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "maximal security measures" mean in testable terms?
Which unauthorized access scenarios must be prevented?

requirement_text: Delivery boy shall be able to start the shift.
user_story: As a delivery boy, I want to start my shift, so that I can begin receiving orders.
technical_task: Provide a start shift function for delivery staff.
acceptance_criteria: Given a delivery boy who is not on shift, when the delivery boy starts the shift, then the shift is started.
Given a shift has started, when the delivery boy views the status, then it shows that the shift is active.

requirement_text: User shall experience quick and seamless authentication processes facilitated by the application.
clarification_questions: What authentication time counts as "quick"?
What makes authentication "seamless"?

requirement_text: The system shall provide three forms of logging: registration for new users, login for existing users, and restricted login for anonymous users.
user_story: As a visitor, I want three ways to log in: registration for new users, login for existing users and restricted login for anonymous users, so that I can use the system in the way that fits me.
technical_task: Provide three forms of logging in: registration for new users, login for existing users and a restricted login for anonymous users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when the user registers, then an account is created.
Given an existing user, when the user logs in, then the user gets access, and given an anonymous user, when the user uses restricted login, then the user gets restricted access.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. What the restriction for anonymous users is not described.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to change the tempo of the music within a score.
user_story: As a musician, I want to change the tempo of the music in a score, so that I can play it faster or slower.
technical_task: Add a tempo setting to a score.
acceptance_criteria: Given a score, when the user changes the tempo, then the music plays at the new tempo.
Given a changed tempo, when the score is reopened, then the new tempo is kept.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability for a user to validate a mapping.
user_story: As a data steward, I want to validate a mapping, so that I know it is correct.
technical_task: Provide a function for a user to validate a mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mapping, when the user validates it, then the result of the validation is shown.
Given a mapping with an error, when the user validates it, then the error is reported.
rationale: Role assumed: data steward. The validation rules are not specified.

requirement_text: System shall offer integration with other Google services such as Google Drive, Google Calendar, and Google Contacts for enhanced productivity.
user_story: As a user, I want integration with Google Drive, Google Calendar and Google Contacts, so that I can use my Google data here.
technical_task: Integrate the system with Google services such as Google Drive, Google Calendar and Google Contacts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Google account, when the user links Google Drive, Google Calendar or Google Contacts, then the data from that service is available.
Given the integration, when the user changes data in one service, then it is reflected where the system uses it.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means other Google services may be included; "productivity" is not measured.

requirement_text: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(a)(1) unless the Secretary determines that the use of such algorithm would pose a significant security risk for Certified EHR Technology.
requirement_text_raw: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(a)(1)  unless the Secretary determines that the use of such algorithm would pose a significant security risk for Certified EHR Technology.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want electronic health information encrypted and decrypted per the standard in 170.210(a)(1), unless the Secretary finds the algorithm a significant security risk, so that data is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information according to the standard specified in 170.210(a)(1), except where the Secretary determines the algorithm poses a significant security risk for Certified EHR Technology.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information, when it is exchanged, then it is encrypted and decrypted in accordance with the standard specified in 170.210(a)(1).
Given the Secretary determines that the algorithm poses a significant security risk for Certified EHR Technology, when it is exchanged, then the standard is not required.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The standard is only referenced; the section symbol in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: User shall be allowed up to three login attempts before the card is blocked.
user_story: As a card holder, I want up to three login attempts before my card is blocked, so that guessing is limited.
technical_task: Block the card after three failed login attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a card holder with fewer than three failed attempts, when the card holder tries to log in, then the attempt is processed.
Given three failed login attempts, when the card holder tries again, then the card is blocked.

requirement_text: System shall offer scalability to accommodate varying project sizes and complexities.
user_story: As a project lead, I want the system to scale for varying project sizes and complexities, so that it suits small and large projects.
technical_task: Build the system so it works for projects of different sizes and complexities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a small project, when the system is used, then it works.
Given a large and complex project, when the system is used, then it works.
rationale: Role assumed: project lead. Sizes are not quantified.

requirement_text: The platform shall allow translation of data type hierarchies for embedded viewers.
user_story: As a viewer user, I want data type hierarchies translated for embedded viewers, so that viewers can show them.
technical_task: Support translating data type hierarchies into a form that embedded viewers can use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data type hierarchy, when it is translated for an embedded viewer, then the viewer can use it.
Given an embedded viewer, when the translated hierarchy is loaded, then it is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user of embedded viewers.

requirement_text: The trigger value is used in combination with the current temperature to determine when a heating or cooling unit shall be turned on or off.
rationale: The sentence describes how a value is used without a concrete required behaviour or value.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a definition of the trigger value?
What must the system do with the trigger value and the current temperature?

requirement_text: A sale transaction authorizes and settles the requested amount against the indicated payment method.
user_story: As a merchant, I want a sale transaction to authorize and settle the requested amount against the indicated payment method, so that I get paid.
technical_task: Authorize and settle the requested amount against the payment method named in a sale transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sale transaction with a payment method and an amount, when it is processed, then the amount is authorized against the payment method.
Given an authorized sale transaction, when it completes, then the requested amount is settled against the payment method.

requirement_text: The Provider - Pharmacy Communication capability should provide non-repudiation requirements (IN 1.5) that guarantees that the sources and receivers of data cannot deny that they entered or sent or received the data.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want the Provider - Pharmacy Communication capability to provide non-repudiation (IN 1.5), so that nobody can deny entering, sending or receiving data.
technical_task: Provide non-repudiation (IN 1.5) in the Provider - Pharmacy Communication capability for data that is entered, sent or received.
acceptance_criteria: Given data is entered or sent, when the action completes, then a record shows the source cannot deny it.
Given data is received, when the receipt completes, then a record shows the receiver cannot deny it.

requirement_text: The system shall recommend content based on user profiles, news events, and image/video similarity.
user_story: As a reader, I want content recommended from my profile, news events and image or video similarity, so that I find things I like.
technical_task: Recommend content using user profiles, news events and image/video similarity.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user profile, when recommendations are made, then they take the profile into account.
Given news events and similar images or videos, when recommendations are made, then they take news events and image/video similarity into account.

requirement_text: A content editor shall be able to easily find content to edit.
clarification_questions: How quickly or in how many steps must a content editor find content?
What search or navigation is meant?

requirement_text: An HCP chooses to document or edit an office visit.
requirement_text_raw: An HCP chooses to document  or edit  an office visit.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to document or edit an office visit, so that the visit record is complete.
technical_task: Provide a screen to document a new office visit or edit an existing one.
acceptance_criteria: Given an office visit, when the HCP documents it, then the documentation is saved.
Given an existing office visit, when the HCP edits it, then the changes are saved.

requirement_text: User shall have a cancellation deadline tied to registration/cancellation workflow, to avoid financial loss.
user_story: As a participant, I want a cancellation deadline in the registration and cancellation workflow, so that I avoid a financial loss.
technical_task: Add a cancellation deadline to the registration and cancellation workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registration, when the cancellation deadline has not passed, then the user can cancel.
Given a registration, when the cancellation deadline has passed, then the user cannot cancel.
rationale: Role assumed: participant. The second criterion is an interpretation of "deadline".

requirement_text: A transmit packet queue and a receive packet queue shall be maintained for each task or Communication ID (CID).
requirement_text_raw: A transmit packet queue and a receive packet queue shall (3.3.6.7) be maintained for each task or Communication ID (CID).
user_story: As a software developer, I want a transmit packet queue and a receive packet queue for each task or Communication ID (CID), so that packets are handled per task.
technical_task: Maintain one transmit packet queue and one receive packet queue for every task or Communication ID (CID).
acceptance_criteria: Given a task or Communication ID (CID), when it is set up, then a transmit packet queue is maintained for it.
Given a task or Communication ID (CID), when it is set up, then a receive packet queue is maintained for it.

requirement_text: The patient or representative views his or her message inbox.
user_story: As a patient, I want to view my message inbox, so that I can read my messages.
technical_task: Display the message inbox to a patient or representative.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient or representative with messages, when the user opens the inbox, then the messages are shown.
Given no messages, when the user opens the inbox, then it is empty.

requirement_text: User shall be able to upload videos to their channel.
user_story: As a creator, I want to upload videos to my channel, so that viewers can watch them.
technical_task: Add a video upload to the user's channel.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video file, when the user uploads it to the channel, then the video is saved on the channel.
Given an uploaded video, when the channel is viewed, then the video is listed.

requirement_text: When access to a chart is restricted the system shall provide a means for appropriately authorized users to "break the glass" for emergency situations.
requirement_text_raw: When access to a chart is restricted  the system shall provide a means for appropriately authorized users to "break the glass" for emergency situations.
user_story: As an emergency clinician, I want to break the glass on a restricted chart in an emergency, so that I can reach the information I need.
technical_task: Provide a break-the-glass function for appropriately authorized users to open restricted charts in emergencies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a restricted chart and an emergency, when an appropriately authorized user breaks the glass, then access to the chart is granted.
Given a restricted chart, when a user who is not appropriately authorized tries to break the glass, then access is not granted.

requirement_text: The system shall display search results, filtered content, and sorted content accordingly.
user_story: As a user, I want search results, filtered content and sorted content displayed according to my choices, so that I see what I asked for.
technical_task: Display results according to the search, filter and sort selections.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search, when the user submits it, then the search results are displayed.
Given a filter or a sort order, when the user selects it, then the content is displayed filtered or sorted accordingly.

requirement_text: System shall reassure funding bodies of robust archival plans for funded research data to justify investments.
rationale: "Reassure" and "robust" are not measurable and the system behaviour is unclear.
clarification_questions: How must the system reassure funding bodies, and what are "robust archival plans"?
Is this a requirement for the system or for the project?

requirement_text: All math/science application software shall take optimal advantage of all language, compiler, and system computational features and resources to reduce run times to the minimum practical level.
clarification_questions: What counts as "optimal advantage" and the "minimum practical level" of run times?
Which math/science application software is meant?

requirement_text: This test verifies the OBC 's immunity to short circuits in the 12 V vehicle electrical system where it is feasible that a short circuit can occur in the wiring or at the OBC lines.
user_story: As a test engineer, I want a test that verifies the OBC's immunity to short circuits in the 12 V vehicle electrical system, so that the OBC survives wiring faults.
technical_task: Define a test that checks the OBC's immunity to short circuits in the wiring or at the OBC lines of the 12 V vehicle electrical system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a short circuit in the 12 V vehicle electrical system wiring, when the test is run, then the OBC's immunity to it is verified.
Given a short circuit at the OBC lines, when the test is run, then the OBC's immunity to it is verified.

requirement_text: System shall have self-monitoring to detect faults periodically.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the system to monitor itself for faults periodically, so that problems are found early.
technical_task: Add a periodic self-monitoring check that detects faults.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is running, when the self-monitoring period elapses, then a check for faults is performed.
Given a fault in the system, when the check runs, then the fault is detected.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The period is not stated.

requirement_text: The FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system shall utilize no more than 9 Megabytes of DRAM code and data space.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system shall [SRS258] utilize no more than 9 Megabytes of DRAM code and data space.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system to use no more than 9 Megabytes of DRAM code and data space, so that memory remains for applications.
technical_task: Limit the combined DRAM code and data space of the FTSS software and VxWorks to 9 Megabytes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system, when their DRAM code and data space is measured, then it is no more than 9 Megabytes.
Given a measured use above 9 Megabytes, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to process appeals to track outcomes and record impacts.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to process appeals, track outcomes and record impacts, so that appeal results are documented.
technical_task: Provide appeal processing with outcome tracking and impact recording.
acceptance_criteria: Given an appeal, when staff process it, then the processing is saved.
Given a processed appeal, when staff open it, then its outcome and recorded impacts are shown.

requirement_text: User shall access the e-store in multiple languages for enhanced accessibility.
user_story: As a customer, I want to use the e-store in multiple languages, so that I can shop in my language.
technical_task: Provide the e-store in several languages.
acceptance_criteria: Given the e-store, when the user selects a language, then the e-store is displayed in it.
Given the supported languages, when the user opens the language options, then more than one language is offered.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The languages are not listed.

requirement_text: The system shall provide the ability to capture the identity of the prescribing provider for all medication orders.
user_story: As a prescriber, I want the identity of the prescribing provider captured for all medication orders, so that orders can be attributed.
technical_task: Record the prescribing provider's identity on every medication order.
acceptance_criteria: Given a medication order, when it is created, then the identity of the prescribing provider is captured.
Given a saved medication order, when it is viewed, then the prescribing provider is shown.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to use secure realtime messaging.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to use secure realtime messaging, so that I can exchange information safely.
technical_task: Provide realtime messaging that is secured.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users, when one sends a realtime message, then the other receives it in real time.
Given a realtime message, when it is sent, then it is protected in transit.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The security mechanism is not specified.

requirement_text: Continuous BIT shall diagnose the faulty FCR within 1 second after detecting a failure.
requirement_text_raw: Continuous BIT shall [SRS096] diagnose the faulty FCR within 1 second after detecting a failure.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Continuous BIT to diagnose the faulty FCR within 1 second after detecting a failure, so that faults are located quickly.
technical_task: Diagnose the faulty FCR within 1 second of Continuous BIT detecting a failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given Continuous BIT detects a failure, when 1 second has elapsed, then the faulty FCR has been diagnosed.
Given a diagnosis that takes longer than 1 second after detection, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: User shall deploy a dataset type independent from any app and allow apps to create and use dataset instances of that type.
user_story: As an app developer, I want to deploy a dataset type independently of any app and let apps create and use instances of it, so that datasets are reusable.
technical_task: Support deploying a dataset type on its own and allow apps to create and use dataset instances of that type.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset type deployed independently from any app, when an app creates a dataset instance of that type, then the instance is created.
Given a dataset instance of that type, when an app uses it, then the app can read and write it.
rationale: Role assumed: app developer; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: Vendor may self-certify compliance with this standard through procedures that make use of commercial malware scanning software.
user_story: As a vendor, I want to self-certify compliance with this standard using commercial malware scanning software, so that certification is practical.
technical_task: Allow vendor self-certification of compliance using procedures that rely on commercial malware scanning software.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vendor, when the vendor runs commercial malware scanning software as part of the procedures, then compliance can be self-certified.
Given a vendor that does not run the procedures, when the vendor claims compliance, then self-certification is not accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: vendor. "May" makes self-certification optional.

requirement_text: The system should avoid becoming overloaded and should maintain optimal performance even under peak load conditions.
clarification_questions: What load counts as "overloaded" and what is "optimal performance"?
What response time and capacity apply at peak?

requirement_text: The system shall leverage a Content Delivery Network (CDN) (e.g., AWS Cloudfront or Akamai CDN) to deliver videos with low latency.
user_story: As a viewer, I want videos delivered through a Content Delivery Network with low latency, so that playback starts quickly.
technical_task: Deliver videos through a Content Delivery Network, for example AWS Cloudfront or Akamai CDN.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video request, when it is served, then it is delivered through a Content Delivery Network.
Given the delivery setup, when it is reviewed, then a CDN such as AWS Cloudfront or Akamai CDN is used.
rationale: Role assumed: viewer. "Low latency" is not quantified.

requirement_text: System shall encrypt sensitive data to prevent unauthorized access.
user_story: As a user, I want sensitive data encrypted, so that unauthorized people cannot read it.
technical_task: Encrypt sensitive data.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given encrypted sensitive data, when an unauthorized person reads it, then it cannot be understood.

requirement_text: He or she is presented with a list of the patients for which he or she is allowed to report measurements.
user_story: As a health worker, I want a list of the patients for whom I may report measurements, so that I report only for my patients.
technical_task: Show a list of the patients for which the user is allowed to report measurements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user allowed to report measurements for certain patients, when the user opens the list, then those patients are shown.
Given a patient the user is not allowed to report for, when the user opens the list, then that patient is not shown.

requirement_text: Message passing communications primitives shall be provided for task-to-task communication as well as for broadcast to all processors.
requirement_text_raw: Message passing communications primitives shall (3.3.6.9) be provided for task-to-task communication as well as for broadcast to all processors.
user_story: As a software developer, I want message passing primitives for task-to-task communication and for broadcast to all processors, so that tasks can talk to each other.
technical_task: Provide message passing communication primitives for task-to-task messages and for broadcast to all processors.
acceptance_criteria: Given two tasks, when one sends a message with the primitive, then the other task receives it.
Given a broadcast, when a message is sent with the broadcast primitive, then all processors receive it.

requirement_text: System shall be compatible with Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome, and Safari browsers.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to work with Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome and Safari, so that I can use my usual browser.
technical_task: Support Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome and Safari.
acceptance_criteria: Given Internet Explorer or Mozilla Firefox, when the user opens the system, then it works.
Given Google Chrome or Safari, when the user opens the system, then it works.

requirement_text: System shall provide user activity reports.
user_story: As an administrator, I want user activity reports, so that I can see how the system is used.
technical_task: Generate reports on user activity.
acceptance_criteria: Given recorded user activity, when the administrator requests a report, then the user activity report is generated.
Given the report, when it is opened, then it shows user activity.

requirement_text: System shall restrict local access and maintenance of database servers to authorized IT team members only.
user_story: As an IT manager, I want local access to and maintenance of database servers limited to authorized IT team members, so that servers are protected.
technical_task: Restrict local access and maintenance of the database servers to authorized IT team members.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized IT team member, when the member accesses or maintains a database server locally, then it is allowed.
Given a person who is not an authorized IT team member, when the person tries local access, then it is denied.

requirement_text: The user (LHCP) selects a patient from the list of requested reports.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to select a patient from the list of requested reports, so that I can open that patient's report.
technical_task: Let the LHCP choose a patient from the list of requested reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list of requested reports, when the LHCP selects a patient, then that patient's report is opened.
Given the list, when it is displayed, then it contains the patients for whom reports were requested.

requirement_text: The system shall allow curators to create, manage, and map collections.
user_story: As a curator, I want to create, manage and map collections, so that collections are organized and linked.
technical_task: Provide functions for curators to create, manage and map collections.
acceptance_criteria: Given a curator, when the curator creates a collection, then it is saved.
Given an existing collection, when the curator manages or maps it, then the change is saved.
rationale: Role stated: curator. What mapping connects is not stated.

requirement_text: When a button becomes active, it will use animation to get the user's attention.
user_story: As a user, I want a button that becomes active to use animation, so that I notice it.
technical_task: Animate a button when it becomes active.
acceptance_criteria: Given a button that becomes active, when it activates, then an animation is shown on it.
Given a button that is inactive, when it is displayed, then no activation animation is shown.

requirement_text: The timer DDPTimerReset is expired if it runs longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the timer DDPTimerReset to expire when it runs longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset, so that resets are timed.
technical_task: Mark the timer DDPTimerReset as expired when it has run longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset.
acceptance_criteria: Given DDPTimerReset has run longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset, when it is evaluated, then it is expired.
Given DDPTimerReset has not run longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset, when it is evaluated, then it is not expired.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to view their list of classes.
user_story: As a student, I want to view my list of classes, so that I know what I am taking.
technical_task: Show each user their list of classes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with classes, when the user opens the list, then the user's classes are shown.
Given a user with no classes, when the user opens the list, then it is empty.

requirement_text: Select the appropriate encounter from the list on the right to highlight it.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to select an encounter from the list on the right to highlight it, so that I can see which one is chosen.
technical_task: Highlight the encounter the user selects from the list on the right.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of encounters on the right, when the user selects one, then it is highlighted.
Given a highlighted encounter, when the user selects another, then the new one is highlighted instead.

requirement_text: The system shall minimize vertical scrolling by prioritizing top placement of important information and utilize links for less crucial details, and avoid horizontal scrolling altogether.
clarification_questions: What counts as "important" and "less crucial" information?
How much scrolling is acceptable, in screens or pixels?

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall use no more than 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move the telemetry data to the MPCC/CTC board and complete communication and error handling for the MPCC/CTC board.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall (3.4.2.10) use no more than 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move the telemetry data to the MPCC/CTC board and complete communication and error handling for the MPCC/CTC board.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software to use at most 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move telemetry data to the MPCC/CTC board and handle communication and errors, so that FCP time is bounded.
technical_task: Limit FTSS use of FCP processing time to 5.2 milliseconds for moving telemetry data to the MPCC/CTC board and completing communication and error handling for it.
acceptance_criteria: Given telemetry data is moved to the MPCC/CTC board, when the FCP processing time of the FTSS software is measured, then it is no more than 5.2 milliseconds.
Given communication and error handling for the MPCC/CTC board, when they are included in the measurement, then the total is still no more than 5.2 milliseconds.

requirement_text: The system shall allow archivists to search images by various criteria.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to search images by various criteria, so that I can find them.
technical_task: Offer image search using several criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given images, when the archivist searches by a criterion, then matching images are listed.
Given several criteria, when the archivist uses them, then the results match them.
rationale: Role stated: archivist. The criteria are not listed.

requirement_text: A patient views a list of his or her referrals.
user_story: As a patient, I want to view a list of my referrals, so that I know where I was sent.
technical_task: Show the patient's referrals in a list.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with referrals, when the patient opens the list, then the referrals are shown.
Given a patient with no referrals, when the patient opens the list, then it is empty.

requirement_text: The system shall allow parents to sign and submit consent forms electronically.
user_story: As a parent, I want to sign and submit consent forms electronically, so that I don't need paper.
technical_task: Provide electronic signing and submission of consent forms.
acceptance_criteria: Given a consent form, when the parent signs it electronically, then the signature is recorded.
Given a signed consent form, when the parent submits it, then it is submitted.

requirement_text: The user interface shall adhere to responsive design principles to ensure optimal viewing and interaction experience across various devices and screen sizes.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface to adapt to various devices and screen sizes, so that it displays well wherever I use it.
technical_task: Apply responsive design principles so the interface adapts to different devices and screen sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Given different screen sizes, when the interface is displayed, then the layout adapts to each.
Given different devices, when the user interacts with the interface, then interaction is possible on each.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Optimal" experience is not measured.

requirement_text: System shall be able to allow customers to apply for loans and check their application status.
user_story: As a customer, I want to apply for loans and check my application status, so that I can follow my application.
technical_task: Provide loan application and application status checking.
acceptance_criteria: Given the loan application form, when the customer submits an application, then it is saved.
Given a submitted application, when the customer checks the status, then the current status is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall support secure communication through message encryption and decryption techniques.
user_story: As a user, I want secure communication through message encryption and decryption, so that my messages stay private.
technical_task: Encrypt outgoing messages and decrypt incoming messages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message to send, when it is sent, then it is encrypted.
Given an encrypted message received, when it arrives, then it is decrypted for the recipient.

requirement_text: The LMS shall support 500 patrons and handle 1000 requests per minute simultaneously.
user_story: As a librarian, I want the LMS to support 500 patrons and handle 1000 requests per minute simultaneously, so that the library can serve its patrons.
technical_task: Size the LMS for 500 patrons and 1000 requests per minute at the same time.
acceptance_criteria: Given 500 patrons, when they use the LMS, then it supports them.
Given 1000 requests per minute, when they arrive at the same time as the 500 patrons, then the LMS handles them.

requirement_text: The patient or personal health representative clicks an appointment to view more details.
user_story: As a patient, I want to click an appointment to see more details, so that I know what it is about.
technical_task: Make appointments clickable to open their details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of appointments, when the patient or personal health representative clicks one, then more details are shown.
Given two appointments, when each is clicked, then each shows its own details.
rationale: Role stated: patient or personal health representative.

requirement_text: Here, especially the division of the smallest replaceable unit (module or individual cell) into categories of different installable remaining life classes shall be taken into account.
rationale: The sentence refers to context that is not given and defines no clear behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the design do with the categories of installable remaining life classes?
What does "here" refer to, and what are the classes?

requirement_text: The user will be able to end the game at any stage of the game.
user_story: As a player, I want to end the game at any stage, so that I can stop whenever I like.
technical_task: Offer an end-game control that works at every stage of the game.
acceptance_criteria: Given a game at any stage, when the user ends it, then the game ends.
Given the game has ended, when the user looks at the screen, then the game is no longer in progress.

requirement_text: If the user forgets their account information, they shall be able to retrieve it via the "forgot your password?" panel.
user_story: As a user who forgot my account information, I want to retrieve it through the forgot your password panel, so that I can sign in again.
technical_task: Add a "forgot your password?" panel for retrieving account information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the "forgot your password?" panel, when the user provides the required information, then the account information can be retrieved.
Given the login screen, when it is displayed, then the "forgot your password?" panel can be reached.
rationale: Role assumed: user who forgot the account information.

requirement_text: System shall present the employee homepage for inputting duty slip information, calculating net bills, and updating car status and customer database.
user_story: As an employee, I want an employee homepage to input duty slip information, calculate net bills and update car status and the customer database, so that I can do my work from one page.
technical_task: Build an employee homepage with functions for duty slip entry, net bill calculation, car status updates and customer database updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given the employee homepage, when an employee enters duty slip information, then it is saved.
Given the employee homepage, when an employee calculates net bills or updates car status and the customer database, then the results are saved.

requirement_text: The Mission Elapsed Time shall be initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame.
requirement_text_raw: The Mission Elapsed Time shall [SRS165] be initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Mission Elapsed Time initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame, so that elapsed time starts from zero.
technical_task: Set the Mission Elapsed Time to zero when the first 50 Hz frame occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the first 50 Hz frame, when it occurs, then the Mission Elapsed Time is zero.
Given later 50 Hz frames, when they occur, then initialization to zero is not repeated.

requirement_text: The system shall offer automation tools and workflows to streamline tasks, engage leads, and nurture customer relationships.
rationale: "Streamline tasks", "engage leads" and "nurture relationships" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: Which automation tools and workflows are required?
How is "engaging leads" or "nurturing relationships" measured?

requirement_text: User shall search for articles on the Online Journal Website by author name, category, or keyword.
user_story: As a reader, I want to search articles on the Online Journal Website by author name, category or keyword, so that I find relevant articles.
technical_task: Add an article search by author name, category and keyword.
acceptance_criteria: Given an author name, when the user searches, then articles by that author are shown.
Given a category or a keyword, when the user searches, then matching articles are shown.

requirement_text: System shall prioritize performance and scalability in managing large datasets and complex record structures.
rationale: "Prioritize performance and scalability" has no measurable target.
clarification_questions: What performance and scalability targets apply to large datasets and complex records?
What size is "large"?

requirement_text: For example selecting "Detailed" from the 'Established Patient' drop-down adds the associated CPT code to the list.
requirement_text_raw: For example  selecting "Detailed" from the 'Established Patient' drop-down adds the associated CPT code to the list.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want selecting Detailed from the Established Patient drop-down to add the associated CPT code to the list, so that the right code is billed.
technical_task: Add the CPT code linked to a selected option, such as Detailed in the Established Patient drop-down, to the list.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Established Patient drop-down, when the user selects Detailed, then the associated CPT code is added to the list.
Given another option in the drop-down, when the user selects it, then its associated CPT code is added to the list.
rationale: Role assumed: billing clerk. "For example" means other options behave alike.

requirement_text: CNG shall support mechanisms allowing the CNDs remote management when applicable.
user_story: As a network operator, I want the CNG to support mechanisms for remote management of the CNDs where applicable, so that I can manage devices remotely.
technical_task: Support remote management mechanisms in the CNG for the CNDs when remote management applies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a CND for which remote management applies, when the operator manages it remotely, then the CNG supports the management.
Given a CND for which remote management does not apply, when the operator tries to manage it remotely, then the CNG does not need to support it.

requirement_text: Patients can also be billed and their payments recorded.
requirement_text_raw: Patients can also be billed  and their payments recorded.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to bill patients and record their payments, so that accounts are accurate.
technical_task: Provide billing of patients and recording of their payments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with a charge, when the clerk bills the patient, then the bill is created.
Given a bill, when the patient pays, then the payment is recorded.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall provide an API call to retrieve the current minor frame number sent from the FCP over the VME interface. Note that the NEFU ICP will not have this information since it does not have an FCP processor.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS231] provide an API call to retrieve the current minor frame number sent from the FCP over the VME interface.  Note that the NEFU ICP will not have this information since it does not have an FCP processor.
user_story: As an application developer, I want an FTSS API call to get the current minor frame number sent from the FCP over the VME interface, so that my application knows the frame.
technical_task: Provide an FTSS API call that returns the current minor frame number sent from the FCP over the VME interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP sends the minor frame number over the VME interface, when an application calls the API, then the current minor frame number is returned.
Given the NEFU ICP, when the API is called, then the minor frame number is not available because it has no FCP processor.

requirement_text: If an assistant is used to enter data that will subsequently be signed by a provider retain the date or time or use stamp of the data entry person as well as the provider.
requirement_text_raw: If an assistant is used to enter data that will subsequently be signed by a provider  retain the date or time or use stamp of the data entry person as well as the provider.
user_story: As an auditor, I want the date, time or user stamp of the data entry person kept as well as the provider's when an assistant enters data that a provider signs, so that both are traceable.
technical_task: Retain the date, time or user stamp of both the data entry person and the provider when an assistant enters data that is later signed by a provider.
acceptance_criteria: Given an assistant enters data that will be signed by a provider, when it is saved, then the stamp of the data entry person is retained.
Given the provider signs the data, when it is signed, then the stamp of the provider is retained as well.

requirement_text: The system shall prompt users to take breaks based on predefined settings or usage patterns.
user_story: As a user, I want prompts to take breaks based on predefined settings or usage patterns, so that I don't overuse the app.
technical_task: Prompt users to take breaks according to predefined settings or usage patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a predefined break setting, when its condition is met, then the user is prompted to take a break.
Given a usage pattern that calls for a break, when it is detected, then the user is prompted to take a break.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The settings are not described.

requirement_text: The EHR System will need to be able to track the changes as well as accommodate moving visit information (e.g. an account) from one medical record to another with associated audit trails.
requirement_text_raw: The EHR System will need to be able to track the changes as well as accommodate moving visit information (e.g.  an account) from one medical record to another with associated audit trails.
user_story: As a records manager, I want the EHR System to track changes and allow moving visit information from one medical record to another with audit trails, so that moves are traceable.
technical_task: Track changes to records and support moving visit information (for example an account) between medical records, with associated audit trails.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change to a record, when it is made, then the change is tracked.
Given visit information in one medical record, when it is moved to another, then an associated audit trail records the move.

requirement_text: Administration interfaces require strong authentication and authorization.
user_story: As a security officer, I want administration interfaces to require strong authentication and authorization, so that only legitimate administrators can use them.
technical_task: Require strong authentication and authorization for every administration interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administration interface, when a user opens it, then strong authentication and authorization are required.
Given a user who fails authentication or authorization, when the user opens an administration interface, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. "Strong" is not defined.

requirement_text: The system shall allow faculty to upload course materials (syllabus, lesson plans, notes, etc.) and question banks.
user_story: As a faculty member, I want to upload course materials, such as syllabus, lesson plans and notes, and question banks, so that students can use them.
technical_task: Provide upload of course materials and question banks for faculty.
acceptance_criteria: Given a faculty member, when the faculty member uploads a course material, then it is saved.
Given a faculty member, when the faculty member uploads a question bank, then it is saved.
rationale: Role stated: faculty. "Etc." means other material types may exist.

requirement_text: The system shall give the mediator privileges to schedule location and equipment resources.
user_story: As a mediator, I want privileges to schedule location and equipment resources, so that I can arrange meetings.
technical_task: Give the mediator the privilege to schedule location and equipment resources.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mediator, when the mediator schedules a location or equipment resource, then the booking is saved.
Given a user who is not a mediator, when the user tries to schedule these resources, then it is refused.
rationale: Role stated: mediator. The second criterion follows from "privileges".

requirement_text: Synchronous message passing sockets shall queue outgoing messages until they are transmitted at frame boundaries. The "create" and "open" API calls for synchronous sockets allow the application to specify the maximum message size and how many incoming messages the socket may buffer.
requirement_text_raw: 1.     Synchronous message passing sockets shall [SRS055] queue outgoing messages until they are transmitted at frame boundaries. The "create" and "open" API calls for synchronous sockets allow the application to specify the maximum message size and how many incoming messages the socket may buffer.
user_story: As an application developer, I want synchronous sockets to queue outgoing messages until frame boundaries, with create and open calls that set the maximum message size and incoming buffer count, so that messages are handled predictably.
technical_task: Queue outgoing messages on synchronous message passing sockets until they are transmitted at frame boundaries, and let the create and open API calls set the maximum message size and the number of incoming messages the socket may buffer.
acceptance_criteria: Given an outgoing message on a synchronous socket, when it is sent, then it is queued until it is transmitted at a frame boundary.
Given the create or open API call for a synchronous socket, when the application calls it, then it can specify the maximum message size and how many incoming messages the socket may buffer.

requirement_text: Cookies with sensitive data (e.g. authentication cookies) are encrypted.
user_story: As a security officer, I want cookies with sensitive data, such as authentication cookies, encrypted, so that they cannot be read.
technical_task: Encrypt every cookie that holds sensitive data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cookie with sensitive data, when it is created, then it is encrypted.
Given an authentication cookie, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.

requirement_text: The system shall allow the mediator to negotiate a location / equipment.
user_story: As a mediator, I want to negotiate a location or equipment, so that resources are agreed.
technical_task: Support negotiation of a location or equipment by the mediator.
acceptance_criteria: Given a location or equipment resource, when the mediator negotiates it, then the negotiation is recorded.
Given a negotiated resource, when the mediator concludes, then the outcome is saved.
rationale: Role stated: mediator. How negotiation works is not described.

requirement_text: The re-align function shall write the voted value from the good channels into the target channel.
requirement_text_raw: The re-align function shall (3.3.8.12) write the voted value from the good channels into the target channel.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the re-align function to write the voted value from the good channels into the target channel, so that the target matches the good channels.
technical_task: Have the re-align function copy the voted value of the good channels into the target channel.
acceptance_criteria: Given good channels and a target channel, when the re-align function runs, then the voted value from the good channels is written into the target channel.
Given the re-align function has run, when the target channel is read, then it holds the voted value.

requirement_text: The system performance shall be responsive for uploading, searching, and downloading files.
clarification_questions: What response times count as "responsive" for uploading, searching and downloading files?
What file sizes apply?

requirement_text: User shall have access to continuous performance monitoring and profiling to identify and address performance bottlenecks proactively, ensuring optimal system efficiency.
user_story: As an administrator, I want continuous performance monitoring and profiling, so that I can find and fix performance bottlenecks early.
technical_task: Run continuous performance monitoring and profiling that identifies performance bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is running, when performance is monitored, then it is monitored continuously.
Given a performance bottleneck, when profiling runs, then the bottleneck is identified.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Optimal efficiency" is not measured.

requirement_text: The ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry data shall be stored on a local SwRI archive.
user_story: As a mission scientist, I want the ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry data stored on a local SwRI archive, so that it is kept at SwRI.
technical_task: Store the ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry data in a local SwRI archive.
acceptance_criteria: Given ASPERA-3 telemetry data, when it is stored, then it is stored on the local SwRI archive.
Given MEX OA telemetry data, when it is stored, then it is stored on the local SwRI archive.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to handle 1000 customers logged in concurrently at the same time.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the system to handle 1000 customers logged in at the same time, so that peak usage is covered.
technical_task: Support 1000 simultaneous logged-in customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given 1000 customers logged in at the same time, when they use the system, then it handles them.
Given fewer customers logged in, when they use the system, then it handles them.

requirement_text: User shall access the discussion forum section.
user_story: As a user, I want to access the discussion forum section, so that I can read and join discussions.
technical_task: Provide access to a discussion forum section.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user opens the discussion forum section, then it is displayed.
Given the discussion forum section, when the user views it, then the discussions are listed.

requirement_text: System shall design components with simplicity to avoid complexity, thereby enhancing overall performance.
rationale: "Simplicity" and "enhancing overall performance" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "simplicity" and "complexity" mean in measurable terms for components?
What performance improvement is expected?

requirement_text: From the time that the NE failure has been identified, and the NE is recoverable, to the time the NE is recovered shall be no more than 1.5 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: From the time that the NE failure has been identified, and the NE is recoverable, to the time the NE is recovered shall (3.1.11) be no more than 1.5 minutes.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a recoverable failed NE recovered within 1.5 minutes of its failure being identified, so that capacity returns quickly.
technical_task: Complete recovery of a recoverable NE within 1.5 minutes of identifying its failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE failure has been identified and the NE is recoverable, when recovery runs, then the NE is recovered within 1.5 minutes.
Given a recovery that takes longer than 1.5 minutes, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: System shall maintain uptime as per defined expectations and handle errors effectively.
rationale: The uptime expectations are not given and "effectively" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What are the "defined expectations" for uptime?
What makes error handling "effective"?

requirement_text: The system shall present information on the screen in a user-friendly way using short sentences, clear sections, and bullet points for easy reading and understanding.
user_story: As a user, I want information shown with short sentences, clear sections and bullet points, so that it is easy to read and understand.
technical_task: Format on-screen information with short sentences, clearly separated sections and bullet points.
acceptance_criteria: Given information displayed on a screen, when it is presented, then it uses short sentences.
Given information displayed on a screen, when it is presented, then it is divided into clear sections and uses bullet points where lists occur.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Short" is not quantified.

requirement_text: The MET shall measure real-time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM).
requirement_text_raw: The MET shall (3.3.10.6) measure real-time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the MET to measure real time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM), so that timing is precise.
technical_task: Measure real time from the event in the MET with an error of no more than 50 PPM.
acceptance_criteria: Given the event has occurred, when the MET measures real time from it, then the accuracy is at most 50 PPM.
Given a measured error above 50 PPM, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "This event" is not identified in the sentence.

requirement_text: System shall load thermostat definitions from initialization data.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the system to load the thermostat definitions from initialization data, so that thermostats are known at start.
technical_task: At start, read the thermostat definitions from the initialization data.
acceptance_criteria: Given initialization data with thermostat definitions, when the system starts, then it loads them.
Given a thermostat defined in the initialization data, when the system runs, then it is known to the system.

requirement_text: User shall be able to record exercises, repetitions, and the followed diet within the application.
user_story: As a fitness user, I want to record exercises, repetitions and my diet in the application, so that I can track my routine.
technical_task: Add logging of exercises, repetitions and the followed diet.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user records an exercise with repetitions, then the entry is saved.
Given the application, when the user records the diet followed, then the entry is saved.

requirement_text: The product shall be robust with fault tolerance.
rationale: "Robust with fault tolerance" names no specific faults or measurable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What does "robust" mean in testable terms?
Which faults must the product tolerate and how?

requirement_text: User shall be able to add interests.
user_story: As a user, I want to add interests, so that my profile reflects what I like.
technical_task: Allow users to add interests to their profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given the profile, when the user adds an interest, then it is saved.
Given saved interests, when the profile is viewed, then the interests are shown.

requirement_text: The LHCP chooses to view all patients with which he or she has ever had an office visit with.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view all patients I have ever had an office visit with, so that I can see my patient history.
technical_task: Show every patient with whom the LHCP has had an office visit.
acceptance_criteria: Given an LHCP with past office visits, when the LHCP opens the list, then all patients with whom the LHCP has had an office visit are shown.
Given a patient with whom the LHCP has had no office visit, when the LHCP opens the list, then that patient is not shown.

requirement_text: Agency user shall be able to understand file-level errors better.
rationale: "Better" is relative and no error information requirement is stated.
clarification_questions: What does "understand file-level errors better" mean in measurable terms?
Which file-level errors are meant and what information must be shown?

requirement_text: In each row the descriptive name is a link to the URL containing patient specific instructions.
requirement_text_raw: In each row  the descriptive name is a link to the URL containing patient specific instructions.
user_story: As a patient, I want each row's descriptive name to be a link to the patient specific instructions, so that I can open them.
technical_task: Make the descriptive name in each row a link to the URL that contains the patient specific instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a row in the list, when it is displayed, then its descriptive name is a link.
Given the link, when the user clicks it, then the URL containing the patient specific instructions opens.

requirement_text: If a movie is selected, there shall be a list of all theatres in that city where it is playing, along with show times.
user_story: As a moviegoer, I want to see all theatres in the city that show a selected movie, with show times, so that I can choose where to watch.
technical_task: After a movie is selected, list the theatres in that city where it is playing together with the show times.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected movie, when the user opens it, then a list of all theatres in that city where it is playing is shown.
Given a theatre in the list, when it is displayed, then its show times are shown.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add the Classroom number for the class.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to add the Classroom number for a class, so that students know where it takes place.
technical_task: Add a Classroom number field to the class record.
acceptance_criteria: Given a class, when the user enters a Classroom number, then it is saved with the class.
Given a saved class, when it is viewed, then the Classroom number is shown.

requirement_text: User shall update a blog by filling out a form with title, description, and content, with validation ensuring data integrity.
user_story: As a blogger, I want to update a blog through a form with title, description and content, with validation, so that my data stays correct.
technical_task: Provide a blog update form with title, description and content fields and validation of the entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given the blog update form, when the user fills in title, description and content and submits, then the blog is updated.
Given invalid entries in the form, when the user submits, then validation rejects them.

requirement_text: The product shall generate a CMA report in an acceptable time.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall generate a CMA report in an acceptable time.'
clarification_questions: How long is an "acceptable time" for generating a CMA report?
What size of report applies?

requirement_text: The system shall be user-friendly and intuitive for users of all technical abilities.
rationale: "User-friendly" and "intuitive" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How are "user-friendly" and "intuitive" measured?
Which technical abilities must be covered?

requirement_text: The system shall be able to display its graphical user interface (GUI) within an 800 x 600 pixel resolution.
user_story: As a user, I want the graphical user interface to fit within an 800 x 600 pixel resolution, so that it is usable on small displays.
technical_task: Lay out the GUI so that it is fully displayed within 800 x 600 pixels.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display with 800 x 600 pixel resolution, when the application is started, then the entire GUI is displayed.
Given the GUI at 800 x 600 pixels, when the user uses all screens, then no part is cut off.

requirement_text: System shall maintain the quality of service without any compromise on performance.
rationale: "Without any compromise on performance" has no measurable target.
clarification_questions: Which quality of service measures and performance targets apply?
What counts as a "compromise" on performance?

requirement_text: The sensor must not miss more than 50 objects of object category TAF-Ordinary per hour in ODA-Standing, where the objects movement category is either Moving or Stationary and the object is missed for longer than 1 sensor cycle and less than 8 sensor cycles.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the sensor to miss no more than 50 TAF-Ordinary objects per hour in ODA-Standing, so that detection is reliable.
technical_task: Limit misses of TAF-Ordinary objects in ODA-Standing, with movement category Moving or Stationary and missed for longer than 1 sensor cycle and less than 8 sensor cycles, to at most 50 per hour.
acceptance_criteria: Given objects of category TAF-Ordinary with movement category Moving or Stationary in ODA-Standing, when they are missed for longer than 1 sensor cycle and less than 8 sensor cycles, then no more than 50 such objects are missed per hour.
Given more than 50 such misses per hour, when they are counted, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The software shall support touch interaction with the interface using fingers or a stylus for actions like drawing, manipulating objects, and adjusting tools.
user_story: As a user, I want to use touch with my fingers or a stylus for drawing, manipulating objects and adjusting tools, so that I can work naturally.
technical_task: Support touch interaction by finger or stylus for drawing, manipulating objects and adjusting tools.
acceptance_criteria: Given a touch screen, when the user draws with a finger or a stylus, then the drawing is made.
Given a touch screen, when the user manipulates objects or adjusts tools by touch, then the action is carried out.

requirement_text: The solution should isolate security functions from nonsecurity functions.
user_story: As a security architect, I want security functions isolated from nonsecurity functions, so that a fault in one does not affect the other.
technical_task: Separate security functions from nonsecurity functions in the design.
acceptance_criteria: Given the solution's design, when it is reviewed, then security functions are isolated from nonsecurity functions.
Given a failure in a nonsecurity function, when it occurs, then security functions are not affected.

requirement_text: The system shall have a user-friendly interface for various user roles.
user_story: As a user in any role, I want a user-friendly interface, so that I can work without confusion.
technical_task: Provide an interface suited to each user role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user role, when the user opens the interface, then it shows the functions for that role.
Given different user roles, when each opens the interface, then each interface is suited to its role.
rationale: Role assumed: user in any role. "User-friendly" is not measured.

requirement_text: User shall be able to register by providing required details and receive a success message upon account creation.
user_story: As a new user, I want to register with the required details and get a success message, so that I know my account exists.
technical_task: Offer registration with the required details and show a success message when the account is created.
