acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the user provides the required details and submits, then the account is created.
Given the account is created, when registration completes, then a success message is shown.

requirement_text: System shall support emerging needs based on data analysis.
rationale: "Emerging needs" and the link to data analysis are not specified.
clarification_questions: Which emerging needs are meant and how are they derived from data analysis?
What must the system do to support them?

requirement_text: The LMS shall store all information about librarians and patrons, including their access keys and priority.
user_story: As a librarian, I want the LMS to store all information about librarians and patrons, including access keys and priority, so that accounts are complete.
technical_task: Store records for librarians and patrons including their access keys and priority.
acceptance_criteria: Given a librarian or patron, when the record is saved, then all information including access key and priority is stored.
Given a stored record, when it is opened, then it shows the access key and priority.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall configure each ICP to halt processing if any of the MPE tests fail.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS288] configure each ICP to halt processing if any of the MPE tests fail.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS to configure each ICP to halt processing if any of the MPE tests fail, so that a failing ICP stops.
technical_task: Configure each ICP so processing halts when an MPE test fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given an MPE test fails on an ICP, when the ICP is configured by the FTSS, then it halts processing.
Given all MPE tests pass, when the ICP runs, then it continues processing.

requirement_text: The windows listing diagnostic results shall increase in height as needed to display entries up to a maximum of ten entries.
user_story: As a technician, I want the windows listing diagnostic results to grow in height up to ten entries, so that I can see the results.
technical_task: Make the diagnostic result windows increase in height as needed, up to a maximum of ten entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given diagnostic results, when more entries are added, then the window increases in height to display them up to ten entries.
Given more than ten entries, when they are listed, then the window height stays at the ten-entry maximum.
rationale: Role assumed: technician. How extra entries are shown is not stated.

requirement_text: Clicking 'OK' will mark this item as cleared indicating that billing has been completed for this encounter.
requirement_text_raw: Clicking 'OK' will mark this item as cleared  indicating that billing has been completed for this encounter.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want clicking OK to mark an item as cleared, so that I know billing is completed for the encounter.
technical_task: Mark the item as cleared when OK is clicked, indicating billing is completed for the encounter.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item awaiting clearance, when the clerk clicks OK, then it is marked as cleared.
Given a cleared item, when it is viewed, then it indicates that billing has been completed for the encounter.

requirement_text: The database shall be maintained using MySQL, and the server will be Apache; in case of system failure, both the database and server can be reinitialized.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the database in MySQL and the server on Apache, with both re-initializable after a failure, so that I can recover them.
technical_task: Maintain the database with MySQL, run the server on Apache and allow both to be reinitialized after a system failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when its components are listed, then the database is in MySQL and the server is Apache.
Given a system failure, when it occurs, then both the database and the server can be reinitialized.

requirement_text: System dependability ensures users are informed of any issues for trusted system performance , measured during testing and prioritized highly.
rationale: The sentence mixes outcomes and process statements, with no clear testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What does "system dependability" require the system to do?
How is "prioritized highly" and "trusted performance" measured?

requirement_text: Science analysis software shall be integrated into the NASA approved data repository.
user_story: As a scientist, I want science analysis software integrated into the NASA approved data repository, so that I can analyze data where it is held.
technical_task: Integrate the science analysis software into the NASA approved data repository.
acceptance_criteria: Given the NASA approved data repository, when the science analysis software is installed, then it is integrated into it.
Given integrated science analysis software, when a scientist uses it, then it works with the repository.

requirement_text: The CNG shall support the connection to a STB (or media gateway) both in a bridged or in a routed mode of operation.
user_story: As a home network user, I want the CNG to connect to a STB or media gateway in bridged or routed mode, so that my set-top box works either way.
technical_task: Support the connection of a STB (or media gateway) to the CNG in bridged and in routed mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a STB or media gateway, when the CNG is in bridged mode, then the connection is supported.
Given a STB or media gateway, when the CNG is in routed mode, then the connection is supported.

requirement_text: System shall ensure that enabling or disabling explore for a dataset does not result in silent loss of data or data available for explore.
user_story: As a data owner, I want enabling or disabling explore for a dataset never to lose data silently, so that data stays available.
technical_task: Ensure enabling or disabling explore on a dataset does not silently lose data or the data available for explore.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when explore is enabled, then no data is lost silently.
Given a dataset, when explore is disabled, then no data is lost silently and no data available for explore is lost without notice.

requirement_text: A subset of FTSS shall reside on the ICP.
requirement_text_raw: A subset of FTSS shall (3.3.11.7) reside on the ICP.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a subset of FTSS to reside on the ICP, so that the ICP has local services.
technical_task: Place a subset of the FTSS software on the ICP.
acceptance_criteria: Given the ICP, when its software is inspected, then a subset of FTSS resides on it.
Given the FTSS software, when it is deployed, then not all of it is required on the ICP.

requirement_text: After initial synchronization, the FCPs shall remain synchronized until a hardware fault occurs. For example, asymmetric I/O calls will not be allowed to induce a large enough skew to force the FCPs to desynchronize.
requirement_text_raw: After initial synchronization, the FCPs shall [SRS168] remain synchronized until a hardware fault occurs.  For example, asymmetric I/O calls will not be allowed to induce a large enough skew to force the FCPs to desynchronize.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCPs to stay synchronized after initial synchronization until a hardware fault occurs, so that they act together.
technical_task: Keep the FCPs synchronized after initial synchronization until a hardware fault, and prevent asymmetric I/O calls from inducing a skew large enough to desynchronize them.
acceptance_criteria: Given initial synchronization has completed, when no hardware fault occurs, then the FCPs remain synchronized.
Given asymmetric I/O calls, when they occur, then they are not allowed to induce a skew large enough to force the FCPs to desynchronize.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to register with PRACTO using valid information and log in using their credentials to access PRACTO services.
user_story: As a patient, I want to register with PRACTO using valid information and log in with my credentials, so that I can use PRACTO services.
technical_task: Provide registration and login for PRACTO using valid information and credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid information, when the user registers with PRACTO, then an account is created.
Given valid credentials, when the user logs in, then the user can access PRACTO services.

requirement_text: User shall/will be provided with reports generated in a time not exceeding five seconds.
user_story: As a manager, I want reports generated in no more than five seconds, so that I don't wait.
technical_task: Generate every report within five seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report request, when the report is generated, then it takes no more than five seconds.
Given a report that takes longer than five seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The system shall allow consumers to download data packages in specific versions.
user_story: As a data consumer, I want to download data packages in specific versions, so that I get exactly the version I need.
technical_task: Provide download of data packages by chosen version.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data package with several versions, when the consumer selects a version, then that version is downloaded.
Given a downloaded data package, when it is checked, then it is the selected version.

requirement_text: If a failure in an FCR other than the NEFU is diagnosed when the FCP is configured as a degraded triplex, no action shall be taken. Note that a failed FCR could be diagnosed using any method, including (but not limited to) Continuous BIT, ICP presence test, or NE syndrome analysis.
requirement_text_raw: If a failure in an FCR other than the NEFU is diagnosed when the FCP is configured as a degraded triplex, no action shall [SRS254] be taken.  Note that a failed FCR could be diagnosed using any method, including (but not limited to) Continuous BIT, ICP presence test, or NE syndrome analysis.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want no action taken when an FCR other than the NEFU fails while the FCP is a degraded triplex, so that the system stays stable.
technical_task: Take no action when a failure is diagnosed in an FCR other than the NEFU while the FCP is configured as a degraded triplex, regardless of the diagnosis method.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP is configured as a degraded triplex, when a failure in an FCR other than the NEFU is diagnosed, then no action is taken.
Given a failed FCR diagnosed by Continuous BIT, ICP presence test or NE syndrome analysis, when the FCP is a degraded triplex, then no action is taken either.

requirement_text: You may click 'Edit' next to any of these forms to edit its contents.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to click Edit next to a form to edit its contents, so that I can correct it.
technical_task: Add an Edit control next to each form that opens its contents for editing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of forms, when the user clicks Edit next to one, then its contents can be edited.
Given an edited form, when the user saves it, then the changes are saved.

requirement_text: The real time clock must be able to cover longer periods of time and schedule events without inbetween wake ups.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the real time clock to cover longer periods and schedule events without wake ups in between, so that power is saved.
technical_task: Extend the real time clock's coverage of time and let it schedule events without intermediate wake ups.
acceptance_criteria: Given a long period to cover, when the real time clock is used, then it covers the period.
Given scheduled events, when the real time clock schedules them, then no wake up happens in between.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. "Longer" is relative to a baseline not given.

requirement_text: System shall maintain and display marks obtained by students in different semesters, including internal and external marks, total marks, and credits.
user_story: As a student, I want to see my marks in different semesters, with internal and external marks, total marks and credits, so that I know my results.
technical_task: Store and display marks per semester including internal marks, external marks, total marks and credits.
acceptance_criteria: Given marks for several semesters, when the student opens the marks page, then the marks are shown per semester.
Given a semester, when it is displayed, then internal marks, external marks, total marks and credits are shown.

requirement_text: This produces a report including all the specified patient information.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want a report with all the specified patient information, so that I can review it.
technical_task: Generate a report that contains all specified patient information.
acceptance_criteria: Given specified patient information, when the report is produced, then it contains all of it.
Given the report, when it is opened, then it shows the patient information.
rationale: Role assumed: billing clerk. The specified information is not listed.

requirement_text: Website must be fully operational with MSN TV2.
requirement_text_raw: Website must be fully operational with MSN TV2.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want the website to be fully operational with MSN TV2, so that I can use it on my television.
technical_task: Verify that the website works fully on MSN TV2.
acceptance_criteria: Given MSN TV2, when the user opens the website, then it is displayed.
Given MSN TV2, when the user uses the website's functions, then they all work.

requirement_text: The accuracy of obj_y for objects having object extension category PointTarget shall be at least 0.05 m for objects closer than 10m (Euclidean distance from the center point of the sensor 's front face), where the accuracy is compared to a point on the object 's contour.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the accuracy of obj_y for PointTarget objects to be at least 0.05 m for objects closer than 10m, so that close objects are located precisely.
technical_task: Achieve an accuracy of at least 0.05 m for obj_y of objects with object extension category PointTarget closer than 10m, compared to a point on the object's contour.
acceptance_criteria: Given a PointTarget object closer than 10m, when obj_y is compared with a point on the object's contour, then the accuracy is at least 0.05 m.
Given an accuracy worse than 0.05 m, when it is measured for such an object, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. The distance is the Euclidean distance from the sensor's front face center point.

requirement_text: Performance must meet specified requirements even under high user load.
user_story: As a user, I want performance requirements met even under high user load, so that the system stays usable.
technical_task: Meet the specified performance requirements while the user load is high.
acceptance_criteria: Given a high user load, when users use the system, then the specified performance requirements are met.
Given a normal user load, when users use the system, then the specified performance requirements are met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The performance requirements and the load are defined elsewhere.

requirement_text: System shall showcase the latest safety tips and tools for LPG usage.
user_story: As an LPG customer, I want to see the latest safety tips and tools for LPG usage, so that I use it safely.
technical_task: Display current safety tips and tools for LPG usage.
acceptance_criteria: Given safety tips and tools for LPG usage, when the user opens the safety section, then the latest ones are shown.
Given a new safety tip, when it is added, then it appears among the latest tips.

requirement_text: The user shall have the option to sign up using their Google account.
user_story: As a new user, I want the option to sign up with my Google account, so that I don't need a new password.
technical_task: Offer sign-up through a Google account.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sign-up page, when the user chooses to sign up with a Google account, then the account is created using it.
Given the sign-up page, when it is displayed, then signing up with a Google account is offered.

requirement_text: The product shall prevent its data from incorrect data being introduced.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall prevent its data from incorrect data being introduced.'
user_story: As a site owner, I want the product to prevent incorrect data from being introduced, so that its data stays reliable.
technical_task: Validate input so that incorrect data is not stored.
acceptance_criteria: Given incorrect data is entered, when it is submitted, then it is not stored.
Given correct data is entered, when it is submitted, then it is stored.
rationale: Role assumed: site owner. What counts as incorrect is not defined.

requirement_text: The ARC shall use an infrared filter wich is open for a short waveband to improve night performance, using the vehicles infrared headlights.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the ARC to use an infrared filter that is open for a short waveband and the vehicle's infrared headlights, so that night performance improves.
technical_task: Equip the ARC with an infrared filter open for a short waveband and use the vehicle's infrared headlights to improve night performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given the ARC, when its optics are inspected, then it uses an infrared filter that is open for a short waveband.
Given night driving, when the ARC operates, then it uses the vehicle's infrared headlights.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. "Short waveband" is not quantified.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to import Data Packages into various platforms like Node.js, Julia, R, Excel, SPSS, STATA, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, Python, Clojure, C++.
user_story: As a data scientist, I want to import Data Packages into Node.js, Julia, R, Excel, SPSS, STATA, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, Python, Clojure and C++, so that I can use them in my tools.
technical_task: Provide import of Data Packages into platforms including Node.js, Julia, R, Excel, SPSS, STATA, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, Python, Clojure and C++.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Data Package, when the user imports it into a listed platform such as Python or R, then the data is available there.
Given a Data Package, when the user imports it into Excel, SPSS, STATA or LibreOffice/OpenOffice, then the data is available there.
rationale: Role assumed: data scientist. "Like" means the list may not be complete.

requirement_text: The streaming server will support 50 simultaneous streaming connections.
requirement_text_raw: The streaming server will support 50 simultaneous streaming connections.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want the streaming server to support 50 simultaneous connections, so that many people can watch at once.
technical_task: Size the streaming server for 50 simultaneous streaming connections.
acceptance_criteria: Given 50 simultaneous streaming connections, when they are open, then the server supports all of them.
Given fewer than 50 connections, when they are open, then the server supports them.

requirement_text: System shall stop protecting the device from threats if the software validity exceeds the limit.
user_story: As a user, I want protection to stop when the software validity exceeds its limit, so that I know the software has expired.
technical_task: Stop protecting the device from threats once the software validity exceeds the limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given the software validity exceeds the limit, when the check runs, then the system stops protecting the device from threats.
Given the software validity is within the limit, when the check runs, then protection continues.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What happens to the user notice is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall be robust, scalable, flexible, and user-friendly to meet diverse user needs effectively.
clarification_questions: What measurable targets define "robust", "scalable" and "flexible"?
Which diverse user needs must be met?

requirement_text: RAM scrub shall actively trigger the EDAC function by cyclically reading (and writing back if an error is found) all used RAM.
requirement_text_raw: RAM scrub shall [SRS043] actively trigger the EDAC function by cyclically reading (and writing back if an error is found) all used RAM.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want RAM scrub to trigger the EDAC function by cyclically reading all used RAM and writing back when an error is found, so that memory errors are corrected.
technical_task: Run RAM scrub as a cyclic read of all used RAM that writes data back if an error is found, thereby triggering the EDAC function.
acceptance_criteria: Given RAM scrub is running, when it cycles, then it reads all used RAM.
Given an error is found while reading, when RAM scrub detects it, then the data is written back.

requirement_text: Employer and agency registration shall be facilitated.
user_story: As an employer or agency, I want to register on the platform, so that I can use its services.
technical_task: Provide registration for employers and agencies.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration page, when an employer registers, then an employer account is created.
Given the registration page, when an agency registers, then an agency account is created.

requirement_text: THEN TSA display content shall be updated according to TSA display strategy earliest 200 milliseconds before passing the sign and no later than the EV is passing the sign.
user_story: As a driver, I want the TSA display updated according to the TSA display strategy at the earliest 200 milliseconds before I pass the sign and no later than when the EV passes it, so that the sign information is current.
technical_task: Update the TSA display content per the TSA display strategy between 200 milliseconds before the sign is passed and the moment the EV passes the sign.
acceptance_criteria: Given the EV approaches a sign, when 200 milliseconds remain before passing it, then the TSA display may be updated according to the TSA display strategy.
Given the EV passes the sign, when it passes, then the TSA display has already been updated.
rationale: Role assumed: driver. The leading "THEN" refers to a condition not shown.

requirement_text: The force-travel-characteristic brings the haptic characteristic closer by Chords-of-pieces as in Fig. F-1, F-2, F-3 and F-4 represented on.
rationale: The sentence describes a characteristic through figures that are not given and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What does "brings the haptic characteristic closer by Chords-of-pieces" require the system to do?
What do the referenced figures F-1 to F-4 show?

requirement_text: MIDs should be considered private sensitive information.
requirement_text_raw: MIDs should be considered private  sensitive information.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want MIDs treated as private sensitive information, so that they are protected accordingly.
technical_task: Classify MIDs as private sensitive information and apply the handling rules for such information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a MID, when it is stored or shown, then it is handled as private sensitive information.
Given a user without permission to see private sensitive information, when the user requests a MID, then it is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. "Should" makes this a recommendation; the handling rules are not listed.

requirement_text: Managers shall be able to confirm when tasks have been completed.
user_story: As a manager, I want to confirm when tasks have been completed, so that completion is recorded.
technical_task: Offer a confirmation action for completed tasks to managers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task that has been completed, when a manager confirms it, then the task is marked as confirmed.
Given a user who is not a manager, when the user tries to confirm a task, then it is not confirmed.

requirement_text: The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).
requirement_text_raw: The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser.  The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80\% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'
user_story: As a user, I want the product to work with any HTML browser, transmit data without problems and display HTML properly in 80% of the browsers tested, so that I can use my browser.
technical_task: Test the product in at least 8 HTML browsers and make sure it displays HTML properly in 80% of the browsers tested while transmitting data without problems.
acceptance_criteria: Given at least 8 HTML browsers, when the product is tested in them, then it displays HTML properly in 80% of them.
Given a browser used with the product, when data is transmitted between the user and the product, then it is transmitted without problems.

requirement_text: User shall ensure that when deploying a new version of an app including a shared dataset type, only dataset instances created by that app start using the new code.
user_story: As an app developer, I want only the dataset instances created by my app to start using the new code when I deploy a new app version with a shared dataset type, so that other apps' datasets are not affected.
technical_task: On deployment of a new app version that includes a shared dataset type, switch only the dataset instances created by that app to the new code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new version of an app with a shared dataset type is deployed, when deployment completes, then dataset instances created by that app use the new code.
Given dataset instances created by other apps, when the new version is deployed, then they do not start using the new code.
rationale: Role assumed: app developer; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: System shall confirm submission of leave request.
user_story: As an employee, I want confirmation that my leave request was submitted, so that I know it was received.
technical_task: Show a confirmation after a leave request is submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a leave request is submitted, when submission completes, then a confirmation is shown.
Given a leave request that fails to submit, when it ends, then no confirmation of submission is shown.

requirement_text: The client will send a GET request to the Web API with the question as a URL parameter.
user_story: As a client developer, I want to send a GET request to the Web API with the question as a URL parameter, so that I can ask a question programmatically.
technical_task: Accept a GET request to the Web API that carries the question as a URL parameter.
acceptance_criteria: Given a GET request with a question as a URL parameter, when it is sent to the Web API, then the Web API receives the question.
Given a GET request without the question parameter, when it is sent, then the Web API does not treat it as a question.
rationale: Role assumed: client developer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The IDC shall provide objects reliable if they are closer than 100 m to ensure a synchronisation to the ADAS graphic in the IC.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the IDC to provide objects reliably when they are closer than 100 m, so that the ADAS graphic in the IC stays synchronized.
technical_task: Deliver objects reliably from the IDC when they are closer than 100 m, to keep the ADAS graphic in the IC synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object closer than 100 m, when the IDC provides objects, then the object is provided reliably.
Given the provided objects, when the ADAS graphic in the IC is updated, then it is synchronized with them.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. "Reliably" is not measured.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access secure authentication mechanisms for controlling access to databases.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want secure authentication mechanisms for controlling access to databases, so that only authorized users connect.
technical_task: Provide secure authentication for access to the databases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with valid credentials, when the user connects to a database, then access is granted.
Given a user without valid credentials, when the user tries to connect, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: database administrator; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: If a primary provider has been entered for that patient they will be selected automatically.
requirement_text_raw: If a primary provider has been entered for that patient  they will be selected automatically.
user_story: As a clerk, I want a primary provider that has been entered for a patient selected automatically, so that I do not select it again.
technical_task: Preselect the primary provider of a patient when one has been entered.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with a primary provider entered, when the provider selection is shown, then the primary provider is selected automatically.
Given a patient with no primary provider entered, when the provider selection is shown, then nothing is preselected.

requirement_text: System shall notify the recipient user of a connection request and allow them to accept or decline.
user_story: As a user, I want to be notified of a connection request and to accept or decline it, so that I control who connects with me.
technical_task: Notify the recipient of a connection request and offer accept and decline actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a connection request, when it is sent, then the recipient is notified.
Given a connection request, when the recipient accepts or declines, then the request is accepted or declined.

requirement_text: Performance of making recommendations and updating them in real-time is crucial, requiring seamless processing to ensure users do not notice data processing.
clarification_questions: What response time counts as "seamless" processing for recommendations and updates?
What does "real-time" mean here?

requirement_text: System shall provide car-wise statistics to assist in predicting profitable new car orders.
user_story: As a car dealer, I want car-wise statistics, so that I can predict which new car orders will be profitable.
technical_task: Provide statistics for each car model to help predict profitable new car orders.

requirement_text: Such determination should be evident solely by examining the audit log.

requirement_text: The HCP has authenticated himself or herself in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC2) (UC3).
user_story: As an HCP, I want to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system, so that I can use it (UC2, UC3).
technical_task: Require the HCP to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system before use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an HCP with valid credentials, when the HCP logs in, then the HCP is authenticated.
Given an HCP without valid credentials, when the HCP logs in, then authentication fails.
rationale: Role stated: HCP. The sentence states a precondition of use cases UC2 and UC3.

requirement_text: The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the concurrency capacity to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon, so that busy periods work.
technical_task: Dimension the concurrency capacity for peak scheduling times, including early morning and late afternoon hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given a peak scheduling time such as early morning, when many users work at once, then the concurrency capacity handles them.
Given a peak scheduling time such as late afternoon, when many users work at once, then the concurrency capacity handles them.
rationale: Role assumed: operations manager. The number of concurrent users is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall display the created board on the dashboard.
user_story: As a user, I want the board I created shown on the dashboard, so that I can see it right away.
technical_task: Display each created board on the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given a board has been created, when the user opens the dashboard, then the board is displayed.
Given several created boards, when the user opens the dashboard, then each is displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall automatically calculate and display individual balances (IOUs) among group members based on expenses.
user_story: As a group member, I want individual balances (IOUs) calculated and shown automatically from expenses, so that I know who owes what.
technical_task: Calculate and display the balance between each pair of group members from the recorded expenses.
acceptance_criteria: Given expenses recorded in a group, when they are saved, then individual balances (IOUs) among members are calculated.
Given calculated balances, when a member opens the group, then the individual balances are displayed.

requirement_text: BR217, the system sets different parameter sets, not only according to to the user 's selection but also depending on the roof status (opened or closed).
user_story: As a driver, I want BR217 to set different parameter sets depending on my selection and on whether the roof is opened or closed, so that the system matches the roof status.
technical_task: Choose the parameter set in BR217 based on the user's selection and on the roof status (opened or closed).
acceptance_criteria: Given a user selection and the roof opened, when BR217 sets parameters, then it uses the parameter set for that selection with the roof opened.
Given the same user selection and the roof closed, when BR217 sets parameters, then it uses the parameter set for that selection with the roof closed.

requirement_text: Only when memory alignment is permitted, Redundancy Management shall initiate periodic re-synchronization attempts on the FCP virtual group at a 1 second rate.
requirement_text_raw: Only when memory alignment is permitted, Redundancy Management shall [SRS124] initiate periodic re-synchronization attempts on the FCP virtual group at a 1 second rate.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to attempt re-synchronization of the FCP virtual group once per second only when memory alignment is permitted, so that recovery is periodic.
technical_task: Start periodic re-synchronization attempts on the FCP virtual group at a 1 second rate, but only when memory alignment is permitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory alignment is permitted, when Redundancy Management runs, then it initiates a re-synchronization attempt on the FCP virtual group every 1 second.
Given memory alignment is not permitted, when Redundancy Management runs, then it does not initiate re-synchronization attempts.

requirement_text: The NE shall be configured to automatically enter ISYNC microcode following power on.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.2.3.1) be configured to automatically enter ISYNC microcode following power on.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the NE to enter ISYNC microcode automatically after power on, so that synchronization starts without intervention.
technical_task: Configure the NE to start in ISYNC microcode after power on.
acceptance_criteria: Given the NE is powered on, when power-up completes, then it enters ISYNC microcode automatically.
Given the NE has entered ISYNC microcode, when it is observed, then no manual action was needed.

requirement_text: The application software shall have the capability to reset a permanently failed channel to its initial recovery state.
requirement_text_raw: The application software shall [SRS285] have the capability to reset a permanently failed channel to its initial recovery state.
user_story: As an application developer, I want the application software to reset a permanently failed channel to its initial recovery state, so that the channel can be recovered.
technical_task: Provide the application software with a way to reset a permanently failed channel to the initial recovery state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a permanently failed channel, when the application software resets it, then the channel is in its initial recovery state.
Given a channel that has not permanently failed, when the application software resets it, then the reset is not needed by this requirement.

requirement_text: The minimum processor clock speed shall be 2 GHz.
user_story: As a user, I want a minimum processor clock speed of 2 GHz, so that the system runs well.
technical_task: Specify 2 GHz as the minimum processor clock speed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a processor with a clock speed of 2 GHz or more, when the system is run, then it operates.
Given a processor slower than 2 GHz, when the system is run, then it is not supported.

user_story: As a user, I want large image files compressed automatically, so that they take less space.
technical_task: Compress large image files automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large image file, when it is saved or uploaded, then it is compressed automatically.
Given a compressed image, when it is compared with the original, then it takes less storage.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What counts as large is not stated.

requirement_text: Passwords must meet specific criteria, including a minimum length of 8 characters, at least one uppercase character, one digit, and one special symbol.
user_story: As a security officer, I want passwords to have at least 8 characters, an uppercase character, a digit and a special symbol, so that they are hard to guess.
technical_task: Enforce a password policy requiring a minimum length of 8 characters, at least one uppercase character, one digit and one special symbol.
acceptance_criteria: Given a password with at least 8 characters, an uppercase character, a digit and a special symbol, when the user sets it, then it is accepted.
Given a password that lacks any of these elements, when the user sets it, then it is rejected.

requirement_text: A list of focused questions and answers with links inside the Get Real site. topics include: money, people, and colleges.
user_story: As a visitor, I want a list of focused questions and answers with links inside the Get Real site, so that I can find answers on money, people and colleges.
technical_task: Add a Q&A list with links inside the Get Real site covering the topics money, people and colleges.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Get Real site, when the visitor opens the Q&A list, then focused questions and answers are shown with links.
Given the Q&A list, when it is reviewed, then it covers the topics money, people and colleges.

Given data from up to 5 years ago, when the administrator opens it, then it is still available.

user_story: As an examiner, I want reports showing whether students meet the specified eligibility criteria for exams, so that I know who may sit them.
technical_task: Display reports that show for each student whether the eligibility criteria for exams are met.
acceptance_criteria: Given students and eligibility criteria, when the examiner opens the report, then each student is shown as meeting the criteria or not.
Given a student who meets the criteria, when the report is displayed, then the student is shown as eligible.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to grant other users permission to modify scores they own.
user_story: As a score owner, I want to grant other users permission to modify scores I own, so that we can collaborate.

acceptance_criteria: Given a score owned by the user, when the owner grants another user permission, then that user can modify the score.
Given a score for which no permission was granted, when another user tries to modify it, then the change is refused.

requirement_text: The system shall enable users to organize ebooks into collections, download for offline reading, and track reading progress.
user_story: As a reader, I want to organize ebooks into collections, download them for offline reading and track my progress, so that I can read comfortably.
technical_task: Provide ebook collections, offline download and reading progress tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Given ebooks, when the user creates a collection and adds them, then they are organized in the collection.
Given an ebook, when the user downloads it and reads it, then it can be read offline and the reading progress is tracked.

requirement_text: System shall maintain consistent functionality across different devices and platforms.
user_story: As a user, I want the same functionality across devices and platforms, so that I get a consistent experience.
technical_task: Keep the system's functions the same on all supported devices and platforms.
acceptance_criteria: Given a function on one supported device, when the same function is used on another supported platform, then it behaves the same.
Given the set of supported platforms, when they are compared, then none lacks a function that another has.

requirement_text: The FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system, together shall utilize no more than 3 megabytes of ROM.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system, together shall [SRS193] utilize no more than 3 megabytes of ROM.

technical_task: Limit the combined ROM use of the FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system to 3 megabytes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system, when their ROM use is added together, then it is no more than 3 megabytes.
Given a total above 3 megabytes, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The website shall be capable of supporting 100 000 customers.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall be capable of supporting 100 000 customers.'

technical_task: Size the website for 100 000 customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given 100 000 customers, when they use the website, then it supports them.
Given fewer customers, when they use the website, then it supports them.

requirement_text: Any and all errors associated with obtaining, validating, converting, or storing the sensed data shall be logged as described in subsequent specifications and selected errors shall be reported to the user.
user_story: As a technician, I want errors in obtaining, validating, converting or storing sensed data logged, with selected errors reported to me, so that I can find data problems.

acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs while obtaining, validating, converting or storing sensed data, when it happens, then it is logged.
Given a selected error, when it occurs, then it is reported to the user.

requirement_text: System provides report generation for delivered goods to facilitate backup and recovery in case of data loss.
user_story: As a store manager, I want a report generated for delivered goods, so that I can back up and recover data after a loss.
technical_task: Generate a report for delivered goods to support backup and recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Given delivered goods, when the user requests a report, then the report is generated.
Given data loss, when the report is used, then it supports recovery of the delivered goods data.

requirement_text: Communication services shall deliver messages in the same order at each member of a virtual group.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS053] deliver messages in the same order at each member of a virtual group.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to deliver messages in the same order to every member of a virtual group, so that all members see the same sequence.
technical_task: Deliver messages to all members of a virtual group in an identical order.
acceptance_criteria: Given several messages sent to a virtual group, when they are delivered, then every member receives them in the same order.
Given two members of a virtual group, when their received orders are compared, then they are identical.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to validate Data Packages to ensure data conformity.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to validate Data Packages, so that the data conforms.
technical_task: Offer validation of Data Packages against conformity rules.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Data Package that conforms, when the user validates it, then it passes validation.
Given a Data Package that does not conform, when the user validates it, then the validation reports the problem.

user_story: As an organizer, I want to create and edit Event records, so that event information is current.
technical_task: Provide create and edit functions for Event records.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new event, when the user creates an Event record, then it is saved.
Given an existing Event record, when the user edits it, then the changes are saved.

requirement_text: System shall notify the device of issues with the account if the serial key is valid but there are account problems.
user_story: As a user, I want my device told about account problems when my serial key is valid but the account has issues, so that I can fix them.
technical_task: Notify the device of account issues when the serial key is valid but there are account problems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid serial key and an account with problems, when the system checks the account, then the device is notified of the issues.
Given a valid serial key and an account without problems, when the system checks the account, then no issue notification is sent.

requirement_text: The system shall allow administrators to create "Other" courses/events without a listing fee.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to create "Other" courses or events without a listing fee, so that special offerings can be added free of charge.
technical_task: Allow administrators to create "Other" courses and events with no listing fee.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator creates an "Other" course or event, then it is created without a listing fee.
Given an "Other" course or event, when its fees are viewed, then no listing fee is shown.

requirement_text: System shall provide comprehensive documentation and support resources for users and administrators.
user_story: As a user or administrator, I want documentation and support resources, so that I can learn to use and run the system.
technical_task: Provide documentation and support resources for users and for administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when a user looks for help, then documentation and support resources for users are available.
Given the system, when an administrator looks for help, then documentation and support resources for administrators are available.

technical_task: Qualify the unit for storage between -30 and +60 degrees C.

technical_task: Compute the minimum power train torque for slipping and closed NAK as the addition of the maximum permissible drag torque of the combustion engine and the idle speed controller desired torque (idle speed controller output and disturbance variable compensation).
acceptance_criteria: Given a slipping or closed NAK, when the minimum power train torque is determined, then it is the sum of the maximum permissible drag torque of the combustion engine and the idle speed controller desired torque.
Given the idle speed controller desired torque, when it is used, then it comprises the idle speed controller output and the disturbance variable compensation.
rationale: Role assumed: powertrain engineer. The clutch pictures referred to are not given.

requirement_text: The presence, or absence of, an NEFU ICP shall not impact the NE firmware (i.e., the NE firmware will not be different).
requirement_text_raw: The presence, or absence of, an NEFU ICP shall (3.2.5.2) not impact the NE firmware (i.e., the NE firmware will not be different).

requirement_text: The contractor shall start environmental qualification that early in time schedule, that all tests are finished and a complete qualification report is available for PPF Sample.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the contractor to start environmental qualification early enough that all tests are finished and a complete qualification report exists for the PPF Sample, so that the sample can be released.
technical_task: Schedule the start of environmental qualification so that all tests are finished and a complete qualification report is available for the PPF Sample.
acceptance_criteria: Given the time schedule, when the PPF Sample is due, then all environmental qualification tests are finished.
Given the PPF Sample, when it is due, then a complete qualification report is available.
rationale: Role assumed: project manager. "That early" is not quantified.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall execute all the tasks in each of the rate groups that have been installed in the current mode.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS198] execute all the tasks in each of the rate groups that have been installed in the current mode.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to execute all tasks of each rate group installed in the current mode, so that every installed task runs.
technical_task: Run every task in each rate group that is installed in the current mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given rate groups installed in the current mode, when the scheduler runs, then all their tasks are executed.
Given a rate group not installed in the current mode, when the scheduler runs, then its tasks are not executed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to search for available distributed location templates(if any).
user_story: As a user, I want to search for available distributed location templates, if there are any, so that I can reuse them.
technical_task: Offer a search for available distributed location templates.
acceptance_criteria: Given available distributed location templates, when the user searches, then matching templates are listed.
Given no distributed location templates, when the user searches, then no templates are listed.

requirement_text: HTML code generates the cart display based on the current contents of the cart.
user_story: As a customer, I want the cart display to show the current contents of my cart, so that I see what I will buy.
technical_task: Generate the cart display with HTML from the current contents of the cart.
acceptance_criteria: Given items in the cart, when the cart is displayed, then it shows the current contents.
Given the cart changes, when it is displayed again, then it shows the updated contents.

requirement_text: System shall display the video in full screen resolution.
user_story: As a viewer, I want the video displayed in full screen resolution, so that I can see it large.
technical_task: Display videos at full screen resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video, when the viewer chooses full screen, then it is displayed at full screen resolution.
Given a video displayed in full screen, when it plays, then it fills the screen.

requirement_text: System shall deny access and display an error message if the ID card is invalid.
user_story: As a cardholder, I want access denied and an error message shown when my ID card is invalid, so that I know why I cannot enter.
technical_task: Refuse access and show an error message for an invalid ID card.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid ID card, when it is presented, then access is denied.
Given an invalid ID card, when access is denied, then an error message is displayed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to log in with their email and password and receive a message indicating successful sign-in.
user_story: As a user, I want to log in with my email and password and see a message that sign-in succeeded, so that I know I am in.
technical_task: Provide login by email and password with a success message after sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email and password, when the user logs in, then the user is signed in.
Given a successful sign-in, when it completes, then a message indicates successful sign-in.

requirement_text: User shall provide valid details to create an account on the STM website.
user_story: As a new user, I want to provide valid details to create an account on the STM website, so that I can use the site.
technical_task: Require valid details when an account is created on the STM website.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid details, when the user creates an account, then the account is created.
Given invalid details, when the user tries to create an account, then no account is created.

requirement_text: User shall report inappropriate content if encountered.
user_story: As a user, I want to report inappropriate content I encounter, so that it can be reviewed.
technical_task: Add a report function for inappropriate content.
acceptance_criteria: Given a piece of content, when the user reports it as inappropriate, then the report is saved.
Given a saved report, when it is reviewed, then it identifies the reported content.

requirement_text: It has to be assured that it is not possible to get a badly calculated engine position (and as a result injections at incorrect angular positions) even if the crank signal is disrupted intermittently.
user_story: As a powertrain engineer, I want to be sure a badly calculated engine position cannot occur even if the crank signal is disrupted intermittently, so that injections happen at correct angular positions.
technical_task: Make the engine position calculation robust against intermittent crank signal disruptions so that incorrect injection angles cannot result.
acceptance_criteria: Given the crank signal is disrupted intermittently, when the engine position is calculated, then it is not badly calculated.
Given the engine position, when injections are triggered, then they occur at correct angular positions.

requirement_text: The healthcare portal shall have high availability, with minimal downtime for scheduled maintenance and updates.
user_story: As a patient, I want the healthcare portal highly available with minimal downtime for scheduled maintenance and updates, so that I can reach it when needed.
technical_task: Run the healthcare portal for high availability and keep downtime for scheduled maintenance and updates as short as possible.
acceptance_criteria: Given normal operation, when a patient opens the portal, then it is available.
Given scheduled maintenance or an update, when it takes place, then the downtime is kept minimal.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. "High availability" and "minimal downtime" are not quantified.

requirement_text: Support Services shall use no more than 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move the telemetry data to the FCC-MPCC board and complete communication and error handling for the FCC-MPCC board.
requirement_text_raw: Support Services shall [SRS257] use no more than 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move the telemetry data to the FCC-MPCC board and complete communication and error handling for the FCC-MPCC board.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Support Services to use at most 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move telemetry data to the FCC-MPCC board and handle communication and errors, so that FCP time is bounded.
technical_task: Limit Support Services use of FCP processing time to 5.2 milliseconds for moving telemetry data to the FCC-MPCC board and completing communication and error handling for it.
acceptance_criteria: Given telemetry data is moved to the FCC-MPCC board, when the FCP processing time of Support Services is measured, then it is no more than 5.2 milliseconds.
Given communication and error handling for the FCC-MPCC board, when they are included in the measurement, then the total is still no more than 5.2 milliseconds.

requirement_text: System shall be able to delete user location information nightly via a cron job.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want user location information deleted every night by a cron job, so that it is not kept longer than needed.
technical_task: Schedule a nightly cron job that deletes stored user location information.
acceptance_criteria: Given stored user location information, when the nightly cron job runs, then it is deleted.
Given location information stored after the job has run, when the next night comes, then it is deleted by the next run.

requirement_text: Website must be connected to a web server to make it available worldwide.
user_story: As a site owner, I want the website connected to a web server, so that it is available worldwide.
technical_task: Connect the website to a web server that makes it reachable worldwide.
acceptance_criteria: Given the website, when it is deployed, then it is connected to a web server.
Given the web server, when a user anywhere accesses the website, then the website is available.

requirement_text: The system shall be available at all times, only restricted by server downtime, and show a replacement page in case of hardware failure or database corruption.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available at all times except for server downtime, and a replacement page shown when hardware fails or the database is corrupted, so that I see something useful instead of an error.
technical_task: Keep the system continuously available except during server downtime, and show a replacement page on hardware failure or database corruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given the server is up, when a user opens the system, then it is available.
Given a hardware failure or database corruption, when a user requests a page, then a replacement page is shown.

requirement_text: System shall securely manage user login credentials and patient data confidentiality.
user_story: As a patient, I want my login credentials and patient data kept secure and confidential, so that my information is protected.
technical_task: Store and handle login credentials and patient data with confidentiality controls.
acceptance_criteria: Given login credentials, when they are stored, then they are protected.
Given patient data, when an unauthorized person tries to read it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. The mechanisms are not specified.

requirement_text: Protection mechanisms are in place for sensitive data that is sent over the network.
user_story: As a security officer, I want protection mechanisms for sensitive data sent over the network, so that it is not exposed.
technical_task: Apply protection mechanisms to sensitive data transmitted over the network.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data to be sent over the network, when it is sent, then a protection mechanism is applied.
Given sensitive data on the network, when an unauthorized party intercepts it, then it cannot be read.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The mechanisms are not listed.

requirement_text: System Initialization shall , when all other activities are completed, start the 50 Hz timer and enable the timer interrupt. This will allow the interrupt handler to initiate normal activities.
requirement_text_raw: System Initialization shall [SRS199], when all other activities are completed, start the 50 Hz timer and enable the timer interrupt.  This will allow the interrupt handler to initiate normal activities.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want System Initialization to start the 50 Hz timer and enable the timer interrupt once all other activities are completed, so that the interrupt handler can begin normal activities.
technical_task: After all other initialization activities complete, start the 50 Hz timer and enable the timer interrupt.
acceptance_criteria: Given all other initialization activities are completed, when System Initialization continues, then it starts the 50 Hz timer.
Given the 50 Hz timer is started, when System Initialization continues, then the timer interrupt is enabled so the interrupt handler can initiate normal activities.

requirement_text: The scope of FDIR shall be limited to the hardware on the four FCP boards, the four MPCC/CTC boards, the five ICPs, and the five NEs.
requirement_text_raw: The scope of FDIR shall (3.3.5.1) be limited to the hardware on the four FCP boards, the four MPCC/CTC boards, the five ICPs, and the five NEs.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scope of FDIR limited to the hardware on the four FCP boards, four MPCC/CTC boards, five ICPs and five NEs, so that its responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Limit FDIR's scope to the hardware on the four FCP boards, the four MPCC/CTC boards, the five ICPs and the five NEs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the hardware on the four FCP boards, the four MPCC/CTC boards, the five ICPs and the five NEs, when FDIR operates, then it covers it.
Given hardware outside these boards, ICPs and NEs, when FDIR operates, then it is not within its scope.

requirement_text: The Separation Elapsed Time shall have a drift rate of at worst 50 PPM.
requirement_text_raw: The Separation Elapsed Time shall [SRS219] have a drift rate of at worst 50 PPM.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Separation Elapsed Time drift rate to be at worst 50 PPM, so that separation timing is accurate.
technical_task: Keep the drift rate of the Separation Elapsed Time within 50 PPM.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Separation Elapsed Time is running, when its drift rate is measured, then it is at worst 50 PPM.
Given a drift rate above 50 PPM, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

user_story: As a seller, I want help keeping a list of my products and their information in my profile, so that my offering is current.

acceptance_criteria: Given a seller profile, when the seller adds a product with its information, then it is saved in the list.
Given the product list, when the seller opens the profile, then the products and their information are shown.

requirement_text_raw: A database management system such as Oracle  DB2  MySql or HSQL will need to be integrated with the product.'

requirement_text_raw: This system shall (3.1.4) provide real time redundancy and fault tolerance among the four FCCs and the NEFU.

acceptance_criteria: Given a fault in one of the four FCCs, when it occurs, then the system continues to operate through the remaining units in real time.
Given a fault in the NEFU, when it occurs, then the system continues to operate in real time.

technical_task: Provide a booking function for clients.
acceptance_criteria: Given the booking page, when a client submits a booking, then it is saved.
Given a saved booking, when the client views their bookings, then it is listed.

requirement_text: Individual or package job adverts shall be purchasable by credit card.
user_story: As an employer, I want to buy individual or package job adverts by credit card, so that I can post jobs.

acceptance_criteria: Given a job advert or a package, when the employer pays by credit card, then the purchase is completed.
Given a failed credit card payment, when it ends, then the advert is not purchased.

requirement_text: The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'
user_story: As a customer, I want the website to keep operating when the payment gateway goes down, so that I can still browse.
technical_task: Keep the website running when the payment gateway is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the payment gateway is down, when a customer uses the website, then the website continues to operate.
Given the payment gateway is down, when a customer tries to pay, then the website handles the failure without stopping.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. What the website does for payment during an outage is not stated.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall , within 60 milliseconds after 1.5 minutes has elapsed since the voted reset was sent to the failed channel, if the voted reset fails to recover the failed channel and alignment is still allowed, request from the application a power cycle of the channel. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS208], within 60 milliseconds after 1.5 minutes has elapsed since the voted reset was sent to the failed channel, if the voted reset fails to recover the failed channel and alignment is still allowed, request from the application a power cycle of the channel. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to request a power cycle of a failed channel 60 milliseconds after 1.5 minutes have passed since the voted reset, if the reset did not recover it and alignment is still allowed, so that the channel gets a further recovery attempt.
technical_task: Within 60 milliseconds after 1.5 minutes have passed since the voted reset was sent, request an application power cycle of the failed channel if the reset failed and alignment is still allowed.
acceptance_criteria: Given 1.5 minutes have passed since the voted reset was sent and the channel is not recovered and alignment is still allowed, when Redundancy Management checks, then it requests from the application a power cycle of the channel within 60 milliseconds.
Given the channel has recovered, when Redundancy Management checks, then no power cycle is requested.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. NEFU recovery does not depend on alignment, per the note.

requirement_text: User shall be able to report errors encountered during system use.

acceptance_criteria: Given an error during use, when the user reports it, then the report is saved.
Given a saved error report, when it is reviewed, then it describes the error.

user_story: As a student, I want to view the detailed attributes of a single assignment, so that I know exactly what it requires.
technical_task: Show a detail view of one assignment's attributes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an assignment, when the user opens it, then its detailed attributes are shown.
Given two assignments, when the user opens each, then each shows its own attributes.

user_story: As an organizer, I want to link BADCamp attendees to their sponsorship page, so that attendance is showcased.
technical_task: Add a link from each BADCamp attendee to their sponsorship page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a BADCamp attendee with a sponsorship page, when the organizer links them, then the attendee is linked to the sponsorship page.
Given a linked attendee, when the sponsorship page is viewed, then the attendance is shown.

user_story: As a facility manager, I want access control measures such as secure validation methods on the cabin door, so that only authorized people enter.

requirement_text: The system shall qualify the certainty of each sensed data item during acquisition, flagging doubtful data due to errors or unexpected values.
user_story: As a data analyst, I want the certainty of each sensed data item qualified during acquisition, with doubtful data flagged, so that I can judge the data.

acceptance_criteria: Given a sensed data item, when it is acquired, then its certainty is qualified.
Given a data item with errors or unexpected values, when it is acquired, then it is flagged as doubtful.

user_story: As a mobile user, I want the user interfaces to follow the Android User Interface Guidelines, so that the app feels familiar.

acceptance_criteria: Given a user interface, when it is reviewed against the Android User Interface Guidelines, then it conforms.
