technical_task: Make the test features available in environments other than Staging.
acceptance_criteria: Given an environment other than Staging, when a tester opens the system, then the test features are accessible.
Given the Staging environment, when a tester opens the system, then the test features remain accessible as before.
rationale: Role stated: tester. "Comprehensive" testing is not measured.

requirement_text: The administrator will store (1) hospital Id number for the hospital ; and (2) up to 30 alphanumeric characters giving the name of the hospital.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to store a hospital ID number and a hospital name of up to 30 alphanumeric characters, so that hospitals are identified.
technical_task: Store for each hospital an ID number and a name limited to 30 alphanumeric characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hospital, when the administrator enters an ID number and a name of up to 30 alphanumeric characters, then they are stored.
Given a name longer than 30 characters, when the administrator enters it, then it is not accepted.

requirement_text: The GSM bearer services [EN 301 515, Index [23]] to be supported are listed in table 2-2.
rationale: The sentence points to a table that is not given.
clarification_questions: Which GSM bearer services are listed in the referenced table?
Is the table part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Confirmation of remaining credits shall be provided after each job posting.
user_story: As an employer, I want confirmation of my remaining credits after each job posting, so that I know how many I have left.
technical_task: Show the employer's remaining credits after each job posting.
acceptance_criteria: Given a job posting is made, when it completes, then a confirmation of remaining credits is shown.
Given two job postings in a row, when the second completes, then the remaining credits reflect both.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall , if power cycle requests fail to result in a recovered channel, request the application to power down the channel and declare the channel to be permanently failed. Note that the same result will occur if the application software ignores or fails to respond to power cycle requests.
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS211], if power cycle requests fail to result in a recovered channel, request the application to power down the channel and declare the channel to be permanently failed.  Note that the same result will occur if the application software ignores or fails to respond to power cycle requests.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to ask the application to power down a channel and declare it permanently failed when power cycle requests fail, so that a dead channel is retired.
technical_task: If power cycle requests do not recover the channel, request the application to power down the channel and declare it permanently failed, which also applies if the application ignores or fails to respond.
acceptance_criteria: Given power cycle requests fail to result in a recovered channel, when Redundancy Management handles it, then it requests the application to power down the channel and declares the channel permanently failed.
Given the application ignores or fails to respond to power cycle requests, when Redundancy Management handles it, then the channel is likewise declared permanently failed.

requirement_text: The system shall display an error message if the new user is not active in the Active Directory.
user_story: As an administrator, I want an error message shown when a new user is not active in the Active Directory, so that I know why the user cannot be added.
technical_task: Display an error message when the new user is not active in the Active Directory.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user who is not active in the Active Directory, when the user is added, then an error message is displayed.
Given a new user who is active in the Active Directory, when the user is added, then no such error message is displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall display car information in a user-friendly format.
clarification_questions: What makes a format "user-friendly" for car information?
Which car information must be shown?

requirement_text: It defines a number of wiring and signaling standards for the Physical Layer of the OSI networking model, through means of network access at the Media Access Control (MAC) / Data Link Layer, and a common addressing format.
rationale: The sentence describes a networking standard and states no requirement for the system.
clarification_questions: What is "It" and what must the system do?
Is this a description of a standard rather than a requirement?

requirement_text: User shall upload examination questions and set parameters.
user_story: As an examiner, I want to upload examination questions and set parameters, so that exams are prepared.
technical_task: Provide upload of examination questions and settings for exam parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Given examination questions, when the user uploads them, then they are saved.
Given an exam, when the user sets parameters, then the parameters are saved.
rationale: Role assumed: examiner. The parameters are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to browse items and see their pictures, prices, and other features.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to browse items and see their pictures, prices and other features, so that I can choose what to buy.
technical_task: Display items with pictures, prices and other features for browsing.
acceptance_criteria: Given items for sale, when the user browses, then they are listed.
Given an item in the list, when it is displayed, then its picture, price and other features are shown.

requirement_text: User shall browse and compare available products before making a purchase.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to browse and compare available products before buying, so that I can choose well.
technical_task: Offer product browsing and a comparison of available products before purchase.
acceptance_criteria: Given available products, when the user browses, then they are shown.
Given selected products, when the user compares them, then their features are shown together.

requirement_text: This documentation will be available in electronic files, and, with the exception of source code, in hard copy format.
user_story: As a project manager, I want documentation available as electronic files and, except for source code, as hard copy, so that it can be read in either form.
technical_task: Deliver the documentation as electronic files and provide hard copies of everything except source code.
acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when it is delivered, then it is available in electronic files.
Given the documentation other than source code, when it is delivered, then it is also available in hard copy format.

requirement_text: User shall be able to deposit datasets through Pure, ensuring a centralized platform for managing research outputs.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to deposit datasets through Pure, so that research outputs are managed in one central platform.
technical_task: Support dataset deposit through Pure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when the user deposits it through Pure, then the dataset is deposited.
Given a deposited dataset, when research outputs are viewed, then it is listed in the central platform.

requirement_text: System shall redirect user to the particular company's portal upon selecting 'give up LPG subsidy' option.
user_story: As a gas customer, I want to be redirected to my company's portal when I select the give up LPG subsidy option, so that I can complete the process there.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the particular company's portal when the give up LPG subsidy option is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given the give up LPG subsidy option, when the user selects it, then the user is redirected to the portal of the particular company.
Given another option, when the user selects it, then no redirect to the company's portal takes place.

requirement_text: The User agrees that absent express written authorization from the appropriate System Manager or the person designated in section 20 of this Agreement to do so the User shall not attempt to link records included in the file(s) specified in section 5 to any other individually identifiable source of information.
requirement_text_raw: The User agrees that  absent express written authorization from the appropriate System Manager or the person  designated in section 20 of this Agreement to do so  the User shall not attempt to link records included in the  file(s) specified in section 5 to any other individually identifiable source of information.
rationale: The sentence is a legal obligation on the user with no stated system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement for the system or a condition of a data use agreement?
What must the system do to prevent linking of records?

requirement_text: The system shall generate reports on sales, inventory, prescriptions dispensed, etc.
user_story: As a manager, I want reports on sales, inventory and prescriptions dispensed, so that I can monitor the business.
technical_task: Generate reports on sales, inventory and prescriptions dispensed, among others.
acceptance_criteria: Given sales data, when the manager requests a sales report, then it is generated.
Given inventory or dispensed prescriptions, when the manager requests the related report, then it is generated.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. "Etc." means other reports may exist.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to view friends' stories, browse global stories, share stories, take screenshots, and report spam content.
user_story: As a user, I want to view friends' stories, browse global stories, share stories, take screenshots and report spam content, so that I can use the story features.
technical_task: Provide viewing of friends' stories, browsing of global stories, sharing, screenshots and spam reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Given friends with stories, when the user opens them, then friends' stories are shown.
Given global stories, when the user browses, then they are shown, and the user can share a story, take a screenshot or report spam content.

requirement_text: User shall have a profile page where they can edit information such as password, email address, and phone number.
user_story: As a user, I want a profile page where I can edit my password, email address and phone number, so that my details stay current.
technical_task: Create a profile page with editing of password, email address and phone number.
acceptance_criteria: Given the profile page, when the user changes the email address or phone number, then the change is saved.
Given the profile page, when the user changes the password, then the new password is saved.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means other fields may exist.

requirement_text: On the other hand the routine will be stopped if the battery current does not become small enough while zero current control is forced.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want the routine stopped when the battery current does not become small enough while zero current control is forced, so that it does not run forever.
technical_task: Stop the routine when the battery current does not become small enough while zero current control is forced.
acceptance_criteria: Given zero current control is forced, when the battery current does not become small enough, then the routine is stopped.
Given zero current control is forced, when the battery current becomes small enough, then the routine is not stopped for this reason.
rationale: Role assumed: battery engineer. "Small enough" is not quantified.

requirement_text: The solution should provide reports for records of information solution activity such as audit logs access reports and security incident tracking reports.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide reports for records of information solution activity  such as audit logs  access reports  and security incident tracking reports.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want reports of solution activity such as audit logs, access reports and security incident tracking reports, so that I can review what happened.
technical_task: Provide reports of information solution activity including audit logs, access reports and security incident tracking reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given solution activity, when the user requests an audit log report, then it is produced.
Given access and security incidents, when the user requests an access report or a security incident tracking report, then it is produced.

requirement_text: For details see [PLGW_R-109] chapters `` Generation of Scc_15118MessagingControl enable '' [SCC-6317] and `` Generation of Scc_15118MessagingControl disable '' [SCC-7145].
rationale: The sentence only points to chapters of another document.
clarification_questions: What do the referenced chapters on enabling and disabling Scc_15118MessagingControl require?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Subscription packages shall have a duration of one month.
user_story: As a customer, I want subscription packages to last one month, so that I know how long I am covered.
technical_task: Set the duration of subscription packages to one month.
acceptance_criteria: Given a subscription package, when it is purchased, then it runs for one month.
Given a subscription package one month after purchase, when the month ends, then it expires.

requirement_text: In cases of faults such as incorrect polarity, overvoltage, short circuits, etc. the component must not be damaged.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the component not to be damaged by faults such as incorrect polarity, overvoltage and short circuits, so that it survives wiring mistakes.
technical_task: Protect the component against incorrect polarity, overvoltage, short circuits and similar faults.
acceptance_criteria: Given incorrect polarity, when it is applied to the component, then the component is not damaged.
Given an overvoltage or a short circuit, when it is applied, then the component is not damaged.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. "Etc." means other faults may be covered.

requirement_text: The APAF system shall process the engineering and ancillary information necessary for calibration and science validation into IDFS data sets.
requirement_text_raw:
The APAF system shall process the engineering and ancillary information necessary for calibration and science validation
into IDFS data sets.
user_story: As a calibration scientist, I want the APAF system to process the engineering and ancillary information needed for calibration and science validation into IDFS data sets, so that I can calibrate and validate.
technical_task: Convert the engineering and ancillary information required for calibration and science validation into IDFS data sets in the APAF system.
acceptance_criteria: Given engineering and ancillary information needed for calibration and science validation, when the APAF system processes it, then IDFS data sets are produced.
Given an IDFS data set, when it is opened, then it contains the processed information.

requirement_text: The solution should implement two-factor authentication for granting remote access to solutions that contain EPHI.
user_story: As a security officer, I want two-factor authentication for remote access to solutions that contain EPHI, so that remote access is protected.
technical_task: Require two-factor authentication before remote access is granted to solutions containing EPHI.
acceptance_criteria: Given a remote user and a solution containing EPHI, when the user provides both authentication factors, then remote access is granted.
Given a remote user who provides only one factor, when the user requests access to a solution containing EPHI, then access is not granted.

requirement_text: Broker user shall have updated error codes that accurately reflect logic and provide enough information.
rationale: "Accurately reflect logic" and "enough information" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: Which error codes must be updated and what must they reflect?
What is "enough information" in testable terms?

requirement_text: The FDIR shall execute CBIT during all operational phases.
requirement_text_raw: The FDIR shall (3.3.5.4) execute CBIT during all operational phases.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FDIR to execute CBIT during all operational phases, so that built-in tests run continuously.
technical_task: Run CBIT from FDIR in every operational phase.
acceptance_criteria: Given any operational phase, when FDIR runs, then it executes CBIT.
Given a change of operational phase, when it occurs, then CBIT is still executed in the new phase.

requirement_text: The HCP selects a patient to deactivate.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to select a patient to deactivate, so that inactive patients are marked.
technical_task: Let the HCP choose a patient and deactivate them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when the HCP selects the patient to deactivate, then the patient is deactivated.
Given a deactivated patient, when the patient list is viewed, then the patient is shown as deactivated.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to freely add items with details, price, amount, and pictures.
user_story: As a seller, I want to add items with details, price, amount and pictures, so that buyers can see what I offer.
technical_task: Provide an item form with details, price, amount and picture upload.
acceptance_criteria: Given the item form, when the user enters details, price, amount and pictures and saves, then the item is added.
Given a saved item, when it is viewed, then its details, price, amount and pictures are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: seller. "Freely" is read as without restriction on the number of items.

requirement_text: After a message in the message inbox is read (i.e. displayed in a new page) the row for the message in the message inbox is not bolded anymore.
requirement_text_raw: After a message in the message inbox is read (i.e.  displayed in a new page)  the row for the message in the message inbox is not bolded anymore.
user_story: As a user, I want a message row no longer shown in bold once I have read the message, so that I can tell read from unread.
technical_task: Remove the bold style from a message's row in the inbox after the message has been displayed on a new page.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unread message in the message inbox, when the message is displayed in a new page, then its row is no longer bolded.
Given an unread message that has not been opened, when the inbox is displayed, then its row is bolded.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation of the bold-until-read behaviour.

requirement_text: User shall/will have sensitive data encrypted during transmission and storage.
user_story: As a user, I want my sensitive data encrypted in transmission and storage, so that it stays private.
technical_task: Encrypt sensitive data when it is sent and when it is stored.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data being transmitted, when it is sent, then it is encrypted.
Given sensitive data being stored, when it is saved, then it is encrypted.

requirement_text: Supervisor shall select thermostat and desired temperature setting from available options.
user_story: As a supervisor, I want to select a thermostat and a desired temperature setting from available options, so that I can control the temperature.
technical_task: Offer lists of thermostats and temperature settings for the supervisor to choose from.
acceptance_criteria: Given available thermostats, when the supervisor opens the selection, then they can choose a thermostat.
Given available temperature settings, when the supervisor chooses one, then it is set as the desired temperature.

requirement_text: The system shall have adequate RAM to handle complex projects and large files without lag or slowdown.
clarification_questions: How much RAM counts as "adequate" and what are "complex projects" and "large files"?
What counts as lag or slowdown?

requirement_text: The parameter set and details of the measurements (resolution, sampling rate, etc.) must be coordinated with the client and documented in the technical specifications or in the component test specifications.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the parameter set and measurement details coordinated with the client and documented, so that tests are agreed.
technical_task: Coordinate the parameter set and the details of the measurements (resolution, sampling rate and others) with the client and document them in the technical specifications or the component test specifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given the parameter set and measurement details, when they are prepared, then they are coordinated with the client.
Given the coordinated details, when the documents are reviewed, then they are documented in the technical specifications or in the component test specifications.
rationale: Role assumed: project manager. The measurement values are not given.

requirement_text: User will input a new password and confirm the password.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter a new password and confirm it, so that I avoid typing mistakes.
technical_task: Provide fields for a new password and its confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new password and confirmation fields, when both match, then the new password is accepted.
Given the new password and confirmation fields, when they differ, then the new password is rejected.

requirement_text: Communications services shall provide a version of Immediate Message Services between rate groups within the FCP that bypasses the NE and that can be used to control and monitor inter-rate group communications.
requirement_text_raw: Communications services shall (3.3.6.13) provide a version of Immediate Message Services between rate groups within the FCP that bypasses the NE and that can be used to control and monitor inter-rate group communications.
user_story: As a software developer, I want a version of Immediate Message Services between rate groups within the FCP that bypasses the NE, so that I can control and monitor inter-rate group communication.
technical_task: Provide an Immediate Message Services version between rate groups on the FCP that does not go through the NE and supports controlling and monitoring inter-rate group communications.
acceptance_criteria: Given two rate groups within the FCP, when a message is sent with this service, then it bypasses the NE.
Given inter-rate group communications, when this service is used, then they can be controlled and monitored.

requirement_text: A new stylistic map must be geographically correct.
user_story: As a user, I want a new stylistic map to be geographically correct, so that I can trust its locations.
technical_task: Check that the new stylistic map matches real geographic positions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new stylistic map, when its positions are compared with real geography, then they are geographically correct.
Given a location on the map, when it is looked up, then it appears at the correct geographic position.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The tolerance for "correct" is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall be easy to use.
rationale: "Easy to use" is subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How is "easy to use" measured?
Which users and tasks does it apply to?

requirement_text: User shall be advised to use genuine antivirus software.
user_story: As a user, I want to be advised to use genuine antivirus software, so that my device stays protected.
technical_task: Show users advice to use genuine antivirus software.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user of the software, when the advice is due, then the user is advised to use genuine antivirus software.
Given the advice, when the user reads it, then it recommends genuine antivirus software.
rationale: Role assumed: user. When the advice is shown is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall add items to the shopping cart with a response time of less than 1 second, enhancing the shopping experience.
user_story: As a shopper, I want items added to my cart in less than 1 second, so that shopping feels quick.
technical_task: Make adding an item to the shopping cart take less than 1 second.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item, when the user adds it to the shopping cart, then it is added in less than 1 second.
Given an addition that takes 1 second or longer, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: When the IBIT is complete, the FTSS in the channels that are part of the fault masking group shall report the results of IBIT for all Radstone boards to the application software for telemetry.
requirement_text_raw: When the IBIT is complete, the FTSS in the channels that are part of the fault masking group shall [SRS239] report the results of IBIT for all Radstone boards to the application software for telemetry.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FTSS in the fault masking group channels to report the IBIT results for all Radstone boards to the application software when IBIT is complete, so that results reach telemetry.
technical_task: When IBIT completes, have the FTSS in each channel of the fault masking group report the IBIT results for all Radstone boards to the application software for telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Given IBIT is complete, when the FTSS in a channel that is part of the fault masking group reports, then the results of IBIT for all Radstone boards are sent to the application software.
Given the reported results, when the application builds telemetry, then they can be included in the telemetry.

requirement_text: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information when exchanged.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want electronic health information encrypted and decrypted when it is exchanged, so that exchanges are secure.
technical_task: Encrypt electronic health information before it is exchanged and decrypt it on receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information to be exchanged, when it is sent, then it is encrypted.
Given encrypted electronic health information received, when it arrives, then it is decrypted.

requirement_text: System Initialization shall initiate the watchdog timer.
requirement_text_raw: System Initialization shall [SRS014] initiate the watchdog timer.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want System Initialization to start the watchdog timer, so that hangs are detected.
technical_task: Have System Initialization start the watchdog timer.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is initializing, when System Initialization runs, then the watchdog timer is started.
Given System Initialization has finished, when the system is running, then the watchdog timer is active.

requirement_text: This operating status describes the situation in a parked and closed vehicle.
rationale: The sentence describes a situation and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which operating status is meant?
What must the system do in a parked and closed vehicle?

requirement_text: Maintenance and updates of the site will be carried out by developers and a team of software engineers.
rationale: The sentence says who does maintenance and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement on the system or a statement about who maintains it?
What maintenance and update capabilities must the site offer?

requirement_text: The system shall produce failure reports indicating internal system component failures, including error number and time stamp.
user_story: As a system operator, I want failure reports for internal component failures with the error number and a time stamp, so that I can diagnose failures.
technical_task: Produce reports of internal system component failures that include an error number and a time stamp.
acceptance_criteria: Given an internal system component fails, when the failure occurs, then a failure report is produced.
Given a failure report, when it is read, then it shows the error number and the time stamp.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner shall have a responsive design that adapts to different screen sizes and devices.
user_story: As a parent, I want Crafty kids corner to adapt to different screen sizes and devices, so that my child can use it on any device.
technical_task: Build Crafty kids corner with a responsive layout that adapts to screen size and device.
acceptance_criteria: Given different screen sizes, when the site is displayed, then the layout adapts.
Given different devices, when the site is opened, then it is usable on each.

requirement_text: Agency user shall be able to leave off the last 4 digits of the ZIP without an error.
user_story: As an agency user, I want to leave off the last 4 digits of the ZIP without an error, so that I can enter a shorter ZIP.
technical_task: Accept a ZIP without its last 4 digits and do not raise an error.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ZIP entered without the last 4 digits, when it is submitted, then it is accepted without an error.
Given a ZIP entered with the last 4 digits, when it is submitted, then it is also accepted.

requirement_text: The system shall guide users through an interface based on end user concepts.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface to guide me using concepts I know as an end user, so that I can find my way.
technical_task: Base the interface's structure and labels on end user concepts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the interface, when it is reviewed, then its structure and labels follow end user concepts.
Given a task, when the user performs it, then the interface guides the user through it.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which concepts are meant is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall increment the streak counter for daily snapping and reset it to zero upon a break in the chain.
user_story: As a user, I want my streak counter to increase for daily snapping and reset to zero when I break the chain, so that it reflects my streak.
technical_task: Increase the streak counter on each day of snapping and reset it to zero when the chain is broken.
acceptance_criteria: Given a day on which the user snaps, when the day is counted, then the streak counter is incremented.
Given a break in the chain, when a day passes without a snap, then the streak counter is reset to zero.

requirement_text: The user shall select and delete a task in one action.
user_story: As a user, I want to select and delete a task in one action, so that removing tasks is quick.
technical_task: Allow a task to be selected and deleted in a single action.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task, when the user selects and deletes it in one action, then the task is deleted.
Given a deleted task, when the task list is viewed, then it is no longer listed.

requirement_text: User shall/will be presented with a login screen featuring fields for username, password, and role selection (Administrator, Student, Teacher).
user_story: As a user, I want a login screen with fields for username and password and a role selection of Administrator, Student or Teacher, so that I can sign in with my role.
technical_task: Show a login screen with username and password fields and a role selection with Administrator, Student and Teacher.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when it is displayed, then it has fields for username and password.
Given the role selection, when the user opens it, then Administrator, Student and Teacher are offered.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall perform memory alignment on a major frame boundary upon successful synchronization of all members of the FCP virtual group.
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS125] perform memory alignment on a major frame boundary upon successful synchronization of all members of the FCP virtual group.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to perform memory alignment on a major frame boundary after all members of the FCP virtual group have synchronized, so that alignment starts at a defined time.
technical_task: Perform memory alignment on a major frame boundary once all members of the FCP virtual group are successfully synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: Given all members of the FCP virtual group are synchronized, when the next major frame boundary arrives, then Redundancy Management performs memory alignment.
Given not all members are synchronized, when a major frame boundary arrives, then memory alignment is not performed.

requirement_text: Text box will originally contain a suggestive text question, to guide the user to the format of an appropriate question.
user_story: As a user, I want the text box to start with a suggestive question, so that I know how to word my question.
technical_task: Prefill the text box with a suggested question that shows the format of an appropriate question.
acceptance_criteria: Given the text box when it is first shown, when it is displayed, then it contains a suggestive text question.
Given the suggestive text, when the user reads it, then it shows the format of an appropriate question.

requirement_text: The product shall allow for customization of start page and views preferences.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall allow for customization of start page and views preferences.'
user_story: As a user, I want to customize my start page and view preferences, so that the product opens the way I like.
technical_task: Add settings for start page and view preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Given the settings, when the user changes the start page, then the new start page is used.
Given the settings, when the user changes view preferences, then the new view preferences are applied.

requirement_text: User shall be able to interact with the text-based command-line interface of the system.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to interact with the system through a text-based command-line interface, so that I can use it from a terminal.
technical_task: Provide a text-based command-line interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the command-line interface, when the user enters a command, then the system executes it.
Given the command-line interface, when the user enters an unknown command, then the system reports it.

requirement_text: The system's overall stability shall depend on the stability of its components and underlying operating system.
rationale: The sentence states a dependency and no testable behaviour or target.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an observation about dependencies?
What stability target must the system reach?

requirement_text: The SEP shall be congruent across all FCP members.
requirement_text_raw: The SEP shall (3.3.10.16) be congruent across all FCP members.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the SEP to be congruent across all FCP members, so that they share the same value.
technical_task: Keep the SEP congruent on every FCP member.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP members, when their SEP values are compared, then they are congruent.
Given an update to the SEP, when it completes, then all FCP members still have congruent values.

requirement_text: Adobe Creative Cloud shall provide users with access to other Adobe creative applications (e.g., Photoshop, Premiere) to enhance their creative workflow by enabling seamless integration.
user_story: As a designer, I want Adobe Creative Cloud to give me access to other Adobe creative applications such as Photoshop and Premiere, so that I can use them together.
technical_task: Provide access from Adobe Creative Cloud to other Adobe creative applications, for example Photoshop and Premiere.
acceptance_criteria: Given Adobe Creative Cloud, when a user looks for other creative applications, then Photoshop and Premiere are accessible.
Given an Adobe creative application, when the user opens it from Adobe Creative Cloud, then it starts.

requirement_text: An API User shall be able to identify Data Publishers.
user_story: As an API user, I want to identify Data Publishers, so that I know who published data.
technical_task: Offer an API function that identifies Data Publishers.
acceptance_criteria: Given published data, when the API user asks who published it, then the Data Publisher is identified.
Given several Data Publishers, when the API user lists them, then each is identified.

requirement_text: User shall be prompted to enter their serial key, and the system shall verify information and password with the service provider.
user_story: As a user, I want to be asked for my serial key and have the system verify my information and password with the service provider, so that my copy is validated.
technical_task: Prompt for the serial key and verify the information and password with the service provider.
acceptance_criteria: Given the serial key prompt, when the user enters a serial key, then the system verifies the information and password with the service provider.
Given an invalid serial key or password, when verification fails, then access is not granted.

requirement_text: Once a company selects a candidate, they shall not be allowed to reject them; otherwise, the company will be blacklisted.
user_story: As a candidate, I want a company that selects me not to be allowed to reject me afterwards, with the company blacklisted otherwise, so that selections are binding.
technical_task: Prevent a company from rejecting a candidate after selecting them and blacklist a company that does.
acceptance_criteria: Given a company has selected a candidate, when the company tries to reject the candidate, then the rejection is not allowed.
Given a company that rejects a candidate it has selected, when this happens, then the company is blacklisted.
rationale: Role assumed: candidate. The two criteria cover the rule and its sanction.

requirement_text: To select the nearest object in path (the relevant object) the component calculates the predicted path of the own vehicle from yaw rate, wheel speeds, steering angle and detected stationary objects from both sides of the road.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the component to calculate the own vehicle's predicted path from yaw rate, wheel speeds, steering angle and detected stationary objects on both sides of the road, so that it can select the nearest relevant object in the path.
technical_task: Predict the path of the own vehicle from yaw rate, wheel speeds, steering angle and detected stationary objects from both sides of the road, and select the nearest object in the path as the relevant object.
acceptance_criteria: Given yaw rate, wheel speeds, steering angle and detected stationary objects from both sides of the road, when the component calculates, then it produces the predicted path of the own vehicle.
Given the predicted path, when objects are evaluated, then the nearest object in the path is selected as the relevant object.

requirement_text: System shall preserve both content and metadata within the repository.
user_story: As an archivist, I want both content and metadata preserved in the repository, so that nothing is lost.
technical_task: Store both the content and its metadata in the repository.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object with content and metadata, when it is stored, then both are preserved in the repository.
Given a stored object, when it is retrieved, then its content and its metadata are returned.

technical_task: Allow authorized healthcare providers to view and update patient EHRs.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized healthcare provider, when the provider opens a patient EHR, then it can be viewed and updated.
Given a user who is not an authorized healthcare provider, when the user tries to open a patient EHR, then access is denied.

user_story: As a project manager, I want the supplier to design the magnet mounting and the tolerance between the magnets and the rotor lamination or stacks, so that responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Assign to the supplier the design of the details for mounting the magnet and of the tolerance design between the magnets and the rotor lamination / stacks.
acceptance_criteria: Given the magnet mounting, when the design is delivered, then it was designed by the supplier.
Given the tolerance design between the magnets and the rotor lamination / stacks, when the design is delivered, then it was designed by the supplier.

requirement_text: By using the Predefined Routine Identifier `` Control Fail Save Reactions '' certain ECU internal DTC reactions shall be disabled.

technical_task: Disable certain ECU internal DTC reactions when the Predefined Routine Identifier "Control Fail Save Reactions" is used.

Given the routine is not used, when the ECU runs, then those DTC reactions remain enabled.

requirement_text: The supplier has to agree to details of geometry with the client after component awarding.

technical_task: Have the supplier agree the details of the component's geometry with the client after the component is awarded.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component has been awarded, when the supplier prepares the geometry details, then they are agreed with the client.

technical_task: Provide a de-identification function for health information that removes what identifies an individual or could reasonably identify them.
acceptance_criteria: Given health information, when it is de-identified, then it no longer identifies an individual.
Given de-identified health information, when it is reviewed, then it provides no reasonable basis to identify an individual.

user_story: As a client, I want the Qualification quality gate to set a date before each software or hardware release, so that the contractor reports the qualification state to me in time.

requirement_text: Immediate diagnostics readiness of all control modules shorter than 1 second after start or switch-on ignition shall be guaranteed (at least inquiry of part number).

acceptance_criteria: Given a control module, when it is started or the ignition is switched on, then it is ready for diagnostics in less than 1 second.

user_story: As a new user, I want an introductory conversation with ALFRED, so that I learn what it can do.
technical_task: Start an introductory conversation with ALFRED that explains its functionalities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when the user starts using ALFRED, then an introductory conversation is offered.
Given the introductory conversation, when it is completed, then the user has been told about ALFRED's functionalities.

user_story: As an employer or job seeker, I want to receive messages about my subscription, so that I stay informed about it.

user_story: As a compliance officer, I want users required to comply with data privacy, security and intellectual property laws, so that production use stays lawful.

Given a production environment, when legal notices are shown, then they cover licensing, copyrights, trademarks and usage restrictions.

requirement_text: The SEP shall be able to increment to at least 1 day without rolling over.
requirement_text_raw: The SEP shall (3.3.10.15) be able to increment to at least 1 day without rolling over.

technical_task: Enforce referential integrity between related records in the data store.
acceptance_criteria: Given a record that references another record, when the referenced record does not exist, then the change is rejected.
Given a referenced record, when it is removed while still referenced, then the system prevents the inconsistency.

user_story: As a developer, I want the system to use database indexing, so that queries perform better.

requirement_text_raw: The patient selects the type of appointment from a pull-down menu of the existing appointment types  enter the appointment date and start time (only a date or time equal or after the current date or time is allowed).
user_story: As a patient, I want to choose an appointment type from a pull-down menu and enter the appointment date and start time, so that I can book a visit.
technical_task: Show a pull-down menu of existing appointment types and accept an appointment date and start time that are not earlier than the current date or time.
acceptance_criteria: Given the pull-down menu, when the patient opens it, then the existing appointment types are listed.
Given a date and start time entered, when it is equal to or after the current date or time, then it is accepted, and otherwise it is rejected.

requirement_text: The dwell times of the measurements have to be chosen appropriately to the time constant of the tuners, amplifiers and the measurement equipment.
rationale: "Appropriately" is not measurable and no values are given.
clarification_questions: What counts as "appropriate" dwell times and what are the time constants?
Which tuners, amplifiers and measurement equipment are meant?

requirement_text: User shall be able to import metadata captured with a metadata tool into a Data Management Plan (DMP).
user_story: As a researcher, I want to import metadata captured with a metadata tool into a Data Management Plan, so that I do not retype it.
technical_task: Provide an import of metadata captured with a metadata tool into a Data Management Plan (DMP).
acceptance_criteria: Given metadata captured with a metadata tool, when the user imports it, then it is added to the Data Management Plan.
Given an imported file, when it is not valid metadata, then it is not added to the Data Management Plan.
rationale: Role assumed: researcher. The import format is not given.

requirement_text: It shall be possible for a single public identity to be associated with multiple CNDs where each association is allocated a unique private identity.
user_story: As a network operator, I want a single public identity associated with several CNDs, each with a unique private identity, so that one identity can serve many devices.
technical_task: Allow one public identity to be linked to multiple CNDs and allocate a unique private identity to each association.
acceptance_criteria: Given a public identity, when it is associated with several CNDs, then each association is allowed.
Given each association, when it is created, then a unique private identity is allocated to it.

requirement_text: Managers shall be able to edit existing tasks.
user_story: As a manager, I want to edit existing tasks, so that I can keep them up to date.
technical_task: Allow managers to edit tasks that already exist.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing task, when a manager changes it and saves, then the changes are stored.
Given an edited task, when it is viewed, then the updated values are shown.

requirement_text: The standard Save File dialog should appear next allowing you to save the generated batch file to your computer.
requirement_text_raw: The standard Save File dialog should appear next  allowing you to save the generated batch file to your computer.
user_story: As a user, I want the standard Save File dialog to appear so I can save the generated batch file to my computer, so that I keep a copy.
technical_task: Open the standard Save File dialog after the batch file is generated.
acceptance_criteria: Given a batch file has been generated, when the next step is reached, then the standard Save File dialog appears.
Given the Save File dialog, when the user confirms a location, then the batch file is saved to the computer.

requirement_text: User shall check the current status of their application using the application number.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to check my application status with the application number, so that I know where it stands.
technical_task: Provide a status lookup by application number.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid application number, when the user submits it, then the current status of the application is shown.
Given an unknown application number, when the user submits it, then no status is shown.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add a new academic year/term to add the exam.
user_story: As an examiner, I want to add a new academic year or term when adding an exam, so that the exam belongs to the right period.
technical_task: Allow a new academic year or term to be added as part of adding an exam.
acceptance_criteria: Given the exam form, when the user adds a new academic year or term, then it is saved.
Given a saved academic year or term, when an exam is added, then it can be assigned to it.

requirement_text: System shall facilitate product purchases using valid credit card information provided by customers.
user_story: As a customer, I want to buy products with my credit card, so that I can complete purchases.
technical_task: Process product purchases using valid credit card information from the customer.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credit card information, when the customer buys a product, then the purchase is processed.
Given invalid credit card information, when the customer buys a product, then the purchase is not processed.

requirement_text: The diagnostic information window shall have a button labeled Print that when clicked will display a window listing items to print including the diagnostic information window, the history window, and both the diagnostic and history windows.
user_story: As a user, I want a Print button on the diagnostic information window that lists the items I can print, so that I can print what I need.
technical_task: Add a Print button to the diagnostic information window that opens a window listing the print options.
acceptance_criteria: Given the diagnostic information window, when the user clicks the button labeled Print, then a window with the list of items to print is displayed.
Given the print list, when it is displayed, then it offers the diagnostic information window, the history window, and both windows.

requirement_text: The utility timer shall shall be set to zero prior to the first application task running in the first minor frame of each major frame.
requirement_text_raw: The utility timer shall [SRS248] shall be set to zero prior to the first application task running in the first minor frame of each major frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the utility timer reset to zero before the first application task runs in the first minor frame of each major frame, so that timing starts from a known point.
technical_task: Reset the utility timer to zero ahead of the first application task in the first minor frame of every major frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new major frame, when its first minor frame begins, then the utility timer is zero before the first application task runs.
Given the first application task, when it starts, then the utility timer has already been set to zero.

requirement_text: Administrators shall be able to modify the list of agenda RSS feeds available in Dutch.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to modify the list of agenda RSS feeds available in Dutch, so that the feeds stay current.
technical_task: Allow administrators to change the list of agenda RSS feeds offered in Dutch.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list of agenda RSS feeds in Dutch, when an administrator adds or removes a feed, then the list is updated.
Given a modified list, when a user views the available feeds, then the changes are shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to retrieve the correct genre from their title or from a list of genres.
user_story: As a user, I want to find the right genre from a title or from a list of genres, so that I can classify an item quickly.
technical_task: Provide a genre lookup that works from a title and from a list of genres.
acceptance_criteria: Given a title, when the user searches, then the matching genre is returned.
Given the list of genres, when the user selects one, then that genre is retrieved.

requirement_text: The supplier shall agree to all details of component styling after awarding of contract.
user_story: As a client, I want the supplier to agree every detail of the component styling once the contract is awarded, so that the styling matches my expectations.
technical_task: Have the supplier agree all details of the component styling after the contract has been awarded.
acceptance_criteria: Given the contract has been awarded, when the supplier prepares the styling, then all details are agreed.
Given the agreed styling details, when they are checked, then none are left open.
rationale: Role assumed: client. The party the supplier agrees with is not named.

requirement_text: User shall have ALFRED encourage real interaction between users and not just ICT tools.
user_story: As a user, I want ALFRED to encourage real interaction between users and not only through ICT tools, so that I connect with other people.
technical_task: Design ALFRED so that it encourages real interaction between users in addition to ICT tools.
acceptance_criteria: Given ALFRED is in use, when users engage with it, then it encourages real interaction between users.
Given the interaction features, when they are reviewed, then they do not rely only on ICT tools.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How interaction is encouraged is not stated.

requirement_text: The client can register themselves in the system by filling in the required data.
user_story: As a client, I want to register myself by filling in the required data, so that I can use the system.
technical_task: Provide a self-registration form that asks for the required data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the client fills in all the required data and submits, then the client is registered.
Given the registration form, when required data is missing, then registration is not completed.
rationale: Role stated: client. The required data fields are not listed.

requirement_text: Authenticated users can add properties to the system.
user_story: As an authenticated user, I want to add properties to the system, so that they are listed.
technical_task: Let authenticated users add properties.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated user, when the user adds a property, then it is stored in the system.
Given a user who is not authenticated, when the user tries to add a property, then it is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access the site on all electronic devices.
user_story: As a user, I want to open the site on any electronic device, so that I am not tied to one device.
technical_task: Make the site accessible from all electronic devices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a desktop computer, a tablet or a phone, when the user opens the site, then it loads and can be used.
Given a different screen size, when the site is displayed, then its content stays usable.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The list of devices is an interpretation of "all electronic devices".

requirement_text: The presence, or absence of, an NEFU ICP shall not impact the FTSS software (i.e., the FTSS ICP load will not be different).
requirement_text_raw: The presence, or absence of, an NEFU ICP shall (3.3.14.1) not impact the FTSS software (i.e., the FTSS ICP load will not be different).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS ICP load unaffected by whether an NEFU ICP is present, so that the FTSS software behaves the same either way.
technical_task: Keep the FTSS software and its ICP load identical whether or not an NEFU ICP is present.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NEFU ICP is present, when the FTSS software runs, then the FTSS ICP load is the same as without it.
Given no NEFU ICP is present, when the FTSS software runs, then the FTSS ICP load is the same as with it.

requirement_text: Customers shall cancel the billing process by card using the bill mode.
user_story: As a customer, I want to cancel the billing process by card through the bill mode, so that I can stop a payment.
technical_task: Provide a cancel option for the card billing process in the bill mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given the billing process by card is running in bill mode, when the customer cancels, then the process is stopped.
Given a cancelled billing process, when the customer reviews the bill, then no card payment is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion is an interpretation of cancelling.

requirement_text: The Long Range Radar is called "LRR" in the OEM communication specification ("[K-Matrix]").
rationale: The sentence states a name used in a specification and no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a naming note for the OEM communication specification?
What must the system do with the name "LRR"?

requirement_text: System shall offer quick calling features with minimal response time.
rationale: "Quick" and "minimal response time" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: How fast must calling features respond, in measurable terms?
What does "quick calling" cover?

requirement_text: System shall provide high-quality images and clear quality video calling for an optimal user experience.
clarification_questions: What image resolution and video quality values define "high-quality" and "clear"?
How is an "optimal user experience" judged?

requirement_text: The OBC shall detect a Circuit Low fault, if the output current of pin R_U exceeds 3.5 ampere for longer than 20 milliseconds.
user_story: As a diagnostics engineer, I want the OBC to detect a Circuit Low fault when pin R_U output current exceeds 3.5 ampere for more than 20 milliseconds, so that overcurrent is reported.
technical_task: Detect a Circuit Low fault in the OBC when the output current of pin R_U is above 3.5 ampere for longer than 20 milliseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given the output current of pin R_U exceeds 3.5 ampere, when it lasts longer than 20 milliseconds, then the OBC detects a Circuit Low fault.
Given the output current of pin R_U exceeds 3.5 ampere, when it lasts no longer than 20 milliseconds, then no Circuit Low fault is detected.

requirement_text: User shall be able to delete transportation routes.
user_story: As a user, I want to delete transportation routes, so that I can remove ones I no longer need.
technical_task: Provide a delete function for transportation routes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transportation route, when the user deletes it, then the route is removed.
Given a deleted route, when the route list is viewed, then it is no longer listed.

requirement_text: For estimators the product shall be able to be operated in a repair facility during dirty and noisy conditions.
requirement_text_raw: For estimators  the product shall be able to be operated in a repair facility during dirty and noisy conditions.'
clarification_questions: What conditions count as "dirty and noisy" and which limits apply?
Which estimators and repair facility are meant?

requirement_text: The system shall be maintainable by highly professional maintainers, who are solely responsible for updating and adding new features.
user_story: As a system owner, I want the system maintainable by the maintainers who alone update it and add new features, so that responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Design the system so that its dedicated maintainers can update it and add new features.
acceptance_criteria: Given a maintainer, when an update is needed, then the maintainer can update the system.
Given a maintainer, when a new feature is requested, then the maintainer can add it.
rationale: Role assumed: system owner. "Highly professional" is not measurable and is not tested.

requirement_text: Further details for the control measures of the HV components in case of an interlock event and the timing shall be designed according to the specification of the OEM.
rationale: The sentence only points to an external specification and gives no content.
clarification_questions: What control measures are required for the HV components in case of an interlock event?
What timing values apply, since the OEM specification is not included?

requirement_text: Requirement and change management shall be utilized during the development phase.
rationale: The sentence names a practice and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which requirement and change management process and tools are meant?
What must be produced and when during the development phase?

requirement_text: Agency user shall have a better understanding of file-level errors to streamline data submission processes.
user_story: As an agency user, I want a better understanding of file-level errors, so that data submission is smoother.
technical_task: Report file-level errors with explanations that help the user correct a submission.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file with errors, when it is submitted, then each file-level error is reported to the agency user.
Given a reported error, when the user reads it, then it explains what is wrong with the file.
rationale: Role stated: agency user. The second criterion is an interpretation of "better understanding".

requirement_text: The solution should present patient-originated data for use by care providers.
user_story: As a care provider, I want patient-originated data presented to me, so that I can use it in care.
technical_task: Display patient-originated data to care providers.
acceptance_criteria: Given patient-originated data, when a care provider opens a patient record, then the data is presented.
Given a user who is not a care provider, when the user opens the record, then the data is not presented.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to play or learn about Mahjong.
user_story: As a player, I want to play Mahjong or learn about it, so that I can enjoy or study the game.
technical_task: Offer a Mahjong game and learning content about Mahjong.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Mahjong option, when the user chooses to play, then a game is started.
Given the Mahjong option, when the user chooses to learn, then information about Mahjong is shown.

requirement_text: The percental load is calculated by dividing the actual Iv-current by the smallest available current limit (derating / thermal limit or client current limit).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the percental load computed from the actual Iv-current and the smallest current limit, so that load is reported consistently.
technical_task: Compute the percental load as the actual Iv-current divided by the smallest of the available current limits (derating / thermal limit or client current limit).
acceptance_criteria: Given the actual Iv-current and the available current limits, when the load is computed, then the smallest current limit is used as the divisor.
Given the actual Iv-current and the smallest current limit, when the load is computed, then the result is the actual Iv-current divided by that limit.

requirement_text: User shall have a link on the home page to a list of training options, for easy access.
user_story: As a user, I want a link on the home page to a list of training options, so that I can reach training easily.
technical_task: Add a home page link that leads to a list of training options.
acceptance_criteria: Given the home page, when it is displayed, then it has a link to the list of training options.
Given the link, when the user selects it, then the list of training options is shown.

requirement_text: The CBIT shall be executed at a 50 Hz rate, after all 50 Hz flight critical operations are complete.
requirement_text_raw: The CBIT shall (3.3.5.5) be executed at a 50 Hz rate, after all 50 Hz flight critical operations are complete.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the CBIT to run at 50 Hz after all 50 Hz flight critical operations finish, so that it does not disturb them.
technical_task: Schedule the CBIT at a 50 Hz rate so that it runs after the 50 Hz flight critical operations have completed.
acceptance_criteria: Given all 50 Hz flight critical operations are complete, when the next CBIT slot arrives, then the CBIT is executed.
Given the CBIT is scheduled, when its rate is measured, then it is 50 Hz.

requirement_text: THEN no passing sign shall be removed from TSA display content earliest 200 milliseconds before and no later than the EV is passing the sign.
user_story: As a driver, I want a passing sign kept in the TSA display content until the EV passes it, so that I see signs as long as they apply.
technical_task: Remove a passing sign from the TSA display content no earlier than 200 milliseconds before the EV passes it and no later than the time it passes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an EV approaching a passing sign, when it is more than 200 milliseconds before the EV passes the sign, then the sign is still in the TSA display content.
Given the EV is passing the sign, when the sign is removed, then the removal is not later than the moment of passing.
rationale: Role assumed: driver. "THEN" at the start suggests an omitted condition; it is not invented.

requirement_text: Measures are in place to prevent the upload of unauthorized files (e.g. executable files).
requirement_text_raw: Measures are in place to prevent the upload of unauthorized files (e.g.  executable files).
user_story: As a security officer, I want uploads of unauthorized files such as executables prevented, so that harmful files stay out.
technical_task: Block the upload of unauthorized files, for example executable files.
acceptance_criteria: Given an executable file, when a user tries to upload it, then the upload is blocked.
Given an allowed file, when a user uploads it, then the upload is accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. Which types are authorized is not listed.

requirement_text: The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.
requirement_text_raw: The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds.  The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'
user_story: As a technician, I want the search for recycled parts to return results in under 15 seconds, so that I find parts quickly.
technical_task: Make the recycled parts search finish and return its results in under 15 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search for recycled parts, when it is submitted, then it takes no longer than 15 seconds.
Given a completed search, when results are returned, then they arrive in under 15 seconds.

requirement_text: The system shall empower end-users to manage their private data, including the option to delete their personal repository.
user_story: As an end user, I want to manage my private data including deleting my personal repository, so that I stay in control.
technical_task: Provide end users with functions to manage their private data, including deletion of their personal repository.
acceptance_criteria: Given an end user, when the user opens the private data settings, then the user can manage their private data.
Given a personal repository, when the user chooses to delete it, then it is deleted.

requirement_text: After detection of tG the recharging thresholds of IP and IS have to be activated and realized as short as possible to assure fast follow-on ignitions.
rationale: "As short as possible" and "fast" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: How quickly must the recharging thresholds of IP and IS be activated, in measurable terms?
What does "fast follow-on ignitions" mean?

requirement_text: The system shall allow archivists to track file usage and provide access to unprocessed materials.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to track file usage and provide access to unprocessed materials, so that I can manage the collection.
technical_task: Offer file usage tracking and access to unprocessed materials for archivists.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file in use, when an archivist reviews usage, then the file usage is shown.
Given unprocessed materials, when an archivist requests access, then access is provided.

requirement_text: User shall be able to search for other users, location-based stories, events, and more, with matched results displayed.
user_story: As a user, I want to search for other users, location-based stories, events and more and see matching results, so that I can find content.
technical_task: Provide a search across users, location-based stories, events and other content that displays the matched results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search term, when the user searches, then matching users, location-based stories and events are displayed.
Given a search term with no matches, when the user searches, then no results are displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "And more" means other content types may exist but none is named.

requirement_text: Admin must not dismiss an engaged menu unless the customer requests it.
user_story: As a customer, I want an engaged menu to stay until I ask to dismiss it, so that an admin does not close it on me.
technical_task: Prevent an administrator from dismissing an engaged menu unless the customer requests it.
acceptance_criteria: Given an engaged menu, when the admin tries to dismiss it without a customer request, then the menu stays open.
Given an engaged menu, when the customer requests dismissal, then the menu is dismissed.

requirement_text: If the diagnostic service '' ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSEâ? with parameter value `` Close '' is received in extended diagnostic session the ADSE interface must be closed.
user_story: As a diagnostics engineer, I want the ADSE interface closed when the ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSE service is received with the value Close in an extended diagnostic session, so that the interface is closed on request.
technical_task: Close the ADSE interface when the diagnostic service ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSE is received with parameter value Close in the extended diagnostic session.
acceptance_criteria: Given an extended diagnostic session, when the service ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSE is received with the value Close, then the ADSE interface is closed.
Given a different diagnostic session, when the service is received, then the requirement does not specify closing.
rationale: Role assumed: diagnostics engineer. The service name contains garbled characters in the source; it is read as ADSE_INTERFACE_OPEN_CLOSE.

requirement_text: The CMCS shall autonomously monitor and respond to hardware issues, software crashes, resource limitations, errors, and communication failures.
user_story: As a system operator, I want the CMCS to monitor and respond to hardware issues, software crashes, resource limitations, errors and communication failures on its own, so that problems are handled without manual action.
technical_task: Have the CMCS automatically monitor for hardware issues, software crashes, resource limitations, errors and communication failures and respond to them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hardware issue or a software crash, when it occurs, then the CMCS detects it and responds without manual action.
Given a resource limitation, an error or a communication failure, when it occurs, then the CMCS detects it and responds without manual action.
rationale: Role assumed: system operator. The responses are not specified.

requirement_text: Customers shall view nearby restaurants within a specified distance.
user_story: As a customer, I want to see restaurants near me within a specified distance, so that I can choose where to eat.
technical_task: List nearby restaurants within a distance that the customer specifies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specified distance, when the customer searches, then restaurants within that distance are shown.
Given a restaurant outside the specified distance, when the customer searches, then it is not shown.
rationale: Role stated: customer. The distance value is not given.

requirement_text: Patient: When an American infant is born or a foreigner requests medical care each is assigned a medical identification number and password.
requirement_text_raw: Patient: When an American infant is born or a foreigner requests medical care  each is assigned a medical identification number and password.
user_story: As a registrar, I want an American infant or a foreigner requesting medical care assigned a medical identification number and password, so that each can be identified.
technical_task: Assign a medical identification number and password when an American infant is born or a foreigner requests medical care.
acceptance_criteria: Given an American infant is born, when the patient record is created, then a medical identification number and password are assigned.
Given a foreigner requests medical care, when the patient record is created, then a medical identification number and password are assigned.
rationale: Role assumed: registrar. The source names the actor as Patient.

requirement_text: Profile updates shall be allowed at any time.
user_story: As a user, I want to update my profile whenever I choose, so that my details stay current.
technical_task: Allow profile updates without time restriction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user profile, when the user edits it at any time and saves, then the update is stored.
Given a saved update, when the profile is viewed, then the new details are shown.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to deliver presentations in various modes, including full-screen mode and slide sorter view.
user_story: As a presenter, I want to deliver presentations in full-screen mode and slide sorter view among other modes, so that I can present in the style that suits me.
technical_task: Support several presentation modes including full-screen mode and slide sorter view.
acceptance_criteria: Given a presentation, when the user chooses full-screen mode, then it is shown full screen.
Given a presentation, when the user chooses slide sorter view, then the slides are shown in the slide sorter view.

requirement_text: System shall be able to ensure that the time elapsed between a player making a move and other players updating the game state is under 5 seconds.
user_story: As a player, I want other players to see my move in under 5 seconds, so that the game stays in step.
technical_task: Update the game state of other players within less than 5 seconds of a player's move.
acceptance_criteria: Given a player makes a move, when the other players' game state is updated, then the time elapsed is under 5 seconds.
Given a move, when the elapsed time reaches 5 seconds, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: System shall be able to log the serial number and update the log file.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the serial number logged and the log file updated, so that records are kept.
technical_task: Log the serial number and update the log file.
acceptance_criteria: Given a serial number, when it is processed, then it is logged.
Given a logged serial number, when the log is saved, then the log file is updated.

requirement_text: User shall have confidence in the system's performance as it supports multiple users simultaneously.
clarification_questions: How many simultaneous users must the system support and what response time is expected?
How is "confidence" in performance measured?

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to update access privilege rules.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want to update access privilege rules, so that permissions stay current.
technical_task: Provide a function to update the access privilege rules.
acceptance_criteria: Given the access privilege rules, when an authorized user changes a rule and saves, then the rule is updated.
Given an updated rule, when a user tries to access a resource, then the new rule applies.

requirement_text: User shall have a maximum of three attempts to enter the password, after which an email notification will be sent if there's an additional attempt.
user_story: As a user, I want three attempts to enter my password and an email notification if I try again, so that unauthorized tries are flagged.
technical_task: Allow at most three password attempts and send an email notification when a further attempt is made.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who entered a wrong password, when the number of attempts is within three, then the user can try again.
Given three attempts have been used, when an additional attempt is made, then an email notification is sent.

requirement_text: Izogn Administrator must be able to add new products to the website within 2 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: Izogn Administrator must be able to add new products to the website within 2 minutes.'
user_story: As an Izogn administrator, I want to add new products to the website within 2 minutes, so that the catalog stays fresh.
technical_task: Make adding a new product to the website achievable in at most 2 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new product, when the administrator adds it to the website, then the task takes no more than 2 minutes.
Given an added product, when the website is viewed, then the product is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall be accessible to individuals with disabilities and comply with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG).
user_story: As a user with a disability, I want the system to be accessible and follow accessibility standards such as WCAG, so that I can use it.
technical_task: Build the system to comply with accessibility standards, for example WCAG.
acceptance_criteria: Given an individual with a disability, when the individual uses the system, then it is accessible.
Given the accessibility standards such as WCAG, when the system is checked against them, then it complies.
rationale: Role assumed: user with a disability. Which WCAG level is meant is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall currently support cash payments, with future expansion for credit/debit cards.
user_story: As a customer, I want to pay in cash now, so that I can complete purchases while card payments are not yet available.
technical_task: Support cash payments in the current release and leave room for credit and debit card payments later.
acceptance_criteria: Given a purchase, when the customer chooses to pay, then cash payment is supported.
Given the system design, when card payments are added in future, then it can be extended for credit and debit cards.

requirement_text: User shall have access to a videophone feature.
user_story: As a user, I want a videophone feature, so that I can talk face to face.
technical_task: Offer a videophone feature to users.
acceptance_criteria: Given the videophone feature, when the user starts a call, then audio and video are connected.
Given a call in progress, when the user ends it, then the call stops.

requirement_text: The Software Quality Gate "Delivery" specifies the date of every Software and / or Hardware release where the contractor gives detailed information about the release to the client.
