rationale: Role assumed: project owner. Which privileges are included is not stated, and "effective collaboration" is not tested.

requirement_text: The global synchronous timer shall be realigned by exchanging and voting the timer value. The timer value will stop incrementing until the realignment of the timer is complete.
requirement_text_raw: The global synchronous timer shall (3.2.2.4.9) be realigned by exchanging and voting the timer value.  The timer value will stop incrementing until the realignment of the timer is complete.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the global synchronous timer realigned by exchanging and voting on timer values and frozen during realignment, so that all members agree on the time.
technical_task: Realign the global synchronous timer by exchanging and voting the timer value and hold the timer value constant until realignment completes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a realignment of the global synchronous timer, when it runs, then the timer value is exchanged and voted.
Given a realignment is in progress, when the timer is read, then its value does not increment until realignment is complete.

requirement_text: For data with enough structuring, web scraping will be used to programmatically extract all the data needed and store it in our database.
user_story: As a data engineer, I want data that is structured enough to be extracted by web scraping and stored in our database, so that I do not enter it by hand.
technical_task: Use web scraping to programmatically extract the needed data from sufficiently structured sources and store it in the database.
acceptance_criteria: Given a source with enough structure, when scraping runs, then all the needed data is extracted.
Given extracted data, when the run finishes, then it is stored in the database.
rationale: Role assumed: data engineer. "Enough structure" is not defined.

requirement_text: The system shall allow adding new items to the estimation list during a session.
user_story: As a session participant, I want to add new items to the estimation list during a session, so that late topics can be covered.
technical_task: Allow items to be added to the estimation list while a session is running.
acceptance_criteria: Given a running session, when the user adds an item, then it appears in the estimation list.
Given an item added during a session, when the list is viewed, then the item is available for estimation.

requirement_text: User shall register for the examination.
user_story: As a candidate, I want to register for the examination, so that I can sit it.
technical_task: Provide an examination registration function.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the candidate submits valid details, then the candidate is registered for the examination.
Given the registration form, when required details are missing, then the registration is not accepted.

requirement_text: System shall authenticate the payment details and proceed to the next interface.
user_story: As a customer, I want my payment details authenticated before I move to the next screen, so that the payment is legitimate.
technical_task: Authenticate the payment details and move on to the next interface when they are accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Given payment details, when they are submitted, then the system authenticates them.
Given authenticated payment details, when the check succeeds, then the next interface is shown.

requirement_text: And HCP chooses to add or edit patient specific instructions.
requirement_text_raw: And HCP chooses to add  or edit  patient specific instructions.
rationale: The sentence is a fragment starting with "And" and states no complete requirement.
clarification_questions: What happens before this step, and which instructions are meant?
What must the system do when the HCP chooses to add or edit instructions?

requirement_text: The solution should provide an override function (that requires a reason and the pharmacist's user ID) to dispense a non-authorized or non-formulary medication in special circumstances.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want an override function that asks for a reason and my user ID, so that I can dispense a non-authorized or non-formulary medication in special circumstances.
technical_task: Provide an override function that requires a reason and the pharmacist's user ID before a non-authorized or non-formulary medication is dispensed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a non-authorized or non-formulary medication, when the pharmacist uses the override function, then a reason and the pharmacist's user ID are required.
Given a reason and the user ID are entered, when the override is confirmed, then the medication can be dispensed.
rationale: Role stated: pharmacist. "Special circumstances" are not defined.

requirement_text: System shall display a pop-up confirming the successful download of the video.
user_story: As a user, I want a pop-up confirming my video download succeeded, so that I know it is complete.
technical_task: Show a pop-up when a video download completes successfully.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video download, when it completes successfully, then a pop-up confirms it.
Given a download that fails, when it ends, then the success pop-up is not shown.

requirement_text: Interface will be presented in a web browser.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface in a web browser, so that I need no installation.
technical_task: Present the interface in a web browser.
acceptance_criteria: Given a web browser, when the user opens the application, then the interface is displayed in the browser.
Given the interface, when the user works with it, then no separate client is needed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: To achieve a faster battery charging a higher voltage is set after the start of the engine until the battery is nearly fully charged.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want a higher charging voltage after engine start until the battery is nearly full, so that the battery charges faster.
technical_task: Set a higher charging voltage after the engine starts and keep it until the battery is nearly fully charged.
acceptance_criteria: Given the engine has started, when charging begins, then a higher voltage is set.
Given the battery is nearly fully charged, when charging continues, then the higher voltage is no longer applied.
rationale: Role assumed: vehicle engineer. The voltage values and the "nearly full" threshold are not given.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to perform staff reviews to validate application compliance with zoning ordinances.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to carry out staff reviews, so that applications are checked against zoning ordinances.
technical_task: Provide a staff review function that validates application compliance with zoning ordinances.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application, when a staff member performs a staff review, then compliance with zoning ordinances is validated.
Given a completed review, when it is viewed, then its result is recorded for the application.

requirement_text: User shall display only 10 matching results on the current screen.
user_story: As a user, I want the current screen to show only 10 matching results, so that the page stays short.
technical_task: Limit the results list on a screen to 10 matching results.
acceptance_criteria: Given more than 10 matches, when the results screen is displayed, then only 10 are shown.
Given 10 or fewer matches, when the results screen is displayed, then all of them are shown.

requirement_text: System shall enable easy listing of summit agendas.
clarification_questions: What does "easy" listing of summit agendas mean in measurable terms?
Who lists the agendas and what information is listed?

requirement_text: An LHCP or UAP can add and delete patients from his or her monitoring list.
user_story: As an LHCP or UAP, I want to add and delete patients on my monitoring list, so that it shows who I follow.
technical_task: Allow an LHCP or UAP to add patients to and remove patients from their own monitoring list.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when an LHCP or UAP adds the patient to the monitoring list, then the patient appears on it.
Given a patient on the list, when the LHCP or UAP deletes the patient, then the patient is removed from it.

requirement_text: The NE shall support class 1 and class 2 bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.3.2.5) support class 1 and class 2 bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want the NE to support class 1 and class 2 bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec, so that traffic is carried.
technical_task: Support class 1 and class 2 bandwidth in the NE with a rate of at least 1 Mbyte/sec.
acceptance_criteria: Given class 1 traffic, when it is carried by the NE, then a bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec is supported.
Given class 2 traffic, when it is carried by the NE, then a bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec is supported.

requirement_text: System shall prioritize the safety of human users during operation.
clarification_questions: Which safety standards or measurable safety behaviours apply?
What does "prioritize" mean when safety and other goals conflict?

requirement_text: The user can manipulate and view fee details, including tuition fees, exam fees, and donation fees.
user_story: As a student, I want to view and manage fee details such as tuition, exam and donation fees, so that I can keep track of what I owe.
technical_task: Provide viewing and editing of fee details including tuition fees, exam fees and donation fees.
acceptance_criteria: Given fee details, when the user opens the fee page, then tuition fees, exam fees and donation fees are shown.
Given a fee detail, when the user changes it and saves, then the change is stored.

requirement_text: Communication services shall provide a "pipe" communication mechanism allowing immediate message passing through the network and allowing a 50hz FCP transfer task to poll until it can read an immediate message from the ICP.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS067] provide a "pipe" communication mechanism allowing immediate message passing through the network and allowing a 50hz FCP transfer task to poll until it can read an immediate message from the ICP.
user_story: As a software developer, I want a "pipe" communication mechanism for immediate message passing, so that a 50hz FCP transfer task can poll until it reads an immediate message from the ICP.
technical_task: Provide a "pipe" mechanism in the communication services for immediate message passing across the network, and let a 50hz FCP transfer task poll until it can read an immediate message from the ICP.
acceptance_criteria: Given the communication services, when a message is sent through the "pipe", then it is passed immediately through the network.
Given a 50hz FCP transfer task, when it polls the pipe, then it reads the immediate message from the ICP once available.

requirement_text: A user (an LHCP or patient) chooses to display his or her appointments in the current month on a calendar for the current month.
user_story: As an LHCP or patient, I want to see this month's appointments on a calendar for the current month, so that I can plan my time.
technical_task: Offer a calendar view of the appointments in the current month for LHCPs and patients.
acceptance_criteria: Given appointments in the current month, when the user chooses to display them, then they appear on a calendar for the current month.
Given a patient user, when the calendar is displayed, then it lists the patient's own appointments.

requirement_text: The solution should limit access to pertinent functions and views only for patient records covered by the audit.
user_story: As an auditor, I want access limited to the functions and views needed for patient records under audit, so that unrelated records stay protected.
technical_task: Restrict access to the pertinent functions and views to patient records covered by the audit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient record covered by the audit, when an auditor opens it, then the pertinent functions and views are available.
Given a patient record not covered by the audit, when an auditor tries to open it, then access is limited.

requirement_text: User shall specify security measures and access controls.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to specify security measures and access controls, so that the system is protected as I decide.
technical_task: Provide settings in which the user specifies security measures and access controls.
acceptance_criteria: Given the security settings, when the user specifies a security measure and saves, then it is stored.
Given the security settings, when the user specifies an access control and saves, then it is applied.

requirement_text: The system shall prioritize continuous operation and ensure that any interruptions can be demonstrably attributed to a trusted operating system issue.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want continuous operation with any interruption traceable to a trusted operating system issue, so that causes are known.
technical_task: Keep the system running continuously and make sure each interruption can be demonstrated to come from a trusted operating system issue.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is in operation, when it runs, then it keeps operating continuously.
Given an interruption, when it is analysed, then it can be shown to be attributed to a trusted operating system issue.
rationale: Role assumed: operations manager. No availability figure is given.

requirement_text: Memory shall be categorized into congruent (identical data) and non-congruent (data that is not identical) memory.
requirement_text_raw: Memory shall (3.3.9.1) be categorized into congruent (identical data) and non-congruent (data that is not identical) memory.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want memory split into congruent and non-congruent memory, so that identical data is kept apart from data that differs.
technical_task: Organize memory into congruent memory, which holds identical data, and non-congruent memory, which holds data that is not identical.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory holding identical data on every member, when it is categorized, then it is congruent memory.
Given memory holding data that is not identical across members, when it is categorized, then it is non-congruent memory.

requirement_text: The contractor shall ensure that the control unit sets a fault code in the control unit for each short circuit and open load detected in the inputs and outputs.
user_story: As a diagnostics engineer, I want the control unit to set a fault code for every short circuit and open load at its inputs and outputs, so that faults are recorded.
technical_task: Have the control unit store a fault code for each short circuit and each open load detected on an input or output.
acceptance_criteria: Given a short circuit is detected at an input or output, when it is detected, then a fault code is set in the control unit.
Given an open load is detected at an input or output, when it is detected, then a fault code is set in the control unit.

requirement_text: System shall maintain backward compatibility and smooth dependency installation for Ubuntu 10.04 LTS.
user_story: As a developer, I want the system to stay backward compatible and install dependencies smoothly on Ubuntu 10.04 LTS, so that it runs on that release.
technical_task: Keep the system backward compatible and make dependency installation work on Ubuntu 10.04 LTS.
acceptance_criteria: Given Ubuntu 10.04 LTS, when the dependencies are installed, then the installation completes.
Given Ubuntu 10.04 LTS, when the system is run, then it works as in newer releases.
rationale: Role assumed: developer. "Smooth" is read as completing without manual fixes.

requirement_text: A user researcher shall develop the user research protocol for internal workflows.
user_story: As a user researcher, I want to write the user research protocol for internal workflows, so that studies follow a plan.
technical_task: Produce a user research protocol that covers internal workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Given internal workflows, when the user researcher prepares the work, then a user research protocol is developed.
Given the protocol, when it is reviewed, then it covers internal workflows.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to rename scores they own.
user_story: As a user, I want to rename the scores I own, so that I can keep them organized.
technical_task: Allow renaming of scores by their owners.
acceptance_criteria: Given a score owned by the user, when the user renames it, then the new name is saved.
Given a score owned by someone else, when the user tries to rename it, then it is refused.

requirement_text: The system shall be scalable to accommodate increasing document volumes without performance degradation.
clarification_questions: What document volume and growth must be supported?
What performance level counts as no "degradation"?

requirement_text: System shall display a login window on the theaa.com website for each user.
user_story: As a user, I want a login window on the theaa.com website, so that I can sign in.
technical_task: Display a login window on the theaa.com website for every user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user on the theaa.com website, when the page is opened, then a login window is displayed.
Given the login window, when the user enters valid credentials, then the user is signed in.

requirement_text: Actions and statuses recorded in accordance with paragraph (d)(2)(i) of this section must not be capable of being changed overwritten or deleted by the EHR technology.
requirement_text_raw: Actions and statuses recorded in accordance with paragraph (d)(2)(i) of this section must not be capable of being changed  overwritten  or deleted by the EHR technology.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want recorded actions and statuses protected from change, overwrite or deletion by the EHR technology, so that the record stays trustworthy.
technical_task: Prevent the EHR technology from changing, overwriting or deleting actions and statuses recorded under paragraph (d)(2)(i).
acceptance_criteria: Given an action recorded under paragraph (d)(2)(i), when a user tries to change it, then the EHR technology refuses.
Given a status recorded under paragraph (d)(2)(i), when a user tries to overwrite or delete it, then the EHR technology refuses.

requirement_text: The TCS shall be capable of storing a minimum of 500 mission plans under unique names to allow for later retrieval.
requirement_text_raw:
The TCS shall be capable of storing a minimum of 500 mission plans under unique names to allow for later
retrieval.
user_story: As an operator, I want the TCS to store at least 500 mission plans under unique names, so that I can retrieve them later.
technical_task: Support storage of a minimum of 500 mission plans, each saved under a unique name.
acceptance_criteria: Given 500 mission plans, when they are stored, then each is saved under a unique name.
Given a stored mission plan, when the operator enters its name, then the plan is retrieved.

requirement_text: System shall allow user registration without any preconditions.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to register without any preconditions, so that I can sign up quickly.
technical_task: Allow user registration with no precondition.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor, when the visitor registers, then no precondition is checked.
Given a completed registration, when the visitor signs in, then the account works.

requirement_text: Communication services shall perform synchronous message passing at rate group frame boundaries. This ensures that all redundant instantiations of a given rate group task have consistent messages throughout the rate group frame.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS054] perform synchronous message passing at rate group frame boundaries. This ensures that all redundant instantiations of a given rate group task have consistent messages throughout the rate group frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want synchronous message passing at rate group frame boundaries, so that redundant instances see the same messages through the frame.
technical_task: Perform synchronous message passing in the communication services at rate group frame boundaries so that all redundant instantiations of a rate group task have consistent messages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a rate group frame boundary, when it is reached, then synchronous message passing is performed.
Given redundant instantiations of a rate group task, when the frame runs, then all see consistent messages throughout the rate group frame.

requirement_text: Customers shall finalize payment by cash using the bill mode.
user_story: As a customer, I want to finalize my payment by cash in bill mode, so that I can settle the bill.
technical_task: Allow payment to be completed by cash in the bill mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bill mode, when the customer chooses cash, then the payment can be finalized.
Given a finalized cash payment, when the bill is viewed, then it is shown as paid.

requirement_text: Users shall remove stocks from their portfolio.
user_story: As an investor, I want to remove stocks from my portfolio, so that it shows only what I hold.
technical_task: Provide removal of stocks from a portfolio.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock in the portfolio, when the user removes it, then it is no longer in the portfolio.
Given a removed stock, when the portfolio is viewed, then the stock is not listed.

requirement_text: User shall find the Gambler Agent application's client side very easy to use and enjoyable, with a simple interface allowing newcomers to quickly start playing.
clarification_questions: How is "very easy to use" and "enjoyable" measured?
How quickly must a newcomer be able to start playing?

requirement_text: Reports on total system sales, jobs, job seekers, accounting, and order history shall be viewable.
user_story: As a manager, I want reports on total sales, jobs, job seekers, accounting and order history, so that I can follow the business.
technical_task: Provide viewable reports on total system sales, jobs, job seekers, accounting and order history.
acceptance_criteria: Given the reports area, when the manager opens it, then reports on sales, jobs, job seekers, accounting and order history can be viewed.
Given a report, when it is opened, then it displays the totals for the system.

requirement_text: The system shall be accompanied by well-documented code, user documentation, and help systems, all designed for clarity and ease of understanding.
clarification_questions: What documentation deliverables and level of detail are required?
How is "clarity and ease of understanding" measured?

requirement_text: The website shall be compatible with all browsers.
user_story: As a visitor, I want the website to work in any browser, so that I can use the browser I like.
technical_task: Make the website compatible with browsers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supported browser, when the visitor opens the website, then it displays and works.
Given a different browser, when the visitor opens the website, then it displays and works.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. The list of browsers is not given, so "all" is taken as the browsers the team selects.

requirement_text: The system shall validate data integrity and format compliance during ingest.
user_story: As a data steward, I want data integrity and format compliance validated at ingest, so that bad data is caught early.
technical_task: Validate the integrity and format compliance of data when it is ingested.
acceptance_criteria: Given data being ingested, when it is checked, then its integrity is validated.
Given data in an invalid format, when it is ingested, then it fails format compliance.

requirement_text: The Patient Encounters & Documents page at the bottom of the screen displays a list of all encounters that have been entered for this patient.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the Patient Encounters & Documents page to list every encounter entered for the patient, so that I can review the history.
technical_task: Show on the Patient Encounters & Documents page a list of all encounters entered for the patient.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with encounters, when the page is opened, then all entered encounters are listed.
Given the page layout, when it is displayed, then the list appears at the bottom of the screen.

requirement_text: For details refer to specification "Masterdatenblatt Verdampferplatte - Batteriekühlung", see [HVB3_R-136].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced specification require?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: User shall be able to block other users through the system.
user_story: As a user, I want to block other users, so that they cannot contact me.
technical_task: Provide a function to block other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given another user, when the user blocks them, then the blocked user is recorded.
Given a blocked user, when they try to contact the user, then the contact is prevented.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The effect of blocking is an interpretation.

requirement_text: Company logos shall be attachable to job adverts.
user_story: As an employer, I want to attach my company logo to job adverts, so that adverts show my brand.
technical_task: Allow company logos to be attached to job adverts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a job advert, when the employer attaches a company logo, then the logo is saved with the advert.
Given an advert with a logo, when it is viewed, then the logo is shown.

requirement_text: System shall trigger the mail message generator to send emails to customers and agents as needed.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the mail message generator triggered to email customers and agents when needed, so that they stay informed.
technical_task: Trigger the mail message generator to send emails to customers and agents as required.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event that requires a notification, when it occurs, then the mail message generator is triggered.
Given the triggered generator, when it runs, then emails are sent to the customers and agents concerned.
rationale: Role assumed: system administrator. "As needed" is not defined.

requirement_text: FTSS shall initialize congruent initialized memory locations from non-volatile memory.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS200] initialize congruent initialized memory locations from non-volatile memory.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to load congruent initialized memory locations from non-volatile memory, so that they start with known values.
technical_task: Initialize congruent initialized memory locations in FTSS with values read from non-volatile memory.
acceptance_criteria: Given FTSS is initializing, when it processes congruent initialized memory locations, then they are set from non-volatile memory.
Given the initialization is complete, when the locations are read, then they hold the values from non-volatile memory.

requirement_text: The latest Buckle sensor specification shall be referenced for detail regarding sensor output characteristics.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What do the latest Buckle sensor specification and its sensor output characteristics say?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: For the CNG management it is recommended to use a single protocol, so as to minimize the complexity and the cost of the service.
user_story: As a network administrator, I want a single protocol used for CNG management, so that complexity and cost of the service are kept low.
technical_task: Use one protocol for the CNG management in place of several.
acceptance_criteria: Given the CNG management, when it is configured, then a single protocol is used.
Given the CNG management service, when its design is reviewed, then it does not need a second management protocol.
rationale: Role assumed: network administrator. The requirement says "recommended"; it is treated as the preferred design, not as a measured limit on cost.

requirement_text: Intermediate files of cleaned-up ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry shall be generated in the event that cleaned-up telemetry is not provided by ESOC.
user_story: As a data processing engineer, I want intermediate files of cleaned-up ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry generated when ESOC does not supply cleaned-up telemetry, so that processing can continue.
technical_task: Generate intermediate files of cleaned-up ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry whenever cleaned-up telemetry is not provided by ESOC.
acceptance_criteria: Given cleaned-up telemetry is not provided by ESOC, when processing starts, then intermediate files of cleaned-up ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry are generated.
Given cleaned-up telemetry is provided by ESOC, when processing starts, then the intermediate files are not needed.
rationale: Role assumed: data processing engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "in the event that".

requirement_text: The system shall offer comprehensive online help and documentation for users of all skill levels.
rationale: "Comprehensive" and "all skill levels" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What topics and formats must the online help and documentation cover?
How is "comprehensive" and "all skill levels" measured?

requirement_text: The system shall allow filtering and ranking videos based on audio/visual quality.
user_story: As a user, I want to filter and rank videos by audio and visual quality, so that I can find the best ones.
technical_task: Provide filtering and ranking of videos by audio quality and visual quality.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of videos, when the user filters by audio or visual quality, then only matching videos are shown.
Given a list of videos, when the user ranks by audio or visual quality, then the videos are ordered by that quality.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The quality scale is not given.

requirement_text: Bidders shall be able to view the team leaderboard in ascending order of points and use the information for bidding decisions.
user_story: As a bidder, I want to view the team leaderboard in ascending order of points, so that I can make bidding decisions.
technical_task: Display the team leaderboard sorted by points in ascending order for bidders.
acceptance_criteria: Given the team leaderboard, when a bidder opens it, then teams are listed in ascending order of points.
Given a bidder viewing the leaderboard, when the bidder reads it, then the points of each team are visible for bidding decisions.

requirement_text: System shall be optimized for fast loading on supported devices.
rationale: "Fast loading" is not measurable and the supported devices are not listed.
clarification_questions: What load time target applies on supported devices?
Which devices are supported?

requirement_text: Each message element of a transaction should be loggable each time it enters or leaves a host system of the solution.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want each message element of a transaction to be loggable when it enters or leaves a host system, so that transactions can be traced.
technical_task: Allow logging of every message element of a transaction each time it enters or leaves a host system of the solution.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message element of a transaction, when it enters a host system, then it can be logged.
Given a message element of a transaction, when it leaves a host system, then it can be logged.

requirement_text: System shall automatically generate mark sheets for students in different semesters.
user_story: As a student, I want mark sheets generated automatically for each semester, so that I get my results without manual work.
technical_task: Generate mark sheets automatically for students for each of their semesters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student with results in a semester, when the mark sheet is requested, then it is generated automatically.
Given results from different semesters, when mark sheets are generated, then one is produced per semester.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall give tasks priority values according to their rate - the higher the rate, the higher the priority.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS027] give tasks priority values according to their rate - the higher the rate, the higher the priority.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to give higher priority to tasks with higher rates, so that faster tasks run first.
technical_task: Assign task priority values in the scheduler according to task rate, with a higher rate giving a higher priority.
acceptance_criteria: Given two tasks with different rates, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then the task with the higher rate gets the higher priority.
Given tasks with the same rate, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then they get the same priority value.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The information extraction unit shall populate the database before system startup to ensure immediate data accessibility.
user_story: As a user, I want the database filled before the system starts, so that data is available immediately.
technical_task: Run the information extraction unit to populate the database before system startup.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is about to start, when the information extraction unit has run, then the database is populated.
Given the system has started, when data is requested, then it is accessible immediately.

requirement_text: System shall process up to 50 tasks per second to maintain operational efficiency.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the system to process up to 50 tasks per second, so that operations stay efficient.
technical_task: Process a load of up to 50 tasks per second.
acceptance_criteria: Given a load of 50 tasks per second, when the system processes the tasks, then all of them are processed.
Given a load below 50 tasks per second, when the system processes the tasks, then all of them are processed.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to allow any faculty member to add inventory for all departments they have access to.
user_story: As a faculty member, I want to add inventory for every department I have access to, so that each department's stock is recorded.
technical_task: Let a faculty member add inventory items for each department that the member can access.
acceptance_criteria: Given a faculty member with access to several departments, when the member adds inventory for one of them, then the inventory is saved for that department.
Given a department the faculty member cannot access, when the member tries to add inventory, then it is refused.

requirement_text: The manager shall view sales statistics in various formats such as pie charts, bar graphs, and tabular formats.
user_story: As a manager, I want to view sales statistics as pie charts, bar graphs or tables, so that I can read them in the form I prefer.
technical_task: Present sales statistics in several formats including pie charts, bar graphs and tabular form.
acceptance_criteria: Given sales statistics, when the manager chooses a pie chart, then they are shown as a pie chart.
Given sales statistics, when the manager chooses a bar graph or a table, then they are shown in that format.

requirement_text: Each MPCC is configured to halt processing if any of the MPE tests, listed in Table 3.2-5, fails.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want each MPCC to halt processing when any MPE test fails, so that faults stop further operation.
technical_task: Configure every MPCC to halt processing if any MPE test in the referenced table fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given an MPCC is running the MPE tests, when any test fails, then the MPCC halts processing.
Given an MPCC is running the MPE tests, when all tests pass, then the MPCC continues processing.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The list of MPE tests is in a table that is not part of the requirement text.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to search for videos using keywords or other criteria.
user_story: As a user, I want to search videos by keywords or other criteria, so that I can find them easily.
technical_task: Provide video search that accepts keywords and further search criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a keyword, when the user searches, then matching videos are listed.
Given another search criterion, when the user searches, then matching videos are listed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The other criteria are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall allow users to participate in online discussions about LPG.
user_story: As a user, I want to join online discussions about LPG, so that I can exchange views with others.
technical_task: Provide online discussions about LPG in which users can take part.
acceptance_criteria: Given a discussion about LPG, when the user posts a message, then it is added to the discussion.
Given a discussion about LPG, when the user opens it, then the messages of others are shown.

requirement_text: User shall have access to the WhatsApp internal server, which must be available 24/7.
user_story: As a user, I want access to the WhatsApp internal server at all times, so that my service is not interrupted.
technical_task: Keep the WhatsApp internal server available 24/7 and accessible to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given the WhatsApp internal server, when a user requests access at any hour, then access is available 24/7.
Given a period of operation, when availability is checked, then no scheduled downtime is allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation of 24/7.

requirement_text: Overrating of small dips (zero values) in the antenna pattern can be avoided by use of the cumulative distribution function.
rationale: The sentence is a remark about a possible technique and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a note on how to evaluate the antenna pattern?
What must the system do with the cumulative distribution function?

requirement_text: For reserved exceptions, the FTPP system shall “handle” the exception by making the error and its context data available to the application and then returning from the exception handler.
requirement_text_raw: For reserved exceptions, the FTPP system shall (3.3.12.6) “handle” the exception by making the error and its context data available to the application and then returning from the exception handler.
user_story: As a software developer, I want reserved exceptions handled by passing the error and its context data to the application and returning from the handler, so that the application can react.
technical_task: Handle a reserved exception in the FTPP system by making the error and its context data available to the application and then returning from the exception handler.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reserved exception occurs, when the FTPP system handles it, then the error and its context data are made available to the application.
Given the error and context data have been made available, when the handling ends, then the exception handler returns.

requirement_text: The system shall provide users with a list of selectable symptoms.
user_story: As a patient, I want a list of symptoms to choose from, so that I can describe how I feel.
technical_task: Display a list of selectable symptoms.
acceptance_criteria: Given the symptom list, when the user opens it, then selectable symptoms are shown.
Given the symptom list, when the user selects a symptom, then it is marked as chosen.

requirement_text: For all objects, the angle between the connecting lines from left edge point to middle edge point and from middle edge point to right edge point shall be not larger than 180° (acute angle), as seen from the system vehicle, i.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the angle between the edge point connecting lines of each object to be no larger than 180°, so that objects have an acute shape from the vehicle's viewpoint.
technical_task: Ensure that for every object the angle between the line from the left edge point to the middle edge point and the line from the middle edge point to the right edge point is not larger than 180°, seen from the system vehicle.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object, when the angle between the two connecting lines is measured from the system vehicle, then it is not larger than 180°.
Given an object with an angle larger than 180°, when it is checked, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. The source text ends in a cut-off "i.".

requirement_text: The system shall allow a Member State to ask for the status of card (lost, stolen) to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority of the ember State having issued the card.
user_story: As a Member State official, I want to ask the Card Issuing Authority of the issuing Member State for the status of a card, so that I know whether it is lost or stolen.
technical_task: Provide a request from a Member State to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority for the status of a card, such as lost or stolen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a card issued by another Member State, when a Member State asks for its status, then the request goes to the corresponding Card Issuing Authority.
Given a status request, when the authority answers, then the status of the card, for example lost or stolen, is returned.

requirement_text: See SPEC LV 123 (`` Reference List for Client Specifications '' [HVBATT R-111]) for details.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Reference List for Client Specifications require?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: User shall expect the system to recover to a stable state within 5 minutes in the event of a system failure.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to recover to a stable state within 5 minutes after a failure, so that I can continue working.
technical_task: Return the system to a stable state within 5 minutes of a system failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a system failure, when recovery runs, then the system is in a stable state within 5 minutes.
Given a recovery that takes longer than 5 minutes, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What counts as a stable state is not defined.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to mark an item as a favorite for change notifications.
user_story: As a user, I want to mark an item as a favorite, so that I get change notifications for it.
technical_task: Provide a favorite marker on items that enables notifications about changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item, when the user marks it as a favorite, then it is flagged as a favorite.
Given a favorite item, when it changes, then a change notification is sent to the user.

requirement_text: The NE syndromes shall include indications of vote errors, fault-tolerant clock synchronization errors, and fiber-optic link errors, as detailed below.
requirement_text_raw: The NE syndromes shall (3.2.2.6.3) include indications of vote errors, fault-tolerant clock synchronization errors, and fiber-optic link errors, as detailed below.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the NE syndromes to include vote errors, clock synchronization errors and fiber-optic link errors, so that these faults can be diagnosed.
technical_task: Include indications of vote errors, fault-tolerant clock synchronization errors and fiber-optic link errors in the NE syndromes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vote error, when the NE syndromes are read, then it is indicated.
Given a fault-tolerant clock synchronization error or a fiber-optic link error, when the NE syndromes are read, then it is indicated.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "As detailed below" refers to text that is not included.

requirement_text: Power de-coupling mechanisms shall be designed into the NE.
requirement_text_raw: Power de-coupling mechanisms shall (3.2.3.1.2.4) be designed into the NE.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want power de-coupling mechanisms designed into the NE, so that power disturbances are limited.
technical_task: Design power de-coupling mechanisms into the NE.
acceptance_criteria: Given the NE design, when it is reviewed, then power de-coupling mechanisms are included.
Given the NE hardware, when it is inspected, then the mechanisms are present.

requirement_text: All account IDs that are used by the System are identified and the resources accessed by each account is known.
user_story: As a security officer, I want all account IDs used by the system identified and the resources each account accesses known, so that access can be audited.
technical_task: Identify every account ID the System uses and record the resources that each account accesses.
acceptance_criteria: Given the System, when its accounts are reviewed, then all account IDs it uses are identified.
Given an account ID, when it is reviewed, then the resources it accesses are known.

requirement_text: System shall maintain data integrity by preventing data loss through proper database management.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want data loss prevented through proper database management, so that data stays intact.
technical_task: Prevent loss of data by managing the database properly, including integrity protection.
acceptance_criteria: Given a database operation, when it completes, then no stored data is lost.
Given an interrupted operation, when the database is restored, then data integrity is maintained.
rationale: Role assumed: database administrator. "Proper" management practices are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to place data under embargo to protect rights of first use and confidentiality responsibilities.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to place data under embargo, so that rights of first use and confidentiality are protected.
technical_task: Provide an embargo function for data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when the user places it under embargo, then the data is withheld from others.
Given an embargoed dataset, when another user requests it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: researcher. The second criterion is an interpretation of embargo.

requirement_text: User shall be able to return to the product category page using the back button in the top corner.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to go back to the product category page with the back button in the top corner, so that I can keep browsing.
technical_task: Place a back button in the top corner that returns the user to the product category page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a page, when the user selects the back button in the top corner, then the product category page is shown.
Given the page, when it is displayed, then the back button is in the top corner.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. Which corner is not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall maintain low latency for a responsive user experience.
clarification_questions: What latency value counts as "low"?
Under what load and for which operations is latency measured?

requirement_text: The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80\% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'
user_story: As a user, I want feedback from the product when needed, so that I know my actions were confirmed.
technical_task: Give feedback on user actions and confirm them accurately, so that 80% of surveyed users report accurate confirmations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user action, when feedback is necessary, then the product gives feedback.
Given a survey of users, when the results are counted, then at least 80% report that the product accurately confirms their actions.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The 80% figure is taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: If a user account is revoked it can only be re-instantiated by the System Administrator.
requirement_text_raw: If a user account is revoked  it can only be re-instantiated by the System Administrator.'
user_story: As a system administrator, I want to be the only one who can re-instantiate a revoked user account, so that revoked accounts stay closed.
technical_task: Restrict re-instantiation of a revoked user account to the System Administrator.
acceptance_criteria: Given a revoked user account, when the System Administrator re-instantiates it, then the account is active again.
Given a revoked user account, when anyone else tries to re-instantiate it, then it is refused.

requirement_text: System shall be able to connect to power through an electrical outlet and support network connections via Ethernet port and serial port jack.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the system to connect to mains through an outlet and to networks through an Ethernet port and a serial port jack, so that it can be powered and networked.
technical_task: Provide a connection to an electrical outlet for power, an Ethernet port and a serial port jack for network connections.
acceptance_criteria: Given an electrical outlet, when the system is connected, then it is powered.
Given an Ethernet port or a serial port jack, when a network cable is connected, then a network connection is supported.

requirement_text: The Contractor shall add necessary implementation details to the Specification.
clarification_questions: Which implementation details are "necessary"?
In which section of the Specification must they be added?

requirement_text: The system shall be multilingual, supporting English, Turkish, Finnish, and Italian for international deployment.
user_story: As an international user, I want the system in English, Turkish, Finnish or Italian, so that I can use my language.
technical_task: Support the languages English, Turkish, Finnish and Italian.
acceptance_criteria: Given the language selection, when the user chooses Turkish, Finnish or Italian, then the interface is shown in that language.
Given the language selection, when the user chooses English, then the interface is shown in English.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner shall utilize scalable hosting solutions that can handle spikes in traffic without sacrificing performance.
user_story: As a parent, I want Crafty kids corner hosted on scalable hosting that copes with traffic spikes, so that the site stays usable.
technical_task: Host Crafty kids corner on scalable hosting that handles spikes in traffic without a loss of performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a spike in traffic, when users access Crafty kids corner, then the site stays available.
Given a spike in traffic, when users use the site, then performance does not drop.

requirement_text: System shall/will identify dependencies on external services or APIs.
user_story: As a developer, I want the dependencies on external services or APIs identified, so that I know what the system relies on.
technical_task: Identify and list the external services and APIs the system depends on.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when its design is analysed, then the dependencies on external services are identified.
Given the system, when its design is analysed, then the dependencies on external APIs are identified.

requirement_text: A chef shall be able to indicate that a customers order item is ready to be served through a display.
user_story: As a chef, I want to mark a customer's order item as ready to serve on a display, so that waiters know to collect it.
technical_task: Provide a display function with which a chef flags an order item as ready to be served.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order item on the display, when the chef marks it as ready, then it is flagged as ready to be served.
Given an item flagged as ready, when the display is viewed, then the item is shown as ready.

requirement_text: The program shall be free software for maximum public benefit through unrestricted redistribution.
user_story: As a user, I want the program released as free software, so that anyone may redistribute it without restriction.
technical_task: Distribute the program as free software with unrestricted redistribution.
acceptance_criteria: Given the program, when it is released, then it is under a free software licence.
Given a recipient of the program, when the recipient redistributes it, then no restriction prevents this.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Maximum public benefit" is not tested.

requirement_text: The administrator chooses a drug from each list to record an interaction between the two drugs.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to record an interaction by picking one drug from each of two lists, so that interactions are stored.
technical_task: Provide two drug lists from which the administrator picks one drug each to record an interaction between them.
acceptance_criteria: Given two drug lists, when the administrator chooses a drug from each, then an interaction between the two drugs is recorded.
Given a recorded interaction, when it is viewed, then both drugs are shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to add inventory assets, with DA group members or authorized inventory group members adding assets owned by the department.
user_story: As a DA group member, I want to add inventory assets owned by my department, so that its assets are recorded.
technical_task: Allow inventory assets to be added by DA group members or authorized inventory group members for assets owned by the department.
acceptance_criteria: Given a DA group member or an authorized inventory group member, when the member adds an asset owned by the department, then the asset is saved.
Given a user outside these groups, when the user tries to add an asset, then it is refused.

requirement_text: The system shall function reliably, with few or no interruptions in its first operational year and fewer still thereafter.

How is reliability measured?

requirement_text: A customer shall not be able to dismiss their engaged menu while there is a non-empty pending order associated with the engaged menu.
requirement_text_raw: A customer shall not be able to dismiss their engaged menu while there is a  non-empty pending order associated with the engaged menu.
user_story: As a customer, I want my engaged menu protected from dismissal while there is a pending order on it, so that I do not lose an order.
technical_task: Block the dismissal of an engaged menu when a non-empty pending order is associated with it.
acceptance_criteria: Given an engaged menu with a non-empty pending order, when the customer tries to dismiss it, then it is not dismissed.
Given an engaged menu with no pending order, when the customer dismisses it, then it is dismissed.
rationale: Role stated: customer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: System shall enable users to export their stories to their gallery and share them directly to social media platforms with ease.
user_story: As a user, I want to export my stories to my gallery and share them directly to social media, so that I can keep and show them.
technical_task: Provide export of stories to the gallery and direct sharing to social media platforms.
acceptance_criteria: Given a story, when the user exports it, then it is saved to the gallery.
Given a story, when the user shares it to a social media platform, then it is posted there directly.

requirement_text: The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want the website to keep working when the streaming server goes down, so that I can still use it.
technical_task: Keep the website operating when the streaming server is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the streaming server is down, when a viewer uses the website, then the website continues to operate.
Given the streaming server is down, when a viewer opens a page that needs streaming, then the website still responds.
rationale: Role assumed: viewer. Which functions continue is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to transfer funds between their own accounts or to others accounts.
user_story: As a bank customer, I want to transfer funds between my own accounts or to other people's accounts, so that I can move money.
technical_task: Support fund transfers between a user's own accounts and to the accounts of others.
acceptance_criteria: Given two of the user's own accounts, when the user transfers funds, then the amount moves between them.
Given another person's account, when the user transfers funds, then the amount is sent to that account.

rationale: The sentence is an introduction to a description and states no requirement.

requirement_text_raw: If the configuration needs to be changed due to a fault, as specified above, Redundancy Management shall [SRS128] issue a configuration update to mask out the failed network element.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to issue a configuration update that masks out a failed network element, so that the fault is isolated.

acceptance_criteria: Given a fault that requires a configuration change, when Redundancy Management reacts, then it issues a configuration update.
Given the configuration update, when it is applied, then the failed network element is masked out.

requirement_text: The administer is presented with two lists of NDC codes or names.
user_story: As an administrator, I want two lists of NDC codes or names shown to me, so that I can pick items from them.
technical_task: Display two lists of NDC codes or names to the administrator.
acceptance_criteria: Given the administrator opens the screen, when it is displayed, then two lists of NDC codes or names are presented.
Given the two lists, when the administrator reads them, then each entry is shown as an NDC code or name.

requirement_text: The public health agent may also choose to remove an adverse event report (such as based upon communication with the reporter or because the report appears to be bogus) .
user_story: As a public health agent, I want to remove an adverse event report, for example after talking to the reporter or when it looks bogus, so that bad reports are cleared.
technical_task: Allow a public health agent to remove an adverse event report.
acceptance_criteria: Given an adverse event report, when the public health agent removes it, then the report is no longer listed.
Given a removed report, when the report list is viewed, then it is not shown.

requirement_text: The operating temperature range for the prototype NEs shall be from 0 to 32.2º C at the inlet to the cooling fans.
requirement_text_raw: The operating temperature range for the prototype NEs shall (3.2.3.1.1.3) be from 0 to 32.2º C at the inlet to the cooling fans.

acceptance_criteria: Given a prototype NE, when the inlet temperature at the cooling fans is within 0 to 32.2 degrees C, then the NE operates.
Given the inlet temperature is measured, when it is checked, then it is taken at the inlet to the cooling fans.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to change the web-portals language to Spanish.
user_story: As a user, I want to switch the web portal's language to Spanish, so that I can read it in Spanish.
technical_task: Offer Spanish as a language for the web portal.
acceptance_criteria: Given the web portal, when the user selects Spanish, then the portal is displayed in Spanish.
Given the portal in Spanish, when the user opens another page, then it is also in Spanish.

requirement_text: The system shall prevent producing any audible disturbance signals independently from opened / closed state of sun roofs, doors and windows.
user_story: As a driver, I want no audible disturbance signals regardless of whether sun roofs, doors and windows are open or closed, so that the cabin stays quiet.
technical_task: Prevent audible disturbance signals in every open or closed state of sun roofs, doors and windows.
acceptance_criteria: Given sun roofs, doors and windows are open, when the system runs, then no audible disturbance signal is produced.
Given sun roofs, doors and windows are closed, when the system runs, then no audible disturbance signal is produced.

acceptance_criteria: Given the login interface, when it is displayed, then it has an input for username or email and an input for password.
Given valid values in both inputs, when the user submits, then the user is logged in.

user_story: As a physician, I want a record of each patient's prescribed medications and dosages, so that I know their treatment.
technical_task: Store the prescribed medications and their dosages in the record of each patient.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when a medication is prescribed, then the medication and the dosage are recorded.
Given a patient record, when it is viewed, then the prescribed medications and dosages are shown.

user_story: As a user, I want to be sent to the manager or worker part of the program after I log in, so that I see what fits my role.
