rationale: Role assumed: user. The management actions are an interpretation.

requirement_text: Official events listed on Drexel website, location and hours will have accuracy greater than 40%.
user_story: As a visitor, I want official events, locations and hours shown with accuracy above 40%, so that I can rely on them.
technical_task: Display official events listed on the Drexel website, with their location and hours, at an accuracy of more than 40%.
acceptance_criteria: Given the official events on the Drexel website, when their accuracy is measured, then it is greater than 40%.
Given an accuracy of 40% or less, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: User shall have their meal planner tailored to accommodate their allergies and food choices for safety and dietary preferences.
user_story: As a user with allergies, I want my meal planner adapted to my allergies and food choices, so that meals are safe and match my preferences.
technical_task: Tailor the meal planner to the user's allergies and food choices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with entered allergies, when the meal planner proposes meals, then it excludes them.
Given a user with food choices, when the meal planner proposes meals, then it matches those choices.

requirement_text: System shall validate email and phone numbers during signup to ensure uniqueness.
user_story: As a new user, I want my email and phone number validated at signup for uniqueness, so that duplicate accounts are avoided.
technical_task: Validate that the email and phone number are unique during signup.
acceptance_criteria: Given an email or phone number not yet registered, when the user signs up, then signup continues.
Given an email or phone number already registered, when the user signs up, then it is rejected.

requirement_text: The details of transitions shall be disclossed to OEM.
user_story: As an OEM representative, I want the details of transitions disclosed to me, so that I can see how states change.
technical_task: Disclose the details of the transitions to the OEM.
acceptance_criteria: Given the transition details, when they are prepared, then they are disclosed to the OEM.
Given the OEM, when it asks for transition details, then they are available.
rationale: Role assumed: OEM representative. Which transitions are meant is not stated.

requirement_text: All content on Crafty kids corner shall be age-appropriate and suitable for children.
user_story: As a parent, I want all content on Crafty kids corner to be age-appropriate, so that it is suitable for my child.
technical_task: Ensure that all content on Crafty kids corner is age-appropriate and suitable for children.
acceptance_criteria: Given content on Crafty kids corner, when it is published, then it is age-appropriate.
Given content that is not suitable for children, when it is found, then it is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: parent. The age range is not given.

requirement_text: Alternatively, the user can push the delete key of the keyboard to delete the connection.
user_story: As a user, I want to press the delete key to delete a connection, so that I can remove it quickly.
technical_task: Support deleting a connection with the delete key of the keyboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected connection, when the user presses the delete key, then the connection is deleted.
Given no selected connection, when the user presses the delete key, then nothing is deleted.
rationale: Role assumed: user. This is an alternative to another way of deleting a connection.

requirement_text: The customer shall receive notifications upon both order acceptance and order delivery.
user_story: As a customer, I want notifications when my order is accepted and when it is delivered, so that I know its progress.
technical_task: Send notifications to the customer on order acceptance and on order delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order is accepted, when the acceptance occurs, then the customer receives a notification.
Given an order is delivered, when the delivery occurs, then the customer receives a notification.

requirement_text: The details of this block are described in the sub chapter below "ECU Specific Environmental Data" [DI-109].
rationale: The sentence only points to another section.
clarification_questions: What does the sub chapter "ECU Specific Environmental Data" contain?
Is the referenced chapter part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Sensitive data and secrets are not incorporated in code.
requirement_text_raw: Sensitive data and secrets are not incorporated in  code.
user_story: As a security officer, I want sensitive data and secrets kept out of code, so that they are not leaked.
technical_task: Keep sensitive data and secrets out of the source code.
acceptance_criteria: Given the source code, when it is reviewed, then it contains no sensitive data or secrets.
Given a secret the application needs, when it is supplied, then it is provided outside the code.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: Dr Susan Poslusny and Dr Julie Donalek are the only people who shall have access to students' personal information.
requirement_text_raw: Dr Susan Poslusny and Dr Julie Donalek are the only people who shall have access to students' personal information.'
user_story: As a program coordinator, I want only Dr Susan Poslusny and Dr Julie Donalek to see students' personal information, so that privacy is protected.
technical_task: Restrict access to students' personal information to Dr Susan Poslusny and Dr Julie Donalek.
acceptance_criteria: Given Dr Susan Poslusny or Dr Julie Donalek, when either opens students' personal information, then access is granted.
Given any other person, when the person tries to open students' personal information, then access is denied.

requirement_text: A server shall host the RMOS and provide system data processing and storage capability.
requirement_text_raw: A server shall host the RMOS and provide system data processing and storage  capability.
user_story: As a system operator, I want a server to host the RMOS and provide data processing and storage, so that the system has a home.
technical_task: Run the RMOS on a server that offers data processing and storage capability for system data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the RMOS, when it is deployed, then it is hosted on a server.
Given system data, when it is processed or stored, then the server provides the capability.

requirement_text: System shall automatically populate relevant DMP fields with existing institutional data.
user_story: As a researcher, I want relevant DMP fields filled automatically from existing institutional data, so that I enter less by hand.
technical_task: Prefill relevant Data Management Plan fields from existing institutional data.
acceptance_criteria: Given existing institutional data, when a DMP is created, then relevant fields are filled automatically.
Given a field with no institutional data, when the DMP is created, then the field is left for the user to enter.

requirement_text: If a user leaves the game prematurely, a new CO is created on another user's machine to fill their place.
user_story: As a player, I want a new CO created on another user's machine when someone leaves early, so that the game goes on.
technical_task: Create a new CO on another user's machine to take the place of a user who leaves the game prematurely.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user leaves the game prematurely, when the departure is detected, then a new CO is created on another user's machine.
Given the new CO, when the game continues, then it fills the place of the user who left.

requirement_text: The system shall allow camp administrators to send warnings to staff members.
user_story: As a camp administrator, I want to send warnings to staff members, so that problems are flagged.
technical_task: Provide a function for camp administrators to send warnings to staff members.
acceptance_criteria: Given a staff member, when the camp administrator sends a warning, then the staff member receives it.
Given a sent warning, when the administrator reviews it, then it is recorded as sent.

requirement_text: Employees shall be able to maintain daily logs.
user_story: As an employee, I want to keep daily logs, so that my work is recorded.
technical_task: Allow employees to maintain a log for each day.
acceptance_criteria: Given a day, when an employee enters a log entry, then it is saved.
Given a saved log, when the employee opens it, then the entries are shown.

requirement_text: User shall choose to download the article.
user_story: As a reader, I want to choose to download an article, so that I can read it offline.
technical_task: Offer a download option for articles.
acceptance_criteria: Given an article, when the user chooses to download it, then it is downloaded.
Given an article, when the user does not choose to download, then no file is downloaded.

requirement_text: The Development Team shall label every scheduled [SYSTEM NAME] build in the source control system.
rationale: The requirement contains the placeholder [SYSTEM NAME].
clarification_questions: Which system does [SYSTEM NAME] stand for?
What is a "scheduled build" and what label format applies?

requirement_text: Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.
requirement_text_raw: Aside from server failure  the software product shall achieve 99.99\% up time.'
user_story: As a user, I want the software available 99.99% of the time apart from server failure, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Achieve 99.99% up time of the software product, excluding server failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a measurement period, when up time is computed without server failure, then it is at least 99.99%.
Given up time below 99.99% not caused by server failure, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: In all FCP IBIT cases, provided the hardware state permits, the FTSS shall log the error and report it in the X-38 telemetry stream.
requirement_text_raw: In all FCP IBIT cases, provided the hardware state permits, the FTSS shall (3.3.2.29) log the error and report it in the X-38 telemetry stream.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS to log and report each FCP IBIT error in the X-38 telemetry stream when the hardware state permits, so that faults are visible.
technical_task: Log the error in all FCP IBIT cases and report it in the X-38 telemetry stream, provided the hardware state permits.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP IBIT error and a hardware state that permits it, when it occurs, then the FTSS logs the error.
Given the same error and hardware state, when it occurs, then the FTSS reports it in the X-38 telemetry stream.

requirement_text: The system shall provide a structured experience for users to navigate through commands tailored to their needs.
rationale: "Structured experience" and "tailored to their needs" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What commands and user needs must the structured experience cover?
How is "structured" measured?

requirement_text: All changes to the System hosting environment are logged and tracked.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want all changes to the hosting environment logged and tracked, so that I can see who changed what.
technical_task: Log and track every change made to the hosting environment of the System.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change to the hosting environment, when it is made, then it is logged.
Given a logged change, when the log is reviewed, then the change can be tracked.

requirement_text: The system shall print a formatted bill for the customer.
user_story: As a cashier, I want to print a formatted bill for the customer, so that the customer gets a record of the sale.
technical_task: Provide bill printing in a formatted layout for the customer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed sale, when the cashier prints the bill, then a formatted bill is printed for the customer.
Given a printed bill, when it is read, then it shows the details of the sale.
rationale: Role assumed: cashier. The layout is not specified.

requirement_text: Internal notes on applicants shall be maintainable.
user_story: As a recruiter, I want to maintain internal notes on applicants, so that my team shares what it knows.
technical_task: Allow internal notes on applicants to be created and edited.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant, when the recruiter adds a note, then it is saved with the applicant.
Given an existing note, when the recruiter edits it, then the change is stored.

requirement_text: Access to these capabilities must be through a secure channel that ensures all content is encrypted and integrity-protected in accordance with the standard for encryption and hashing algorithms specified at § 170.210(f).
user_story: As a security officer, I want access to these capabilities only over a secure channel with encrypted, integrity-protected content, so that data cannot be read or altered in transit.
technical_task: Provide access to the capabilities only through a secure channel that encrypts and integrity-protects all content using the encryption and hashing algorithms specified at § 170.210(f).
acceptance_criteria: Given a request to use the capabilities, when it is made over an insecure channel, then access is refused.
Given a request over the secure channel, when content is exchanged, then it is encrypted and integrity-protected according to § 170.210(f).
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. "These capabilities" refers to an earlier requirement that is not included.

requirement_text: Authorised networks shall be listed (or automatically selected if automatic selection has been enabled) in the following order: (M) home EIRENE network; foreign EIRENE networks; public networks.
requirement_text_raw: 10.5.1 Authorised networks shall be listed (or automatically selected if automatic selection has been enabled) in the following order: (M) home EIRENE network; foreign EIRENE networks; public networks.
user_story: As a railway user, I want authorised networks listed in a fixed order, so that my home network is preferred.
technical_task: List the authorised networks, or select them automatically when automatic selection is enabled, in the order home EIRENE network, foreign EIRENE networks, public networks.
acceptance_criteria: Given authorised networks are available, when they are listed, then the order is home EIRENE network, foreign EIRENE networks, public networks.
Given automatic selection is enabled, when a network is selected, then it follows the same order.
rationale: Role assumed: railway user. The (M) tag in the source is not interpreted.

requirement_text: User shall easily maintain the system due to its modular design, especially concerning frequent changes in database contents.
clarification_questions: What maintenance effort or time is meant by "easily"?
What counts as a "frequent" change in database contents?

requirement_text: The data mentioned in requirement 3.4.2.2 and any other Draper-provided telemetry data shall fit within Draper’s allocated telemetry budget of 5000 bits/sec.
requirement_text_raw: The data mentioned in requirement 3.4.2.2 and any other Draper-provided telemetry data shall (3.4.2.9) fit within Draper’s allocated telemetry budget of 5000 bits/sec.
user_story: As a telemetry engineer, I want the listed data and any other Draper-provided telemetry to fit in Draper's 5000 bits/sec budget, so that the allocation is not exceeded.
technical_task: Keep the data from the referenced requirement and any other Draper-provided telemetry data within Draper's allocated telemetry budget of 5000 bits/sec.
acceptance_criteria: Given the telemetry data, when the combined rate is measured, then it does not exceed 5000 bits/sec.
Given a rate above 5000 bits/sec, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: telemetry engineer. The referenced requirement is not included in the text.

requirement_text: System shall integrate with Pure to enable dataset deposition and management within the platform.
user_story: As a researcher, I want the system to integrate with Pure, so that I can deposit and manage datasets within the platform.
technical_task: Integrate with Pure for dataset deposition and management.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when the user deposits it, then it is stored via Pure.
Given a deposited dataset, when the user manages it, then the management happens within the platform.

requirement_text: Necessary offset compensation shall only base on comparison of the signals among each other and an appropriate averaging over time and driven distance.
user_story: As a sensor engineer, I want offset compensation based only on comparing the signals and on averaging over time and driven distance, so that no outside reference is used.
technical_task: Base any necessary offset compensation solely on the comparison of the signals with each other and on an appropriate averaging over time and driven distance.
acceptance_criteria: Given offset compensation is needed, when it is calculated, then it uses only the comparison of the signals among each other and averaging over time and driven distance.
Given an input from any other source, when compensation is calculated, then it is not used.
rationale: Role assumed: sensor engineer. "Appropriate" averaging is not quantified.

requirement_text: If sensors usses daisy chain see PSI 5 specification v 1.3 for details (adressing).
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What does the PSI 5 specification say about daisy chain addressing?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The system shall allow camp administrators to modify added parents' information.
user_story: As a camp administrator, I want to change the information of parents I added, so that records stay correct.
technical_task: Allow camp administrators to modify the information of added parents.
acceptance_criteria: Given an added parent, when the camp administrator edits the information and saves, then the change is stored.
Given a modified parent record, when it is viewed, then the new information is shown.

requirement_text: If the vehicle was parked for longer than T_STANDBY, the position assignments of the four wheel sensors are redetermined in the subsequent trip.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want wheel sensor positions determined again on the next trip after a long parking time, so that assignments stay correct.
technical_task: Redetermine the position assignments of the four wheel sensors on the next trip when the vehicle was parked for longer than T_STANDBY.
acceptance_criteria: Given the vehicle was parked for longer than T_STANDBY, when the next trip starts, then the position assignments of the four wheel sensors are redetermined.
Given the vehicle was parked for no longer than T_STANDBY, when the next trip starts, then the assignments are not required to be redetermined.
rationale: Role assumed: vehicle engineer. The value of T_STANDBY is not given.

requirement_text: The solution should support remote monitoring and administration via Netscape Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) IETF Secure Shell (SSH) IETF IP Security (IPSEC) or similar secure method.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should support remote monitoring and administration via Netscape Secure Sockets Layer (SSL)  IETF Secure Shell (SSH)  IETF IP Security (IPSEC) or similar secure method.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want remote monitoring and administration over SSL, SSH, IPSEC or a similar secure method, so that remote access is protected.
technical_task: Support remote monitoring and administration through Netscape Secure Sockets Layer (SSL), IETF Secure Shell (SSH), IETF IP Security (IPSEC) or a similar secure method.
acceptance_criteria: Given a remote administrator, when connecting, then SSL, SSH or IPSEC can be used.
Given remote monitoring, when it is carried out, then it runs over a secure method.

requirement_text: The system shall ensure multi-lingual support, with English, Turkish, Finnish, and Italian as supported languages due to replication partnerships.
user_story: As an international user, I want the system in English, Turkish, Finnish and Italian, so that partners in each language can use it.
technical_task: Provide multi-lingual support for English, Turkish, Finnish and Italian.
acceptance_criteria: Given the language setting, when a user picks Turkish, Finnish or Italian, then the system is shown in that language.
Given the language setting, when a user picks English, then the system is shown in English.
rationale: Role assumed: international user. The replication partnerships are the stated reason.

requirement_text: Connectors, couplers or plugs must not have sharp edges or any radius smaller than 0.5 millimetres, to avoid damages of cable harness or injuring of assembler.
user_story: As an assembler, I want connectors, couplers and plugs without sharp edges or radii below 0.5 millimetres, so that I am not injured and the cable harness is not damaged.
technical_task: Design connectors, couplers and plugs without sharp edges and with no radius smaller than 0.5 millimetres.
acceptance_criteria: Given a connector, coupler or plug, when it is inspected, then it has no sharp edges.
Given a connector, coupler or plug, when its radii are measured, then none is smaller than 0.5 millimetres.

requirement_text: Support Services shall continue to close and reopen a faulty MPCC device until status shows that the device has recovered.
requirement_text_raw: Support Services shall [SRS242] continue to close and reopen a faulty MPCC device until status shows that the device has recovered.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Support Services to keep closing and reopening a faulty MPCC device until it recovers, so that transient faults clear.
technical_task: Have Support Services repeat closing and reopening a faulty MPCC device until its status shows recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Given a faulty MPCC device, when its status shows a fault, then Support Services closes and reopens it.
Given the status shows the device has recovered, when Support Services checks it, then it stops closing and reopening the device.

requirement_text: Details of the signal group and the application ID are within the actual CAN matrix.
rationale: The sentence says where details are found and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a statement about where details are kept?
What must the system do with the signal group and application ID?

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to record changing the date and time where the clinical solution allows this to be done.
user_story: As an auditor, I want changes of the date and time recorded where the clinical solution allows them, so that time changes are traceable.
technical_task: Record each change of the date and time in the clinical solution wherever the solution allows it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the clinical solution allows the date and time to be changed, when it is changed, then the change is recorded.
Given the clinical solution does not allow the change, when the date and time are viewed, then no change is recorded.

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide status data to the application about each FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC used for command data.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS304] provide status data to the application about each FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC used for command data.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to give the application status data for each FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC used for command data, so that I can monitor the links.
technical_task: Provide status data to the application for every FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC that is used for command data.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCC-MPCC RS-422 link to the CTC used for command data, when the application asks, then FTSS provides the status data of that link.
Given several such links, when the application asks, then FTSS provides status data for each of them.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to select a specific train schedule for further details (e.g., departure time, platform number).
user_story: As a traveller, I want to select a train schedule to see details such as departure time and platform number, so that I can plan my trip.
technical_task: Allow a specific train schedule to be selected and show its details, for example departure time and platform number.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of train schedules, when the user selects one, then its details are displayed.
Given the details, when they are displayed, then they include the departure time and the platform number.

requirement_text: System shall direct the user to respective account pages for login and terms acceptance.
user_story: As a user, I want to be taken to the right account pages for login and terms acceptance, so that I can finish both steps.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the respective account pages for login and for terms acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who needs to log in, when the user continues, then the login account page is shown.
Given a user who must accept terms, when the user continues, then the terms acceptance account page is shown.

requirement_text: The solution should comply with the Privacy Rule that protects all individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity or its business associate in any form or media whether electronic paper or oral.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should comply with the Privacy Rule that protects all individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity or its business associate  in any form or media  whether electronic  paper  or oral.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the solution to follow the Privacy Rule for individually identifiable health information, so that it is protected in any form.
technical_task: Comply with the Privacy Rule protecting all individually identifiable health information held or transmitted by a covered entity or its business associate in electronic, paper or oral form.
acceptance_criteria: Given individually identifiable health information held by a covered entity or its business associate, when it is processed, then the Privacy Rule is followed.
Given the information in electronic, paper or oral form, when it is transmitted, then it is protected under the Privacy Rule.

requirement_text: Master Password has no limits in length. A whole sentence can be used with more than 100 characters.
user_story: As a user, I want a master password without a length limit, so that I can use a whole sentence of more than 100 characters.
technical_task: Accept master passwords of any length, including whole sentences with more than 100 characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a master password of more than 100 characters, when the user sets it, then it is accepted.
Given a master password in the form of a whole sentence, when the user enters it, then it works to unlock.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to choose to view "tatkaal" or "normal" applicants.
user_story: As a user, I want to choose to view "tatkaal" or "normal" applicants, so that I can focus on one kind.
technical_task: Provide a choice between viewing "tatkaal" applicants and "normal" applicants.
acceptance_criteria: Given the applicant list, when the user chooses "tatkaal", then only tatkaal applicants are shown.
Given the applicant list, when the user chooses "normal", then only normal applicants are shown.

requirement_text: User shall download attached files from experiments using a web browser or a network drive.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to download files attached to experiments through a web browser or a network drive, so that I can use them offline.
technical_task: Offer downloads of the files attached to experiments via a web browser or via a network drive.
acceptance_criteria: Given an experiment with attached files, when the user downloads a file using a web browser, then the file is downloaded.
Given an experiment with attached files, when the user accesses a file through a network drive, then the file can be retrieved.

requirement_text: The system requires end users to provide their symptoms accurately to avoid false predictions.
user_story: As a patient, I want to enter my symptoms accurately, so that the predictions are not false.
technical_task: Require end users to enter their symptoms to the system for predictions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the symptom form, when the end user enters symptoms, then the symptoms are used for the prediction.
Given the symptom form, when no symptom is provided, then no prediction is made.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. The accuracy of user input cannot be enforced by the system.

requirement_text: User shall select a specific car from the list.
user_story: As a customer, I want to pick a specific car from the list, so that I can see or choose it.
technical_task: Provide a list from which a specific car can be selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of cars, when the user selects one, then that car is chosen.
Given a chosen car, when the next page is displayed, then it refers to that car.

requirement_text: The product must record the score (time and number of counts) of a play associated with the name of a user.
user_story: As a player, I want my play's score, time and number of counts recorded with my name, so that results are attributed to me.
technical_task: Record the score of a play, being its time and number of counts, together with the name of the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a finished play, when it is recorded, then the time and the number of counts are stored.
Given a recorded play, when it is viewed, then it is associated with the name of the user.

requirement_text: The data in the database is analyzed according to the risk factors for the disease to determine if the patient exhibits one or more risk factors.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the database analyzed against disease risk factors, so that I know whether a patient has one or more of them.
technical_task: Analyze the data in the database according to the risk factors for the disease and determine whether the patient has one or more risk factors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient's data in the database, when the analysis runs, then it is evaluated against the risk factors for the disease.
Given the analysis result, when it is shown, then it states whether the patient exhibits one or more risk factors.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The risk factors are not listed.

requirement_text: Upon successful payment, the user shall be enrolled in the course.
user_story: As a learner, I want to be enrolled in a course once my payment succeeds, so that I can start learning.
technical_task: Enroll the user in the course when the payment is successful.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful payment, when it is confirmed, then the user is enrolled in the course.
Given a failed payment, when it is processed, then the user is not enrolled.

requirement_text: System shall generate notifications when the stock of a particular medicine falls below a predefined threshold.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want a notification when a medicine's stock falls below a set threshold, so that I can reorder.
technical_task: Generate a notification whenever the stock of a medicine falls below its predefined threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Given the stock of a medicine falls below its predefined threshold, when this is detected, then a notification is generated.
Given the stock is at or above the threshold, when it is checked, then no notification is generated.
rationale: Role assumed: pharmacist. The threshold values are not given.

requirement_text: The system display shall support a minimum resolution of 1024 x 576 pixels.
user_story: As a user, I want the display to support at least 1024 x 576 pixels, so that content fits.
technical_task: Support a minimum display resolution of 1024 x 576 pixels.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display of 1024 x 576 pixels, when the system is shown, then the content is displayed.
Given a display with a higher resolution, when the system is shown, then the content is also displayed.

requirement_text: In the Search or Add Patient page enter the patient's name & birth date.
user_story: As a clerk, I want to enter the patient's name and birth date in the Search or Add Patient page, so that I find or create the patient.
technical_task: Provide the Search or Add Patient page with inputs for the patient's name and birth date.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Search or Add Patient page, when it is displayed, then it has inputs for name and birth date.
Given a name and birth date entered, when the clerk submits, then the patient search or addition continues.

requirement_text: The details of the balancing concept shall be designed by the contractor.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor to design the details of the balancing concept, so that responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Assign the design of the details of the balancing concept to the contractor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the balancing concept, when its details are designed, then the contractor designed them.
Given the delivered design, when it is reviewed, then it covers the details of the balancing concept.

requirement_text: Shall a city be selected, all theatres and movies showing on that day shall be listed.
user_story: As a moviegoer, I want all theatres and movies showing that day listed when I select a city, so that I can choose a show.
technical_task: List all theatres and movies showing on the day when a city is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected city, when the list is displayed, then all theatres in it are listed.
Given a selected city, when the list is displayed, then all movies showing that day are listed.

requirement_text: The user may click in the frame that contains the remaining wall and a frame showing the discarded tiles will be shown.
user_story: As a player, I want to click the frame with the remaining wall and see a frame with the discarded tiles, so that I can check what is left.
technical_task: Show a frame with the discarded tiles when the user clicks the frame that contains the remaining wall.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frame that contains the remaining wall, when the user clicks it, then a frame showing the discarded tiles is shown.

user_story: As a researcher, I want descriptive records for ETDs available externally, so that others can discover them.

Given a displayed transaction number, when the user quotes it, then it identifies the transaction.

requirement_text: The patient chooses a specific referral from the list to view complete details about the referral: sending HCP name and specialty receiving HCP name and specialty time generated priority office visit date and notes.
requirement_text_raw: The patient chooses a specific referral from the list to view complete details about the referral: sending HCP name and specialty  receiving HCP name and specialty  time generated  priority  office visit date  and notes.

requirement_text: The sensor shall deliver fewer than 100 false alarm sensor objects per hour in all ODAs, where the number of sensor cycles the false alarm is delivered as sensor object is less than or equal 2.
user_story: As a sensor engineer, I want fewer than 100 false alarm objects per hour in all ODAs, with each false alarm delivered for no more than 2 sensor cycles, so that false alarms are rare and short.

Given a false alarm delivered as a sensor object, when its duration is counted in sensor cycles, then it is less than or equal to 2.

requirement_text: Edit task page will be opened.
rationale: The sentence is a fragment that describes a page opening and gives no trigger or behaviour.

What must the page contain?

requirement_text: The system shall securely store and manage patient electronic health records, including medical history, diagnoses, treatments, and lab results.
user_story: As a physician, I want patient electronic health records stored and managed securely, including history, diagnoses, treatments and lab results, so that I can rely on them.

requirement_text: The user chooses to open his or her message inbox or outbox.

acceptance_criteria: Given the messages page, when the user opens the inbox, then received messages are shown.
Given the messages page, when the user opens the outbox, then sent messages are shown.

requirement_text: System shall be available 24 hours a day.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available 24 hours a day, so that I can use it at any time.
technical_task: Keep the system available 24 hours a day.
acceptance_criteria: Given any hour of a 24 hour day, when the user opens the system, then it is available.
Given a full day of operation, when availability is checked, then it is available throughout the 24 hours.

user_story: As a user, I want to select a session by FACET and the tool I wish to use, so that I join the right session.

acceptance_criteria: Given a FACET and a tool, when the user selects them, then the matching session is offered.
Given the matching session, when the user selects it, then the session is joined.

requirement_text: Access to the transmit queues shall be controlled within the communication service primitives .
requirement_text_raw: Access to the transmit queues shall (3.3.6.8) be controlled within the communication service primitives .

requirement_text: System shall provide search functionality based on criteria such as person, type of crime, modus operandi, etc.
user_story: As an investigator, I want to search by person, type of crime, modus operandi and other criteria, so that I can find related cases.

user_story: As a user, I want to customize the irregular activity reports, so that they show what I need.

user_story: As a customer, I want to choose a payment method and complete the payment, so that I can buy.

acceptance_criteria: Given the payment methods, when the user selects one, then it is chosen for the payment.
Given a chosen payment method, when the user completes the payment, then the payment is processed.

user_story: As a user, I want progress indicators while cloning runs, so that I know how far it has come.

requirement_text: THEN effective TSA speed limit shall be updated earliest 200 milliseconds before and no later than when the EV is passing the speed limit sign associated with exit ramp.
user_story: As a driver, I want the effective TSA speed limit updated near the exit ramp sign, so that I see the right limit.

acceptance_criteria: Given the NE, when 6 virtual groups are configured, then all are supported.
Given fewer than 6 virtual groups, when they are configured, then they are supported too.

requirement_text: User shall be able to handle the initial withdrawal sequence.
rationale: "Handle" and "initial withdrawal sequence" are not defined.
clarification_questions: What is the "initial withdrawal sequence" and what steps does it have?
What must the system do when the user handles it?

requirement_text: FDIR shall report the total FCC status to the Vehicle/Mission Manager when requested to do so by the Vehicle/Mission Manager.
requirement_text_raw: FDIR shall (3.3.5.3) report the total FCC status to the Vehicle/Mission Manager when requested to do so by the Vehicle/Mission Manager.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want FDIR to report the total FCC status to the Vehicle/Mission Manager when it asks, so that I can see the overall state.
technical_task: Report the total FCC status from FDIR to the Vehicle/Mission Manager on request by the Vehicle/Mission Manager.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Vehicle/Mission Manager requests the FCC status, when FDIR handles the request, then it reports the total FCC status.
Given no request from the Vehicle/Mission Manager, when FDIR runs, then the report is not required.

requirement_text: User shall receive a more helpful file-level error message when uploading a file with the wrong extension.
user_story: As a user, I want a more helpful error message when I upload a file with the wrong extension, so that I can correct it.
technical_task: Show an improved file-level error message when an uploaded file has a wrong extension.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file with the wrong extension, when the user uploads it, then a file-level error message is displayed.
Given the error message, when the user reads it, then it explains that the extension is wrong.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "More helpful" is read as stating the cause of the error.

requirement_text: Employers shall be able to create questions for applicants to respond to when applying.
user_story: As an employer, I want to create questions for applicants to answer when they apply, so that I can screen them.
technical_task: Provide a function for employers to create questions that applicants answer when applying.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application setup, when the employer creates a question, then it is saved.
Given an application, when the applicant applies, then the applicant is asked the employer's questions.

requirement_text: A maximum of 10 Free Users shall be allowed in Webble with limited access to features.
user_story: As a Webble product owner, I want the number of Free Users capped at 10 with reduced feature access, so that paying users keep the full feature set.
technical_task: Enforce a cap of 10 Free Users on Webble and give those accounts only a limited set of features.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 Free Users already exist, when another Free User tries to register, then the registration is refused.
Given a Free User, when the user opens a feature outside the limited set, then access to it is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: Webble product owner. The list of limited features is not given.

requirement_text: Create a message digest in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210©.
user_story: As a security officer, I want a message digest created for data using the standard cited in § 170.210©, so that tampering can be detected.
technical_task: Add a hashing step that outputs a message digest built as defined by the cited standard, § 170.210©.
acceptance_criteria: Given data to be protected, when the hashing step runs, then a message digest is produced.
Given the message digest, when its algorithm is checked, then it follows the standard cited in § 170.210©.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The cited standard is not reproduced in the requirement; the © sign is read as a closing parenthesis of the citation.

requirement_text: The Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation) to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
requirement_text_raw: The  Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation)  to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
user_story: As a clinician, I want Clinical Decision Support to show who authored data and who is responsible for it, so that I can trust the information.
technical_task: Make the Clinical Decision Support capability conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation) by presenting the author and the responsible party for each data item.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data item shown by Clinical Decision Support, when a clinician views it, then its authorship is displayed.
Given the same data item, when a clinician views it, then the party responsible for it is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The details of function IN.1.8 are not in the requirement.

requirement_text: The system shall support real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring/control, and PLD/FPGA personality updates over the network.
user_story: As a radio astronomy operator, I want correlator operations to run in real time and hardware to be monitored, controlled and updated remotely over the network, so that I can run the instrument without being on site.
technical_task: Offer network access for real-time correlator operations, monitoring and control of hardware, and PLD/FPGA personality updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given a network connection, when the operator starts a correlator operation, then it runs in real time.
Given a network connection, when the operator sends a PLD/FPGA personality update, then the update is applied to the hardware.
rationale: Role assumed: radio astronomy operator. The latency of "real time" is not given.

requirement_text: Only adjusters can request recycled parts audit reports. No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.
requirement_text_raw: Only adjusters can request recycled parts audit reports. No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.'
user_story: As an insurance manager, I want recycled parts audit reports available only to adjusters, so that other staff cannot see them.
technical_task: Limit the request of recycled parts audit reports to users holding the adjuster role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the adjuster role, when the user asks for a recycled parts audit report, then the report is provided.
Given a user without the adjuster role, when the user asks for a recycled parts audit report, then the request is denied.

requirement_text: Click 'Add' to schedule an office visit.
user_story: As a receptionist, I want an Add button that starts scheduling an office visit, so that I can book a patient in.
technical_task: Place an 'Add' button on the screen that opens the scheduling of an office visit.
acceptance_criteria: Given the screen with the 'Add' button, when the user clicks it, then the office visit scheduling starts.
Given the scheduling has started, when the user completes it, then an office visit is scheduled.

requirement_text: On cards that are aware of logical channels, the MANAGE CHANNEL commands are only processed by the OPEN and are not dispatched to an Application.
user_story: As a card developer, I want MANAGE CHANNEL commands handled by the OPEN itself on cards that use logical channels, so that applications never see them.
technical_task: On logical channel capable cards, let the OPEN process MANAGE CHANNEL commands itself and keep them away from any Application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a card that supports logical channels, when a MANAGE CHANNEL command arrives, then the OPEN processes it.
Given a MANAGE CHANNEL command, when it has been processed, then it was not dispatched to an Application.

requirement_text: System shall restrict users from viewing other users' details to ensure privacy and security.
user_story: As a user, I want other users to be unable to open my personal details, so that my privacy is kept.
technical_task: Deny a user access to the detail pages of other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user viewing their own details, when the page is opened, then the details are shown.
Given a user trying to open another user's details, when the page is requested, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Exceptions for administrators are not mentioned.

requirement_text: Sensitive data will be encrypted before being sent over insecure connections like the internet.
user_story: As a customer, I want sensitive data encrypted before it travels over open networks such as the internet, so that nobody can read it on the way.
technical_task: Apply encryption to sensitive data before transmitting it on insecure connections.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data to be sent over the internet, when it is transmitted, then it is encrypted first.
Given an insecure connection, when sensitive data is sent through it, then only the encrypted form is transmitted.

requirement_text: Enter the appropriate information and click 'Save Form' to return to the Encounter summary page.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to fill in the form and click Save Form, so that I am returned to the Encounter summary page.
technical_task: Accept the form entries and, on 'Save Form', store them and show the Encounter summary page.
acceptance_criteria: Given the form with appropriate information entered, when the user clicks 'Save Form', then the information is saved.
Given the information has been saved, when the click is processed, then the Encounter summary page is displayed.

requirement_text: After the journey, users shall receive a feedback form to provide feedback based on their journey experience.
user_story: As a traveller, I want a feedback form once my journey ends, so that I can tell the operator how it went.
technical_task: Present a feedback form to the user at the end of a journey asking about the journey experience.
acceptance_criteria: Given a journey has ended, when the user returns to the app, then a feedback form is offered.
Given the feedback form, when the user submits it, then the feedback on the journey is stored.

requirement_text: Record disclosures made for treatment payment and health care operations.
requirement_text_raw: Record disclosures made for treatment  payment  and health care operations.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want disclosures for treatment, payment and health care operations recorded, so that I can account for them.
technical_task: Keep a log entry for each disclosure made for treatment, payment or health care operations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a disclosure for treatment, when it is made, then it is recorded.
Given a disclosure for payment or health care operations, when it is made, then it is recorded.

requirement_text: The iTrust user (admin) has been authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC3).
rationale: The sentence describes a state that already holds and gives no behaviour to implement.
clarification_questions: Is this a precondition of a use case or a requirement on the system?
What must the iTrust Medical Records system do once the admin is authenticated?

requirement_text: Please refer the `` Diagnostic Specification Central Display Telematic5 '' [DSPC-4585] for details.
rationale: Only a pointer to another document, with no content of its own.
clarification_questions: Which CAN failures and which display behaviour does the referenced specification cover?
Should the content of the reference be copied into this requirement?

requirement_text: For further details see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Wireless Subsystem" .
requirement_text_raw: For further details see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Wireless Subsystem" [RD3651].
rationale: A bare reference to a system specification, with no requirement stated.
clarification_questions: What detail about the wireless subsystem is expected from the cited system specification?
Which parts of that document are binding for this requirement?

requirement_text: Each syndrome shall represent an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
requirement_text_raw: Each syndrome shall (3.2.2.6.4) represent an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want each syndrome to flag that its error happened at some point between two packet deliveries, so that I can narrow down when the error occurred.
technical_task: Set a syndrome so that it marks an occurrence of the indicated error within the interval from the previous packet delivery to the current one.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs after the previous packet delivery and before the current one, when the syndrome is read, then it flags the error.
Given no error occurs in that interval, when the syndrome is read, then it does not flag the error.

requirement_text: Store contact details of a received SMS or e-mail to the address book application.
requirement_text_raw: 3. Store contact details of a received SMS or e-mail to the address book application.
user_story: As a phone user, I want a received SMS or e-mail sender saved as a contact, so that I can reach them later.
technical_task: Offer an action that saves the sender details of an incoming SMS or e-mail into the address book application.
acceptance_criteria: Given an incoming SMS, when the user saves the sender, then a contact is created in the address book application.
Given an incoming e-mail, when the user saves the sender, then a contact is created in the address book application.

requirement_text: All three edge points shall be equal to the reference point if the extension of the object is smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction.
user_story: As a perception engineer, I want a very small object described by three coinciding edge points, so that its outline is not more detailed than the accuracy allows.
technical_task: Collapse the three edge points onto the reference point for objects smaller than the required x- and y-accuracy.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction, when its outline is built, then the three edge points coincide with the reference point.
Given an object at least as large as the required accuracy, when its outline is built, then the edge points are not collapsed.
rationale: Role assumed: perception engineer. The required accuracy value is not given.
